Description: Interview, saved accepted answers, and a U.S. federal tax year 2026 estimate. Use synthetic data only. This prototype does not file a return.

StringResources.BAD_DEBT_RECOVERED_ABOVE_ADVANCED: Bad debt: the amount recovered or reimbursed cannot be more than the amount you advanced, paid or deposited.

StringResources.ESTATE_AMT_ACTIVITY_RECONCILE: Reconcile each activity's AMT difference with the allocated box 12 adjustments.
StringResources.ESTATE_AMT_LINE_INVALID: Match depreciation to Form 6251 line 2l or pre-1987 line 3, and depletion to line 2d. Amortization needs its actual activity or source worksheet.
StringResources.ESTATE_AMT_RECONCILE: Reconcile signed box 12 A with B, C, D and the statement's other components.
StringResources.ESTATE_AMT_TREATMENT_NEEDED: Identify the treatment of this fiduciary AMT statement amount.
StringResources.ESTATE_BOX6_RECONCILE: The business activities must total printed box 6.
StringResources.ESTATE_BOX7_RECONCILE: The real-estate rental activities must total printed box 7.
StringResources.ESTATE_BOX8_RECONCILE: The other rental activities must total printed box 8.
StringResources.ESTATE_CREDIT_AMOUNT_INVALID: Review the Form 1041 credit statement amounts.
StringResources.ESTATE_CREDIT_CODE_TWICE: Enter each Form 1041 credit code once, or once for each Form 3800 line the fiduciary's statement names.
StringResources.ESTATE_CREDIT_LINE_INVALID: Choose a Form 3800 line this credit code can report: line 1c or 4i for code I, line 1f or 4e for code J.
StringResources.ESTATE_EIN_INVALID: Enter the estate or trust EIN from item A as nine digits without punctuation.
StringResources.ESTATE_FINAL_CHARACTER_INVALID: Reconcile final-year deduction and capital-loss character with the fiduciary statement.
StringResources.ESTATE_FOREIGN_ALLOCATION_INVALID: Review the fiduciary allocation's country, withholding class and exact source amounts; qualified dividends must be included in ordinary dividends.
StringResources.ESTATE_FOREIGN_AMOUNT_INVALID: Review the fiduciary's foreign-tax statement amount.
StringResources.ESTATE_FOREIGN_INCOME_TOTAL_INVALID: Foreign interest, ordinary dividends or qualified dividends exceed their corresponding regular or AMT K-1 amount.
StringResources.ESTATE_FOREIGN_PARENT_INVALID: This foreign allocation needs one unambiguous accepted estate or trust K-1 identity.
StringResources.ESTATE_FOREIGN_TAX_TOTAL_INVALID: The foreign-tax allocations must total this K-1's box 14 code B exactly.
StringResources.ESTATE_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT_INVALID: Reconcile ordinary and preferential investment income in the fiduciary's statement.
StringResources.ESTATE_MINIMUM_TAX_EXCLUSION_INVALID: Enter the signed box 12 code J amount from the fiduciary statement within the supported amount range.
StringResources.ESTATE_MORTGAGE_LINK_INVALID: Select this final deduction's saved first-lender loan on Home mortgage interest. Unlink the K-1 before deleting or replacing that loan.
StringResources.ESTATE_MORTGAGE_LINK_TWICE: The same saved loan cannot represent two separate fiduciary final-year interest deductions. Keep one actual source claim.
StringResources.ESTATE_NOL_PERIOD_INVALID: Check actual fiduciary dates and the accounting convention. For inherited losses, also check the original loss year, consecutive taxable periods, termination date and remaining carry period.
StringResources.ESTATE_PARTICIPATION_NEEDED: Complete your participation records for this fiduciary activity.
StringResources.ESTATE_QBI_ALLOCATION_RECONCILE: QBI activity allocations must identify each linked activity once and reconcile to the fiduciary statement without repeating qualified losses.
StringResources.ESTATE_QBI_AMOUNT_INVALID: Check the fiduciary QBI amounts and retained loss records.
StringResources.ESTATE_QBI_APPORTIONMENT_NEEDED: Apportion this beneficiary QBI statement among its linked activities, with each activity's prior-loss history.
StringResources.ESTATE_QBI_HISTORY_RECONCILE: The supplied QBI passive-loss worksheet must reconcile to this activity's prior regular passive loss. Keep missing history empty; do not enter a different balance.
StringResources.ESTATE_QBI_SOURCE_TWICE: Enter each fiduciary QBI statement only once.
StringResources.ESTATE_SELECTED_ACTIVITY_TWICE: Select each fiduciary activity only once.
StringResources.ESTATE_SOURCE_PERIOD_INVALID: Check the current entity's actual dates and accounting election for this beneficiary's 2026 return. A normal December-reference 52/53-week year may end in early January 2027. A shortened elected year with a different reference year needs separate source-year verification.
StringResources.ESTATE_SUCCESSOR_NEEDED: Establish whether you succeed to the terminated entity before claiming its final-year deductions.
StringResources.ESTIMATE_LATER_ITEMS: {0,plural,one {# more item in later sections} other {# more items in later sections}}
StringResources.ESTIMATE_METHOD_AND_LIMITATIONS: 2026 federal estimate using the September 2026 draft Tax Table for applicable taxable amounts below $100,000 and the tax computation worksheet for applicable amounts of $100,000 or more. Draft EIC, special worksheets, penalties, interest, offsets, forms and e-filing remain subject to final instructions. Synthetic data only.
StringResources.ESTIMATE_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE: No estimate: this return is outside what the App calculates. The item below says why.
StringResources.ESTIMATE_UNAVAILABLE: Estimate so far: not available yet
StringResources.ESTIMATE_ZERO_BALANCE: No federal refund or balance due
StringResources.EXCHANGE_ENTER_THE_RENTAL_DATE: Enter the 2026 or 2027 date the new property was first available to rent.
StringResources.EXCHANGE_IDENTIFIED_AFTER_RECEIVED: The identification date can't be after the date you received the new property.
StringResources.EXCHANGE_LAND_ABOVE_VALUE: The land part can't be more than the value of the property you received.
StringResources.EXCHANGE_LAND_VALUE_ABOVE_TOTAL: The land part of this rental's value can't be more than everything you received for it.
StringResources.EXCHANGE_REASON_FOREIGN: U.S. and foreign real property are not like kind
StringResources.EXCHANGE_REASON_IDENTIFIED_LATE: the new property was identified more than 45 days after the transfer
StringResources.EXCHANGE_REASON_PERSONAL: you use the new property as a home
StringResources.EXCHANGE_REASON_RECEIVED_LATE: the new property was received more than 180 days after the transfer or after your return's due date
StringResources.EXCHANGE_REASON_RELATED: a related person sold you the new property, or disposed of the property you gave them, within two years
StringResources.EXCHANGE_RENTAL_WITHOUT_BUILDING: A property you rent out needs a building: its land part must be less than its value.
StringResources.EXCHANGE_RENTED_BEFORE_RECEIVED: The new property can't be available to rent before you received it.
StringResources.EXCHANGE_SAY_WHETHER_YOU_EXTEND: You received the new property after April 15, 2027: say whether you extend your 2026 return.
StringResources.EXEMPT_REDUCTION_ABOVE_AMOUNT: Exempt premium must belong to and not exceed its matching exempt OID.
StringResources.EXPENSE_PERSON_OWNER_REQUIRED: Supply the actual taxpayer, spouse or both ownership for this expense or retained carryover. An originating entity does not identify the individual owner.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0ESTATE_TRUST_N_PASSIVE_ACTIVITY: Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) boxes 6–8 passive income after box 9 deductions: Schedule E line 33 column (d), available on Form 8582 to absorb other passive losses, and net investment income. Not additional income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0FARM_RENTAL_N_SUSPENDED_LOSS: Alternative minimum tax passive loss of this farm rental that Form 8582 does not allow in 2026; it carries to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0PARTNERSHIP_N_ACTIVITY_NET: Ordinary partnership result after basis, at-risk and passive limits, plus nonpassive guaranteed payments and any separately entered prior Form 4136 credit recognized on Schedule E. Return-level limits and tax classifications remain separate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0PARTNERSHIP_N_PASSIVE_SUSPENDED: Ordinary partnership loss remaining after the shared passive limit; distinct from basis and at-risk carries. No rental special allowance applies to this business activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0PERSONAL_RENTAL_N_N_ALLOWED_EXP: Current paid expenses and depreciation plus released prior deductions allowed on Schedule 1 line 24b. Do not deduct the opening balance again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0PERSONAL_RENTAL_N_N_PRIOR_SUSPE: Opening suspended operating expenses and depreciation from this activity's retained tax worksheets; not an additional payment or a second reduction of asset basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0PERSONAL_RENTAL_N_N_SUSPENDED_L: Closing suspended operating expenses and depreciation for this activity. Zero means the entire available expense balance was allowed. Retain the separate regular-tax and AMT records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0PERSONAL_RENTAL_PASSIVE_INCOME: Personal-property rental profit available to offset passive losses, already reported on Schedule 1. Recharacterized nonpassive rent is excluded. This is not additional taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_INCOME: Rental profit less currently allowed losses, including the phased-out active-participation allowance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_MAGI: Rental-loss MAGI excludes passive income/losses, taxable Social Security, IRA/student-loan deductions and the half-SE-tax deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_N_DEPRECIATION: AMT residential or nonresidential depreciation: 40-year ADS for pre-1999 buildings; otherwise 27.5 years for residential or 39 years for nonresidential real property. Mid-month convention; land excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_N_N_HOME_DEPRECIATION_CA: Worksheet 5-1 line 7b: combined casualty and depreciation above the rent left after operating expenses. Retain its separate regular-tax and AMT amounts and its actual casualty character for the next worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_N_N_HOME_OPERATING_CARRY: Worksheet 5-1 line 7a: rental share of operating expenses above the rent left after interest, taxes and rental-only expenses. Enter it next year as this property's operating carryover.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_N_SALE_RELEASED_LOSS: The part of the rental's overall loss (this year's loss and the unallowed balance) that is allowed this year because the installment sale of the whole property recognizes this share of its gain (section 469(g)(3), Form 8582 instructions, Disposition of an Entire Interest). The rest stays unallowed until later payments recognize more gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_N_SUSPENDED_LOSS: No passive loss remains for a property sold in full.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_N_SUSPENDED_LOSS_2: Current and prior loss remaining after passive-activity limits; retain this property balance for a later return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_0RENTAL_SUSPENDED_LOSS: Total current and prior passive loss remaining for a later year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_12F: Eligible cash contributions when using the standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_13A: Supported Schedule 1-A senior, tips, overtime and vehicle-interest deductions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_15: Adjusted gross income less deductions, floored at zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_16: 2026 tax on current income plus any positive Form 8978 line 14, any Form 4972 tax and any recapture of an education credit under the 2025 Form 1040 line 16 instructions. Check line 16 box 2 for Form 4972 and box 3 for Form 8978 (identify it) or for the education credit recapture (enter ECR). Current-year ordinary-tax lookups below $100,000 use the September 2026 draft Tax Table; Schedule J and Form 8615 retain their own calculations.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_17: Schedule 2 Part I: Form 6251 AMT, excess advance premium credit and transferred clean-vehicle credit repayments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_18: Regular income tax including positive Form 8978 adjustments, AMT, advance premium credit repayment and transferred clean-vehicle credit repayment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_19: Nonrefundable portion after eligibility, phaseouts and credit ordering.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1A: W-2 box 1 wages after any supported Form 8958 community allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1B: Household employee pay without a W-2 is Form 1040 line 1b, with no self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1C: Additional cash and noncash tip income; allocated estimates are replaced by adequate actual records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1D: Medicaid waiver payments outside W-2 box 1 are Form 1040 line 1d; excluded payments also subtract on Schedule 1 line 8s.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1E: Employee benefits not excluded and not already included in W-2 box 1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1F: Net Form 8839 employer-benefit wage adjustment, including a prior-year foreign-benefit or qualified special-needs exclusion; W-2 box 1 remains unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1G: Employee compensation omitted from W-2; actual payroll coverage determines its employee payroll tax. Not Schedule C receipts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1H: Foreign employee pay, taxable employer disability pensions before minimum retirement age, military moving reimbursements above the move's cost, and elective deferrals above the annual limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1I: The App compares each person’s combat-pay and Medicaid earned-income choices and keeps the largest earned income credit plus additional child tax credit. This election does not add taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_1Z: W-2 wages, additional employee tips and Form 8919 wages, taxable disability pensions, dependent-care/adoption benefits and foreign employee pay before exclusions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_20: Supported foreign tax, education, care, elderly, adoption, minimum-tax, mortgage-interest, DC homebuyer, residential-energy, employer tip FICA carryforward, personal refueling and Form 8978 credits, and Saver's Credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_21: Child credit plus supported Schedule 3 credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_22: Income tax remaining after nonrefundable credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_23: Self-employment, Additional Medicare, net investment income, retirement and HSA/MSA withdrawal taxes, Trump-account excess and returned-income taxes, plus Form 8828 mortgage-subsidy and prior education-credit recapture, after any allowed negative Form 8978 Schedule 2 line 13z adjustment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_24A: Income tax after credits plus supported additional taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_24B: Form 1062 line 15; first installment due at the unextended deadline.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_24C: Line 24a plus 24b; the full elected liability is separately offset through Schedule 3, not treated as an actual payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_25A: Form W-2 box 2 federal income tax withholding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_25B: Federal income tax withholding attributed to Form 1099 payer records; verify the source document for statements that do not identify a form.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_25C: Withholding on Forms W-2G and Schedule K-1, other non-1099 payer records, and Form 8959 Additional Medicare withholding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_25D: Sum of Form 1040 lines 25a through 25c after each source line is rounded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_26: Entered federal estimated payments plus a beneficiary's Form 1041 K-1 box 13 code A allocation from timely Form 1041-T.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_27A: Uses the draft 2026 IRS EIC Table and the earned-income/AGI worksheet sequence; final-table reconciliation remains required.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_2A: Tax-exempt interest documents; excluded from total income but used by applicable worksheets.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_30: Current-year refundable adoption credit; prior nonrefundable carries are excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_31: Extension payment, excess Social Security withholding, net premium tax credit, section 1341 repayment credit, Form 2439 and Form 4136 tax-paid credits, and the separate Form 1062 deferral offset.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_32C: Provisional line 32a amount: the draft Schedule 3-A reduction has not been applied; review the final rules before filing.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_33: Payments, refundable credits and any Form 1062 deferral offset. The offset is not cash paid. Proposed Schedule 3-A reduction is not applied; read Estimate notes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_34: Before the estimated tax penalty on line 38, offsets, interest or an election to apply the overpayment to next year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_34_2: Before penalties, offsets, interest or an election to apply the overpayment to next year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_35A: Available overpayment after line 38, less the reported line 36 applied credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_36: Planned applied credit, rounded once to whole dollars; the cash refund is the exact remainder. This draft is not a filed election or an actual payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_37_2: Balance due plus the line 38 penalty, less any overpayment the penalty absorbs; before interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_38: Form 2210 line 19 with the Schedule AI installments (box C), rounded to whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_38_2: Form 2210 line 19 by the regular method, rounded to whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_38_3: Form 2210-F line 16, rounded to whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_3A: Included in ordinary dividends; used for preferential tax rates.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_3B: Total ordinary dividends, including qualified dividends once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_5A: Pension-category 1099-R box 1 amounts; a lump sum taxed on Form 4972 adds nothing, or only its ordinary part with the 20% capital gain rate alone.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_5B: Pension-category payer amounts or calculated Simplified Method taxable benefits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_6A: Combined SSA-1099 and equivalent RRB-1099 box 5 net benefits, floored at zero after combining the return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_6B: Calculated using the Social Security worksheet and other return income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_7A: Net investment sales and capital-gain distributions after the supported annual loss limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_1040_8: Schedule 1 ordinary section 1231 income/loss, ISO compensation not in W-2 wages, prior NOL deduction, state income tax refund, ordinary shareholder-loan repayment gain, section 1244 ordinary stock loss, business income/loss, unemployment, gambling, jury pay, scholarships, prizes, taxable temporary-living-expense insurance, personal debt cancellation, taxable LTC benefits, hobby sales, alimony, HSA/MSA withdrawals and inherited values, rental and royalty income, foreign exclusion and excess-business-loss adjustment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_4A: Schedule 1 lines 3, 5 and 6: business, rental, royalty, partnership, S corporation and farm income or loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_4B: Removes the income or loss of nonpassive trades or businesses, including a real estate professional's rentals under the 500-hour safe harbor; financial trading and passive activities stay in.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_5A: Form 1040 line 7 capital gain or loss plus Schedule 1 line 4 other gains or losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_5B: Gains and losses of nonpassive business property, deferred employer-stock appreciation and the excluded-loss carryforward difference.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8812_COMBAT_PAY: Schedule 8812 always counts all nontaxable combat pay, independently of the earned income credit election.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_AGE_SPOUSE: Your spouse’s age at the end of 2026 (at least 25 but under 65 for one filer to claim the credit).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_AGE_TAXPAYER: Your age at the end of 2026 (at least 25 but under 65 for one filer to claim the credit).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_ANOTHER_QUALIFYING_CHILD_NO: No: whether a filer could be another taxpayer's qualifying child for 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_ANOTHER_QUALIFYING_CHILD_YE: Yes: whether a filer could be another taxpayer's qualifying child for 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CHECKED_AOTC: The American Opportunity Tax Credit box is checked.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CHECKED_CHILD_CREDITS: The Child Tax Credit/Additional Child Tax Credit/Credit for Other Dependents box is checked.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CHECKED_EIC: The Earned Income Credit box is checked.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CHILD_HOME_DAYS: Days {0} lived with you in the United States during 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CHILD_HOME_DAYS_EXCEPTION: Days {0} lived with you in the United States during 2026 (365 under the newborn, death or temporary-absence rule).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CLAIMABLE_SPOUSE_NO: No: whether your spouse can be claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CLAIMABLE_SPOUSE_YES: Yes: whether your spouse can be claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CLAIMABLE_TAXPAYER_NO: No: whether you can be claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_CLAIMABLE_TAXPAYER_YES: Yes: whether you can be claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_FINDING_NOT_ONLY_INCOME: No: the earlier finding was not only misreported earned or investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_FOUR_PRIOR_YEARS_NO: No: whether the Hope or American opportunity credit was claimed for {0} in any 4 earlier tax years (part of the Form 8863 line 23 confirmation).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_FOUR_PRIOR_YEARS_YES: Yes: whether the Hope or American opportunity credit was claimed for {0} in any 4 earlier tax years (part of the Form 8863 line 23 confirmation).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_INCOME_REPORTING_ONLY: Yes: the only reason was incorrectly reported earned or investment income; the rest of Part II is skipped.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_STUDENT_ELIGIBLE_NO: No: {0} meets the eligible-student requirements for the American opportunity credit in 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_STUDENT_ELIGIBLE_YES: Yes: {0} meets the eligible-student requirements for the American opportunity credit in 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_US_HOME_DAYS_SPOUSE: Days during 2026 that your spouse’s main home was in the United States (at least 183 to claim the credit).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8862_US_HOME_DAYS_TAXPAYER: Days during 2026 that your main home was in the United States (at least 183 to claim the credit).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8959_WAGES_AND_RRTA: Form 8959 applies a separate full filing-status threshold to Medicare wages and RRTA compensation. Line 19 includes ordinary W-2 box 12 codes B/N with box 6, but excludes RRTA B/N. Ordinary Medicare and RRTA compensation have separate full thresholds; only the reconciled Additional Medicare withholding is a payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_8Z: Other income: taxable grants, paid family leave, temporary living-expense insurance above the increase, disaster or wildfire relief not confirmed as excluded, a prior-year mortgage interest refund, and the taxable value of a Trump account at death.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_9A: Schedule A line 9 investment interest, after the aggregate itemized-deduction cap.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_9B: State and local income tax allocated to investment income and real property tax on investment property, after the SALT and aggregate caps.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_9C: Miscellaneous investment expenses are not deductible.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ABLE_N_ANNUAL_TAXABLE: This ABLE account's taxable annual earnings after its own Form 1099-QA earnings ratio, rollover treatment and nonduplicated qualified-expense allocation. Other accounts are calculated separately before Form 1040 and Form 5329 totals are added.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ABLE_N_FOLLOWING_EXPENSES: Qualified disability expenses paid in the first 60 days of 2027 elected for 2026 under section 1.529A-3(a)(2); exclude these expenses from the 2027 calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ABLE_N_N: 2026 ABLE base limit is $20,000. Only qualifying beneficiary-funded cash can use the additional compensation/prior-year poverty allowance. Form 5329 Part VIII taxes current excess at 6%, capped by year-end value; no prior-excess carry-in or income deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ABLE_N_N_2: Qualified rollover amount and its source-payment earnings are removed before the annual disability-expense ratio. The rollover is not a disability expense and is not entered twice.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ACCOUNT_ADDITIONAL_TAX: Form 5329 Part II line 8 of each filer added: 10% of the ABLE and education account distributions subject to the additional tax, Schedule 2 line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ACCOUNT_EXCEPTIONS: Form 5329 Part II line 6: the distributions on line 5 that are not subject to the additional tax (death, disability, a timely returned Coverdell excess, expenses used only for an education credit, tax-free scholarships and military academy costs, and ABLE distributions not penalized).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT: Form 5329 Part II line 7: line 5 less line 6.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ACCOUNT_TAX: Form 5329 Part II line 8: 10% of line 7, carried to Schedule 2 line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ACCOUNT_TAXABLE: Form 5329 Part II line 5: the ABLE and education account distributions included in income, with source amounts added before rounding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ACQUISITION_N_GAIN: Form 8949 sale of property a lender acquired, at its amount realized. A personal-use loss is disallowed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT: Unused credit subject to child count, earned-income and three-child payroll alternative limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_CHILDREN: $1,700 for each qualifying child counted on line 4.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_EARNED_I: Your earned income, from the Earned Income Worksheet (wages, tips, net self-employment earnings, and the other items the schedule lists).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_EARNED_O: Earned income above $2,500; blank when it is $2,500 or less.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_EIC_OFFS: Form 1040 line 27a plus Schedule 3 line 11, which reduce the payroll-tax alternative.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_LARGER: The credit is the smaller of line 17 and this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_OTHER_PA: Schedule 1 line 15 (half of self-employment tax) plus Schedule 2 lines 16c and 17c.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_PAYROLL_: Line 23 less line 24, not below zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_SMALLER: The most the additional child tax credit can be before the earned-income test.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_UNUSED: Line 12 less line 14: the part that did not reduce your tax and can become the additional child tax credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_WITHHELD: Part II-B, three or more children: Social Security and Medicare tax withheld (W-2 boxes 4 and 6), adjusted for the Additional Medicare Tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_MEDICARE_SELF_EMPLOYM: Schedule 2 line 11: Additional Medicare tax on self-employment earnings, Form 8959 Part IV line 18, after the wage threshold is used first.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_MEDICARE_TAX: Additional Medicare tax across wages and self-employment earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADDITIONAL_MEDICARE_WAGES: Schedule 2 line 17b: Additional Medicare tax on wages and RRTA compensation, Form 8959 Part III line 12 (Part I line 7 for Medicare wages).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADJUSTMENTS: Half of self-employment tax, eligible owner SEP and business health insurance, educator/HSA/MSA/IRA amounts, phased student-loan interest, savings-withdrawal penalties, qualifying alimony paid, jury pay surrendered for continued salary and terminating-estate or trust section 67(e) deductions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION: {0}: this employee's W-2 code T benefit for the child. The shared Form 8839 exclusion uses it once; a partly available exclusion is attributed by employee. Box 1 omits it, boxes 3 and 5 already include it, and any box 2 withholding is counted only from the W-2.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_2: Actual code T excluded or taxable for this employee without changing the W-2. A special-needs deemed exclusion beyond actual code T is a separate joint Form 8839 line 31 adjustment, not employee earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_BENEFITS_EXCLUDED: Current exclusion, including eligible benefits taxed before a foreign adoption became final.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_CARRYFORWARD: Unexpired nonrefundable balances after using the oldest credit first.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_CHILD_N_BENEFITS_N_EXCL: This child's own Form 8839 line 29 exclusion, before adding the other child's exclusion on line 30.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_CHILD_N_BENEFITS_N_TAXA: This child's contribution to joint Form 8839 line 31. It is negative when a special-needs deemed exclusion exceeds actual code T.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_CHILD_N_SPECIAL_NEEDS_D: This child's Form 8839 line 29 exclusion beyond actual W-2 code T; it reduces joint line 1f without reducing either employee's earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_EXCLUSION_MAGI: Form 8839 employer-benefit exclusion modified income before its own phaseout.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_JOINT_SPECIAL_NEEDS_DEE: Finalized special-needs Form 8839 line 29 exclusions above actual W-2 code T. These reduce joint Form 1040 line 1f without reducing either spouse's earned income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_NONREFUNDABLE_CREDIT: Nonrefundable adoption credit after coordination with the child credit; oldest carryover is used first.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_N_N_2: Unused nonrefundable credit retains its original five-year carryforward period; it cannot become refundable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_N_N_LIMIT: Per-child limit assigned to this return for {0} before prior claims and income phaseout. Credit and employer-benefit limits are independent.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_PRIOR_TAXED_BENEFITS: Foreign-adoption benefits received and taxed before 2026 finalization, used once in the exclusion worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_REFUNDABLE_CREDIT: 2026 refundable portion, up to $5,120 per child after income phaseout; prior credit carries are never refundable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_W2_N_CODE_T_TAXABLE: The box 12 code T adoption benefits on {0} that no adoption on More credits accounts for. They are taxable wages on Form 1040 line 1f (Form 8839 Part III).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ADOPTION_WAGE_ADJUSTMENT: Net Form 1040 line 1f wage adjustment after current benefits and the exclusion; prior-year foreign benefits or a qualified special-needs plan can make it negative. W-2 box 1 stays unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ALASKA_DIVIDENDS: Alaska Permanent Fund dividends, Schedule 1 line 8g: the whole dividend, including any energy relief part. Unearned income for the child tax rules; not net investment income, earned income or self-employment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ALIMONY_PAID_DEDUCTION: Qualifying pre-2019 alimony paid plus recipient recapture deduction. Current payments follow child-support priority; post-2018 instruments and express new-law modifications produce no current-payment deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ALIMONY_RECAPTURE_DEDUCTION: Recipient's third-year deduction for previously taxed alimony. Included in adjustments separately from current payments received.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ALIMONY_RECAPTURE_INCOME: Payer's third-year recapture of previously deducted alimony. Included in Schedule 1 income and, for decree-related instruments, payer IRA compensation. Not EIC earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ALTERNATIVE_MINIMUM_TAX: 2026 exemption, 50% phaseout, 26%/28% rates, capital-gain bands and foreign-exclusion stacking, less regular tax after the foreign credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ALTERNATIVE_MINIMUM_TAXABLE_INCO: Form 6251 line 4: regular deductions adjusted for standard deduction or SALT, senior deduction, private-activity interest, ISO exercise spread and the applicable married-separate income addition.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_BUSINESS_DEPRECIATION_ADJUST: AMT business income minus regular income from separate depreciation, before the independently recalculated excess-business-loss limit. Regular QBI and self-employment tax are unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_CAPITAL_COMPUTATION: The AMT worksheet uses its own gain amounts and the regular-tax capital-gain band occupancy. Rate components keep their cents and the final comparison rounds once. Foreign excluded income is subtracted afterward in its separate worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_COMPARISON: The exemption uses the current filing status and AMT income. The AMT tax after its foreign tax credit is compared with regular tax, before Schedule J averaging and after the applicable credits and repayment taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_CURRENT_NET_OPERATING_LOSS: Current alternative-tax NOL with section 172(d) capital-loss and nonbusiness-deduction limits recomputed from AMT amounts. The standard deduction and QBI do not create an ATNOL.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_DISPOSITION_ADJUSTMENT: Form 6251 line 2k combines the difference between AMT and regular taxable disposition amounts after activity limits and capital netting. Those amounts already enter the AMT calculation; this row does not add them again. The QBI deduction remains the regular-tax deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_EXCESS_BUSINESS_LOSS_CARRYFO: Separately calculated AMT Form 461 disallowed loss, carried to the next year in addition to the current ATNOL.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_FARM_CONSERVATION_ADJUSTMENT: Regular section 175 allowance minus the separately computed AMT allowance adjusts AMT business income once. Each uses its own retained carry; regular QBI and self-employment tax remain unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_FARM_PRODUCTION_ADJUSTMENT: Regular production deductions less the separate AMT current and released cost, from the same source cohorts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_FARM_SUPPLIES_ADJUSTMENT: Regular supply deductions less the separate AMT allowance, from the same retained supply and farming-expense records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_FOREIGN_COMPUTATION: AMT is figured on taxable income plus the net foreign exclusion, then reduced by the tax on that exclusion. The existing exclusion calculation already removes related deductions and floors the net exclusion at zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_ISO_COMPENSATION_ADJUSTMENT: Form 6251 line 2k ordinary-income adjustment for sales of stock exercised in earlier years. The separate AMT capital adjustment applies its own gain/loss limits. Same-year exercise and sale has no ISO AMT adjustment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_ITEMIZED_TAXES: State and local taxes, investment property taxes and foreign income taxes deducted on Schedule A, or the standard deduction, are added back for alternative minimum tax. Generation-skipping transfer tax on income distributions is excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_K1_OTHER_RENTAL_NET: Alternative minimum tax: this K-1's box 3 other rental income or loss after that system's basis, at-risk and Form 8582 limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_K1_OTHER_RENTAL_SUSPENDED: Alternative minimum tax box 3 other rental loss that Form 8582 does not allow in 2026; it carries to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_K1_RENTAL_REAL_ESTATE_NET: Alternative minimum tax: this K-1's box 2 rental real estate income or loss after that system's basis, at-risk and Form 8582 limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_K1_RENTAL_REAL_ESTATE_SUSPEN: Alternative minimum tax box 2 rental real estate loss that Form 8582 does not allow in 2026; it carries to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_MORTGAGE_DWELLING_INTEREST: Deducted interest, points and premiums on a second home that is a boat or recreational vehicle are added back for alternative minimum tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_RELATED_ADJUSTMENTS: Form 6251 line 3 combines mortgage adjustments and the regular-minus-AMT differences in income-limited deductions; each adjustment enters AMTI once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_RELATED_DEDUCTIONS: The existing deduction worksheet uses actual AMT business income, unchanged actual half-SE tax and unchanged regular phaseout MAGI. This is an AMT deduction, not another payment or contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_RENTAL_ADJUSTMENT: AMT passive activity income minus regular income, after separate depreciation and loss allocation; do not add depreciation twice.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_AMT_TOTAL_NOL_CARRYFORWARD: Current and unexpired historical AMT NOL after current-year use and debt reduction. Retain original loss years and exception classifications separately from regular losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_LOSS_N: Original investment less prior recovery, calculated current-year recovery and other tax-free payouts. Available only on the final annuitant's itemized final return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_BASIS_INCREASE: Taxable nonqualified-annuity loan or pledge increases investment under section 72(e)(4)(A). Its untaxed portion does not reduce investment, and repayment does not increase it again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_BASIS_RECOVERY: Final contract payment recovers remaining investment first; only cash above that investment is taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_BASIS_RECOVERY_2: The portion of this withdrawal exceeding available combined contract earnings is tax-free recovery of investment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_BASIS_RECOVERY_3: General Rule ratio after any refund-feature adjustment, rounded to three decimal places and applied to full and partial payments. Starts after 1986 are capped by remaining net cost before that adjustment; earlier starts continue the exclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_EARLIER_RECOVERY: First annuitant's earlier 2026 tax-free recovery reduces common remaining investment; it is not income or an exclusion of the survivor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_EXPECTED_RETURN: Original installment amount times the fixed installment count, or annual payments weighted by IRS Table V, VI or VIII factors. Lifetime factors include the applicable original timing adjustment; temporary-life factors do not.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_REFUND_ADJUSTMENT: Single-life Table VII percentage times the lesser of original net cost or guaranteed return, rounded to whole dollars. This reduces investment for the exclusion ratio, not the net-cost recovery cap or final death deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_REMAINING_BASIS: Combined investment after this event; taxable loans/pledges increase it and repayments do not change it, before subsequent contributions or other basis adjustments. If related contracts are present this is a group total, not the paying contract's separate basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_REMAINING_BASIS_2: Unrecovered contract cost after earlier first-annuitant recovery and this recipient's payments; retain the complete common record for next year's calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_ROLLED_BASIS: After-tax investment transferred to the receiving retirement account, if this is an eligible employer-plan rollover.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_SURRENDER_LOSS: Unrecovered cost on complete cash surrender is a nondeductible miscellaneous itemized loss in 2026, not a capital loss or future contract basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ANNUITY_N_N_TAXABLE_WITHDRAWAL: Actual or deemed distribution allocated first to earnings of the paying contract and required related contracts combined. Cash values ignore surrender charges.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_CONTRIBUTION_N_N: Form 8853 Part I: monthly 65% self-only or 75% family deductible limit, spouse allocation and linked compensation after applicable SE-tax deduction. Employer deposits are excluded, never deducted again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_CORRECTION_EARNINGS: Positive earnings returned with timely Archer MSA excess corrections enter other income in the distribution year. A loss reduces the cash returned but not the principal removed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_CORRECTION_EMPLOYER_PRINC: Timely returned employer excess principal deposited in 2026 enters 2026 other income when absent from W-2 wages; a 2027 deposit belongs to 2027 income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_MSA_ADDITIONAL_TAX: 20% of combined nonmedical withdrawals after the account holder age/disability exceptions. Eligible rollovers and inherited death-date values are excluded from this additional tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_MSA_DEDUCTION: Eligible personal Archer MSA contributions and retained prior excess using unused 2026 room reduce income; employer contributions do not create another deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_MSA_N_EXCESS_EARNINGS: Form 1099-SA box 2 earnings on a returned Archer MSA excess contribution. The returned contribution itself is not income; its earnings are Schedule 1 line 8z other income, with no additional tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_MSA_N_N: Form 8853 Part II: qualified medical spending and eligible indirect rollovers are excluded. Deemed distributions cannot be excluded for medical spending or rolled over. Terminated accounts use January 1 value and date; loan pledges use collateral value on the pledge date. Retained nonmedical amounts enter income; withdrawals after age 65 or disability onset escape the 20% additional tax. Combine spouses before applying the tax rate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_MSA_TAXABLE_DISTRIBUTIONS: Taxable ordinary Archer MSA withdrawals and inherited account values after applicable medical and rollover exclusions. Schedule 1 income; inherited death transfers do not incur the separate withdrawal penalty.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_CORRECTED_CONTRIBUTIONS: Timely returned 2026-designated principal is removed before Archer MSA contribution and HSA-limit calculations; attributable earnings and taxable employer principal follow their own income years.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_EXCESS_ACCOUNT_VALUE: Sum of the owners' account values used separately to cap each owner's Form 5329 tax; this sum is not a shared tax ceiling.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_EXCESS_CONTRIBUTION_TAX: This owner's Form 5329 Part VI line 41 tax, calculated separately from the spouse's excess and account value.
Form 5329 Part VI line 41: 6% of the smaller of remaining prior plus current uncorrected personal/employer Archer MSA excess or owner account value, included on Schedule 2 line 18.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_N_EXCESS_ACCOUNT_VALUE: All owner Archer MSA fair market values at December 31 plus later deposits designated for 2026 cap the 6% tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_N_UNCORRECTED_EMPLOYER_: Employer contributions above the smaller of the Form 8853 coverage or linked-compensation limits enter Form 5329 line 39.
Uncorrected excess from employer deposits actually made in 2026 enters Schedule 1 other income unless already included in 2026 W-2 wages. Excess from 2027 deposits belongs to 2027 income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_N_UNCORRECTED_PERSONAL_: Personal Archer MSA deposits not deductible under Form 8853 enter Form 5329 line 39, including deposits barred by employer contributions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_PRIOR_DESIGNATED_CORREC: Timely returned 2025-designated principal belongs on the corrected 2025 Form 8853, not in 2026 contribution or HSA-offset totals. Current-year earnings and employer-principal income use their actual dates.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_PRIOR_DESIGNATED_EMPLOY: Uncorrected employer excess deposited in 2026 but designated for 2025 belongs to retained Form 8853 contribution and Form 5329 excess worksheets, not 2026 contributions or HSA offsets.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_DEDUCTED: Remaining prior excess treated as a 2026 Archer MSA contribution and deducted on Form 8853 line 5 within unused contribution room.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_REMAININ: Prior excess remaining after taxable Archer MSA distributions and unused 2026 contribution room; combined with current excess for Form 5329 line 40.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_USED_BY_: Retained 2025 Form 5329 line 40 excess absorbed by taxable 2026 Archer MSA distributions on Form 8853 line 8.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_UNCORRECTED_EMPLOYER_EX: Sum of owner-specific employer Archer MSA excess on Form 5329 line 39.
Employer Archer MSA excess actually deposited in 2026 and omitted from W-2 wages enters 2026 other income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_N_UNCORRECTED_PERSONAL_EX: Sum of owner-specific personal Archer MSA excess on Form 5329 line 39.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_PRIOR_DESIGNATED_EMPLOYER: Uncorrected employer Archer MSA excess designated for 2025 but actually deposited in 2026 enters 2026 other income if omitted from W-2 wages; it is not a 2026 contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_DEDUCTED_N: Sum of owner-specific retained Archer excess deducted using each owner's unused 2026 contribution room.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_REMAINING_: Sum of owner-specific prior excess remaining for each owner's later Form 5329.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ARCHER_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_USED_BY_DI: Sum of owner-specific retained Archer excess absorbed by each owner's taxable 2026 Form 8853 line 8 distributions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_ADDITIONAL_DEPRECIATION: Form 4797 line 28a: the depreciation allowed, including the section 50(c) reduction of an investment credit, over straight line on the cost before that reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_DISPOSAL_POSTPONED: Gain from the condemnation that is not taxed this year because the cost of the replacement property is at least the amount received for it (section 1033); it lowers the replacement property's basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SALE_N: Building part of the sale price (the gross sales price).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SALE_N_2: Cost of the building and improvements, without the land, plus its share of selling expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SALE_N_3: Depreciation allowed or allowable through the month of sale, mid-month convention.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SALE_N_6: Business-use share of the sale price (the gross sales price).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SALE_N_7: Business-use share of the cost, plus its selling expenses. A clean-vehicle or other credit that lowered the basis is not subtracted here; it is part of line 24.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SALE_N_8: Depreciation, section 179, special allowances and the basis reduction of any credit (a clean-vehicle or investment credit), allowed or allowable, including 2026 by the convention for the year of disposition.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SECTION179_PRIOR: Form 4797 Part IV line 35(a): the section 179 deduction taken on property that is now used 50% or less for business or was kept for personal use.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SECTION179_RECAPTURE: Form 4797 Part IV line 37(a): the section 179 deduction above the depreciation that would have been allowable is other income of the business, and the property's basis rises by it (section 179(d)(10)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ASSET_SECTION179_RECOMPUTED: Form 4797 Part IV line 36(a): the depreciation that would have been allowable on the section 179 amount from the year the property was placed in service through this year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ATNOL_N_N_CARRYFORWARD: Unused ATNOL continuing into 2027 after debt reduction; keep its original loss year and statutory exception classification.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ATNOL_N_N_DEBT_REDUCTION: AMT Form 982 reduction after current tax, current-year loss first and then original-year order.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ATNOL_N_N_EXPIRED: Unused pre-2018 loss beyond its twenty-year carryforward period, including a 2006 balance expiring after 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ATNOL_N_N_OPENING: Retained ATNOL balance entering 2026, separate from regular NOL.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ATNOL_N_N_USED: Absorbed by modified 2026 AMTI, oldest loss year first subject to the ordinary 90% limit and documented exceptions. This can exceed the deduction claimed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BAD_DEBT_N_SHORT_TERM_LOSS: The unrecovered adjusted basis of a wholly worthless nonbusiness debt is a short-term capital loss regardless of holding period. A purchased debt uses its acquisition cost, not its face amount. An insolvent personal contractor's unreturned deposit or a former-home mortgage shortfall can also qualify. Capital netting and annual loss limits apply. Retain the debt and collection statement required with Form 8949.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BIRTH_ADOPTION_USED_N_N: Qualified birth/adoption amount used for this parent and child through 2026, including prior-year usage.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BOND_CREDIT_DEEMED_INTEREST: Current Form 1097-BTC box 1 credit is deemed taxable interest on its 2026 credit allowance or payment dates, including the part Form 8912 cannot use. Prior-year credit carry is excluded. The amount joins Form 1040 line 2b and applicable investment-income calculations once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BOND_PREMIUM_DEDUCTION: Eligible amortizable premium on taxable bonds entered from the bond records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_CARRY_NONPASSIVE: Form 3800 Part IV line {0} column (f): {1,number,0} {2} credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_CARRY_PASSIVE: Form 3800 Part IV line {0} column (d): {1,number,0} {2} credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_CURRENT_NONPASSI: Form 3800 Part III line {0} column (e): {1,number,0} {2} credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_CURRENT_PASSIVE: Form 3800 Part III line {0} column (d): {1,number,0} {2} credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_ALLOWED: Form 8582-CR line 37 share (Worksheet 9): the part of this passive credit allowed for 2026, which Form 3800 uses like a nonpassive credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_CARRYBACK_N: Unused 2026 credit applied on a carryback return (the year is in the row).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_EXPIRED: Unused credit at the end of its 20-year carryforward period; a qualified business credit becomes a section 196 deduction in 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_TO_N: Form 8582-CR: the part of this passive credit not allowed for 2026 (Worksheet 8); it carries to 2027 as a prior-year unallowed credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_TO_N_2: Credit carried forward to 2027 (Part IV column (i) for a carryforward).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_USED: Credit used against 2026 tax, earliest year first (Part IV column (g) for a carryforward).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_DEPLETION: Cost or percentage depletion of this business's working interest, after the applicable income limit, Schedule C line 12.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_DEPLETION_CARRY: Oil and gas percentage depletion above the taxable-income limit carried to2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_DE_MINIMIS: Qualifying low-cost property deducted once under the annual de minimis safe-harbor election, Schedule C PartV.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_GROSS_PROFIT: Net receipts less cost of goods sold, Schedule C line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_INVENTORY: Inventory amounts valued under the selected method, Schedule C PartIII.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_NET_RECEIPTS: Gross receipts less returns and allowances, Schedule C line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_NONQUALIFIED_EXCESS_LOS: Foreign service-business excess loss included once in the NOL carryforward. None is qualified business income loss, either currently or when this suspended loss is later deducted. This character detail is not an additional carryforward amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_N_BUSI: Business-use percentage: business miles divided by all miles.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_N_COST: Cost or other basis of the whole vehicle.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_N_DEPR: Depreciation deduction after the section 280F passenger-automobile limit on the business-use share, which also counts section 179 and the special allowance. Use 50% or less is ADS straight line over 5 years.
Basis for depreciation: business-use share of cost less elected section 179 and the special allowance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_N_SECT: Elected section 179 cost; zero unless business use is more than 50%.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_N_TYPE: Type of property: {1}; vehicle {0}, listed first.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_PRIOR_: Form 4797 Part IV line 35, column (b): the depreciation, with any section 179 and bonus, allowed for the earlier years while the vehicle was used more than 50% for business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_RECAPT: Form 4797 Part IV line 37, column (b): the excess depreciation, which section 280F(b)(2) includes in income now that business use is 50% or less. It is on Schedule C line 6, and the vehicle's basis is increased by it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_RECOMP: Form 4797 Part IV line 36, column (b): the straight-line (ADS) depreciation the earlier years would have allowed at the earlier business use, within the section 280F limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_LISTED_SPECIA: Special depreciation allowance for this vehicle used more than 50% for business, after the section 280F limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_AMT_DEPRECI: Current AMT deduction from the retained asset schedule, using the same recovery period and convention with 150% declining balance when required. This does not change regular self-employment tax or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_AMT_REMAINI: Separately retained AMT basis after current depreciation; do not replace regular asset basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_BONUS: Bonus allowance on business-use basis after elected section 179 cost: 100% for qualifying acquisition after January 19, 2025; 20% for ordinary eligible acquisition after September 27, 2017 and before January 20, 2025; zero if elected out or already placed in service before 2026. This is not the total deduction when basis remains for MACRS.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_MACRS: Current GDS deduction after elected section 179 and bonus. New assets use the class-wide method and return-wide convention; continuing assets preserve their original convention and table/manual approach, including the required straight-line switch. Add to bonus once. Bonus-eligible property placed after 2015 has the same regular/AMT depreciation even when bonus is elected out; post-1998 150%/straight-line GDS also agrees when basis history is identical. Retain basis and method records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_NONMACRS: Recovery from the actual original non-MACRS schedule and prior basis history; statutory elections and published annual rounding are applied once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_NONMACRS_DE: Original method: {0}. Applicable recovery period: {1} months, using {2}. Current recovery retains the original schedule, basis and actual prior deductions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_REMAINING_B: Business depreciable basis after prior allowed-or-allowable depreciation, elected section 179 (including separately reported unused carryforward), current bonus and current MACRS, before future events. This does not reduce original acquisition basis used for QBI property limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_SECTION179: Current section 179 deduction after shared dollar and business-income limits: current elections first, then oldest carryforward year; proportionate asset allocation within each year. Deducted once in this business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_ASSET_N_N_SECTION179_: Unused asset-specific section 179 amount. Retain with the original election and asset records. It is excluded from bonus/MACRS basis; do not deduct it again as depreciation or an ordinary expense. Disposal or changed use requires separate treatment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_CARD_ISSUER_RETAINED_: Schedule C line 6 other income: retained registered-card-issuer fuel-tax benefit accrued in 2026 after the buyer funded the claimable tax cost and the issuer obtained an unconditional right to the separate claim. Inclusion is an inference from section 61 business gain and the complete card ledger; it does not rely on the conditional deducted-tax recovery rule. Buyer card payments and vendor settlements are balance-sheet flows, not additional business receipts or expenses. The same Form 4136 amount separately reaches Schedule 3 line 12 as a refundable payment; neither amount is entered again elsewhere.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_CAR_AND_TRUCK: Car and truck expenses: standard-mileage vehicles plus the business-mile share of actual-expense vehicles' operating costs. Vehicle-loan interest is on its own line (Schedule C 16b, Schedule F 21b) and actual-expense depreciation is on the depreciation line, not here.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_CASH_FUEL_TAX_RECOVER: Cash-method 2026 Schedule F line 8 other income from a prior-year Form 4136 credit or fuel-tax refund after any documented section 111 exclusion. For full prior tax benefit, this equals the gross amount. The same taxable amount must not also be in recorded receipts.

Cash-method 2026 Schedule C line 6 other income from a prior-year Form 4136 credit or fuel-tax refund after any documented section 111 exclusion. For full prior tax benefit, this equals the gross amount. The same taxable amount must not also be in recorded receipts.

Section 111 amount excluded from 2026 Schedule C income: the recovered tax less the increase in 2025 taxable income when that one deduction is removed. The retained comparison includes related half-SE and QBI changes; original taxable income was zero. No unused credits or carryovers change the result.
Gross 2026 cash-method fuel-tax credit or refund before the section 111 tax-benefit exclusion. It was deducted on the original 2025 Schedule C, not claimed as a second 2026 Form 4136 payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_COST_OF_GOODS_SOLD: Opening inventory plus purchases and production costs, less personal withdrawals and closing inventory; deducted once from business receipts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXCLUDED_CHILD_PREMIU: Unused incremental premiums for a child under 27 who is not eligible for medical itemization. No Schedule A deduction is allowed for this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE10_COMMIS: Schedule C line 10: commissions and fees.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE14_EMPLOY: Schedule C line 14: employee benefit programs, other than retirement plans reported on line 19.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE15_INSURA: Schedule C line 15: insurance, other than health.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE16A_MORTG: Schedule C line 16a: mortgage interest paid to banks or other financial institutions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE16C_OTHER: Schedule C line 16c: other business interest; interest on a vehicle loan is on line 16b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE17_LEGAL_: Schedule C line 17: legal and professional services.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE19_PENSIO: Employee pension and profit-sharing plan contributions, Schedule C line 19; owner contributions belong on Schedule 1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE20A_RENT_: Schedule C line 20a: rent or lease of vehicles, machinery and equipment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE20B_RENT_: Schedule C line 20b: rent or lease of other business property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE21_REPAIR: Schedule C line 21: repairs and maintenance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE22_SUPPLI: Schedule C line 22: supplies not included in cost of goods sold.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE23_TAXES_: Schedule C line 23: taxes and licenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE24B_MEALS: Schedule C line 24b: deductible meals, after the 50% ordinary or 80% DOT hours-of-service limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE26_WAGES: Schedule C line 26: wages, less any employment credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_EXPENSE_LINE27B_OTHER: Schedule C line 27b: other expenses from Part V, including a section 481(a) decrease.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FOREIGN_NET_INCOME: Wholly foreign service-business profit or loss before any separate earned-income exclusion. SE tax uses full profit; this income and its attributable deductions do not enter U.S. qualified business income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM5884_LINE0_1A: Form 5884 line 1a: 25% of qualified first-year wages of employees who worked 120 to 399 hours, each within its targeted-group limit less wages counted on the 2025 form.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM5884_LINE0_1B: Form 5884 line 1b: 40% of qualified first-year wages of employees who worked at least 400 hours.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM5884_LINE0_1C: Form 5884 line 1c: 50% of qualified second-year wages of long-term family assistance recipients, up to $10,000 each.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM5884_LINE0_N: Form 5884 lines 2 and 4 and Form 3800 Part III line 4b; the business's wages deduction is reduced by this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8846_N_ACTUAL_EMP: Employer Social Security and Medicare tax actually paid or incurred on reported customer tips, reconciled from payroll; payroll-period rounding may differ from 7.65% of annual rounded tips.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8846_N_LINE1: 2026 Form 8846 line 1: customer tips for eligible services reported to the employer and subject to employer Social Security and Medicare tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8846_N_LINE2: 2026 Form 8846 line 2: monthly employee tips used to bring wages excluding tips to the selected service's statutory hourly basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8846_N_LINE3: 2026 Form 8846 line 3: taxed customer tips after the monthly wage shortfall for the selected service.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8846_N_LINE4: 2026 Form 8846 line 4: 7.65% of creditable tips; no employee reaches the 2026 Social Security wage base.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8846_N_REMAINING_: Schedule C deduction equals actual employer FICA on reported tips less the determined Form 8846 line 4 credit, even if Form 3800 limits this year's credit use. Other payroll costs remain in Business expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8881_LINE_N: Form 8881 line 1: qualified start-up costs paid in 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8881_LINE_N_2: Form 8881 line 2: 100% of line 1 with 50 or fewer employees on line A, 50% with 51 to 100.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8881_LINE_N_3: Form 8881 line 3: $250 for each eligible non-highly compensated employee.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8881_LINE_N_4: Form 8881 line 4: the greater of $500 or line 3, not more than $5,000.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8881_LINE_N_5: Form 8881 lines 5 and 8 and Form 3800 Part III line 1j; the start-up costs deduction is reduced by this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8881_LINE_N_6: Form 8881 lines 9 and 11 and Form 3800 Part III line 1dd: $500 in the first auto-enrollment year and the next two.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_1: Form 8941 line 1: the individuals you considered employees in 2026, seasonal workers included; excluded owners and relatives are not listed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_10: Form 8941 line 10: state premium subsidies and state tax credits for the line 4 premiums.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_11: Form 8941 line 11: line 4 less line 10, not below zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_12: Form 8941 line 12: the smaller of line 9 and line 11, the credit; Schedule C line 14 is reduced by this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_13: Form 8941 line 13: employees enrolled in the coverage (shown when line 12 is more than zero).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_14: Form 8941 line 14: full-time equivalent employees of the enrolled employees, rounded down (shown when line 12 is more than zero).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_15: Form 8941 line 15: the credit from your partnerships and S corporations (Schedule K-1 code BA); it also reaches Form 3800 Part III line 4h on its own.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_16: Form 8941 line 16: lines 12 and 15 to Form 3800 Part III line 4h.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_2: Form 8941 line 2: hours of service of the listed employees divided by 2,080, rounded down (at least 1); seasonal workers' hours are left out. At 25 or more, the credit is zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_3: Form 8941 line 3: W-2 box 5 wages of the listed employees divided by line 2, rounded down to a multiple of $1,000; seasonal workers' wages are left out. At $69,000 or more, the credit is zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_4: Form 8941 line 4: premiums you paid for the employees' coverage (your share only; Worksheet 4 column (b)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_5: Form 8941 line 5: what you would have paid at your share for the months enrolled if each plan cost the county's 2026 average premium (Worksheet 4 column (c)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_6: Form 8941 line 6: the smaller of line 4 and line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_8: Form 8941 line 8: line 7 reduced by (line 2 − 10) / 15 of line 7 above 10 full-time equivalent employees (Worksheet 5).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8941_LINE_9: Form 8941 line 9: line 8 reduced by (line 3 − $34,100) / $34,100 of line 7 above $34,000 average wages, Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (Worksheet 6).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8994_LINE_1A: Form 8994 line 1a: for each employee, the leave wages (at most the normal hourly rate times the leave hours, and at most 12 weeks of leave) times 12.5% plus 0.25 point for each point the policy's rate of payment exceeds 50% (at most 25%); Schedule C line 26 is reduced by this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8994_LINE_1B: Form 8994 line 1b: the creditable paid leave insurance premiums times the same percentage for the policy's rate of payment; the Schedule C line 14 employee benefit programs deduction is reduced by this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8994_LINE_2: Form 8994 line 2: the credit from your partnerships and S corporations (Schedule K-1 code BB); it also reaches Form 3800 Part III line 4j on its own.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM8994_LINE_3: Form 8994 line 3: lines 1a, 1b and 2 to Form 3800 Part III line 4j.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_1099_RECEIPTS: Part of Schedule C line 1: the Form 1099-NEC, 1099-K and 1099-MISC amounts entered on Self-employment and Other income that name this business, less a 1099-K part's refunds and the part of box 10 paid on to clients. The business's own typed receipts leave these forms out.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_4562B_EARLIER: Form 4562-B line 2: this year's amortization of start-up costs and section 197 intangibles whose amortization began before 2026. Only amortization that begins in 2026 is listed on line 1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_4562B_TOTAL: Form 4562-B line 3: line 1 column (f) plus line 2. It is carried to Schedule C Part V (lines 48 and 27b) with the start-up costs' initial deduction, because the 2026 Form 4562 has no amortization part.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_ALLOWED: Allowable expenses for business use of the home: lines 14, 27 and 33 (line 35 is zero). Schedule C line 30.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_BASIS: The smaller of the home's cost or other basis and its value when first used for business, with the land.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_BUILDING: Basis of the building: line 37 less line 38.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_BUSINESS_BA: Business basis of the building: line 39 times the business percentage ({0,number,0.00}%).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_DEDUCTIBLE_: Lines 9 through 11, column (b); the business share of it is line 13.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_DEPRECIATIO: Depreciation of the home from line 42.
Line 40 times line 41, {0,number,0.000}%: 39-year straight line, mid-month; the 2026 percentage for the first-use month, else 2.564%.
Allowable excess casualty losses and depreciation: the smaller of line 28 or line 32.
Excess casualty losses and depreciation carried over to 2027: line 32 less line 33.
Limit on excess casualty losses and depreciation: line 15 less line 27.
Lines 29 through 31; casualty losses are not calculated.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_DIRECT_REPA: Repairs and painting of the office space only, column (a).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_EXCESS_INTE: Standard deduction: all mortgage interest and mortgage insurance premiums on loans to buy, build or improve the home, column (b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_EXCESS_TAXE: Itemizing: the business share of real estate taxes above the state and local tax limit room, column (a); standard deduction: all the home's real estate taxes, column (b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_INCOME: Schedule C line 29 less this business's Form 4797 losses on its assets, which do not come from the use of the home.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_INDIRECT_SH: Line 12 column (b) times the business percentage (line 7: {0} square feet of {1}, {2,number,0.00}%).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_LIMIT: Line 8 less line 14, not less than zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_MORTGAGE_IN: Itemizing: the home's deductible mortgage interest and mortgage insurance premiums, column (b). The personal part stays on Schedule A lines 8a and 8d.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_OPERATING_A: Allowable operating expenses: the smaller of line 15 or line 26.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_OPERATING_C: Operating expenses carried over to 2027: line 26 less line 27.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_OPERATING_S: Line 23 column (b) times the business percentage ({0,number,0.00}%).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_OTHER: Other expenses of the whole home, column (b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_PRIOR_DEPRE: Excess casualty losses and depreciation carried over from the last Form 8829 (its line 44).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_PRIOR_OPERA: Operating expenses carried over from the last Form 8829 (its line 43).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_REAL_ESTATE: Itemizing: when your state and local taxes together are within $10,000 ($5,000 if married filing separately), all the home's real estate taxes, column (b) (Step 1); otherwise Line 11 Worksheet line 10, the business share of those taxes up to the room left under the state and local tax limit, column (a) (Step 2).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_REPAIRS: Repairs and maintenance of the whole home, column (b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_UNLIMITED: Line 12 column (a) plus line 13: deductible without the income limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FORM_8829_WORKSHEET_B: Itemizing: Line 11 Worksheet line 6, the business share of the home's real estate taxes, left out of Schedule A line 5b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_FUEL_N: 2026 Form 4136 qualified fuel quantities at the printed rate or the authorized line 13c 24.4-cent-tax write-in rate, using GGE or DGE on applicable alternative-fuel rows and rounding to cents on this business's form line. If full fuel cost was deducted, the credit enters gross income in the fuel-use year for accrual accounting or the filing year for cash accounting.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_HEALTH_INSURANCE: Eligible coverage months, limited to this business's profit or attributable optional SE earnings less its share of deductible self-employment tax and its owner SEP deduction. This is an income adjustment, not a Schedule C expense.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_INTANGIBLE_N_N_AMORTI: Form 4562-B line 1: the original and later capitalized cost of {0}, amortized under section 197 beginning with the month of {1}.

Section 197: original business cost amortized over 180 months from the later of acquisition and business commencement. Later acquisition costs use the remaining original months, or are deducted immediately after that period expires. This line deducts only 2026 amounts; no initial $5,000 deduction or bonus depreciation applies.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_INTANGIBLE_N_N_PERIOD: Form 4562-B line 1 column (e): the 180-month (15-year) amortization period of section 197(a).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_INTANGIBLE_N_N_REMAIN: Unrecovered business intangible basis after 2026 amortization. Retain original allocation and dates for future deductions and disposition. This intangible is not tangible qualified property for QBI UBIA.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_KIDDIE_EARNED_INCOME: Personal-service business earnings for the young-filer worksheets. Mixed-source profit uses the same attributable half-SE deduction as QBI before its 30% ceiling; a loss has no 30% ceiling.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_LONG_TERM_CARE_DEDUCT: Qualified long-term-care part of this business's health deduction, within remaining shared per-person age limits. Included in the total health adjustment, not an additional deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_MACRS_MID_QUARTER: Convention indicator: 1 = mid-quarter, 0 = half-year. The >40% test combines all entered 2026 equipment across the return before bonus depreciation, after personal-use allocation and elected section 179 cost. MACRS preserves each asset’s table/manual computation choice; retain that approach. File class-wide bonus election-out and any optional method elections with the timely return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_MARKETPLACE_HEALTH_IN: Canonical Marketplace premiums established under this business. Nonspecified premiums use its existing earnings limit first; specified premiums use the remaining limit and selected shared premium-credit method. Each source and the same allocable credit are counted once in this business's health deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_MEDICAL_PREMIUMS: Remaining medical-eligible premiums enter itemization once, subject to the 7.5% AGI floor. The self-employed deduction uses eligible incremental nondependent-child premiums first; unused child-only amounts do not enter Schedule A.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_NET_PROFIT: Net profit or loss: tentative profit less the business use of your home. It enters Schedule 1 line 3 and Schedule SE line 2.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_HOME_OFFICE: Business-use-of-home deduction allocated to this activity from its linked home claims. The Home offices page shows each claim's method, income limits, and carryforwards.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_HOME_OFFICE_2: Simplified home-office deduction: monthly qualifying area at $5 per square foot annually, limited to positive business income; no current-year unused amount carries forward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_2: Other business income: a prior fuel-tax credit or refund recovered, fuel-credit income under the accrual method, and the 2026 part of a section 481(a) increase.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_3: Gross income: gross receipts less cost of goods sold, plus other income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_4: Depreciation and section 179 expense from Form 4562: bonus, MACRS and the allowed section 179 deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_5: Total expenses before the business use of your home.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_6: Tentative profit or loss: gross income less total expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_7: Section 179 expense deduction allowed to this business after the dollar and business-income limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_N_8: Total depreciation and section 179: bonus, MACRS for 2026 and earlier assets, listed property and the allowed section 179 deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_OFFICE_DEPRECIATION: Prior actual depreciation/casualty carryforward is preserved; simplified use creates no current home depreciation deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_N_OFFICE_OPERATING_CA: Prior actual operating expenses remain available for a future actual-expense year; not deducted this year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_QUALIFIED_OVERTIME: FLSA overtime premium separately reported on this business's 2026 Form 1099 and already included in ordinary receipts. It shares the Schedule 1-A annual cap and income phaseout with W-2 overtime, without reducing Schedule C profit or self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_QUALIFIED_TIPS: Schedule 1-A business tip amount after this business's separate net-income limit, including allocable half-SE, owner retirement and health deductions. The shared $25,000 return cap and income phaseout apply to employee and business tips together; this line does not reduce Schedule C profit or self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_SALE_COVENANT: A payment for your covenant not to compete in the sale of the business is ordinary income on Schedule 1 line 8z, not self-employment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_SALE_INVENTORY: The price of the inventory sold with the business is ordinary business income counted with your sales (Schedule C line 1, Pub. 544).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_SEP_DEDUCTION: Timely employer contribution for this owner's traditional SEP. Reduces AGI, QBI, IRA compensation and this business's health-insurance income limit, but not SE tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_SEP_LIMIT: 2026 traditional SEP ceiling: net business earnings after deductible SE tax times the reduced plan rate, limited to the original plan rate times $360,000 compensation and $72,000. Deposit eligibility is checked in cents.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_STARTUP_AMORTIZABLE: Form 4562-B line 1: the qualifying start-up costs left after the initial deduction, amortized under section 195 over 180 months beginning with the month the business began ({0}).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_STARTUP_N_AMORTIZATIO: Remaining qualifying costs are amortized over 180 months beginning with the opening month. Only 2026 months are deducted; cumulative cent rounding preserves total basis. Prior-year initial deductions are not repeated.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_STARTUP_N_INITIAL: Initial start-up deduction in the opening year: at most $5,000, reduced dollar-for-dollar by total costs over $50,000. Capitalization election means no deduction.
