StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_STARTUP_N_REMAINING_B: Unrecovered start-up basis after 2026. An affirmative capitalization election retains the entire cost with no amortization; this irrevocable original election applies to all start-up costs of this business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_STARTUP_PERIOD: Form 4562-B line 1 column (e): the 180-month amortization period of section 195(b)(1)(B).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_VEHICLE_LOAN_INTEREST: Business-use share of vehicle-loan interest (annual interest times business miles over total miles), shown on its own line in the 2026 draft Schedule C (line 16b) and Schedule F (line 21b) whether the vehicle uses the standard mileage rate or actual costs. It is not also in car and truck expenses; the Schedule 1-A vehicle-loan-interest deduction cannot be claimed again for it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_VEHICLE_N_BASIS_REDUC: Owned vehicle: 35 cents per business mile is the depreciation component for basis records, not an additional deduction. Leased vehicles have no owner basis reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_VEHICLE_N_EXPENSE: 2026 business miles use 72.5 cents through June and 76 cents from July; add business parking/tolls and allocated interest/value-based tax once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_N_WAGERING_DEDUCTION: 2026 section 165(d): 90% of wagering losses plus otherwise deductible wagering expenses, capped at gross winnings. Applied before business profit, SE tax and QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_PASSIVE_ALLOWED: This business's operating profit or allowed current loss from the same Form 8582 passive pool. It remains Schedule C income and retains its self-employment character.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_PASSIVE_CURRENT: Current operating result after selected deductions and any at-risk limit, before the common passive loss limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_PASSIVE_SUSPENDED: Current operating loss held by the passive activity limit; keep this source's regular and AMT carryovers separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_QUALIFIED_EXCESS_LOSS: Domestic qualified excess loss included once in the NOL carryforward, after offsetting foreign business profit. Excluded from current QBI losses and retained as qualified suspended loss for the year it is deducted; not an additional carryforward amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_RETURNS: Customer returns and allowances, Schedule C line 2.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_BUSINESS_STATUTORY_W2: Statutory employee box 1 is Schedule C gross receipts and qualified business income after expenses, without self-employment tax. Earned income uses gross receipts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CANONICAL_HOME_WORKSHEET: The home worksheet uses the saved property's costs, this owner's qualifying use, and the linked activities' income and expenses. Casualty amounts go to Form 4684 separately from the business home-use deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN: Net short- and long-term gains; apply the current-year ordinary loss limit. Carryforward output is not a filed schedule.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_11: Long-term gain from Form 6781 line 9 (60% of section 1256 contracts) plus long-term gain recognized this year from earlier-year installment sales of investment property (Form 6252 line 26) and from earlier related-party exchanges disposed of within two years (Form 8824 line 24), plus long-term personal casualty or theft gain (Form 4684 line 15), Form 2439 box 1a undistributed gain and the Form 4797 Part I gain, as Schedule D line 11.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_1A: Totals for short-term transactions reported on a Form 1099-B or 1099-DA showing basis reported to the IRS, with no Form 8949 adjustment code and no wash-sale disallowance (Form 8949 box A or G, no adjustment).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_1B: Totals for short-term transactions reported on Form 8949 with box A or G checked: basis reported to the IRS, but with an adjustment code or a wash-sale disallowance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_4: Short-term gain from Form 6781 line 8 (40% of section 1256 contracts) plus short-term gain recognized this year from earlier-year installment sales of investment property (Form 6252 line 26) and from earlier related-party exchanges disposed of within two years (Form 8824 line 24), plus short-term personal casualty or theft gain (Form 4684 line 15), as Schedule D line 4.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_8A: Totals for long-term transactions reported on a Form 1099-B or 1099-DA showing basis reported to the IRS, with no Form 8949 adjustment code and no wash-sale disallowance (Form 8949 box D or J, no adjustment).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_8B: Totals for long-term transactions reported on Form 8949 with box D or J checked: basis reported to the IRS, but with an adjustment code or a wash-sale disallowance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_COLUMN_D: Total of column (d), proceeds, of the Form 8949 rows on this Schedule D line.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_COLUMN_E: Total of column (e), cost or other basis, of the Form 8949 rows on this Schedule D line.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_COLUMN_G: Total of column (g), adjustments, of the Form 8949 rows on this Schedule D line.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_N: Totals for short-term transactions reported on Form 8949 with box B or H checked: a Form 1099-B or 1099-DA was received, but its basis was not reported to the IRS.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_N_2: Totals for short-term transactions with no Form 1099-B or 1099-DA received, including a reported sale of your main home and a deferral of gain invested in an opportunity fund (Form 8949 box C or I).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_N_3: Totals for long-term transactions reported on Form 8949 with box E or K checked: a Form 1099-B or 1099-DA was received, but its basis was not reported to the IRS.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CAPITAL_GAIN_N_4: Totals for long-term transactions with no Form 1099-B or 1099-DA received, including a reported sale of your main home, a deferral of gain invested in an opportunity fund and previously deferred opportunity fund gain recognized (Form 8949 box F or L).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_AGI: Form 1040 line 11a, which sets the credit percentage.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_BENEFITS_EXCLUDED: Employee benefits excluded after plan, expense and earned-income limits. Reduces the current care-credit expense ceiling.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_BENEFITS_TAXABLE: Additional taxable employee benefits reported on Form 1040 line 1e. Amounts already in W-2 box 1 are not added again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_CREDIT: 2026 care percentage and expense/earned-income limits; nonrefundable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_CREDIT_LIMIT: Form 1040 line 18 less the foreign tax credit: the credit cannot exceed it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_DISTRIBUTION_N_N_EXCEPTION: Taxable distribution covered by the long-term-care exception. Ordinary pension income stays taxable. Spouse coverage needs a joint return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_DISTRIBUTION_N_N_LIMIT: Annual plan ceiling: smaller of 10% of vested benefit and the 2026 $2,600 ceiling. Certified premiums and earlier qualifying payments further limit the exception.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_DISTRIBUTION_N_N_USED: Annual qualifying taxable amount used by this plan through this payment; multiple payments share its ceiling.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_EXPENSES_ALLOWED: Line 2 column (d) expenses added, limited to $3,000 for one qualifying person or $6,000 for two or more (less any excluded employer benefits).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_EXPENSES_SMALLEST: The smallest of the allowed expenses and each spouse’s earned income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_OWNER_USED: One person's long-term-care exception is limited to $2,600 a year across every plan; the plans' rows share it in entry order.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_PERCENT: The percentage from the 2026 phase-out schedule: 50% falling by one point for each $2,000 over $15,000 to 35%, then by one point for each $2,000 ($4,000 on a joint return) over $75,000 ($150,000) to 20%.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_SOURCE_DEDUCTION: Form 2441 line 24, allocated among the selected own-business benefit sources in proportion to their received benefits. This source deduction is counted once in income and its attributable QBI; the original K-1 facts are retained.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CARE_WORKSHEET_A: Worksheet A copies the seven retained 2025 return facts and applies the 2025 credit table. Its result increases 2026 Form 2441 line 9b, subject to the 2026 credit limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CASUALTY_LONG_NET: Signed short- or long-term personal-use casualty result when Form 4684 has an overall net gain; entered once on Schedule D line 11, then coordinated with other capital gains and losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CASUALTY_SHORT_NET: Signed short- or long-term personal-use casualty result when Form 4684 has an overall net gain; entered once on Schedule D line 4, then coordinated with other capital gains and losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHAPTER_ONE_NET_TAX: Chapter1 tax after nonrefundable and refundable credits, including AMT, income-tax distribution additions, Form 8828 mortgage-subsidy recapture and education-credit recapture. Excludes payroll, self-employment, NIIT, section 4973 HSA excess and other Chapter43 excise taxes; used for the section 1341 restoration-year comparison, not the return's total tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_CARRYOVER_ALLOWED: Prior-year charitable gifts allowed this year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_CASH_DEDUCTION: Current public-charity cash and eligible volunteer-service portion, taken first under the 2026 60%-of-AGI ceiling, then reduced by its share of the 0.5% floor before section 68. The floor separately charges appreciated stock first, then 30%-class student maintenance and whaling expenses, other noncash gifts and cash-class gifts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_CASH_GIFTS: Current cash gifts before the charitable limits and floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_CLASS_WORKSHEET: Charitable contribution limits, oldest eligible carryovers, and the 2026 income floor are applied in the statutory class order.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_CURRENT_ALLOWED: Current gifts allowed after the charitable limits and floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_CURRENT_CASH_N_CARRYFORW: Only the current direct public-charity cash gift's 2026 60%-class percentage excess and any eligible share of the 2026 itemizer floor. The 2025 imported balance remains separate in its original contribution year; the appreciated-stock or student/whaling 30%-class carry is also shown separately. A 2026 balance can be used only in the five succeeding years, through 2031.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_DEDUCTION: Current and carried gifts allowed after the charitable limits and floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_FLOOR_NOT_CARRIED: Floor-disallowed amount not carried: absent current contribution-year percentage excess, no floor amount can carry. Even when a current-year gift has percentage excess, a prior-year cash, stock or household balance consumed in 2026 does not gain a new contribution year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_HOSTED_STUDENT_DEDUCTION: Section 170(g) student-maintenance expense allowed under the 30%-of-AGI and residual 50%-of-AGI limits, after its 2026 0.5%-of-AGI floor share. Appreciated capital-gain property takes floor priority ahead of this class. This class is itemized only; any regular NOL limitation is reflected in the total charity deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_HOSTED_STUDENT_N_CARRYFO: Gross 2026 30%-class excess for student maintenance, plus its floor-disallowed share only when a percentage limit creates a carryover. It keeps its class and expires after 2031 unless used earlier; the total charity carryforward separately reflects any NOL reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_HOSTED_STUDENT_N_ELIGIBL: Section 170(g) actual student-hosting expense, at most $50 per qualifying student-month with at least 15 eligible days. It is a 30%-limit contribution for the use of the sponsoring organization, not a 60%-limit cash gift. Ineligible months, general household costs and reimbursement do not count.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_NONCASH_DEDUCTION: Personally purchased used goods, qualifying road vehicles, short-held or nonappreciated public stock and basis-elected appreciated public stock after the 50%-of-AGI limit and 2026 floor, which is charged to appreciated stock at FMV and student maintenance before this class. The source includes Form 8283 Section A or B facts when required, but does not produce the attachment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_NONCASH_GIFTS: Current noncash and other charitable gifts before the charitable limits and floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_NONCASH_N_CARRYFORWARD: 2026 supported noncash 50%-limit excess plus its floor-disallowed share only when any charitable percentage limit creates a carryover in the contribution year. This class keeps its 50% limit and expires after 2031 unless used earlier.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_NONCASH_N_CARRYFORWARD_2: Supported noncash 50%-limit excess retained from a year using the standard deduction, without any 0.5% itemizer floor. The five following years end in 2031.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_N_CARRYFORWARD: Current-year cash/service, supported noncash gifts, appreciated public stock and 30%-class student maintenance above their 2026 percentage limits retain their gift classes and year even when the standard deduction is selected. The standard-route cash deduction counts only qualifying cash gifts made to eligible organizations; the separately computed carryover keeps the hypothetical itemized percentage limits and excludes the itemizer-only 0.5% floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_N_CARRYFORWARD_2: Current-year 60%-class cash/service, 50%-class property, 30%-class public stock at FMV, and 30%-class student-maintenance and whaling percentage-limit excess, plus only the current-year floor share when such an excess exists. Retain each class and the 2026 year; the five following years end in 2031. After reducing any amount that increased retained regular NOLs. Imported cash and supported 2025 stock and household balances retain their original years; other imported classes require further worksheets.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_N_NOL_REDUCTION: Charitable excess removed because it increased regular NOL carryforward; the same amount cannot remain in both carryovers.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_OTHER_N_PERCENT_DEDUCTIO: Combined section 170(g) student-maintenance and section 170(n) whaling contribution after the shared 30%-of-AGI and amended residual 50%-of-AGI limits and the 2026 itemizer floor. Both are current-year 30%-class contributions; the sources identify eligible amounts separately, but neither statute assigns the shared deduction between them. Any regular NOL limit appears in the total charity deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_OTHER_N_PERCENT_N_CARRYF: Combined 2026 30%-class percentage-limit excess for hosted-student and statutory-capped whaling claims, plus the class's floor share only when a percentage limit creates a carryover. This shared class expires after 2031 unless used earlier; whaling costs beyond the separate $50,000-per-captain statutory cap do not carry.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_CONSUMED_WITH: Prior-year carryover treated as paid within the 2026 percentage limit but not deducted because this return takes the standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_DEDUCTION: Prior-year public-charity cash balance deducted on Schedule A line 14 (carryover from prior year) after the 2026 60% ceiling and 0.5%-of-AGI floor. A standard-deduction return claims none.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_EXPIRED_AFTER: Unused 2021 cash balance after the 2026 percentage-limit calculation expires rather than moving to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_FLOOR_NOT_CAR: The 2026 0.5%-of-AGI floor reduces the imported carryover's current deduction; it does not create a new contribution-year carryover for a 2021–2025 gift.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_N_UNUSED: Original-year balance left after 2026 percentage-limit use. A 2021 contribution expires after 2026; a later year's unused balance retains its original five-year period.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_N_USED: This original-year cash balance uses 2026 room oldest first after current-year public-charity gifts. A supported ordinary goods or vehicle gift reduces its aggregate 60%-of-AGI room; in the appreciated-stock pairing, current cash and then this balance use the 60% room before stock uses the remaining 50% room and separate 30% ceiling. With a hosted-student or whaling claim, current direct cash uses the 60% room first, then this older balance, then the 30%-class claim; that class's residual 50% limit restores up to 10% of AGI of the total cash. The balance is treated as paid even in a standard-deduction year; treatment as paid alone is not a tax deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_CASH_REMAINING_N: Unused 2022–2025 original-year cash balances available for a later return, subject to each original five-year expiry and intervening-use rules.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_CONSUM: A percentage-usable prior noncash balance is treated as paid, but not deductible, in a standard-deduction year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_DEDUCT: Imported 2025 household-furnishing balance included once in 2026 Schedule A line 14 (carryover from prior year) after percentage limits and the itemizer floor; no itemized deduction is claimed on the standard route.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_FLOOR_: The 2026 itemizer floor reduces this imported 2025 deduction; it cannot turn the older gift into a new 2026 carryover.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_OPENIN: Reconciled unused 2025 50%-class balance entering 2026; it is not a current-year gift.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_REMAIN: Unused 2025 50%-class balance available in 2027, subject to intervening use; the five following years end after 2030, not after 2031.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_USED: 2025 balance treated as paid after 2026 cash, 50%-class property and allowable 30%-class public stock use the 50%-of-AGI room. This older 50%-class balance then precedes a 2025 30%-class stock carry. Treatment as paid alone is not a tax deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_CONSUMED_W: Prior 2025 balance treated as paid within the 2026 percentage limits but not deducted because this return takes the standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_DEDUCTION: Prior 2025 public-stock balance included once in the 2026 Schedule A line 14 carryover from prior year, after the current-year percentage ceilings and itemizer floor. A standard-deduction return claims none.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_FLOOR_NOT_: The 2026 itemizer floor reduces the imported 2025 balance's deduction and cannot create a new 2026 contribution-year carryover.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_OPENING: Reconciled unused 2025 30%-class FMV balance entering 2026; original donation is not entered again as a 2026 gift.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_ORIGINAL_B: Original adjusted basis retained with the 2025 Form 8283 Section A facts and any future capital-gain-property election review; the 2026 FMV carry path does not use basis as its claim.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_ORIGINAL_V: Original 2025 public-market fair value of the directly donated long-term stock lot. This is Form 8283 Section A evidence, not a second contribution or 2026 deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_REMAINING_: Unused original-year 30%-class balance still available in 2027, subject to intervening use; its five following carry years are 2026 through 2030, not 2026 through 2031.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PRIOR_STOCK_N_USED: 2025 balance treated as paid in 2026 after current-year stock gifts use the 30%-class and residual public-charity 50% limits. Treatment as paid alone does not mean a tax deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PUBLIC_STOCK_N_CARRYFORW: Gross 2026 30%-class FMV stock excess, plus its floor share only when a percentage ceiling creates a carryover. Retain this class through 2031; the total carryforward separately reflects any NOL reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PUBLIC_STOCK_N_CLAIM: Purchased, section 1014 inherited or ordinary section 1015 gifted publicly traded stock delivered to an eligible public charity: short-held or nonappreciated shares claim the lesser of FMV and basis in the 50% class; appreciated long-term shares claim FMV in the 30% class or basis under the annual reduction election. The gift realizes no sale gain; Form 8283 Section A applies when total noncash gifts exceed $500.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_PUBLIC_STOCK_N_PERCENT_D: Appreciated public stock at FMV after the separate 30%-of-AGI and remaining public-charity 50%-of-AGI ceilings. The 2026 itemizer floor charges this class first. No immediate standard-route deduction; the total charity deduction separately reflects any NOL limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_VOLUNTEER_N_EXPENSE: Unreimbursed direct volunteer service expense: qualifying car, away travel, uniform, foster care, selected-youth outing or permanent diaconate cost. This enters the cash-contribution class once; donated time and personal costs are not deductible. Retain reliable written records and any required charity acknowledgment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_WHALING_DEDUCTION: Section 170(n) statutory-capped 2026 whaling expenses after the 30%-of-AGI other-contribution limit, residual 50% ceiling and 0.5%-of-AGI itemizer floor. Any overall NOL limit appears in the total charity deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_WHALING_ELIGIBLE_EXPENSE: Unreimbursed, substantiated 2026 reasonable and necessary sanctioned whaling expenses after allocating any boat also used for other activities by sanctioned-use days over 365 days. This is before each captain's separate $50,000 statutory cap or AGI percentage limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_WHALING_N_CARRYFORWARD: Only percentage-limit excess of the statutory-capped 2026 whaling contribution, plus its eligible floor share when a percentage ceiling creates a carryover. Expense above the separate $50,000 annual statutory cap never carries; this 30% class expires after 2031 unless used earlier.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_WHALING_N_ELIGIBLE_EXPEN: This captain's eligible whaling expenses after any mixed-use boat allocation, before that individual's $50,000 statutory cap.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_WHALING_N_STATUTORY_CLAI: The 2026 section 170(n) $50,000 annual cap applies to this recognized captain separately, including on a joint return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHARITY_WHALING_STATUTORY_CLAIM: Section 170(n) deems up to $50,000 of each recognized captain's 2026 expenses a charitable contribution. It is itemizer-only and enters the 30%-of-AGI other-contribution class, not the 60% public-charity cash or nonitemizer class. Other charity limits apply afterward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ANNUITY_N_N: Temporary child-annuity cost recovery is limited to monthly payments and remaining cost; unused exclusion remains separate from investment and is usable only against eligible later payments. Ending the annuity does not automatically create a deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT: Child and other-dependent credits after MAGI phaseout and prior nonrefundable credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_AFTER_PHASEOUT: Line 8 less line 11. If it is zero you cannot take the child tax credit, the credit for other dependents or the additional child tax credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_AGI: Form 1040 line 11b, your adjusted gross income: where the child tax credit and credit for other dependents phase-out starts counting.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_CHILDREN: Qualifying children under age 17 at the end of 2026 who have the required Social Security number; a child attains 17 on the birthday.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_CHILDREN_AMOUNT: $2,200 for each qualifying child on line 4.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_EXCESS_INCOME: Modified adjusted gross income over the threshold, rounded up to the next multiple of $1,000.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_EXCLUSIONS_TOTAL: Lines 2a through 2c added; only the Form 2555 amount on line 2b is modeled.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_FOREIGN_EXCLUSIONS: Form 2555 lines 45 and 50, the foreign earned income and housing exclusions, added back to income for the phase-out. Puerto Rico and American Samoa exclusions (lines 2a and 2c) are not modeled.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_LIMIT: Your tax after the credits that come before this one (Credit Limit Worksheet A line 13): the child tax credit and credit for other dependents cannot exceed it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_MAGI: Line 1 plus line 2d: the income the phase-out tests.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_OTHER_DEPENDENTS: Other dependents, including qualifying children who are not under 17 or who lack the required SSN; never yourself, your spouse or anyone who is not a U.S. citizen, national or resident alien.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_OTHER_DEPENDENTS_AM: $500 for each other dependent on line 6.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_PHASEOUT_REDUCTION: 5% of line 10: $50 for each $1,000 over the threshold.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_CREDIT_PHASEOUT_THRESHOLD: $400,000 on a joint return and $200,000 otherwise.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_CAPITAL_GAIN_DIST: Form 8814 line 10 of every child. It is inside Schedule D line 13 and Form 1040 line 7a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_EXEMPT_INTEREST: Form 8814 line 1b of every child. It counts toward the earned income credit's investment income and not Form 1040 line 2a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_INVESTMENT_INCOME: Form 8814 line 12 of every child less the Alaska Permanent Fund share. It is Form 8960 line 7, Form 4952 investment income and the earned income credit's investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_CAPITAL_GAIN_DI: Child's capital gain distributions from Forms 1099-DIV box 2a.
Line 6 times the fraction of line 4 that is capital gain distributions. It goes on Schedule D line 13.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_EXEMPT_INTEREST: Child's tax-exempt interest. Its private-activity bond part is an alternative minimum tax preference, and the amount counts toward the earned income credit's investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_INCOME_OVER_BAS: Line 4 less $2,700. The first $2,700 is not added to your income; this excess is.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_INTEREST: Child's taxable interest after bond premium and accrued interest, from the child's Forms 1099-INT and 1099-OID. It counts toward line 4 only and is not Form 1040 line 2b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_ORDINARY_DIVIDE: Child's ordinary dividends from Forms 1099-DIV box 1a, plus the Alaska Permanent Fund dividend.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_OTHER_INCOME: Line 6 less line 11: the child's interest and other dividends above $2,700. It goes on Schedule 1 line 8z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_QUALIFIED_DIVID: The part of line 2a that is qualified dividends.
Line 6 times the fraction of line 4 that is qualified dividends. It goes on Form 1040 lines 3a and 3b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_TAX: 10% of line 14, at most $135. It is added to Form 1040 line 16, even for income the child's own rate would tax less.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_TAXABLE_OVER_UN: Line 4 less $1,350, the amount not taxed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_N_TOTAL_INCOME: Lines 1a, 2a and 3. Over $1,350 and under $13,500, the child can be reported on your return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_OTHER_INCOME: Form 8814 line 12 of every child. It is Schedule 1 line 8z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_QUALIFIED_DIVIDEN: Form 8814 line 9 of every child. It is inside Form 1040 lines 3a and 3b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CHILD_ELECTION_TAX: Form 8814 line 15 of every child, added to Form 1040 line 16. It is not reduced by credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CIVIL_SERVICE_DEATH_N_N: Civil-service lump sum plus earlier tax-free annuity recovery, less employee cost, determines taxable income. Any remaining cost is not an automatic deduction on this beneficiary's return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLAIM_REPAYMENT: Restoration-year Chapter1 tax less refundable credits, without the repayment deduction or credit. Refigured capital losses and minimum-tax credits affect this comparison only; payroll, NIIT and excise taxes are excluded. Saved source history and actual current income remain unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_BUSINESS_PART: {0}: business-use new clean vehicle credit before the Form 3800 limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_BUSINESS_TOTAL: Form 8936 line 8: new clean vehicle business credit before the Form 3800 limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_K1_BUSINESS_TOTAL: Form 8936 line 7: current new clean vehicle credits from partnership and S corporation Schedules K-1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_MODIFIED_AGI_N: Form 8936 line 2: 2026 AGI plus excluded Puerto Rico income, Form 2555 lines 45 and 50, and Form 4563 line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_MODIFIED_AGI_N_2: Form 8936 line 4: prior-year modified AGI tested against the 2025 filing-status limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_N_POTENTIAL: 2026 Schedule A (Form 8936) for VIN {0}: eligible personal-use credit before the Form 1040 tax limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLEAN_VEHICLE_OWN_BUSINESS_TOTAL: Form 8936 line 6: business credit from your new clean vehicle schedules.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLERGY_HOUSING_EXCESS: The designated housing or utility allowance above the excluded amount is taxable as excess allowance on Form 1040 line 1h.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLERGY_HOUSING_EXCLUDED: The furnished parsonage value and used utility allowance, or the smallest designated housing, actual housing cost and rental value, are excluded under section 107.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLERGY_NONDEDUCTIBLE_EXPENSES: The expense share allocable to tax-free housing is added back for income tax but remains deductible for self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLERGY_SE_EARNINGS: Ministerial wages, full housing value or designation and ministerial business profit, less allowable employee expenses, determine the ministerial ScheduleSE share before an approved exemption.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CLERGY_TAX_FREE_PERCENT: Tax-free housing divided by ministerial wages, ministerial gross business income and the full housing designation determines the expense allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_COOPERATIVE_N_N_DISTRIBUTIONS: Total cooperative distributions (Form 1099-PATR boxes 1, 2, 3 and 5), routed to this owner's farm for Schedule F line 3a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_COOPERATIVE_N_N_NONQUALIFIED: Taxable distributions above the box 8 qualified items, excluded from the farm's qualified business income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_COOPERATIVE_N_N_PATRON_REDUCTION: Form 8995-A Schedule D patron reduction on the box 7 qualified payments: zero because the farm has no W-2 wages allocable to them.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_COOPERATIVE_N_N_TAXABLE: Taxable distributions after the personal-purchase dividends, routed to this owner's farm for Schedule F line 3b, self-employment earnings and QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_COVERDELL_CORRECTION_EARNINGS: Positive net earnings on a timely returned Coverdell contribution are taxable in the original contribution year, without the additional early-distribution tax. The linked Form 1099-Q owns the same earnings when supplied; a loss is not deducted.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_COVERDELL_PART_V: Form 5329 Part V aggregates this beneficiary’s accounts, donor limits, timely corrections, retained excess and non-rollover distributions. The 6% tax is limited by the combined year-end account value.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CREATIVE_PROPERTY_ORDINARY: Creative property disposition proceeds, ordinary property income
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CREDIT_ENTITY_STATEMENTS: Part IV line 20: eligible entity credit amounts reported on statements other than Form 1097-BTC. A duplicate Form 1097-BTC credit is entered only once in Part III.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CREDIT_SOURCE_ROW: {0}, bond {1}: Form 8912 Part {2}. This is the eligible current credit before the return-level tax limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_CURRENT_NET_OPERATING_LOSS: Current-year NOL after capital-loss and nonbusiness-deduction limits; the separate Form 461 carryover is added below.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DC_HOMEBUYER_CARRYFORWARD_N: 2026 Form 8859 line 4: unused balance carried to 2027 without a fixed expiration.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DC_HOMEBUYER_CREDIT: 2026 Form 8859 lines 1–3: prior DC first-time homebuyer carryforward, limited by tax after the listed credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_CANCELLATION_N_TAXABLE: Personal recourse debt cancellation, including nondeductible interest, is ordinary Schedule 1 line 8c income unless a confirmed exception applies. A genuine gift or bequest is excluded without reducing tax attributes. Not wages, self-employment earnings or investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_INSTRUMENT_LOSS_DEDUCTION: Ordinary loss on contingent payment or inflation-indexed debt from the issuer or broker records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_0BASIS_REDUCTION: Excluded debt applied to property basis on January 1, 2027 in the Treas. Reg. 1.1017-1 order, limited for a bankruptcy or insolvency by post-discharge basis plus cash minus liabilities. No current tax or deduction change.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_0PROPERTY_N_N: {0}: January 1, 2027 basis reduction in proportion to adjusted basis within its property category. Retain the reduced basis and the reduction for later section 1245 or 1250 ordinary-income recapture; this is not current depreciation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE: Box checked: the part excluded because of the title 11 case or insolvency.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE2: Total discharged debt excluded from gross income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_10A: Applied to the basis of property held on January 1, 2027, secured business property first and personal-use property last.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_11A: Farm debt applied to depreciable qualified property not reduced on line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_11B: Farm debt applied to land used in the farming business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_11C: Farm debt applied to other qualified property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_1C: Box checked: the qualified farm debt excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_1D: Box checked: the qualified real property business debt excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N: Qualified real property business debt applied to the basis of depreciable real property, the securing property first.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_2: Excluded debt you elected to apply first to the basis of depreciable property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_3: Applied to the 2026 NOL, then NOL carryovers to 2026 in the order of their years.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_4: Applied to the general business credit carryover, 33 1/3 cents of credit for each dollar.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_5: Applied to the minimum tax credit available at the beginning of 2027, 33 1/3 cents for each dollar.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_6: Applied to the 2026 net capital loss and capital loss carryovers.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_7: Applied to passive activity loss carryovers from 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_FORM982_LINE_N_8: Applied to the foreign tax credit carryover, 33 1/3 cents for each dollar.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N: Seller purchase-price adjustment: reduce the identified property's basis immediately, without cancellation income or a current deduction. Retain the adjusted basis for later dispositions; this is not a Form 982 next-year attribute reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_2: Form 982 box 1a and line 2: debt discharged in a confirmed chapter 12 or 13 case is excluded without a solvency limit. Attribute reduction follows the current-year income tax calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_3: Form 982 line 2: discharged debt limited to liabilities exceeding all asset fair market value immediately before discharge. The balance is taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_AFTER: Balance carried to 2027 after the debt reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_CAPITAL_REDUCTION: Capital loss carryforward reduced dollar for dollar; the carryforward to 2027 keeps the balance shown after reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_ELECTION_BASIS_REDUCTIO: Excluded debt applied first to depreciable property basis by the section 108(b)(5) election.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_FARM_BASIS_REDUCTION: Farm debt applied to the basis of qualified property: depreciable property, then farm land, then other.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_FARM_EXCLUSION: Form 982 box 1c: qualified farm debt above any insolvency exclusion, within adjusted tax attributes plus the basis of qualified property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_FTC_REDUCTION: Foreign tax credit carryover reduced by 33 1/3 cents for each dollar of excluded debt applied.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_NOL_REDUCTION: Separate regular/AMT loss reduction after current tax: current-year NOL first, then unused prior losses in original-year order, before basis. Current tax and deductions remain fixed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_PASSIVE_REDUCTION: Passive activity loss carryover reduced dollar for dollar.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_REAL_PROPERTY_BASIS_RED: Qualified real property business debt applied to the basis of depreciable real property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_REAL_PROPERTY_EXCLUSION: Form 982 box 1d: qualified real property business debt above any insolvency exclusion, within the principal over the net value of the securing property and the basis of depreciable real property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_REDUCTION_GBC: General business credit carryover reduced by 33 1/3 cents for each dollar of excluded debt applied; the balance carries to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_N_REDUCTION_MTC: Minimum tax credit available at the beginning of 2027 reduced by 33 1/3 cents for each dollar of excluded debt applied.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_SALE_GAIN: Form 8949 sale: a later sale using basis after the seller's price adjustment, or property the creditor took at its amount realized. Personal losses are disallowed; taxable gains retain their holding period and collectible treatment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEBT_N_STUDENT_EXCLUSION: Qualifying student-loan cancellation exception: excluded without Form 982 tax-attribute reduction. Forgiven interest is not a student-loan interest payment. The expired general 2021–2025 exclusion is not used.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEDUCTION: Itemized medical, capped SALT, mortgage interest and points, cash gifts after the 0.5% AGI floor and remaining qualifying educator expenses and limited gambling losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEDUCTION_2: Standard deduction including age/blindness additions and eligible non-itemizer cash gifts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DEFERRED_PENSION: W-2 box 1 pension or annuity from a nonqualified deferred compensation plan or a nongovernmental section 457 plan, Schedule 1 line 8t instead of Form 1040 line 1a. Not earned income for the earned income credit or compensation for an IRA; earned income for the dependent standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DIGITAL_ASSET_INCOME: Fair market value of digital assets received as ordinary income (staking, mining not as a business, airdrops, hard forks), Schedule 1 line 8v. That value is the basis of a later sale; not net investment income or self-employment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISASTER_MITIGATION_N_EXCLUDED: 2026 section 139(g) hazard-mitigation payment excluded from income. The excluded amount cannot increase property basis or fund a second deduction or credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISASTER_RELIEF_N_EXCLUDED: 2026 section 139 qualified disaster relief excluded from gross income. No deduction or credit may be claimed for an expenditure paid by the excluded amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISASTER_RELIEF_N_WITHHOLDING: Federal income tax actually withheld on a payer's Form 1099 for an excluded section 139 payment. Claim the withheld tax on Form 1040 line 25b; the payment remains excluded from AGI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISTRIBUTION_N_N_BASIS_REDUCTION: Return of capital applied against this lot's basis; not taxable income or a loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISTRIBUTION_N_N_CAPITAL_GAIN: Gain beyond this lot's remaining basis, or loss on final liquidation and cancellation. Holding period determines capital treatment; interim payments never create a loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISTRIBUTION_N_N_REMAINING_BASIS: Basis remaining after this distribution; zero when final liquidation cancels the shares. Retain for later distributions or sales, without duplicating an adjustment already in broker records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DISTRIBUTION_N_PROPERTY_N_BASIS: {0}: basis of the property received is its distribution-date fair market value. Retain this allocation with the asset records for a later sale.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DOMESTIC_ABUSE_USED_TAXPAYER: Qualified domestic-abuse gross amount used through 2026, including prior-year claims. Retain for later returns.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_DONATED_VEHICLE_N_CLAIM: Personally used road vehicle: an ordinary unrelated sale claims the smaller of supported fair market value and proceeds when proceeds exceed $500, or the smaller of fair market value and $500 otherwise. A certified significant-use, material-improvement or needy-person exception claims fair market value; when the similar road-vehicle group exceeds $5,000, its FMV-exception vehicles need qualified appraisals and Section B evidence. Gross-proceeds-limited vehicles stay in Section A. Retain the timely charity acknowledgment and attach Form 8283 when required. This on-screen estimate does not prepare the attachment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EARLY_DISTRIBUTION_TAX: 10% additional tax, including taxable Roth earnings and recent taxable-conversion recapture, or 25% for early traditional SIMPLE IRA distributions within two years, after supported source-based exceptions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EARLY_FILER: Separate filer Form 5329 Part I amount, rounded after aggregating source amounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EARNED_INCOME_CREDIT: EIC is unavailable because a filer is another taxpayer’s EIC qualifying child.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EARNED_INCOME_CREDIT_2: Draft 2026 IRS EIC Table: look up earned income, then AGI when required, and use the lower amount. Reconcile with the final 2026 table before filing use.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_LOAN_INTEREST_: Earnings made tax-free by 529 payments on this student's own student loans, which cannot also be deducted as student loan interest (section 221(e)(1)); removed before the income phaseout.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_N_ADJUSTED_EXP: The adjusted qualified education expenses matched with this distribution: the student's qualified expenses less tax-free assistance, the expenses an education credit used and expenses used elsewhere, shared between the student's 529 and Coverdell distributions (Publication 970 Worksheet 6-3 line 5; chapter 7).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_N_BASIS_REMAIN: Publication 970 Worksheet 6-3 line 15: the Coverdell account's basis at the end of 2026, to carry to next year's worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_N_DISTRIBUTION: The Form 1099-Q gross distribution less any part put back within 60 days; for a direct transfer to another account, only the part that does not qualify.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_N_EARNINGS: The earnings in that distribution: Form 1099-Q box 2 in proportion to the distribution or, for a Coverdell ESA with only a year-end value, Publication 970 Worksheet 6-3 lines 3 to 11.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_N_EXCEPTIONS: The taxable earnings not subject to the 10% additional tax: death or disability, a timely returned Coverdell excess, expenses used only for an education credit, and the part covered by tax-free scholarships or military academy costs (Form 5329 Part II line 6).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_N_TAXABLE: The earnings left taxable: earnings less the part matched by adjusted qualified expenses (Publication 970 Worksheet 6-3 line 14; chapter 7 step 2), Schedule 1 line 8z. A loss is never deducted.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_TAXABLE_EARNIN: The taxable earnings of every Form 1099-Q from a 529 plan or Coverdell ESA: Schedule 1 line 8z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_CREDIT: Nonrefundable education credits, subject to available tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_CREDIT_RECAPTURE_TAX: Form 1040 line 16 box 3 (enter ECR): tax-liability increase after refiguring the sole fully usable 2025 education credit for post-filing refunds or tax-free assistance. No 2026 education expense is reduced here. It is part of line 18, the base of the credit limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATION_N_SCHOLARSHIP_INCLUDED: Part of the box 5 grant that {0} includes in income because it pays living costs (Pub. 970 chapter 2): the education credit uses more of the tuition, and this part is taxable scholarship.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EDUCATOR_ITEMIZED_DEDUCTION: Eligible classroom expenses left after Schedule 1 line 11, other instructional expenses, and interscholastic sports administrator or coach expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EIC_INVESTMENT_INCOME: Publication 596 Worksheet 1 investment income, excluding section 1231 capital from the capital line and counting passive property income once in the passive line.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ELDERLY_CREDIT: Schedule R credit for age-qualified filers and supported disability retirement income, limited by disability income where applicable, exempt benefits, AGI and available tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_COVERAGE_PAYROLL: Employee payroll coverage worksheet: known covered pay and its employee Social Security and Medicare liability, using separate coverage and the remaining Social Security wage base. This is an estimate, not a numbered Form 8919.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_EQUIPMENT_SECTION179: Current section 179 deduction after the return-wide dollar and business-income limits. Current elections precede prior carryforwards, oldest year first. Included once in this job's Form 2106 line 4 expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSES_N_EXCESS: Reimbursements above the expenses (Form 2106 line 8), included in Form 1040 line 1a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSES_N_LINE_N: A line of Form 2106 for one job, in whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSES_N_VEHICLE_N: A vehicle's operating costs (line 27) or depreciation (line 28) on Form 2106 Part II.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSES_N_VEHICLE_N_OT: The excess depreciation on a Form 2106 vehicle whose business use fell to 50% or less is other income on Schedule 1 line 8z, the schedule the deduction reached (Form 4797 Part IV).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_STOCK_N_N: Ordinary employee stock source records determine compensation and sale basis. Compensation was already reported as wages in the recognition year and is not added again. Regular and AMT sale basis are the same. For an elected-stock forfeiture, basis excludes previously taxed compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_TIPS_N_N_TAX: Employee share of unreported-tip payroll tax from this filer's Form 4137; separate from withholding and self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_TIP_INCOME: Additional tip wages outside W-2 box 1, including noncash tips and cash tips below the monthly payroll threshold.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_NOT_COVERED: Employee pay outside ordinary Social Security and Medicare coverage remains on line 1h; payroll tax is omitted with a notice.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_N_N_TAX: Form 8919 employee payroll tax after W-2 wages and covered unreported tips; not employer withholding or self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_N_PAY: Form 8919 line 6: employee pay a firm reported on a Form 1099 or paid without payroll tax; it is on Form 1040 line 1g.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_N_SOCIAL_BASE: Form 8919 line 10: the pay under the Social Security wage base left after W-2 wages, covered tips and Form 4137 wages.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_N_TAX: Form 8919 line 13: the uncollected Social Security and Medicare tax, carried to Schedule 2 line 16b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_REMAINING_BASE: Form 8919 line 9: the annual Social Security wage base less line 8, with a minimum of zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_USED_BASE: Form 8919 line 8: this employee's W-2 Social Security wages and tips, compensation subject to the 6.2% railroad tax, and Form 4137 covered tips.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_WAGE_BASE: Form 8919 line 7: the annual Social Security wage base for this return's tax year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EMPLOYER_LOAN_INTEREST_REMOVED: Interest your employer paid tax-free under an educational assistance program, removed from the student-loan interest claim before the $2,500 cap and phase-out; it cannot also be deducted.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESPP_SALE_N_N: Section 423 holding periods select grant-discount or exercise-discount compensation. Basis includes compensation; reported wages are not added again. Unreported compensation enters Schedule 1 line 8k.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_ACTIVITY_CARRY: Estate or trust document {0}, activity {1}: passive loss still suspended.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_ACTIVITY_COLUMN: Estate or trust document {0}, activity {1}: Schedule E column {2}.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_AMT_INDEPENDENT: Fiduciary source adjustment on its applicable Form 6251 line, included once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_PAID_MEDICAL_ELECTION: Elected estate-paid expenses incurred in 2026; included in medical expenses before the 7.5% AGI floor. Attach the required statement that these amounts were not claimed for estate tax and waive the estate-tax deduction. This App does not submit the election.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_67E_DEDUCTION: Allocated terminating-estate or trust section 67(e) excess deduction on Schedule 1 line 24k, combined across K-1 sources before rounding. It reduces AGI but does not create a second carryover of the fiduciary expense.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_IRD_ESTATE_TAX_DEDU: Schedule A line 17e section 691(c) estate-tax deduction allocated solely to box 1 taxable IRD interest. Does not reduce AGI; the allowed itemized share also reduces Form 8960 net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_11A_67E_DEDUCTION: Final-year Form 1041 K-1 box 11 code A section 67(e) deduction allocated to the beneficiary succeeding to property. Enters Schedule 1 line 24k once, reduces AGI, and cannot be carried to another beneficiary tax year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_11B_PERSONAL_PROP: Beneficiary-allocated final-year personal property tax retains its non-miscellaneous itemized character and joins the beneficiary's SALT limit; unused excess does not carry to another year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_11B_REAL_ESTATE_T: Final-year box 11 code B noninvestment real-estate tax allocated to the beneficiary, included on Schedule A line 5b and subject to the beneficiary's SALT limit; not a Form 8960 deduction or AMT deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_11B_STATE_INCOME_: Final-year box 11 code B state/local income tax already limited by the fiduciary, available on Schedule A line 5a only when the beneficiary elects income rather than sales tax and subject to the beneficiary's SALT limit; no Form 8960 allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_11B_STATE_SALES_T: Final-year box 11 code B general sales tax already limited by the fiduciary, available on Schedule A line 5a only when the beneficiary elects general sales rather than income tax and subject to the beneficiary's SALT limit; no Form 8960 allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_12A_AMT_ADJUSTMEN: Form 1041 K-1 box 12 code A total on Form 6251 line 2j; regular AGI is unchanged. Codes B through F are portions, not another addition to AMTI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_12B_AMT_QUALIFIED: Form 1041 K-1 box 12 code B is entirely included in code A, and changes only the qualified-dividend amount used in the Form 6251 preferential-rate calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_12C_AMT_SHORT_GAI: Form 1041 K-1 box 12 code C is entirely included in code A. It refigures AMT Schedule D line 5; regular Schedule D and AGI are unchanged, and code C is not added to AMTI again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_12D_AMT_LONG_GAIN: Form 1041 K-1 box 12 code D is entirely included in code A. It refigures AMT Schedule D line 12; regular Schedule D and AGI are unchanged, and code D is not added to AMTI again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_12E_AMT_UNRECAPTU: Form 1041 K-1 box 12 code E is a section 1250 portion included in code D and code A, not another AMTI addition. It refigures line 11 of the AMT Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet; code D refigures AMT Schedule D line 12. Neither changes regular Schedule D or AGI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_12F_AMT_RATE_N_GA: Form 1041 K-1 box 12 code F is the 28%-rate portion already included in D and A. It refigures line 4 of the AMT 28% Rate Gain Worksheet; regular Schedule D and AGI are unchanged, and it is not added to AMTI again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_14A_PRIVATE_ACTIV: Specified private-activity interest included in tax-exempt box 14 code A; added once to the shared Form 6251 line 2g preference, not to regular AGI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_14H_NIIT_LINE_N: Form 1041 K-1 box 14 code H adjustment on Form 8960 line 7, separate from the portfolio income boxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_14H_NIIT_MAGI: Corresponding Form 8960 modified-AGI adjustment from the fiduciary's box 14 code H statement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_14I_SECTION199A_D: Beneficiary's fiduciary-allocated section 199A dividends are already included in box 2a ordinary dividends; qualified amounts join the shared REIT/PTP deduction calculation without adding income again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_9A_ROYALTY_DEPREC: Fiduciary-apportioned box 9 code A straight-line depreciation of one box 5 nonbusiness sound-recording royalty asset, deducted once on Schedule E line 33(e). The confirmed same-character amount reduces AMT income and net investment income through the shared royalty calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_9B_ROYALTY_DEPLET: Fiduciary-apportioned box 9 code B cost depletion from one box 5 nonbusiness mineral royalty property, deducted once on Schedule E line 33(e). The confirmed same-character amount also reduces AMT income and net investment income through the shared royalty calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_9C_ROYALTY_AMORTI: Fiduciary-apportioned box 9 code C amortization from the same box 5 nonbusiness royalty activity, deducted once on Schedule E line 33(e). The confirmed same-character amount also reduces AMT income and net investment income through the shared royalty calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_ALLOCATED_ESTIMAT: Form 1041 K-1 box 13 code A estimated tax allocated on timely Form 1041-T, included once on Form 1040 line 26. For Form 2210 it is treated as paid January 15, 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_BACKUP_WITHHOLDIN: Form 1041 K-1 box 13 code B backup withholding, counted once on Form 1040 line 25c, not subtracted from income or capital gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_LINE33E_ROYALTY_D: Fiduciary-apportioned box 9 royalty deductions on Schedule E line 33 column (e), separate from gross royalties in column (f). These deductions reduce income once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_LINE33F_ROYALTIES: Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 5 gross royalties: Schedule E line 33, column (f). Directly apportioned royalty deductions are separate in column (e), not netted from this income column.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N: Fiduciary-allocated successor NOL box total, with each original estate/trust loss year preserved; regular and AMT deductions and carryforwards are calculated separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_14F_GROSS_FARMI: Form 1041 K-1 box 14 code F gross farming and fishing income included in box 6, shown on Schedule E line 42 for the Form 2210 farmer and fisherman two-thirds test; it adds no income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_2: Beneficiary-share Form 1041 K-1 amount carried to the corresponding Form 1040, Schedule D or Schedule E line; qualified dividends and special long-term gain classes are included in, not added to, their parent totals. Royalty-only box 5 enters Schedule E line 33(f).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_3: Final-year Form 1041 K-1 box 11 capital loss carryover allocated to the beneficiary succeeding to property; short-term code C reaches Schedule D line 5 and long-term code D reaches line 12, with unused losses retained by character.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_ESTATE_TAX: Fiduciary-allocated section 691(c) estate-tax deduction attributable solely to taxable box 1 IRD interest; claim on Schedule A line 17e only when itemizing.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_N_BUSINESS_APPO: Form 1041 K-1 box 9 codes A–C directly apportioned to the box 6 activity, deducted once against that activity on Schedule E line 33 column (c) or (e); the same amount applies for AMT and net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_N_BUSINESS_INCO: Form 1041 K-1 box 6 ordinary business income in which you materially participated: nonpassive, Schedule E line 33 column (f), outside Form 8582 and reversed out of net investment income on Form 8960 line 4b.

Form 1041 K-1 box 6 ordinary business income without material participation: passive, Schedule E line 33 column (d), available on Form 8582 against other passive losses and included in net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_N_OTHER_RENTAL_: Form 1041 K-1 box 9 codes A–C directly apportioned to the box 8 activity, deducted once against that activity on Schedule E line 33 column (c); the same amount applies for AMT and net investment income.
Form 1041 K-1 box 8 other rental income: passive, Schedule E line 33 column (d), available on Form 8582 against other passive losses and included in net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ESTATE_TRUST_N_N_N_RENTAL_REAL_E: Form 1041 K-1 box 9 codes A–C directly apportioned to the box 7 activity, deducted once against that activity on Schedule E line 33 column (c); the same amount applies for AMT and net investment income.

Form 1041 K-1 box 7 net rental real estate income: passive, Schedule E line 33 column (d), available on Form 8582 against other passive losses (no special allowance applies to income) and included in net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCESS_BUSINESS_LOSS: 2026 Form 461 adds back net business loss beyond $256,000 ($512,000 joint); employee wages do not increase that limit. The disallowed amount carries forward as an NOL.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCESS_BUSINESS_LOSS_CARRYFORWAR: Form 461 disallowed loss carried to the following year, shown separately from the current-year Form 172 NOL. Included once in the total NOL carryforward below.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE15: Cash you received, plus the value of other property you received, plus loans the other side took over from you net of the loans you took on and the cash you paid, less your exchange expenses (not below zero).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE16: Fair market value of the like-kind property you received.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE18: Adjusted basis of the rental you gave up (land and buildings less depreciation allowed or allowable through the month you gave it up), plus the net loans you took on and cash you paid, plus the exchange expenses not used on line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE19: Realized gain or (loss): line 17 less line 18.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE20: The smaller of line 15 or line 19, not below zero: the gain recognized because you also received cash or other property. A loss is never recognized.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE21: Ordinary income under the recapture rules, always zero here: a building depreciated straight line after 1986 has no additional depreciation to recapture (Form 4797 line 17 in the 2026 draft).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE22: Line 20 less line 21: section 1231 gain on property held more than one year, to Form 4797 line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE24: Deferred gain or (loss): line 19 less line 23. It reduces the basis of the property you received.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE25: Basis of the like-kind property you received: line 18 plus line 23 less line 15, which is its value less the deferred gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_LINE25A: Part of that basis in the building, in proportion to values. The part up to the adjusted depreciable basis of the building you gave up continues its depreciation; any excess is depreciated as new property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_EXCHANGE_SECTION1231: Section 1231 gain recognized in a like-kind exchange (Form 8824 line 22), Form 4797 line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FAMILY_LEAVE_1099G: Paid family leave benefits (Form 1099-G box 10) on Schedule 1 line 8z under Rev. Rul. 2025-4; only the includible family-leave portion, with no medical-leave amount present. Not wages, self-employment earnings, EIC or IRA compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM126_BASIS: A wholly qualified, fully funded improvement uses the supported owner contribution plus taxable improvement income. Mixed funding uses actual improvement cost less the actual excluded funding applied, separately from the income-right appraisal.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM126_RECAPTURE_PORTION: The section 1255 source is the regulation's applicable excludable portion after the actual partial or full no-exclusion election. It is not government cash minus taxable income and is not capped at improvement value minus owner contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM126_TAXABLE: Qualified improvement income is its economic value minus the owner contribution and the applicable supported excludable portion, with no negative income. Separately identified nonqualified payments are added to taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM126_VALUE: The improvement fair market value is multiplied by qualified section 126 cost divided by total improvement cost. This economic benefit differs from government cash financing.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARMING_FISHING_GROSS_INCOME_N: Gross income from farming or fishing for the farmer and fisherman estimated-tax test: Schedule F line 9, Form 1041 K-1 box 14 code F, Form 1065 K-1 box 14 code B and commercial fishing Schedule C line 7.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_ACCRUAL_SUBTOTAL: Accrual gross receipts before opening inventory, purchases and closing inventory.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_AVERAGING: Schedule J ordinary-farm election. The current-year reduced-income tax uses the applicable 2026 Tax Table or special worksheet; base-year recomputation uses the IRS rate schedules, not filing Tax Table intervals.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_AVERAGING_N_N: Retained base-year income/tax and rate-schedule recomputation after one-third of elected ordinary farm income. Prior returns and carryovers are not amended by this allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_AVERAGING_QBI_DEDUCTION: Farm-attributable QBI deduction from the same activity calculation after loss netting and wage/property limits. REIT and nonfarm components are not subtracted from eligible farm income. Mixed overall-income-cap and minimum-deduction attribution remains unresolved.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_CONSERVATION_AMT_CARRY: The unused AMT section 175 cost remains separate from regular-tax carry and from an assessment's nine-year spread.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_CONSERVATION_AMT_DEDUCTION: The section 175 AMT deduction uses the same legal gross-income cap with the parcel's separate retained AMT carry amounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_CUSTOM_HIRE: Custom-hire receipts, separately identified from production income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_AVERAGING_ELECT: The selected ordinary farm election limited to Form 1062 reduced taxable income for this comparison only; no new actual election is made.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_AVERAGING_N_N: Form 1062 comparison only: Schedule J allocation after its reduced taxable-income ceiling. Actual election and retained base-year records are unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_ACTUAL_CREDIT: Form 1062 applicable foreign and personal credits, including personal credits against AMT. Section 53 minimum-tax credit is excluded from this comparison and remains on the actual return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_ACTUAL_FOREIG: Form 1062 line 4a: the actual payee-statement foreign tax credit, before personal credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_ACTUAL_REGULA: Form 1062 line 3: regular income tax plus premium-credit repayment, before applicable credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_APPLICABLE: Form 1062 line 14: tax attributable to all elected sales; this is a deferral offset, not withholding or a payment made.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_CURRENT: Annual tax less deferred liability, before other payments and refundable credits. A negative position contributes to the estimated overpayment; annual tax and future installments remain unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_ELECTED_GAIN: Form 1062 line 7: all elected gains together, not independent per-sale tax differences.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_FIRST: Form 1062 line 15: first 25% installment, rounded to a whole dollar, due without a filing extension.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_REDUCED_CREDI: Form 1062 line 12z: aggregate refigured foreign and personal credits cannot exceed reduced regular liability; eligibility and phaseout amounts are retained.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_REDUCED_FOREI: Form 1062 line 12a: payee-statement credit re-limited to reduced regular tax; no election-year carryover.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_REDUCED_REGUL: Form 1062 line 11: refigured regular income tax plus unchanged premium-credit repayment; credit limits use this liability.
Form 1062 line 9: shared tax worksheet using redetermined gain character and the comparison-specific capped Schedule J worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_REDUCED_TAXAB: Form 1062 line 8: actual taxable income less elected gains; AGI and deductions are unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_REGULAR_ADDIT: Form 1062 lines 2 and 10: unchanged premium-credit repayment from actual household MAGI, coverage and advance payments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_INSTALLMENT_N_REMAINING: Liability deferred after the first installment; remains owed and may accelerate on default or death.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_LAND_1255_RECAPTURE: Section 1255 recapture is limited to positive gain remaining after other PartIV ordinary recapture. Its actual exclusion history uses the last certified payment date and the statutory ten-to-twenty-year percentages. Installment gain takes section 1252 first, then section 1255, as each payment's gain is recognized.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_LAND_INSTALLMENT_RECAPTURE_: Retain this remaining ordinary recapture pool with the original sale and payment records. Each later payment's recognized gain takes remaining section 1252 first, then section 1255, before residual section 1231 gain. This is not immediate section 453(i) depreciation recapture.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_LAND_RETAINED_PART: The selected parcel's original opening basis and prior deductions are reduced only by their actual recorded sold-tract amounts. These balances belong to the retained land; they are not another current deduction or gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_ACCRUAL_SALES: Sales recognized under the accrual method, including products raised and purchased.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_ADVANCES: Current advances included under section 77; prior taxed loans are not included again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_FORFEITURE: Current-year forfeiture principal not previously taxed; earlier forfeitures are not taxed again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_FORFEITURE_REPORTED: Full current forfeiture principal for Schedule F line 5b or 40b, including income-elected loans; only the separate taxable amount enters income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_INCOME: CCC income before the separate paid-deficiency expense enters farm receipts once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_MARKET_GAIN: Current redemption market gain before the prior-inclusion exclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_PAID_DEFICIENCY: Required deficiency actually paid this year for an income-included loan: included once in farm expenses, not a reduction of gross receipts or a repeat deduction of previously taxed principal.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_RETAINED_BASIS: Basis of unsold commodities; retain individual loan and redemption records for later disposition.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_SALES_NET: Sale proceeds less commodity basis; losses remain deductible farm losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_SALES_NET_CASH: Recognized CCC commodity sales before the farm's shared opening/closing inventory adjustment; do not deduct cash-method basis again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_SURPLUS: Additional CCC proceeds recognized in 2026 under the farm accounting method, including after an earlier forfeiture; principal and released deficiencies are not deducted again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_TAXABLE_MARKET_GAIN: Market gain is taxable only for loans not previously included in income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CCC_WITHHOLDING: Actual current-year federal withholding, independent of principal inclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CLOSING_INVENTORY: Closing tax inventory, added once in Schedule F Part III.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CONSERVATION_INCOME_LIMIT: Shared section 175 limit: 25% of the same taxpayer's combined supported gross farming income, before farm operating expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_COOPERATIVE_DISTRIBUTIONS: Total Form 1099-PATR distributions routed to this farm: patronage dividends, nonpatronage distributions, per-unit retain allocations and redeemed nonqualified notices (Schedule F line 3a).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_COOPERATIVE_TAXABLE: Taxable cooperative distributions after the personal-purchase dividends reported on line 3a only (Schedule F line 3b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CRP_N_INCOME: Taxable CRP income included once in farm profit, on Schedule F lines 4a and 4b (39a and 39b on the accrual method); an SE exclusion does not remove this income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CRP_N_SE_EXCLUSION: Schedule SE line 1b: qualifying payments excluded from SE and applicable earned-income limits, not taxable farm profit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_CRP_N_WITHHOLDING: Actual current-year federal withholding credited once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_DEPRECIATION: Depreciation and section 179 expense: bonus, MACRS and the allowed section 179 deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSES: Farm operating expenses and supported shared deductions, including their applicable limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE13_CUSTOM_HIR: Schedule F line 13: custom hire (machine work) where the operator furnished the equipment; equipment you rented and operated yourself is line 24a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE15_EMPLOYEE_B: Schedule F line 15: employee benefit programs other than pension and profit-sharing plans on line 23.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE17_FERTILIZER: Schedule F line 17: fertilizers and lime.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE18_FREIGHT_AN: Schedule F line 18: freight and trucking; transportation of livestock bought for resale is part of its cost instead.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE19_GASOLINE_F: Schedule F line 19: gasoline, fuel and oil.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE20_INSURANCE: Schedule F line 20: insurance, other than health.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE21A_MORTGAGE_: Schedule F line 21a: mortgage interest paid to banks or other financial institutions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE21C_OTHER_INT: Schedule F line 21c: other farm interest; interest on a loan to buy a farm vehicle belongs on line 21b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE22_LABOR_HIRE: Schedule F line 22: labor hired for farm work, wages and contract labor, less any employment credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE23_PENSION_AN: Schedule F line 23: contributions to employees' pension, profit-sharing or annuity plans; your own contributions as a self-employed person are Schedule 1 line 16.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE24A_RENT_VEHI: Schedule F line 24a: rent or lease of vehicles, machinery and equipment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE24B_RENT_OTHE: Schedule F line 24b: rent or lease of other property, such as pasture or farmland.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE25_REPAIRS: Schedule F line 25: repairs and maintenance of farm buildings, machinery and equipment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE26_SEEDS_AND_: Schedule F line 26: seeds and plants.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE27_STORAGE_AN: Schedule F line 27: storage and warehousing.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE29_TAXES: Schedule F line 29: taxes on farm business assets and the employer's payroll taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE30_UTILITIES: Schedule F line 30: utilities for business use on the farm.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE31_VETERINARY: Schedule F line 31: veterinary, breeding and medicine.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_ADVERTISIN: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses, advertising.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_CCC_DEFICI: Schedule F lines 32a–32f: a required CCC loan deficiency payment actually paid in 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_COMMISSION: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses, commissions and fees.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_LEGAL_AND_: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses, legal and professional fees.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_MEALS: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses, deductible meals after the 50% ordinary or 80% DOT hours-of-service limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_OFFICE: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses, office expense.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_OTHER: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses entered with their own description.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_PREPAID_SU: Schedule F lines 32a–32f: the deduction for prepaid farm supplies and released earlier prepayments, after the one-half-of-other-expenses ceiling.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_STARTUP_AM: Schedule F lines 32a–32f: the start-up cost deduction, the amortization of start-up costs and the section 197 amortization.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_EXPENSE_LINE32_TRAVEL: Schedule F lines 32a–32e: other expenses, travel.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_GROSS_INCOME: Farm gross income after product basis or the accrual inventory reconciliation, before operating expenses, including fuel-tax credit or refund income and the 2026 part of a section 481(a) increase (line 8), any Form 1099-G box 7 agriculture-program payment and taxable Form 1099-PATR distributions routed to this farm.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_LAND_N_N_CONSERVATION_REC: Section 1252 ordinary recapture, limited by gain and the holding-period percentage of prior allowed conservation deductions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_LAND_N_N_GAIN: Land proceeds less selling expenses and retained basis (for an installment sale, the part in 2026's payments, Form 6252 line 24); not Schedule F operating receipts or self-employment earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_LAND_N_N_ORDINARY: Direct Form 4797 ordinary amount before downstream return coordination; includes all gain/loss for land held one year or less.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_LAND_N_N_SECTION1231: Eligible long-held land amount after conservation recapture, before return-wide section 1231 netting and five-year lookback.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_NET_PROFIT: Schedule F profit included once in Schedule 1, self-employment earnings and applicable QBI/deduction calculations, including any Form 1099-G box 7 agriculture-program payment and taxable Form 1099-PATR distributions routed to this farm.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CONSERVATION_ASSESSMENT: District assessment amounts available this year, including statutory acceleration on the farm owner's final return; subject next to the 25% farming-income limit.
Paid assessment costs treated as paid in later years of the nine-year spread; separate from the 25%-limited carryforward and future unpaid installments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CONSERVATION_BASIS_ADDI: Capitalized conservation payments to retain with land basis; no current deduction or automatic update of another property record.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CONSERVATION_CARRYFORWA: Unused section 175 deduction for later years, subject again to their gross-farm-income limit; do not also add this balance to land basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CONSERVATION_DEDUCTION: Section 175 costs and prior unused deduction, limited to 25% of gross farming income; included once in Schedule F expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CONSERVATION_EXPIRED: The deceased farm owner's unused section 175 income-limited balance expires; it is not transferred to a survivor or estate and is not added to land basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CROP_INSURANCE_BEFORE_D: Current crop-insurance and disaster proceeds recognized before the election; exclude duplicate subsidy entries.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CROP_INSURANCE_CURRENT_: Current-year proceeds less the amount elected into 2027 (Schedule F line 6b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CROP_INSURANCE_DEFERRED: Eligible current physical-loss proceeds elected into 2027; retain the amount for next year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CROP_INSURANCE_PRIOR_IN: 2025 deferred proceeds included once in 2026; not eligible for another deferral.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CROP_INSURANCE_TAXABLE: Insurance and disaster income included once in farm gross income, SE earnings and QBI.
