StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_N_CROP_INSURANCE_WITHHOLD: Actual 2026 federal withholding remains a payment credit even if eligible income is deferred.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_OPENING_INVENTORY: Opening tax inventory, subtracted once in Schedule F Part III.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_OTHER_ACCRUAL_INCOME: Recognized custom-hire, ordinary program and other operating income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_PRODUCT_PURCHASES: Accrued product purchases, subtracted once; unsold inventory remains in closing valuation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_PROGRAM_PAYMENTS: Agricultural program payments received: program payments, Conservation Reserve Program payments, CCC loan market gain, any Form 1099-G box 7 payment routed to this farm and any cost-sharing payment (Schedule F line 4a).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_PROGRAM_TAXABLE: Taxable agricultural program payments: the fully taxable payments, CRP payments and the market gain on a loan not included in income (Schedule F line 4b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_RAISED_SALES: Schedule F line 2: raised products and market livestock receipts, including a redeemed CCC commodity sold whose loan was not included in income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_RESALE_BASIS: Schedule F line 1b: paid basis of purchased products sold, deducted once; a redeemed CCC commodity's basis is its redemption payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_RESALE_NET: Schedule F line 1c is sales of purchased products less their actual undeducted cost, including the current weather-election adjustment only once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_RESALE_PROCEEDS: Schedule F line 1a: purchased products sold, proceeds before basis, including a redeemed CCC commodity sold whose loan was included in income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_SUPPLIES_N_DEDUCTION: Current deduction for this farm's prepayments and released costs, included once in operating expenses. Supported same-owner cash farms share one expense ceiling; the deduction retains its source farm.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_SUPPLIES_N_ELIGIBLE: Eligible new supply prepayments and payment-method unsold resale-poultry purchases, before the expense ceiling. Supply purchase, business-purpose and income-distortion tests apply separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_SUPPLIES_N_POULTRY_DISPOS: Current purchase costs and previously undeducted costs of resale poultry disposed of this year. Included in the total supply deduction below; do not deduct again against sales receipts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_SUPPLIES_N_PRODUCTION_POU: Production-poultry costs paid in 2025 but deferred by its prepaid ceiling release in 2026. Included once in the released-cost subtotal and current deduction; sale is not a prerequisite.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_SUPPLIES_N_RELEASED: Earlier undeducted supplies consumed, resale-poultry costs disposed of, and eligible 2025 production-poultry deferrals released this year; deducted once and included in other deductible expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_N_SUPPLIES_N_REMAINING: Undeducted supply cost retained after this year's deduction; preserve identified cost and consumption records for subsequent returns.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_OTHER_INCOME: Other farm income, including supported signed hedge settlements and the existing method-change and fuel-tax recovery owners exactly once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_PARCEL_BASIS: The canonical parcel opening or acquisition basis includes each supported live improvement adjustment once. Prior exclusion and conservation histories are retained recapture facts, not a second basis subtraction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_PRODUCTION_CAPITALIZED: Current section 263A allocation subtracted once after showing the unreduced production expense categories. Other mandatory capital costs remain outside ordinary expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_PRODUCTION_POULTRY_CURRENT_: Current part of the actual whole-month ratable period, treated as other deductible expense for the prepaid ceiling.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_PRODUCTION_POULTRY_PREPAID_: Following-year part of the actual lesser-of-12-months/useful-life period; only this part enters the shared prepaid pool.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_PRODUCTION_RETAINED_BASIS: Opening unrecovered source basis plus current required capital allocations less actual released cost. Do not repeat this cohort in ordinary expenses or inventory balances.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_PRODUCT_COST: Opening inventory plus product purchases less closing inventory; a negative amount increases gross income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_CAR_AND_TRUCK: Form 4835 line 8: car and truck expenses of this rental's vehicles, without the vehicle-loan interest shown on line 19b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_COOPERATIVE_DISTRI: Form 4835 line 2a: Form 1099-PATR distributions routed to this rental.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_COOPERATIVE_TAXABL: Form 4835 line 2b: the taxable part of those distributions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_DEPRECIATION: Form 4835 line 12: depreciation of this rental's property. Section 179 is not figured for a farm rental.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSES: Form 4835 line 31: total expenses, including the section 175 conservation deduction and any CCC deficiency paid.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE13_EMP: Form 4835 line 13: employee benefit programs other than on line 21.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE17_GAS: Form 4835 line 17: gasoline, fuel and oil.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE18_INS: Form 4835 line 18: insurance other than health.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE19A_MO: Form 4835 line 19a: mortgage interest paid to banks.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE20_LAB: Form 4835 line 20: labor hired, less employment credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE21_PEN: Form 4835 line 21: pension and profit-sharing plans.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE22A_RE: Form 4835 line 22a: rent or lease of vehicles, machinery and equipment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE22B_RE: Form 4835 line 22b: rent or lease of other property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE29_VET: Form 4835 line 29: veterinary, breeding and medicine.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE30_MEA: Form 4835 line 30: business meals at 50%, one of the other expenses on lines 30a to 30f.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE30_OTH: Form 4835 line 30: other expenses, lines 30a to 30f.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_GROSS_INCOME: Form 4835 line 7: gross farm rental income, lines 1, 2b, 3b, 4a, 4c, 5b, 5d and 6, which is also Schedule E line 42 income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_LINE34C_ALLOWED_LO: Form 4835 line 34c: the loss allowed after Form 6198 and Form 8582, which goes to Schedule E line 40.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_NET_INCOME: Form 4835 line 32: net farm rental income or loss. A rental that is income only before its prior-year unallowed losses shows zero (PAL); the loss goes to Form 8582 and line 34c.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_OTHER_INCOME: Form 4835 line 6: other income, including any CCC surplus above the loan.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_PRODUCTION: Form 4835 line 1: crop and livestock shares sold in 2026 or converted to money, with the net of a redeemed CCC commodity that was sold.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_PROGRAM_PAYMENTS: Form 4835 line 3a: agricultural program payments, Form 1099-G box 7 payments routed to this rental and CCC market gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_PROGRAM_TAXABLE: Form 4835 line 3b: the taxable part of those payments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_SUSPENDED_LOSS: Passive loss of this farm rental that Form 8582 does not allow in 2026; it carries to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_RENTAL_N_VEHICLE_LOAN_INTER: Form 4835 line 19b: the business share of interest on loans for this rental's vehicles.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_SUPPLIES_AMT_DEDUCTION: Current allowed supply costs using the AMT other-expense ceiling and separate retained AMT cost.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_SUPPLIES_AMT_REMAINING: Net unrecovered supply cost retained for AMT after its current allowance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_WEATHER_POSTPONED: Section 451(g) class income postponed to the following year; not another current expense.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FARM_WEATHER_PRIOR_INCLUDED: Prior-year section 451(g) income included once in this year, retaining product character.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES: Annual taxable ABLE earnings after qualified disability expenses enter Schedule 1 line 8q. Form 5329 Part II adds 10% per recipient; principal and qualifying rollovers or post-death payments are excluded. Timely excess-contribution corrections include earnings in the contribution year without the 10% tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_10: Unused capital loss after the annual limit and actual use against unfloored taxable income with the section 151 enhanced senior deduction added back; short-term losses are used first. The additional age/blindness standard deduction is not added back. A selected section 1341 credit uses the refigured restoration-year balance under section 1341(b)(4).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_11: Preferential income included in Form 8615 line 5 after the applicable deduction allocation. Available for other affected children's family worksheets.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_12: Original gain source before Form 8615 deduction allocation, for coordinating another child's return. Special-rate amounts precede the net-capital-gain cap.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_13: Separate AMT capital netting, personal-loss disallowance and special-rate pools using retained sale basis and AMT loss history; does not change regular AGI or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_14: Separate AMT capital-loss carryover after actual use against unfloored AMTI, before the AMT exemption. Preserve short/long character and retain separately from regular carryovers. A selected section 1341 credit uses the refigured restoration-year balance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_15: Aggregate investment-related itemized deductions are limited to total itemized deductions allowed after section 68. The 2026 law applies that limitation after Form 4952 and has no former investment-interest exception.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_16: Current-year loss carryover after separate regular/AMT debt reduction. The original loss and current tax are unchanged; carryovers retain only the post-reduction balance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_2: Combined Form 8853 Section B. Taxable distributions enter Schedule 1 line 8e; the separate additional tax enters Schedule 2. Medical withdrawals are not also deductible.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_3: 2026 regular IRA contribution treatment. Nondeductible traditional amounts require Form 8606 and basis records; this prototype prepares no forms.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_5: Form 4952 investment-property pool, distinct from Schedule D totals. Personal/home dispositions are excluded; confirmed investment losses and carryovers are netted, including both ordinary and capital portions of section 1244 losses. Nonbusiness royalties contribute after directly deductible expenses. Qualified dividends and net capital gain are excluded from ordinary investment income without an election.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_6: 2026 Schedule 1-A deduction after claimant eligibility, annual limits and income phaseout. Does not reduce AGI or payroll tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_7: Qualified/nonqualified portion of the same excess-business-loss NOL carryforward, allocated from loss-only source activities. Qualified suspended loss is excluded from current QBI carryforward until deductible; these details are not additional NOL amounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_8: Separate regular and AMT investment-interest limits. Disallowed expense carries forward; choosing the standard deduction does not carry forward interest that the income limit allowed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FEDERAL_RULES_9: Form 8615 line 1, the child's unearned income. Form 8615 applies when it is more than $2,700.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FINAL_BOND_INTEREST_N: Mandatory annual-method accrual or elected deferred-method interest through death: redemption value less cost and previously reported interest. Preserve this record for the recipient; do not include it again in another income entry.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FINAL_BOND_RECIPIENT_INTEREST_N: Unreported pre-death interest left for the estate or beneficiary under the no-election choice. Post-death earnings are separate and are not calculated here. This amount is not included in the decedent's taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FIRST_HOME_USED_TAXPAYER: Lifetime first-home IRA amount used through 2026, including the opening history. Retain for later returns.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_AMT_HIGH_TAX_NET_INCOME: Net passive income reclassified independently for AMT after AMT-allowed deductions and the applicable 26% or 28% rate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_AMT_HIGH_TAX_TAXES: Foreign taxes moved with high-taxed income to the AMT general category; regular classification can differ.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_AMT_LINE_N_RATE_ADJUSTME: AMT Worksheet for Line 18: Form 6251 line 23 plus 0.4643 of line 30, 0.2857 of line 33 and 0.1071 of line 36; zero under the adjustment exception or when no adjustment is required.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_AMT_QUALIFIED_DIVIDEND_A: AMT Form 1116 line 1a: foreign qualified dividends taxed at 0% are left out and those taxed at 15% or 20% are kept at 0.5357 or 0.7143.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_BUSINESS_N_N: One Form 2555 limit for this person's combined qualifying business receipts and employee pay. Business exclusion is its proportional share. Excluded receipts disallow proportional business expenses and half-SE deduction. Net exclusion reduces Schedule 1 income while SE tax remains computed on full business profit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_CAPITAL_WORKSHEET: A line of the Form 1116 adjustment worksheet for foreign capital gains and losses; the worksheet is kept for your records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_EARNED_EXCLUSION: Gross foreign earned-income exclusion before restoring deductions related to excluded business receipts; limited to $132,900 per person in 2026, prorated for qualifying days.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_EARNED_N_N_DAYS: Form 2555 lines 31 and 38: the qualifying days in 2026 of the bona fide residence or the 12-month physical presence period, which prorate the exclusion limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_EARNED_N_N_INCOME: Form 2555 line 26: this person's foreign earned income, W-2 pay for work abroad plus pay from a foreign employer plus receipts of businesses run abroad.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_EMPLOYEE_N_GROSS_EXCLUSI: Employee share of this person's combined foreign earned-income exclusion. Business receipts share the same cap; this amount is included in the total gross exclusion, not added again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_GENERAL_AMT_EXCLUDED_TAX: The same reduction of foreign taxes on excluded foreign earned income applies to the alternative minimum tax foreign tax credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_GENERAL_AMT_UNUSED_TAX: Separate AMT foreign tax balance; keep it distinct from the regular-tax balance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_GENERAL_EXCLUDED_TAX_RED: Form 1116 line 12: foreign tax on foreign earned income excluded on Form 2555 is not creditable (section 911(d)(6)); the employment taxes fall by the excluded share.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_GENERAL_UNUSED_TAX: Current-year foreign tax exceeding the category limitation; review the one-year carryback and ten-year carryforward rules separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HIGH_TAX_NET_INCOME: Net passive income reclassified to general income after regular-tax expense allocation and the 37% high-tax test.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HIGH_TAX_TAXES: Foreign taxes moved with high-taxed income to the regular general category.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_DEDUCTION: Self-employed housing deduction, including allowed prior-year carryover. Reported separately from the income exclusion in Schedule 1 adjustments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_EXCLUSION: Housing exclusion allocated to employer-provided foreign income before the earned-income exclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_N_N: Current housing deduction is limited by foreign earned income after gross exclusions and used before the prior-year carryover. Unused current amount carries one year; unused prior-year amount expires.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_N_N_BASE: This claimant's full qualifying-period base housing amount; each separate claimant subtracts their own base.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_N_N_EXCLUSION: Eligible expenses limited by location, less the base housing amount and nontaxable housing allowances, capped at this claimant's employer-provided foreign earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_N_N_EXPENSES: This claimant's eligible housing expenses before the location limit and base amount; excludes amounts allocated to the other spouse.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_N_N_LIMIT: Sum of published location expense limits for this claimant's qualifying stays, combining repeated locations.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_HOUSING_N_N_NONTAXABLE_A: Tax-free housing allowance paid to the claimant or spouse for this qualifying period; reduces the limited housing amount, not foreign wages.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_INCOME_TAX_DEDUCTION: Foreign income taxes deducted on Schedule A line 6, outside the state and local tax limit, after removing taxes on excluded foreign earnings and applying K-1 basis limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_INVESTMENT_N_GROUP_N: Allowed investment interest allocated by current-year average adjusted basis, including released prior disallowed interest. Regular deduction reflects section 68; AMT uses its independent deduction and basis. Groups0–4 precede high-tax reclassification; group5 is domestic.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_INVESTMENT_TAX_DEDUCTION: The deducted foreign income taxes attributable to net investment income join Form 8960 line 9b, subject to the overall allowed itemized-deduction limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_K3_DEFINITELY_RELATED_DE: Form 1116 line 2: Schedule K-3 Part II section 2 deductions of columns (c) and (d) (lines 25, 26, 31 through 37 and 44 through 50), already allocated to the passive and general categories; column (f) deductions are apportioned by gross income on line 3b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FOREIGN_K3_GROSS_INCOME_CORRECTI: Form 1116 line 3e: each Schedule K-3's Part II line 24 gross income in place of its K-1's net Schedule E amount and its interest and dividends (box 5 and 6a; Form 1120-S boxes 4 and 5a) already in adjusted gross income.

StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_2210_F_NO_PENALTY_9: Line 9 is less than $1,000: no penalty.

StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PERSONAL_GAINS: Personal-use casualty gains from reimbursement above basis. They offset eligible undeclared losses first, then ordinary and qualified declared-disaster losses; recognized excess enters Schedule D.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PERSONAL_LOSS_AFTER_AGI: Provisional 2026 Form 4684 line 18: ordinary personal-use disaster loss after its 10%-of-AGI reduction. Claimed only on the itemized route.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PERSONAL_LOSS_AFTER_EVENT: Form 4684 line 14: declared-disaster losses after $100 per ordinary event or $500 per qualified major-disaster event, plus undeclared losses after $100 per event only up to current personal casualty gains. Before gain and AGI reductions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PERSONAL_NET_AFTER_GAINS: Personal-use disaster losses after event reductions and casualty gains, before the ordinary-loss 10%-of-AGI reduction. Qualified major-disaster loss bypasses that AGI reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_COST: Original purchase cost recorded with the 2025 Form 8283 Section A and valuation evidence; the 50%-class contribution was limited to the lower used-item fair market value.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_N_VALUE: Original 2025 Form 8283 Section A fair market value of the personally purchased furnishing. It is evidence for the carryover, not another 2026 contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_PRIOR_INCOME_TAX: Form 8978 line 12: verified 2025 ordinary income tax before the BBA-audit portfolio-interest change.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_SECTION_A_VALUE: Publicly traded stock at FMV or elected reduced basis, personally purchased clothing, household goods, books or jewelry in similar-property groups of $5,000 or less, and qualifying Section A vehicle claims, reportable in Form 8283 Section A before income limits and the 2026 charitable floor. Public stock stays in Section A without an appraisal even above $5,000. Attach required acknowledgments and the form to a filed return; this on-screen estimate does not prepare the attachment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_SECTION_B_VALUE: Personally purchased clothing, household goods, books or jewelry in similar-property groups over $5,000, plus FMV-based road-vehicle exception claims whose similar-vehicle group exceeds $5,000, before income limits and the 2026 charitable floor, reportable in Form 8283 Section B. Gross-proceeds-limited vehicles stay in Section A. Each affected gift needs a qualified appraisal and each donee needs the required appraisal summary and signatures; this on-screen estimate does not prepare or attach the form.

StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_UNUSABLE_DECREASE: Negative Form 8978 amount remaining after the Schedule 3 and Schedule 2 limits. It does not increase a refund or reduce other additional taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_FORM_N_WAIVER_REQUESTED_AMOUNT: Form 2210 Part II box B: amount of the penalty requested to be waived (at most the penalty), subtracted from the penalty to give line 19. The IRS decides the waiver; attach your explanation and documentation.

StringResources.EXPLAIN_GAMBLING_WINNINGS: Casual gambling winnings enter Schedule 1 in full, without netting itemized losses against income.

StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_11: Part II line 13: 25% of net regular tax over $25,000 ($12,500 married filing separately unless the spouse has no business credit).

StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_13: Part II line 15: the greater of lines 13 and 14.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_14: Part II line 16: line 11 less line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_15: Part II line 17: credit allowed after the section 38(c)(1) limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_16: Part II line 26: empowerment zone employment credit; none on this return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_17: Part II line 27: line 11 less line 13.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_19: Part II line 29: room for specified credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_2: Part I line 2: passive credits not allowed against tentative minimum tax, current and carried, before Form 8582-CR.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_20: Part II line 30: current nonpassive specified credits (Part III line 5, column (e)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_21: Part II line 32: passive specified credits, current and carried, before Form 8582-CR.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_22: Part II line 33: passive specified credits allowed by Form 8582-CR (line 37).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_23: Part II line 34: nonpassive specified carryforwards to 2026 (Part IV line 5, column (f)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_25: Part II line 37: specified credits allowed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_26: Part II line 38 and Schedule 3 line 6a: general business credit allowed for 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_3: Part I line 3: passive credits allowed by Form 8582-CR (line 37).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_4: Part I line 4: nonpassive carryforwards to 2026 of credits not allowed against tentative minimum tax (Part IV line 6, column (f)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_6: Part II line 7: Form 1040 line 16 and Schedule 2 line 1z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_7: Part II line 8: Form 6251 line 11 alternative minimum tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GENERAL_BUSINESS_CREDIT_N_9: Part II line 11: net income tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_GROSS_INCOME_N: Total gross income for the farmer and fisherman estimated-tax test: the return's income (not loss) amounts, with each business's gross income in place of its net profit. The test is met when farming and fishing is at least two-thirds of this.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HEALTH_ACCOUNT_EXCESS_FORM: The prior excess is reduced by taxable distributions and unused contribution room. The remaining prior excess and current excess are combined, and the additional tax is limited by the retained account value. Contribution and account amounts include cents; additional tax is rounded to whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HEALTH_LOAN_INTEREST_REMOVED: Health-service program-paid interest removed from the student-loan interest claim before the cap and phaseout.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HEALTH_LOAN_N_EXCLUDED: Qualifying health-service loan repayment assistance excluded from income. Program-paid interest cannot also be deducted; disclosed overlap is removed before the student-loan deduction cap and phaseout.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOBBY_SALES_INCOME: Ordinary hobby goods sales less calculated cost of goods sold, floored at zero, on Schedule 1 line 8j. No operating-expense deduction, business loss, QBI or self-employment tax. Property-sale gain remains subject to applicable net investment income tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_KEROSENE_FUEL_4A: Form 4136 line 4a, type of use 8: home-use undyed kerosene at 24.3 cents per gallon. This is the business-information exception, a payment credit and not taxable business income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_ADJUSTMENT: Form 8949 Part II box F column (g) adjustment for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_ADJUSTMENT_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part II box F column (g) adjustment for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_BASIS: Form 8949 Part II box F column (e) basis for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_BASIS_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part II box F column (e) basis for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_GAIN: Form 8949 Part II box F column (h) gain for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_GAIN_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part II box F column (h) gain for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_PROCEEDS: Form 8949 Part II box F column (d) proceeds for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_LONG_PROCEEDS_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part II box F column (d) proceeds for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_DEPRECIATION_GAIN: Post-May 6, 1997 depreciation cannot be excluded. This component enters the shared section 1250 gain worksheet, within the total taxable gain, without a second basis reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE15: Form 8824 line 15: the cash and fair market value of other property received, plus loans the other party took over, less your exchange expenses (not below zero).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE16: Form 8824 line 16: the fair market value of the like-kind property received.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE18: Form 8824 line 18: the old home's adjusted basis plus any exchange expenses not used on line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE19: Form 8824 line 19: the realized gain, lines 15 and 16 less line 18. The home exclusion does not reduce it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE20: Form 8824 line 20: the smaller of line 15 less the home exclusion (Rev. Proc. 2005-14) or line 19, not below zero: the recognized gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE24: Form 8824 line 24: the gain deferred, line 19 less the recognized gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCHANGE_LINE25: Form 8824 line 25: the basis of the new property, line 18 plus the recognized gain, less line 15, plus the home exclusion. Use it as the new property's basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_EXCLUDED_GAIN: Section 121 exclusion from ownership, residence and prior-sale facts; excluded gain does not enter AGI or net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_FIRPTA_WITHHOLDING: Tax the buyer withheld from a foreign seller's price and sent in with Form 8288-A, claimed as withholding on Form 1040 line 25c.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_INSTALLMENT_EXCLUSION: The section 121 exclusion, subtracted from the gross profit on line 14 before the gross profit percentage (Pub. 523, Installment Sale).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_NONQUALIFIED_GAIN: Gain allocated by nonqualified days divided by total ownership days, after removing the depreciation component. This amount cannot be excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_REALIZED_GAIN: Selling price less selling expenses and adjusted basis; personal losses are not deductible.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_SEPARATE_BASIS: The separate space's share of the cost, by floor area, less the depreciation taken on it. The rest of the price, expenses and basis is your home's sale.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_SEPARATE_EXPENSES: The separate space's share of the selling expenses, by floor area.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_SEPARATE_GAIN: Gain or loss on the separate space, a section 1231 item on Form 4797 line 2 that the home-sale exclusion does not reach.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_SEPARATE_PRICE: The separate business or rental space's share of the selling price, by floor area (Pub. 523, Business Use or Rental of Home).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_SEPARATE_UNRECAPTURED: The straight-line depreciation on the separate space, up to its gain: unrecaptured section 1250 gain taxed at up to 25% (Schedule D Tax Worksheet).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_N_N_TAXABLE_GAIN: Home-sale gain remaining after exclusion, included once in capital-gain netting.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_ADJUSTMENT: Form 8949 Part I box C column (g) adjustment for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_ADJUSTMENT_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part I box C column (g) adjustment for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_BASIS: Form 8949 Part I box C column (e) basis for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_BASIS_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part I box C column (e) basis for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_GAIN: Form 8949 Part I box C column (h) gain for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_GAIN_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part I box C column (h) gain for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_PROCEEDS: Form 8949 Part I box C column (d) proceeds for the sale of your main home; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOME_SHORT_PROCEEDS_WITH_CODES: Form 8949 Part I box C column (d) proceeds for the sale of your main home, column (f) code {0}; column (h) goes to Schedule D line 3.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HOUSEHOLD_N_N: Schedule H employer liability, including employee taxes collected. Not the employer's income, personal withholding credit or self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_ADDITIONAL_TAX: 20% of nonmedical withdrawals on or before the 65th birthday, except withdrawals after permanent and total disability.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_CONTRIBUTION_CENTS: This owner's Form 8889 Part I detail uses the existing contribution calculation, actual annual Archer contributions, spouse allocation and selected monthly/December method. Monthly worksheet fractions remain in twelfths of cents until each displayed amount is rounded to cents; independently rounded detail rows can differ by a cent from their sum. The actual combined owner limit and return deduction retain their existing rounding. A married-family catch-up is shown separately on line 7; other catch-ups belong in line 3. Line 13 includes eligible prior excess absorbed under Form 5329 line 43 and can exceed current line 2. These are estimate details, not a separately rounded filing-ready form.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_CORRECTION_EARNINGS: Positive attributable earnings on timely returned excess contributions enter other income in the withdrawal year, without ordinary HSA withdrawal tax. Corrected employer principal already in W-2 wages is not added again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_CORRECTION_EMPLOYER_PRINCIPA: Timely returned employer HSA excess principal actually deposited in 2026 and omitted from W-2 wages enters 2026 Schedule 1 other income, even if designated for 2025 or returned in 2027. Corrected principal already in 2026 W-2 wages is not counted again. A 2027 deposit follows 2027 income reporting. This other income is not EIC earnings or IRA compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_DISTRIBUTION_CENTS: Actual classified cents from this owner's accepted statements and completed corrections. The detailed Form 8889 arithmetic retains cents. Pledged assets enter Schedule 1 directly. These are on-screen calculation rows, not filing-ready rounded forms; the separate estimate-transfer rows show the rounded amounts used in this estimate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_DISTRIBUTION_ESTIMATE: This owner's existing estimate transfer rounds taxable distribution income to whole dollars and calculates rounded 20% tax from the rounded actual penalty base. It includes direct pledged-asset amounts. Separate spouses are rounded independently; detailed cents remain visible above.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_DISTRIBUTION_EXCEPTION: One means at least one actual taxable distribution qualifies for the age, disability or death exception; zero means none. The 20% base retains actual dated payment classes, not a residual reconstructed from rounded amounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_FUNDING_BASIS_N_N: Taxable IRA money is used first. This transfer amount consumes basis, removed from the source IRA and not carried into the HSA; later withdrawals use the remaining basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_FUNDING_N_N: Qualified direct IRA funding: excluded from IRA income and early-distribution tax, not deductible, and reduces other HSA contribution capacity. Keep eligibility records through the same month of 2027; a nonexcepted loss in 2026 is recaptured here.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_FUNDING_RECAPTURE: Prior qualified IRA-to-HSA funding included in 2026 income when eligibility first fails in its testing period, except loss caused by death or disability.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_LAST_MONTH_RECAPTURE: Last-month-rule recapture for a first loss in 2026, including prior-year and December 2026 contributions. Income is capped at non-IRA contributions; qualified IRA funding retains its own testing period and is not included twice.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_CORRECTED_CONTRIBUTIONS: Timely corrected 2026 principal removed before calculating eligible contributions; attributable earnings are separately reported in the withdrawal year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_DEEMED: Terminated accounts use January 1 fair market value and date; loan pledges use dated collateral values. No medical or rollover exclusion applies.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_EXCESS_CONTRIBUTION_TAX: Form 5329 Part VII line 49: 6% of the smaller of remaining prior plus current excess or the HSA value at year end including later contributions designated for 2026. This reaches Schedule 2 line 18 and is not a taxable HSA distribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_LAST_MONTH_CONTRIBUTIONS: 2026 contributions above the ordinary monthly limit; continued eligibility through December 31, 2027 is required unless loss is caused by death or disability. This rule does not backdate account establishment for medical reimbursements.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_LATER_EMPLOYER_EXCESS_INCO: Part of the 2026-designated Form 5329 excess came from employer deposits actually made in 2027. Their wage or other-income inclusion belongs to 2027, not this on-screen 2026 return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_LATE_EXCESS_WITHDRAWALS: Prior-year excess withdrawn after its correction deadline is taxable on Form 8889 line 16 even if spent on medical care; it also reduces retained prior excess through Form 5329 line 44.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_N_EXCESS_ACCOUNT_VALUE: All HSA fair market values on December 31, 2026 plus contributions made later and designated for 2026; Form 5329 limits the 6% excise tax to this value.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_N_UNCORRECTED_EMPLOYER_EXC: Employer contributions above the owner's current Form 8889 limit remain in Form 5329 line 47. The part deposited in 2026 and not already included in W-2 wages enters 2026 other income; a 2027 deposit follows 2027 income reporting.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_N_UNCORRECTED_EXCESS: 2026 personal contributions above the available Form 8889 limit remain nondeductible and carry into Form 5329 Part VII. The same original-year excess remains relevant to 2027 unless corrected or absorbed under later-year rules.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_PRIOR_DESIGNATED_EMPLOYER_: Uncorrected 2025-designated employer excess actually deposited in 2026 and omitted from W-2 wages enters 2026 other income, not the 2026 Form 8889 contribution total.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_DEDUCTED_N: Remaining prior excess treated as a 2026 HSA contribution and deducted on Form 8889 line 13 within unused line 12 room.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_REMAINING_N: Prior excess remaining after taxable HSA distributions and unused 2026 contribution room; combined with current excess for Form 5329 line 48.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_PRIOR_EXCESS_N_USED_BY_DIS: Retained 2025 Form 5329 line 48 excess absorbed by taxable 2026 HSA distributions on Form 8889 line 16 before unused contribution room is applied.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_PRIOR_MONTHLY_LIMIT: 2025 monthly contribution limit without the last-month rule, using historical coverage, age-55 catch-up and Archer contributions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_ROLLOVER: Eligible same-owner indirect HSA rollover: excluded from income, not deductible and not counted against ordinary contribution limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_N_UNCORRECTED_EMPLOYER_EXCES: Uncorrected employer HSA excess actually deposited in 2026 and omitted from W-2 wages enters 2026 Schedule 1 other income once. Any excess already in W-2 wages remains there; a later deposit follows 2027 income reporting. This other income is not EIC earnings or IRA compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_TAXABLE_DISTRIBUTIONS: Nonmedical withdrawals and taxable inherited HSA values enter Schedule 1 income. Inherited values have no additional withdrawal tax. Contribution eligibility does not limit withdrawals from an existing account.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_TESTING_OWNER_FORM: This owner's existing whole-dollar estimate amounts for Form 8889 Part III. Last-month and qualified IRA-funding recapture are combined before the single 10% tax calculation; spouses remain separate. This is distinct from ordinary distribution income and its 20% tax. The original source amounts and historical eligibility remain in their existing records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_HSA_TESTING_PERIOD_TAX: Form 8889 Part III: combine last-month and IRA-funding recapture before applying 10%, separately for each owner. This is not the 20% withdrawal tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_IMPAIRMENT_WORK_DEDUCTION: Eligible disability-related attendant care and other employee expenses needed to work.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INCOME_TAX: Regular 2026 income tax, positive Form 8978 adjustment, excess advance premium credit repayment and AMT, before nonrefundable credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_ESTATE_TAX_DEDUCTION: Section 691(c) federal estate-tax deduction on inherited IRA income, before the general itemized-deduction limitation. Does not reduce AGI or create an NIIT deduction for IRA income; remains deductible for AMT when itemizing.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_IRA_FORM: Separate Form 8606 for this beneficiary and deceased owner, using the inherited group's existing opening basis, distributions, qualified exclusions, recovery and carry. The displayed ratio does not replace the full fraction used for dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_IRA_N_N_BASIS_RECOVERE: Separate beneficiary/decedent Form 8606 allocation using this group's annual distributions and year-end balance. Personal contributions and another deceased owner's basis do not enter this fraction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_IRA_N_N_BASIS_REMAININ: Unrecovered allocated basis stays with this inherited group. It is not a deduction and cannot be transferred to personal IRAs or another deceased owner's accounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_IRA_N_N_ESTATE_IRD_VAL: Unused estate-tax IRD value for future taxable distributions. Value used this year is consumed even if the standard deduction is selected; it is not a deduction carryforward or IRA basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_IRA_N_N_ESTATE_TAX_DED: Section 691(c): estate tax attributable to net IRD, allocated by the lesser of this year's taxable inherited IRA income or unused estate-tax value, divided by gross estate-wide IRD value. Available only when itemizing; the general itemized-deduction limitation applies.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_IRA_N_N_TAXABLE: Inherited traditional IRA income before the filer-level QCD exclusion, less allocated basis recovery. Qualifying charitable transfers use pretax funds first; the shared QCD worksheet applies the annual limit and deductible-contribution adjustment once. The death exception removes early-distribution tax; it does not exclude ordinary taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_MEDICAL_EARNINGS: Earnings after the account holder's death: Form 1099-SA box 1 above the box 4 value at death. The 1099-SA recipient instructions put them on Schedule 1 line 8z other income in the year received.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_MEDICAL_N_N: Inherited medical account: in the death year, nonspouse beneficiaries report allocated death-date value less qualifying bills paid within one year; estate beneficiaries use the decedent's final return without this offset. No additional withdrawal tax on the death transfer. A designated spouse continues the account without taxable inheritance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_ROTH_FORM: Separate Form 8606 for this inherited Roth group, using the deceased owner's five-year period and existing contribution/conversion basis after qualified HSA funding. Other deceased owners and personal IRA basis remain separate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_ROTH_N_N: Unrecovered allocated basis retained by this beneficiary's Roth IRAs from this deceased owner; do not combine it with the beneficiary's own Roth accounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_ROTH_N_N_CONVERSION_RE: This inherited group's allocated conversion basis recovered before earnings, with no early-conversion recapture tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_ROTH_N_N_REGULAR_RECOV: This inherited group's allocated regular-contribution basis recovered first; personal Roth contributions cannot shelter inherited earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INHERITED_ROTH_N_N_TAXABLE: Original-owner five-tax-year qualification excludes the distribution; otherwise inherited contribution and conversion basis is recovered before earnings. The death exception prevents early-distribution tax, including conversion recapture.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INJURED_SPOUSE: Estimated injured spouse share of the joint refund; the IRS makes the final computation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INJURED_SPOUSE_LIMITS: This is a prospective allocation before later IRS offsets, refunds or debt balances. The IRS makes the final computation. Your ordinary federal estimate remains available when a Form 8379 allocation cannot be calculated.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INMATE_PAY: Pay for work while an inmate in a penal institution, Schedule 1 line 8u instead of Form 1040 line 1a. Not earned income for the earned income credit; compensation for an IRA and earned income for the dependent standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_GROSS_PROFIT_RATIO: Line 16 gross profit divided by line 18 contract price, expressed as a decimal.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N: Selling price, including the buyer's note and the loans the buyer took over, without interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_NO_HOME_EXCLUSION: This investment or personal-use property sale claims no main-home exclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_10: Line 14 (line 5 less line 13) less the home-sale exclusion on line 15, which is zero unless the property was your main home.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_11: Loans the buyer took over above line 13, treated as a 2026 payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_12: Line 7 plus line 17. The gross profit percentage (line 19) is line 16 divided by line 18.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_13: Line 17 in the year of sale.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_2: Mortgages and other debts the buyer assumed or took the property subject to.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_4: Cost or other basis of the property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_5: Depreciation allowed or allowable through the date of sale.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_8: Section 1245 recapture from Form 4797 line 33, taxed in full in 2026 even without payments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_QUALIFIED_INCOME: The part of this earlier-year installment gain that your section 1231 lookback makes ordinary is qualified business income of the business that sold the property.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_N_SECTION1231: The section 1231 gain of an earlier-year installment sale of business or rental property, from Form 6252 line 26: Part I line 4, netted on line 8.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_PLEDGE: Eligible net proceeds of a loan secured by this installment note are treated as principal received under section 453A(d), included once on Form 6252 line 21.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_PROFIT_BEFORE_EXCLUS: Line 5 selling price less line 13 adjusted basis, selling expenses and recapture; any home-sale exclusion is applied separately on line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSTALLMENT_RELATED_ACCELERATION: The related buyer's second disposition accelerates the shared installment calculation's additional income under section 453(e), in addition to line 26; this nondepreciable property's ordinary recapture is zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSURANCE_EXCEPTION_N: IRA health-insurance exception based on actual unemployment compensation. Premium relief is limited to the taxable withdrawal; ordinary income remains taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INSURANCE_EXCEPTION_N_2: IRA health-insurance exception based on compensation that would have been received but for self-employed status. No hypothetical unemployment income is added; ordinary IRA income remains taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INTEREST_DEDUCTION: Allowed home mortgage interest, points and premiums plus investment interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INVESTMENT_CREDIT_BASIS_REDUCTIO: Section 50(c): the amount that reduces this property's depreciable basis for the investment credit, the whole rehabilitation credit determined or half of an energy credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INVESTMENT_PROPERTY_TAX_DEDUCTIO: Itemized real-estate taxes on property held solely for investment appreciation, outside the personal SALT cap; after proportional section 68 reduction. Not deducted again from AGI or capital gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_INVESTMENT_SOURCE_ROUTING: One Form 4952 limit uses gross investment income and allowed noninterest expenses. Determined source amounts go once to Schedule A or Schedule E, with distinct regular and AMT carryforwards; no priority is guessed between limited mixed sources.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_IRA_EXCESS_N_N: Form 5329 Parts III and IV: a 2025 excess carried in is reduced by unused 2026 room and 2026 withdrawals; the 2026 excess is the contribution above the App's computed limit. Each part taxes 6% of the smaller of its total excess or the December 31, 2026 value of that IRA type, on Schedule 2 line 18. Line 12 is the part of 2026 withdrawals that paid back an excess from before 2026; it is not income. Line 10 unused room takes in the carried excess (it is a 2026 contribution for the deduction), and a 529-to-Roth transfer above the year's room is a Roth excess on line 23.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_IRA_FORM_PART_I: This person's actual traditional IRA basis worksheet. Qualified reservist repayments are current nondeductible basis on line 1, outside the regular contribution limit. The displayed fraction has four decimal places; monetary amounts retain the calculation's full fraction and separate whole-dollar rounding. No distribution or conversion stops after lines 1–3 and 14.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_IRA_FORM_PART_II: This person's traditional-to-Roth IRA conversion. Part I supplies its recovered basis when applicable; otherwise line 17 shows the basis available for the conversion. A line 18 at or below zero adds no taxable income and creates no deductible loss. The existing annual tax and basis calculation is unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_IRA_FORM_RELIEF: The existing qualified disaster owner supplies line 15b, before spreading that amount on Form 8915-F. Line 15c removes that amount and the existing accepted special-repayment reduction from line 15a. These relief amounts retain source cents; later-year repayment basis remains separately reported.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_IRA_FORM_RETAINED_WORKSHEET: Pub. 590-B Worksheet 1-1 determines the deduction before final IRA taxable income. Its retained exclusion goes to Form 8606 line 13; lines 6–12 are skipped rather than replaced by a different ratio. Conversion and ordinary taxable portions keep the existing worksheet's separate allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ISO_SALE_N_N: ISO source records determine compensation and regular/AMT basis. Compensation already included in W-2 wages is not added again; other compensation enters Schedule 1 line 8k. Same-year sales have no ISO AMT difference. Later-year sales reverse regular compensation for AMT and retain the AMT recognition basis. Restricted shares use vesting facts for regular compensation and independent AMT recognition facts; current-year AMT recognition is included once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ISO_UNREPORTED_COMPENSATION: Calculated ISO or ESPP compensation not already in W-2 wages enters Schedule 1 line 8k as employee compensation. It is earned income, not self-employment or investment income, and does not increase Social Security or Medicare wages.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ITEMIZED_DEDUCTIONS_ALLOWED: Total itemized deductions after the section 68 reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ITEMIZED_DEDUCTION_REDUCTION: 2026 section 68: 2/37 of the lesser of itemized deductions or income above the 37% threshold after adding back itemized deductions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_JURY_PAY: Jury pay on Schedule 1 line 8h: all jury fees are income; they are not earned income for the EIC or self-employment earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_JURY_PAY_REMITTED: Jury pay surrendered to the employer for continued salary is deducted on Schedule 1 line 24a. W-2 wages are unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_BASIS_ALLOWED: This activity's current and retained ordinary loss allowed by the whole-interest basis limit, before its at-risk and passive limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_BASIS_SUSPENDED: Ordinary loss retained by the whole-interest basis limit for this source. Keep it separate from at-risk and passive carryforwards.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_BEFORE_PASSIVE: Current ordinary result of this actual passive group after basis and at-risk limits, before subtracting its separate prior passive loss or applying the return's passive pool.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_ENTITY_BASIS: Ending outside basis of the whole partnership interest after the entity's income, distributions and basis-limited losses. Each activity shares this one basis worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_LONG_GAIN: Entity-only K-1 portfolio long-term capital gain, Schedule D line 12; it increases entity basis once, outside activity income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_PASSIVE_OPENING: This source's retained ordinary loss that already passed basis and at-risk limits, before the passive group's current-year release or common passive allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_RISK_ALLOWED: Ordinary loss allowed from this source by its actual at-risk group, including released at-risk carry. Passive and return-level limits still apply.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_RISK_SUSPENDED: Ordinary loss retained by this source's at-risk group. It has already passed basis and must not reduce basis again when released.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ACTIVITY_SHORT_GAIN: Entity-only K-1 portfolio short-term capital gain, Schedule D line 5; it increases entity basis once, outside activity income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_AMT_DEPLETION: The signed depletion adjustment after the applicable source and activity limits, counted once in AMT income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_AMT_LOSS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT: AMT minus regular-tax nonpassive activity income after basis and at-risk loss limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_AMT_PASSIVE_ADJUSTMENT: AMT minus regular-tax activity income after the passive loss limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_COMPONENT_CAPITAL_BASIS_ALLOW: Current and retained capital losses allowed by the shared whole-interest basis limit, before the actual source group’s at-risk limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_COMPONENT_CAPITAL_BASIS_CARRY: Capital loss retained at basis for this component and holding term; it has not entered the at-risk limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_COMPONENT_CAPITAL_NET: This component’s portfolio capital income less its current and retained capital losses allowed after basis and at-risk limits. The signed source cents enter Schedule D once, outside ordinary passive income, self-employment and QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_COMPONENT_CAPITAL_RISK_ALLOWE: Capital loss allowed by this component’s actual at-risk group, including released prior at-risk losses. It enters the portfolio capital category, outside ordinary passive income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_COMPONENT_CAPITAL_RISK_CARRY: Capital loss retained by this component’s actual at-risk group. It has already passed basis and does not reduce basis again on release.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_DEFERRED_COMPENSATION_TAX: K-1 box 20 code AI interest and additional tax on deferred compensation, Schedule 2 line 13h.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_DISTRIBUTION_GAIN: K-1 box 19 cash above your basis: section 731(a)(1) gain on Form 8949 box C or F by how long you held the interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ENTITY_NONDEDUCTIBLE_USED: These are basis reductions, not tax deductions or activity losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_CHARITY_FIFTY: K-1 code C noncash contribution (50% limit), Schedule A line 12 in the section 170(b)(1)(A) class with your own gifts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_CHARITY_PROPERTY: K-1 code E capital gain property to a 50% organization (30% limit), Schedule A line 12 in the section 170(b)(1)(C) class.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_CHARITY_THIRTY: K-1 code B or D contribution (30% limit), Schedule A line 11 or 12 in the section 170(b)(1)(B) class with your own gifts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_DEBT: K-1 box 11 code E canceled debt, Schedule 1 line 8c in full; a section 108 exclusion is not applied. It is income of the K-1's activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_EARLY_PENALTY: K-1 code AB penalty on early withdrawal of savings, Schedule 1 line 18.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_GAMBLING_LOSSES: K-1 code K gambling losses that the basis and at-risk limits allow, Schedule A line 17a with your own: 90 percent of them, and only to the extent of winnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_INVESTMENT_INTEREST: K-1 code H investment interest expense, Form 4952 line 1 with your own.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_NONPORTFOLIO: K-1 code S non-portfolio capital gain (loss), Schedule D line 5 or 12; an item of the K-1's activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_ORDINARY: K-1 box 11 code R specially allocated ordinary gain (loss), Form 4797 Part II line 11 and Schedule 1 line 4; an item of the K-1's activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_PORTFOLIO: K-1 code A other portfolio income, Schedule 1 line 8z; net investment income (Form 8960 line 7) and Form 4952 investment income, never passive income or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_PREFERRED: K-1 box 11 code Q Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac preferred stock, Schedule D line 5 or 12 by how long it was held.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_RECOVERY: K-1 code J recovery of a tax benefit item, Schedule 1 line 8z in full; an exclusion for a recovery that gave no earlier benefit is not applied.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_SECTION1256: K-1 code C section 1256 contracts, one Form 6781 Part I line 1 row: 40 percent short-term and 60 percent long-term.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ITEM_WINNINGS: K-1 code K gambling winnings, Schedule 1 line 8b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ORDINARY_GAINS: Ordinary gains from Schedules K-1 (box 11 code R and the section 751 gain on a sale of an interest): Form 4797 Part II line 11, then Schedule 1 line 4.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_OTHER_RENTAL_NET: Schedule E line 28: this K-1's box 3 other rental income or loss after the basis, at-risk and Form 8582 limits, column (g) or (h).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_OTHER_RENTAL_SUSPENDED: Box 3 other rental loss that Form 8582 does not allow in 2026; it carries to 2027 with this activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_RENTAL_REAL_ESTATE_NET: Schedule E line 28: this K-1's box 2 rental real estate income or loss after the basis, at-risk and Form 8582 limits; column (g) or (h) when passive, (i) or (k) when a real estate professional materially participated.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_RENTAL_REAL_ESTATE_SUSPENDED: Box 2 rental real estate loss that Form 8582 does not allow in 2026; it carries to 2027 with this activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_RENTAL_SECTION1231_SUSPENDED: The rental activity's section 1231 loss not allowed by the passive activity rules carries separately from its ordinary rental loss. Keep this amount with this activity for next year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ROYALTIES: Royalties from Schedule K-1: gross receipts on Schedule E line 4, allowed code I expenses on lines 19 and 20, and the difference on line 21. Portfolio royalties are outside the passive-loss calculation, QBI and self-employment income; their net amount remains investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_ROYALTY_DEDUCTIONS: K-1 code I royalty expenses allowed after the basis and at-risk limits, Schedule E line 19. These portfolio expenses do not enter Form 8582.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_SALE_GAIN: The sale or cash liquidation of your whole interest, Form 8949 box C or F: proceeds {0,number,currency} after the section 751 part, basis {1,number,currency}. Codes AC and AD are parts of a long-term gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_SALE_ORDINARY: K-1 box 20 code AB section 751 gain on the sale of your interest, Form 4797 Part II line 11 and Schedule 1 line 4.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_K1_SECTION179_SALE: The partners and shareholders worksheet restores the unused section 179 carryover to adjusted basis before finding the gain or loss. Sale losses shown here reflect basis, at-risk and passive limits; section 1231 items also enter the shared return-wide worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_KIDDIE_TAX_DIRECT_GAMBLING_DEDUC: Casual gambling losses actually deducted after the 2026 loss limit and section 68. Directly connected with ordinary unearned winnings for Form 8615 line 2; no allocation against preferential gains.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_KIDDIE_TAX_NET_UNEARNED_INCOME: Form 8615 line 5 is zero after its deduction or taxable-income limit; no parent-rate calculation changes regular tax. This does not determine whether a form must be attached to a filed return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_KIDDIE_TAX_NET_UNEARNED_INCOME_2: Form 8615 line 5: unearned income less the greater of $2,700 or $1,350 plus allowed directly connected deductions, limited to taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_KIDDIE_TAX_PARENT_SHARE: Allocated increase in the parent's tax after including all affected children. The applicable 2026 draft Tax Table is used below $100,000; regular tax is at least the child's own tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_KIDDIE_TAX_PREFERENTIAL_INTEREST: Allowed investment interest directly connected with qualified dividends or net capital gain, after the itemized-deduction reduction; used in the Form 8615 Line 5 worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LEASE_AMOUNT: Business share of lease payments or passenger-automobile inclusion, Publication463.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LEGACY_ANNUITY_N_N: Withdrawal ordering: old investment, old earnings, new earnings, new investment. Both earnings portions are income and enter NIIT; earnings allocated to pre-August 14, 1982 investment are exempt from section 72(q) early-distribution tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LEGACY_EV_PASSIVE_CREDIT: Form 8834 line 7 and Schedule 3 line 6i: current-year Form 8582-CR release, limited by net regular tax above tentative minimum tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LEGACY_EV_PASSIVE_CREDIT_UNUSABL: Form 8834 line 7 instructions: released credit lost to the tax limit cannot carry to another year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LONG_TERM_CARE_N_N_ELIGIBLE: All entered premiums for this insured person, capped once at the 2026 age limit across personal, business and public-safety policies, after removing tax-free public-safety funding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LONG_TERM_CARE_N_N_EXCLUDED: Premiums above the age cap or unused child-only premiums that cannot be deducted on Schedule A.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LONG_TERM_CARE_N_N_MEDICAL: Remaining capped medical-eligible long-term-care premiums after self-employed deductions. Added once to medical itemization before the AGI floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LTC_BENEFIT_N_EXEMPT: Confirmed qualifying reimbursement or terminal-illness accelerated death benefit excluded from income. Reimbursed care is not also a medical deduction; interest and unqualified policy payments need separate treatment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LTC_BENEFIT_N_N_N: 2026 shared limit: greater of $430 per covered day or qualified care costs, less applicable reimbursements. Insured filing unit first, then proportional allocation to other policyholders; periods calculated separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LTC_NONQUALIFIED_TREATMENT: Actual accident/health funding and eligible employer-attributable reimbursements or permanent-injury payments, outside Form 8853 SectionC’s per-diem limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LUMP_SUM_N_LINE_N: A line of Form 4972 for one participant's lump-sum distribution. Part II is the 20% capital gain rate; Part III is the 10-year tax option on the 1986 rate schedule. Amounts are exact; line 30 is rounded to whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_LUMP_SUM_TAX: Form 4972 line 30 for every participant, included in Form 1040 line 16 (box 2). The amounts taxed on Form 4972 are outside Form 1040 lines 5a and 5b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE: Someone claims you as a dependent: you cannot take the credit and do not file Form 8962. The taxpayer who claims you reconciles the advance credit for your coverage.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_ANNUAL_CONTRIBUTION: 2026 applicable percentage times household income. Monthly calculations use the rounded annual contribution divided by twelve.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME: Return MAGI plus required-to-file dependents' MAGI; exempt interest, excluded foreign income and nontaxable Social Security are added back.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_ITERATIVE_PAIR: Publication 974 accepts the Step 4 premium credit together with the Step 5 specified-premium worksheet component when both changes are strictly below $1. Combine a signed component with the selected nonspecified premiums before claiming the nonnegative health deduction. These cent work amounts remain separate from rounded form rows and allocated to their existing policies and businesses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_MARRIAGE: Optional marriage-year worksheet: half joint household income, the actual permitted alternative family and its coverage months. This may reduce repayment but cannot create additional refundable credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_SPECIFIED_DEDUCTION: Pub. 974 continuing Step 3/5 worksheet component: specified premiums less their allocable credit, within the existing earned-income limit. Combine any negative component with the same source's selected nonspecified premiums before claiming the nonnegative health deduction. When nonspecified premiums consume the trade limit, retain the separate Worksheet P/Form 7206 stop route.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_SPECIFIED_MAXIMUM: Pub. 974 Worksheet X line 30: the smaller of the specified premiums and the business's remaining earned-income limit. 2026 requires full repayment, so no repayment limitation enters.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MARKETPLACE_SPECIFIED_PREMIUMS: Pub. 974 Worksheet W line 1: Marketplace premiums of the months marked under the business, after any Part IV share.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MEDICAID_WAIVER_EXCLUDED: Notice 2014-7 payments excluded from income subtract on Schedule 1 line 8s. They may still count for credits and nondeductible IRA room.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MEDICAL_AGI: Adjusted gross income used for the medical expense deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MEDICAL_DEDUCTION: Eligible medical expenses above the 7.5% floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MEDICAL_EXPENSES: Eligible unreimbursed medical and dental expenses before the adjusted-gross-income floor.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MEDICARE_MSA_N_N: Form 8853 Section B: taxable ordinary and deemed nonmedical distributions; 50% tax after disability/death exceptions and prior balance less 60% of the January 1 deductible. Compute each spouse separately. Age 65 is not an exception.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_METHOD_CHANGE_DECREASE: The section 481(a) decrease from the {0,number,0} accounting-method change ({1}), deducted in full in its year of change; other expenses on this activity's schedule.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_METHOD_CHANGE_INCREASE: The 2026 part of the section 481(a) increase from the {0,number,0} accounting-method change ({1}); other income on this activity's schedule.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_METHOD_CHANGE_REMAINING: The rest of this section 481(a) increase, taken in 2027 and later years unless the activity stops sooner.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT: Nonrefundable credit limited to available balance and current tax capacity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT_AVAILABLE: Prior credit carryforward plus signed newly generated credit, floored at zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT_CARRYFORWARD: Unused minimum-tax credit to retain for the next return; not a refundable payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT_GENERATED: Prior-year AMT less tax on exclusion items; a negative amount reduces older credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT_LIMIT: Current regular liability after other nonrefundable credits, less tentative minimum tax after its foreign credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MINIMUM_TAX_EXCLUSION_TAX: Prior-year net minimum tax on permanent exclusion items, using 2025 parameters.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_AVERAGE_BALANCE: Pub 936 Table 1 line 12: total 2026 average balance of every mortgage on the main and second home.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_CERTIFIED_INTEREST: Form 8396 line 1: filer-share mortgage interest attributable to certified indebtedness. Whole-loan interest is allocated using certified debt divided by the original mortgage amount, capped at all interest; the ratio stays fixed as principal is repaid.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_CREDIT_CARRY_N_TO_N: Form 8396 line 16: unused 2024 credit carried to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_CREDIT_CARRY_N_TO_N_2: Form 8396 line 14: unused 2025 credit carried to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_CREDIT_CARRY_N_TO_N_3: Form 8396 line 17: unused 2026 current credit carried to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_CREDIT_CURRENT_POTENTIA: Form 8396 line 3: filer-share certified interest times certificate rate, calculating each paid period separately when 2026 reissue rates differ, subject to the allocated $2,000 high-rate cap and the original-schedule ceiling for a reissue. This amount reduces itemized mortgage interest even if the credit carries forward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_GRANDFATHERED_BALANCE: Average qualified grandfathered debt under the monthly use-of-proceeds allocation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_INSURANCE_PREMIUMS_8D: Qualified mortgage insurance premiums (Form 1098 box 5) treated as home mortgage interest for 2026, reduced by 10% for each $1,000 ($500 if married filing separately), or part of it, of adjusted gross income over $100,000 ($50,000) and none above $109,000 ($54,500).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_INTEREST_8A: Home mortgage interest and points reported on Form 1098, limited by the Pub 936 Table 1 qualifying fraction; the Form 8396 mortgage interest credit reduces the interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_INTEREST_8B: Home mortgage interest paid to a seller who financed the home and did not send Form 1098, limited by the same qualifying fraction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_INTEREST_8E: Total deductible home mortgage interest, points and mortgage insurance premiums (lines 8a through 8d).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_INTEREST_CREDIT: Form 8396 line 9: current credit and surviving carries limited by tax after preceding credits and the nonrefundable child-credit reserve.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_NONDEDUCTIBLE_INTEREST: Pub 936 Table 1 line 16: interest above the qualified loan limit. It is personal interest and not deductible.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_NOT_QUALIFIED_HOME_INTE: Interest on a third home or a second home not chosen as a qualified home.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_ORIGINAL_PERIOD_CREDIT: Original-certificate portion of the 2026 Form 8396 line 3 statement: certified interest paid before refinancing times the original credit rate, before the annual and original-schedule ceilings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_ORIGINAL_SCHEDULE_CAP: Form 8396 reissue ceiling: 2026 interest scheduled on the original certified mortgage times its original certificate rate, after any allocated $2,000 high-rate cap. The reissued certificate cannot increase line 3 above this amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_OTHER_USE_INTEREST: Interest allocated to proceeds used for something other than buying, building or substantially improving the home; enter business, rental or investment interest on that activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_POINTS_8C: Points not reported on Form 1098 (a refinance): amortized ratably over the loan term by the months outstanding in 2026, times the Pub 936 Table 1 qualifying fraction. Points reported in Form 1098 box 6 are on line 8a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_POST_2017_BALANCE: Average later acquisition debt, including refinanced earlier debt after its permitted term.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_PRE_2018_BALANCE: Average acquisition debt incurred before December 16, 2017, retaining a refinance date only through the permitted term.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_QUALIFIED_INTEREST: Interest allocated to grandfathered and acquisition debt before Table 1 limits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_QUALIFIED_LOAN_LIMIT: Pub 936 Table 1 line 11: grandfathered debt plus October 14, 1987 – December 15, 2017 acquisition debt up to $1,000,000 ($500,000 if married filing separately), then later acquisition debt up to the larger of that result or $750,000 ($375,000).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_REISSUED_PERIOD_CREDIT: Replacement-certificate portion of the 2026 Form 8396 line 3 statement: certified interest paid after refinancing times the replacement credit rate, before the annual and original-schedule ceilings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_ADJUSTED_QUALIF: Form 8828 line 16: issuer-notice income for the family's size at disposition and its full and partial holding years.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_AMOUNT: Form 8828 line 19: 6.25% of this return's share of the highest federally subsidized mortgage principal.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_DISPOSITION_GAI: Form 8828 line 13: the owner's sale proceeds less selling expenses and adjusted basis, reduced by any qualified subordinate-loan gain share actually paid, or fair market value less basis for a nonspouse gift. Section 121 exclusion does not reduce this line.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_MODIFIED_INCOME: Form 8828 line 15: adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest, less gain included in gross income from a matched home sale. A nonspouse gift contributes no sale gain to gross income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_QSML_PAID_GAIN_: Form 8828 line 13 qualified subordinate mortgage-loan worksheet: gain share actually paid to the governmental lender, separately from HomeSale selling expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX: Total Form 8828 federal mortgage-subsidy recapture tax from this return's subsidized-home dispositions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_2: Section 143(m)(8)(C): a transfer without recognized gain or loss under section 1041 does not trigger federal mortgage-subsidy recapture or Form 8828.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_3: A qualified home improvement loan that is this home's sole federal mortgage subsidy does not create Form 8828 recapture.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_4: Form 8828 does not apply when the sole original federally subsidized mortgage loan was provided before January 1, 1991.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_5: Form 8828 casualty rule: timely replacement of the destroyed home on its original site for main-home use generally avoids mortgage-subsidy recapture.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_6: No Form 8828 recapture after the original federally subsidized loan's nine-year period.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_7: Form 8828 stops at line 13 when the deemed sale or actual sale produces a loss; the form still has to be filed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MORTGAGE_SUBSIDY_RECAPTURE_TAX_8: Form 8828 line 23 and Schedule 2 line 13b: lesser of half the disposition gain or the subsidized amount after the issuer or early-repayment holding-period percentage and the income percentage.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MOVING_EXCESS_REIMBURSEMENT: Government moving reimbursement (W-2 box 12 code P) above your Form 3903 moving expenses; taxable wages on Form 1040 line 1h.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MOVING_EXPENSE_DEDUCTION: Form 3903 line 5: moving and travel costs of your permanent change of station or intelligence reassignment above the government reimbursement in W-2 box 12 code P. Schedule 1 line 14.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MTC_CURRENT_LIMIT: One current regular-tax limit after preceding credits, less current tentative minimum tax. The minimum-tax credit does not offset current AMT or section 4999 excise.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_MTC_RETAINED_WORKSHEET: Retained prior-year exclusion-only worksheet. The 2026 credit uses 2025 source rules; separately filed histories keep their own prior status. Amounts do not use current-year rates or reconstruct an unavailable historical source.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N: Business income or loss: the Schedule C net profits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NET_INVESTMENT_INCOME_TAX: 3.8% of supported net investment income or MAGI excess, whichever is smaller.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NET_INVESTMENT_MODIFIED_AGI: Form 8960 MAGI adds back the earned-income exclusion less its disallowed deductions and includes any beneficiary K-1 box 14 code H MAGI adjustment. Housing exclusion and housing deduction are not added back.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NEW_CLEAN_VEHICLE_CREDIT: Form 8936 line 13 and Schedule 3 line 6f: new clean-vehicle credit after earlier personal and previously owned vehicle credits; unused personal credit expires.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NEW_CLEAN_VEHICLE_CREDIT_UNUSABL: New personal-use credit lost to the Form 1040 tax limit; it does not carry forward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NEW_CLEAN_VEHICLE_TRANSFER_REPAY: 2026 Schedule 2 line 1b: repay transferred new-vehicle credit when both MAGI years exceed their limits or the vehicle was resold within 30 days.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NIIT_CAPITAL_CARRY_ADJUSTMENT: Excluded capital losses still in the Schedule D carryover, including retained prior differences; retain this Form 8960 worksheet difference for next year's investment-tax calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NIIT_DISPOSITION_ADJUSTMENT: Ordinary property income, non-investment business and realized deferred-NUA exclusions, and prior excluded-loss differences, after the current capital-loss carryover adjustment; add once to capital income in Form 8960.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NIIT_INCOME_TAX_DEDUCTION: Elected state/local income-tax share after the SALT cap and source-income allocation, before the aggregate NIIT section 68 cap. Sales and personal-use property taxes contribute zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_N_N_CARRYFORWARD: Unused regular NOL continuing into 2027 after Form 982 reduction, retaining its original loss year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_N_N_DEBT_REDUCTION: Form 982 reduction after current-year tax, in original loss-year order; not an additional deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_N_N_EXPIRED: Unused pre-2018 balance beyond its twenty-year period, including 2006 losses expiring after 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_N_N_OPENING: Retained regular NOL balance entering 2026; distinct from AMT loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_N_N_USED: Loss absorbed by 2026 income, oldest eligible year first. Pre-2018 deduction can exceed absorption.
