StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_PTP_EBL_LOST: Original PTP qualification no longer backed by the financial NOL after absorption, expiration or its whole-dollar boundary, without an actual NOL deduction. It enters neither this year's Form 8995 loss nor a later qualified carry.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_PTP_EBL_PRE_DEBT_CLOSING: Qualified PTP character remaining in the financial NOL before any section 108 debt-attribute reduction. This balance is outside the Form 8995 loss carry.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NOL_PTP_EBL_QUALIFIED: The actual NOL deduction includes this original-year qualified PTP loss once, separately from ordinary QBI and from the prior Form 8995 loss carry.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NONBUSINESS_PERSONAL_RENT: For-profit nonbusiness personal-property gross rent, Schedule 1 line 8l; not self-employment earnings, IRA compensation or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NONBUSINESS_PERSONAL_RENT_DEPREC: Current bonus and MACRS depreciation before passive loss limits; not a cash operating expense or section 179 deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NONBUSINESS_PERSONAL_RENT_EXPENS: Allowed personal-property rental expenses after passive loss limits, Schedule 1 line 24b. Suspended expenses remain identified by activity; personal-property losses receive no rental real-estate special allowance.
Eligible paid rental expenses before passive loss limits. Only the allowed amount is deducted on Schedule 1 line 24b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NONBUSINESS_ROYALTY_INCOME: Schedule E nonbusiness royalties less eligible paid expenses, included through Schedule 1 line 5. Portfolio income for investment-tax and EIC rules; not SE earnings, IRA compensation or QBI. Nonbusiness losses cannot create an NOL.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NONQUALIFIED_ANNUITY_INVESTMENT_: Taxable nonqualified annuity income enters Form 8960 line 3. Qualified retirement-plan distributions remain outside net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_NUA_SALE_N_N: Deferred NUA realized on sale is long-term gain and excluded from NIIT. Remaining gain or loss follows the post-distribution holding period, or is long-term for inherited shares; original pension income is not repeated.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_10: Penalty on early withdrawal of savings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_13: Total adjustments to income, Form 1040 line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_16: Taxable nonqualified annuities; qualified plans and IRAs are excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_17: Nonbusiness personal-property rent, hobby sales income and a fiduciary's box 14 code H adjustment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_19: Penalty on early withdrawal of savings and the estate-tax deduction for inherited investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_2: Rental real estate, royalties, partnerships and S corporations (Schedule E).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_21: Line 8 less line 11, not below zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_22: Adjusted gross income plus the foreign earned-income exclusion and a fiduciary's modified-AGI adjustment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_23: $250,000 joint or surviving spouse, $125,000 married filing separately, $200,000 otherwise.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_24: Line 13 less line 14, not below zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_25: The smaller of line 12 or line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_27: Net section 1231 gain or loss from Part I lines 2 through 7 of every source on this return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_28: Your nonrecaptured net section 1231 losses from the five preceding years (2021 through 2025), the whole balance. The smaller of this and line 8 is ordinary income on line 13.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_29: Line 8 less line 9: long-term capital gain on Schedule D line 11.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_7: Deductible part of self-employment tax (Schedule SE line 13).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_8: Self-employed SEP, SIMPLE and qualified plans.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_AMOUNT_REALIZED: Amount realized on the foreclosure, repossession or deed in lieu: the smaller of the property's fair market value and the debt for a recourse loan, or the whole debt for a nonrecourse loan.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_BUILDING: Loss on the building and improvements: the building part of the sale price less its share of selling expenses and its adjusted basis, a section 1231 loss (Part I line 2).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_CARRY_REMAINING: Retained prior-year balance after 2026 use and expiration; excludes newly generated 2026 excess taxes and their carryback.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_CARRY_USED: Prior balance used after current-year taxes, oldest original year first within this category and tax system.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_CURRENT_LOSS_HISTORY: Current deductible net section 1231 loss entering the five-year lookback history. This is not an additional deduction or an NOL carryforward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_EXPENSE_N_DE_MINIMIS: Rental cost expensed under the annual de minimis election; no annual dollar cap or QBI depreciable-property basis. Attach a statement titled Section 1.263(a)-1(f) de minimis safe harbor election with taxpayer name, address, TIN and election declaration to the timely original return, including extensions. This on-screen calculation does not file that statement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_EXPENSE_N_DE_MINIMIS_2: Business cost expensed under the annual de minimis election; no annual dollar cap or QBI depreciable-property basis. Attach a statement titled Section 1.263(a)-1(f) de minimis safe harbor election with taxpayer name, address, TIN and election declaration to the timely original return, including extensions. This on-screen calculation does not file that statement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_FORM4797_LINE1B: The gain on partial dispositions of MACRS assets that lines 2, 11 and 26 include (Form 4797 line 1b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_FORM4797_LINE1C: The loss on partial dispositions of MACRS assets that lines 2 and 11 include (Form 4797 line 1c).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_GAIN: Line 24 less line 25: a section 1231 gain on Form 4797 line 4, netted with the return's other business-property gains and losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_GAIN_2: Line 24 less line 25: a capital gain on Schedule D.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_INCOME: Installment sale income: line 22 times the gross profit percentage (line 16 divided by line 18).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_INSTALLMENT_GAIN: Section 1231 gain from this installment sale (Form 6252 line 26); the rest of the gain is taxed as later payments arrive.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_INSTALLMENT_ORDINARY: Ordinary gain from an installment sale of property held one year or less: Form 6252 line 26 goes to Form 4797 line 11, marked From Form 6252.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_IRA_REPAYMENT_N_INCOME_REDUCTI: Repayment reduces IRA taxable income, limited to the qualified taxable pool. It does not reduce original gross distributions or withholding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_IRA_REPAYMENT_N_LATER_DEPOSITS: Actual later-year repayments included in this original-year calculation. If the original return was already filed, an amended return may be required.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_IRA_REPAYMENT_N_QUALIFIED_GROS: Line 15c worksheet qualified distribution pool includes all four applicable types for this owner, even when only one was repaid.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_IRA_REPAYMENT_N_QUALIFIED_TAXA: Taxable part of the owner's qualified distribution pool before repayment, using the Form 8606 ordinary-distribution ratio.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_IRA_REPAYMENT_N_TAXABLE_AFTER: Form 8606 line 15c ordinary IRA taxable amount after repayment. Roth conversions remain in Part II and are added separately to the return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_IRA_REPAYMENT_N_YEAR_END: Form 8606 line 6 value after removing repayments made in 2026 of these 2026 distributions. Later-year deposits do not change this value.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_LAND: Land part of the sale price less its share of selling expenses and the land cost: a section 1231 gain or loss (Part I line 2).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_NONDEDUCTIBLE_LOSS: Loss on a main home the lender took: not deductible and not reported.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_1A: Net farm profit or loss from Schedule F line 34.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_1B: Conservation Reserve Program payments included on Schedule F and excluded from self-employment earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_4A: Line 3 times 92.35% when more than zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_4B: The total of lines 15 and 17: the farm and nonfarm optional method amounts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_4C: Net earnings from self-employment: line 4a, or the optional methods, and zero under $400.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_FORM_N_BOX0_N_DEPOSIT: 2027 regular deposit designated for 2026: the IRA custodian includes this principal on its 2026 Form 5498. This is part of the entered 2026 contribution, not an additional 2027 contribution or a Form 1099-R distribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_BASIS_CARRYFORWARD: Unused traditional IRA basis retained for a later distribution; each spouse has a separate basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_BASIS_RECOVERED: Form 8606 tax-free recovery of nondeductible contributions across all this filer's traditional IRAs.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_BASIS_TAXABLE: Taxable traditional IRA distributions after owner-level pro-rata basis allocation, before any separately reported special repayment reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_CURRENT_NONDEDUCTIBLE_BA: Form 8606 line 1: regular nondeductible contributions plus qualified reservist repayments. Repayments do not use annual contribution limits or create a deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_INCOMING_PLAN_BASIS: After-tax employer-plan contributions rolled into this owner's traditional IRA by year-end. Added once to basis; not a deductible or annual-limit contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_OUTSTANDING_ROLLOVER: Completed next-year IRA-to-IRA rollovers included in the basis worksheet's year-end value, without treating them as taxable withdrawals.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_IRA_RESERVIST_BASIS: Current-year qualified reservist repayments added as nondeductible IRA basis, outside regular contribution limits and without reversing original distribution income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N: Retained Form 4952 election applied under Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 3–9 before foreign capital-gain-excess and special-rate caps. Current deductions and AGI are unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_NEXT_LOOKBACK: Nonrecaptured loss-year balance remaining for next year's section 1231 lookback, after current recapture and expiry.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_2: Base-year Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet. Excess gains reduce net capital gain before dividends; special-rate pools are recomputed before the net-gain cap. Skip tax computation when allocated taxable income is nonpositive.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_3: Net profit or loss from Schedule C and partnership self-employment earnings (K-1 box 14 code A).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_4: Combined net farm and nonfarm profit or loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_5: Self-employment tax: 12.4% Social Security up to the wage base left after wages, plus 2.9% Medicare.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_6: Deduction for one-half of self-employment tax, Schedule 1 line 15.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_SECTION179: K-1 section 179 allowed on Form 4562 line 12 after your dollar and business-income limits: Schedule E line 28 column (j) of this nonpassive activity, deducted from its box 1 income; it reduces QBI and, for a general partner, box 14 code A earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_SECTION179_CARRYFORWARD: K-1 section 179 disallowed by the business income limit, carried to your 2027 Form 4562 line 10 (Form 4562 line 13). Your basis in the interest already fell by the full K-1 amount this year; on a disposition, basis rises by the unused carryover immediately before the transfer (Regulations section 1.179-3(h)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_N_SECTION179_PRIOR_CARRYOVER: K-1 section 179 carried from your 2025 Form 4562 line 13, entering Form 4562 line 10 after this year's elections. It already reduced your basis in the year the entity allocated it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_RECAPTURE: Section 1250 recapture: the additional depreciation, the depreciation allowed over straight line, is ordinary income. Straight-line nonresidential real property placed in service after 1986 has none except the section 50(c) reduction of an investment credit; the gain up to the rest of the depreciation is unrecaptured section 1250 gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_RECAPTURE_2: Section 1245 recapture: the smaller of the gain and the depreciation on line 24, ordinary income through line 33 to line 14.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_ROTH_FORM_N_BOX10: The receiving Roth IRA custodians report their respective qualified 529 transfers in 2026 Form 5498 box 10, rather than box 2. This is the combined amount across all receiving accounts. It shares annual IRA contribution room but is not an ordinary Roth contribution, current income, or a Saver's Credit contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_ROTH_SOURCE_CONTRIBUTION_BAS: The combined source 529 contribution portions retain contribution character in the beneficiary's Roth IRA. Reconcile each transfer with its 529 distributor's Form 1099-Q box 3; source earnings remain Roth earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_ROTH_TRANSFER_N_AMOUNT: Direct 2026 transfer {0,number,0} from 529 account reference {1} on {2,date}. Reconcile this transfer's contribution and earnings portions with its Form 1099-Q and the administrator's five-year seasoned available balance; do not reuse another account's balance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_TIMELY_RETURN_EARNINGS: Form 1040 line 4b: sum of positive attributable earnings from each corrected account, taxable on the 2026 contribution-year return including a distribution received in 2027. A custodian-allocated loss cannot offset another account's earnings or create a separate loss deduction. A timely section 408(d)(4) return incurs neither the 6% excess-contribution tax nor the 10% early-distribution tax (Form 5329 exception 21).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_N_TIMELY_RETURN_GROSS: Form 1040 line 4a for the contribution-year return: sum of the actual cash distributed in the timely distinct-account corrections, each equal to its original principal plus attributable net income or minus a net loss. Original principal is not a retained regular contribution, deduction, IRA basis addition, Saver's Credit contribution, or taxable income; do not report a corrective payment again as an ordinary IRA withdrawal.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_ORDINARY: Section 1252 recapture taken from line 24 first, ordinary income on Form 4797 line 16.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_ORDINARY_2: Loss from abandoning or scrapping business property: its adjusted basis, an ordinary loss (Part II line 11).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_ORDINARY_3: Gain or loss on business property held too short a time, ordinary (Part II line 11): one year or less, or for livestock kept for draft, breeding, dairy or sport less than 24 months (cattle and horses) or 12 months (other livestock), Part II line 18.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_ORDINARY_RELATED: Gain on depreciable property sold to a corporation, partnership, trust or estate you control is ordinary income (section 1239), Form 4797 Part II line 11.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_PARTIAL_DEPRECIATION: The depreciation allowed on the replaced or removed part: its share of the building's depreciation through the month of the disposition (Regulations section 1.168(i)-8(f)(3)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_PARTIAL_GAIN: Gain or loss on the replaced or removed part of a building: the amount received less the part's cost and plus its depreciation allowed (Form 4797 line 2, or line 11 when held one year or less; Regulations section 1.168(i)-8).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_SECTION1231: Loss on depreciable business property held long enough: a section 1231 loss (Part I line 2, or line 7 for livestock), sale price less adjusted basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_TAXABLE: The 2026 Schedule 1 line 8z amount is zero until the main home becomes usable again. Otherwise it is cumulative insurer payments above the whole temporary living-expense increase, less taxable payments already reported before 2026. Earlier payments are included when use is regained in 2026; later payments are included in their receipt year. A federally declared disaster-area payment is excluded. Property-damage reimbursement is separate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_TEMPORARY_INCREASE: Temporary increase in reasonable living expenses while the main home could not be used: actual expenses less normal expenses for the same period, but not below zero. If use has not yet been regained, this is the amount recorded through 2026 and remains open for later years.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_TOTAL_PAYMENTS: Line 21; there is no line 20 amount after the year of sale.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_UNRECAPTURED_N: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain of this property: the smaller of its depreciation and its building gain, before the return-wide section 1231 netting.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_UNRECAPTURED_N_2: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain in line 26: the gain of each payment is unrecaptured gain first, until the sale's total is reported (Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 4).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_N_WITHHOLDING: Federal income tax actually withheld on insurers' 2026 Forms 1099, claimed on Form 1040 line 25b. Prior-year withholding is not credited again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OLYMPIC_EXCLUSION: Schedule 1 line 24c: the line 8m prize excluded under section 74(d) because adjusted gross income without the exclusion is not above $1,000,000 ($500,000 married filing separately). Zero when the prize is taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OLYMPIC_PRIZES: Value of Olympic and Paralympic medals and USOC prize money on Schedule 1 line 8m. Line 24c removes it when adjusted gross income without the exclusion is $1,000,000 or less ($500,000 married filing separately).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OPTIONAL_SE_N_N_FARM: Optional farm earnings: two-thirds of gross farm income, capped at $7,560; no further 92.35% reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OPTIONAL_SE_N_N_NET: Schedule SE line 4c combines regular earnings or loss with elected optional earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OPTIONAL_SE_N_N_NONFARM: Nonfarm optional earnings share the remaining $7,560 cap.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_INCOME_N_CARD_INSURANCE: Credit card disability or unemployment insurance benefits above the premiums paid in 2026, Schedule 1 line 8z (Publication 525).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_INCOME_N_OTHER: {0}: other taxable income on Schedule 1 line 8z. Not self-employment income or earned income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_INCOME_N_RTAA: Form 1099-G box 5 reemployment trade adjustment assistance (RTAA) payments, Schedule 1 line 8z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_INCOME_N_SUBSTITUTE_PAYMEN: Form 1099-MISC box 8 substitute payments in lieu of dividends or interest, Schedule 1 line 8z. Not qualified dividends or tax-exempt interest; net investment income (Form 8960 line 7).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_INCOME_N_UNEMPLOYMENT_FUND: Private or union unemployment fund benefits above your own nondeductible payments into the fund, Schedule 1 line 8z (Publication 525).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_ITEMIZED_TOTAL: The sum of Schedule A lines 17a through 17k, including qualified disaster losses and the standard deduction only on the increased-standard route.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OTHER_TAXES_DEDUCTION: Generation-skipping transfer tax on a taxable trust income distribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OWNER_PLAN_DEDUCTION: Owner retirement plan deduction, Schedule 1 line 16; it also reduces the health-insurance limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OWNER_PLAN_STEP: Owner plan deduction worksheet step {0,number,integer}, Publication 560.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_OWN_FORM3468_CREDIT: Gross credit for this actual K-1 property from your completed Form 3468, before Form 3800 limits. It replaces the automatic credit and supplies the current outside-basis reduction once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_FUEL_N: Partner-share K-1 box 20 code C fuel quantities at the Form 4136 printed rate or the authorized line 13c 24.4-cent-tax write-in rate, using GGE or DGE on the applicable alternative-fuel rows. This is a partner-level payment credit; it is not added again to the K-1 box 1 amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_BACKUP_WITHHOLDI: K-1 box 15 code O backup withholding, included once on Form 1040 line 25c.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_CASH_CHARITY: K-1 box 13 code A cash contributions (60%), Schedule A line 11 with your own cash gifts; not part of Form 8582.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_DIVIDENDS: K-1 box 6a ordinary dividends, reported on Form 1040 line 3b and Schedule B with the partnership's name; box 6b qualified dividends are included and also on line 3a.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_EXEMPT_INTEREST: K-1 box 18 code A tax-exempt interest, Form 1040 line 2a; it increases outside basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_INTEREST: K-1 box 5 interest, reported on Form 1040 line 2b and Schedule B with the partnership's name.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_LONG_GAIN: K-1 box 9a net long-term capital gain or loss, Schedule D line 12, including the box 9b and 9c parts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_N_SHORT_GAIN: K-1 box 8 net short-term capital gain or loss, Schedule D line 5.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_PRIOR_FUEL_CREDIT_: Partner fuel credit claimed on the 2025 Form 1040 filed in 2026, recognized once as 2026 Schedule E nonpassive income after a full prior tax benefit. It is not current K-1 box 1 or box 14 income and is not a second Form 4136 payment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNERSHIP_N_SECTION1231: Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) box 10 business-property net section 1231 gain or loss after the basis, at-risk and passive limits: Part I line 2, netted on line 8.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PARTNER_ENTITY_NONDEDUCTIBLE_CAR: The partnership basis worksheet retains expenses exceeding available basis separately from deductible losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PAYMENTS: Income tax withholding, estimated/extension payments and eligible excess payroll withholding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_CONTRIBUTION_DEDUCTION: Schedule 1 line 24f employee-funded pension deduction. Code H remains in W-2 wages and is not deducted a second time there. Traditional IRA capacity is reduced by these contributions under Pub. 590-A.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_CONTRIBUTION_LIMIT_TAXPA: Annual section 501(c)(18)(D) limit after the employee's compensation and other regular elective deferrals. No age-based increase applies to this trust contribution limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_COMMON_MONTHLY_EXCLUSI: Common monthly exclusion before simultaneous-annuitant allocation; retain with whole-contract recovery records. Do not allocate the recipient's already reduced monthly exclusion again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_EARLIER_COMMON_RECOVER: Common cost recovered in earlier payment months of this year by other annuitants; this is not an additional exclusion on this recipient's return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_NEXT_YEAR_IRA_BASIS: After-tax employer-plan cash deposited into the IRA in 2027. Add once to the 2027 IRA basis record; this is neither 2026 IRA basis nor an outstanding IRA-to-IRA rollover.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_N_BASIS_RECOVERY: Simplified Method exclusion using original monthly recovery and remaining cost; pre-1987 starts have no lifetime cost cap.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_N_BASIS_RECOVERY_3: Distribution multiplied by unrecovered investment divided by the same nonforfeitable account or separate-contract balance, limited to the distribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_N_INCOME_EXCLUSION: Tax-free pension income, limited to the contributory portion for railroad benefits; vested dual and supplemental benefits remain taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_N_MONTHLY_EXCLUSION: Recipient monthly exclusion at the final entered payment month. Retain the common worksheet and allocation history; entitlement changes can alter the recipient share, while cost-of-living changes alone do not.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_N_REMAINING_BASIS: Unrecovered investment after this distribution, before later contributions or adjustments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_N_ROLLED_BASIS_2: After-tax investment transferred to the receiving retirement account. Retain its basis record; this is not a deductible annual contribution.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PENSION_N_REMAINING_BASIS: Unrecovered whole-contract cost after the entered payment months. Reconcile any later recovery by other annuitants before carrying the common record to next year's worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_CASUALTY_DEDUCTION: Ordinary 2026 personal-use disaster loss requires itemizing; qualified federal major-disaster loss is also added to the standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_DEBT_CANCELLATION: Taxable personal debt cancellation on Schedule 1 line 8c. Increases AGI and nonbusiness unearned income; does not create IRA/EIC compensation, self-employment tax or net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_REFUELING_CREDIT: Form 8911 line 10 and Schedule 3 line 6j: personal-use credit after the per-unit limit and tax above tentative minimum tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_REFUELING_CREDIT_UNUSAB: Personal-use refueling credit disallowed by the tax limit expires; it does not carry to another year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_RENTAL_N_ASSET_N_N: Purchased rental equipment: bonus and GDS depreciation before passive limits; remaining basis is reduced even when the deduction is suspended. Section 179 is unavailable. AMT deductions use the separate retained schedule when required; the passive worksheet determines the allowed income adjustment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_RENT_N_INVESTMENT_INCOM: Net rental income after prior suspended expenses, recharacterized for Form 4952 when less than 30% of the rental activity's unadjusted basis is depreciable. Ordinary passive rental income stays outside this investment-interest pool; Form 8960 has a separate definition.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PERSONAL_SALE_DISALLOWED_LOSS: Personal-use losses are disallowed item by item before capital-gain netting; they cannot offset other gains or create carryforwards. Proceeds reported on a 1099-K are not automatically taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREMIUM_CREDIT_ADVANCE: Advance payments from all entered monthly policy statements, after any Part IV share of a shared policy.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREMIUM_CREDIT_REFUNDABLE: Additional premium tax credit after subtracting advance payments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREMIUM_CREDIT_REPAYMENT: 2026 requires full repayment of excess advances; the earlier repayment caps no longer apply.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREMIUM_TAX_CREDIT: Married filing separately without the domestic abuse or abandonment exception: no credit is allowed and the advance credit is repaid in full (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (f)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREMIUM_TAX_CREDIT_2: Household income below the poverty line: allowed because advance credit was paid on the Marketplace's enrollment estimate, at the 2.10% applicable percentage.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREMIUM_TAX_CREDIT_3: Allowed credit before advances, using the 2026 100%–400% poverty range and any Part IV shares of shared policies.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREVIOUSLY_OWNED_CLEAN_VEHICLE_C: Form 8936 line 18 and Schedule 3 line 6m: used clean-vehicle credit after earlier personal credits; unused personal credit expires.
Previously owned personal-use credit lost to the Form 1040 tax limit; it does not carry forward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PREVIOUSLY_OWNED_CLEAN_VEHICLE_T: 2026 Schedule 2 line 1c: repay transferred used-vehicle credit when both MAGI years exceed their limits or the vehicle was resold within 30 days.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PRIOR_ATNOL_DEDUCTION: Ordinary prior ATNOL is limited to 90% of AMTI before this deduction. Documented special losses can absorb the remaining AMTI. This does not change regular AGI, self-employment tax or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PRIOR_INCOME_REPAYMENT_REVIEW_TO: Combined earlier-year unemployment and railroad principal and net negative Social Security benefits, before tax-line rounding. This is a review threshold, not a claim that every dollar was taxable in its original year. Unentered repayments of other income must be reported in Additional coverage checks.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PRIOR_NOL_DEDUCTION: Pre-2018 loss plus post-2017 loss limited to 80% of taxable income before NOL and QBI, less the pre-2018 loss. Reported as negative Schedule 1 income, not a reduction to SE earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PRIOR_YEAR_CARE_CREDIT: 2025 care first paid in 2026, using the prior year expense/earnings limits and 20%-35% rate. Added to current care before the current tax-liability limit; 2026 instructions remain draft.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PROPERTY_ROLLOVER_N_N: Retained sale proceeds allocate between distribution value and post-distribution gain or loss. The rolled portion recognizes neither sale gain nor sale loss; no duplicate capital-sale entry is needed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PUBLIC_SAFETY_MEDICAL_BEFORE_COO: Unexcluded premiums under this election before business long-term-care coordination. The shared per-person long-term-care medical lines replace the LTC portion of this subtotal; do not add both. Ordinary medical premiums enter itemization once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_PUBLIC_SAFETY_N_EXCLUDED: Section 402(l) election: excluded after pension basis recovery, limited to otherwise taxable distributions and the officer's remaining $3,000 annual allowance. Preserve the PSO reporting notation; no duplicate medical deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_ACTIVE_MINIMUM: The 2026 minimum deduction: $400 when active qualified business income is at least $1,000.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_ACTIVITY: Qualified business income after netting losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_ACTIVITY_2: Qualified business income or loss of this trade or business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_ACTIVITY_COMPONENT: Qualified business income component after the W-2 wage and UBIA limit and the phase-in reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_ACTIVITY_LIMITED: The greater of the 20% amount reduced by the phase-in and the wage and UBIA limit, before the patron reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_ACTIVITY_PATRON_REDUCTION: The patron reduction allocable to this trade or business (Schedule D line 6).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_AFTER_COOPERATIVE: Line 37 less the cooperative deduction, which this return does not have.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_AGGREGATION_SOURCE: Actual member income, W-2 wages and qualified property enter the elected aggregation before its combined wage/property limit and cross-business loss netting.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_BEFORE_INCOME_LIMIT: Qualified business income deduction before the income limitation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_COMPUTED_COLUMN: This form line uses the settled qualified business income, allowed losses, wages, property and applicable phase-in from this calculation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_COOPERATIVE_DPAD: The issuer-allocated section 199A(g) deduction is limited to taxable income before QBI minus the ordinary QBI deduction, without applying the ordinary 20% capital-gain income limit again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_DEDUCTION: QBI after service-business applicability, loss netting, phased wage/property limits and taxable-income cap, with the 2026 active-business minimum.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_INCOME_LESS_GAIN: Taxable income less net capital gain, not less than zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_LIMITED_DEDUCTION: The smaller of line 10 and line 14.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_LOSS_CARRYFORWARD: Net qualified business loss including the prior QBI carryforward, after service-business applicability. Carries to the next year without a second AGI deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_NET: Total qualified business income after the prior-year loss, not less than zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_NET_CAPITAL_GAIN: Net capital gain: qualified dividends plus the net capital gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_PATRON_REDUCTION: The Schedule D patron reduction for Form 1099-PATR box 7 qualified payments: the lesser of 9% of the QBI allocable to them or 50% of the allocable W-2 wages, which is zero without farm W-2 wages.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_PRIOR_LOSS: Qualified business net loss carried forward from the prior year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_PRIOR_REIT_PTP_LOSS: Qualified REIT dividends and PTP loss carried forward from the prior year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_REIT_PTP: Qualified REIT dividends and publicly traded partnership income or loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_REIT_PTP_COMPONENT: REIT and PTP component: 20% of line 8.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_REIT_PTP_NET: Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP income, not less than zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_TAXABLE_INCOME: Taxable income before the qualified business income deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QBI_TOTAL: Total qualified business income or loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QCD_ADJUSTMENT_CARRYFORWARD: Total unused deductible-contribution adjustment; retain the separately reported owner balances.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QCD_CASH_GIFTS: Nonexcluded qualifying cash gifts enter the ordinary charity deduction calculation once.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QCD_EXCLUSION: Qualified charitable distributions excluded from IRA income, not deducted again as gifts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QCD_TAXPAYER_ADJUSTMENT_CARRY: Unused deductible-contribution adjustment retained for this owner's next QCD worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QCD_TAXPAYER_EXCLUSION: 2026 exclusion after the $111,000 owner limit and unused prior plus current post-age-70½ IRA deductions. Gross IRA distributions remain reported.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_DEFERRAL_N_LONG: Long-term 2026 gain deferred by an investment in a qualified opportunity fund in 2027 (Form 8997 Part II; Form 8949 Part II box F, code Z).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_DEFERRAL_N_SHORT: Short-term 2026 gain deferred by an investment in a qualified opportunity fund in 2027 (Form 8997 Part II; Form 8949 Part I box C, code Z).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_N_BASIS_AFTER: Basis in the investment after the inclusion: the basis increase plus the gain included (Form 8997 Part V). Use it as the basis when you enter the sale of the investment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_N_BASIS_INCREASE: Basis added to the opportunity fund investment for the years you held it: 10% of the deferred gain at five years and a further 5% at seven (Form 8997 Part III).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_N_INCLUDED_LONG: Long-term deferred gain included in 2026, by the same rule (Form 8949 Part II box F, code Y).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_N_INCLUDED_PROPERTY: Section 1231 part of the deferred gain included in 2026 (special gain code B): Form 4797 Part I, with the Form 8949 code Y and code O rows netting to zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QOF_N_INCLUDED_SHORT: Short-term deferred gain included in 2026: the smaller of the deferred gain and the investment's value on the earlier of its sale and December 31, 2026, less the basis increase, shared by the character of the deferred gain (Form 8949 Part I box C, code Y).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_AMT_PREFERENCE: 7% of the section 1202 exclusion on qualified small business stock acquired before September 28, 2010 (50% and 75% exclusions), an alternative minimum tax preference on Form 6251 line 2h. Stock acquired later has no preference.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_AMT_PREFERENCE: Seven percent of the excluded gain from shares acquired before September 28, 2010; Form 6251 line 2h, before whole-dollar rounding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_EXCLUDED_GAIN: Applicable 50%, 60%, 75% or 100% exclusion of eligible gain for directly purchased original-issue shares held more than five years; Form 8949 code Q.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_EXCLUSION_LIMIT: Greater of remaining issuer dollar cap or ten times the original-issue basis of this year's disposed shares.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_RATE_N_GAIN: Unexcluded eligible section 1202 gain before Schedule D loss coordination; 100%-excludable shares contribute zero, even if issuer-cap excess remains taxable.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_REALIZED_GAIN: Cash proceeds less original-issue basis, before the section 1202 exclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_TAXABLE_GAIN: Eligible gain not excluded plus gain above the section 1202(b) issuer limit. Only the former belongs in the 28%-rate pool; the latter has ordinary long-term capital-gain rates.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QSBS_N_N_ZONE_GAIN_THROUGH_N: Source-valued pre-2019 empowerment-zone gain receiving ten additional percentage points of exclusion above its 50% base.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_QUALIFIED_NET_DISASTER_LOSS: Provisional 2026 Form 4684 line 15 and Schedule A line 17b: qualified major-disaster losses after a $500 reduction per event and any remaining casualty gains. Available whether itemizing or taking the increased standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RAILROAD_PRIOR_YEAR_REPAYMENTS: Fully taxable earlier-year railroad benefits repaid in 2026. Do not net against current pension receipts. The combined return-wide threshold and original-year comparison determine any deduction or credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RATE_N_GAIN: Long-term 28%-rate gain from collectibles and unexcluded eligible section 1202 gain after long-term loss carryovers and net short-term losses; capped by net capital gain. Tax is at most 28%, not a flat 28%.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REAL_ESTATE_N_GAIN: Form 8949 box C or F: the Form 1099-S box 2a proceeds less the adjusted basis and the selling expenses (code E). A loss on real estate you used yourself is not deductible.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RECOVERY_N_TAXABLE: Publication 525 Worksheet 2 line 11 for this prior year: the part of a refund or reimbursement of an itemized deduction that lowered that year's tax, limited by the deduction, by the itemized deductions above the standard deduction and by a negative taxable income. The state or local income tax refund share is on Schedule 1 line 1; the rest is on line 8z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REFUNDABLE_EDUCATION_CREDIT: American opportunity refundable portion using the taxpayer's age/support eligibility.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REGULAR_INCOME_TAX: Regular income tax including an applicable Schedule J election, Form 8615 parent-rate tax, preferential gains and foreign-exclusion stacking, before AMT and credits. Applicable current-year ordinary-tax lookups below $100,000 use the September 2026 draft Tax Table, including Schedule J line 4; its base-year recomputations use the IRS rate schedules.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REGULAR_TOTAL_NOL_CARRYFORWARD: Unexpired prior regular losses plus newly generated current NOL and excess business loss, counted once and reduced by Form 982 after current tax. Retain year and origin; new excess-business-loss components require their own QBI allocation before later use.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REIT_PTP_LOSS_CARRYFORWARD: Remaining prior REIT/PTP loss after qualified section 199A dividends; tracked separately from business QBI and never deducted again from AGI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RELATED_EXCHANGE_GAIN: Deferred gain from an earlier related-party exchange, taxable in 2026 because the related person disposed of the property within two years (Form 8824 line 24).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_ASSET_DEPRECIATION: Rental asset depreciation uses the return-wide MACRS convention and the asset's own elections and history.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_AT_RISK: Form 6198 limits the loss before the passive-activity rules; the excess carries to next year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_AT_RISK_RECAPTURE: Recapture is income of this activity after its current at-risk limit and becomes a separate deduction next year; it does not release the current at-risk loss.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_CASUALTY_ACTIVITY: The recurring casualty's Section B loss passes through this rental's existing at-risk and passive-activity limits. It is reported separately from Schedule E expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_CASUALTY_SOURCE: Event-date property facts and any shown line 27 loss precede activity limits. Remaining basis does not establish a completed continuing-depreciation schedule.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_ENERGY_DEDUCTION: The documented physical-building allowance and actual qualifying cost limit the section 179D deduction. This same source-cent amount reduces the qualifying property's depreciation basis; it is already included in Schedule E other expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_HOME_CASUALTY_ALLOWED: The home-use worksheet retains casualty character for current losses and prior carryovers. Its allowed casualty is deducted once through Form 4684 and Form 4797.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_HOME_CASUALTY_CARRY: The actual casualty part still carried to the next home-use worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_HOME_CASUALTY_OTHERWISE: Worksheet 5-1 line 2c is the rental portion of this dwelling's otherwise deductible personal casualty loss. The shared Form 4684 worksheet uses the whole saved property once; itemizing includes ordinary and qualified disaster allowances, while an increased standard deduction includes only the qualified allowance. This amount joins the allowed excess casualty on Section B, not Schedule E depreciation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_HOME_THIRD_TIER_ALLOWED: Remaining rental income allows current casualty losses first, then current depreciation, then prior casualty and depreciation carryovers.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_BUILDING_N_DEPRECIATION: This building's current GDS deduction, mid-month convention; land excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_DEPRECIATION: 39-year nonresidential real property GDS, mid-month convention; land excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_DEPRECIATION_2: 27.5-year residential GDS, mid-month convention; land excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE10_LEGAL_AN: Schedule E line 10: legal and other professional fees.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE12_MORTGAGE: Schedule E line 12: mortgage interest paid to banks or other financial institutions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE13A_VEHICLE: Schedule E line 13a (2026 draft): vehicle-loan interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE13B_OTHER_I: Schedule E line 13b (2026 draft): other interest.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE19_OTHER: Schedule E line 19: other expenses, with a description, including a section 481(a) decrease.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE6_AUTO_AND_: Schedule E line 6: auto and travel.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_EXPENSE_LINE7_CLEANING_: Schedule E line 7: cleaning and maintenance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_LINE22_ALLOWED_LOSS: Rental loss of a property sold in full, including its prior suspended losses: allowed in full because the activity, with its sale gain, has an overall loss (section 469(g)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_LINE22_ALLOWED_LOSS_2: Deductible rental real estate loss after the passive activity limits (Form 8582), including a prior-year unallowed loss that the property's own income used.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_LINE22_NONPASSIVE_LOSS: Rental real estate loss that is not from a passive activity, as for a qualified real estate professional: the loss from line 21, deductible in full.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_N_N: Rents received, and the 2026 part of a section 481(a) increase reported with them.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_N_N_N_4: Income or loss: rents less total expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_REPLACEMENT_CARRYOVER_DEP: Depreciation of the exchanged basis of the property you received in a like-kind exchange: the same method over the remaining recovery period of the building you gave up (Form 4562 line 17; Reg. 1.168(i)-6).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_REPLACEMENT_EXCESS_DEPREC: Depreciation of the excess basis of the property you received in a like-kind exchange, placed in service the day it was ready to rent (Form 4562 lines 19i and 19j; Reg. 1.168(i)-6(d)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_SALE_POSTPONED: Gain from the condemnation that is not taxed this year because the cost of the replacement property is at least the amount received for it (section 1033).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RENTAL_SALE_ROW_ORDINARY: Gain or loss on a building or improvement held one year or less is ordinary (Form 4797 Part II line 11), because section 1231 needs more than a year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REPAYMENT_CREDIT: Section 1341 credit from verified prior-year tax decreases, allowed only by the credit method and not limited to current income tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REPAYMENT_CREDIT_POTENTIAL: Verified historical and applicable restoration-year Chapter1 tax decrease; used only by the credit method. The deduction method does not also claim this credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REPAYMENT_ITEMIZED_AMOUNT: Repayment included once in the itemized-deduction method before the general 2026 itemized limit. The credit method excludes it entirely.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REPAYMENT_YEAR_N_N: Original-year tax, enhanced senior deduction, elderly credit and earned-income-credit table recomputation after excluding the matching repaid benefits. The Chapter 1 decrease includes AMT, early-distribution tax and changed refundable EIC. NIIT under Chapter 2A is not part of this credit; no user-calculated repayment credit is accepted.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REPAYMENT_YEAR_N_N_EXCLUSION_N: Independent exclusion-only capital worksheet, preserving original and refigured loss utilization.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRIBUTION_TAX: Form 5329 Part IX tax enters Schedule 2 and total tax without changing income. Later-year corrective payments are income only in their payment year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RESERVIST_N_N_N_BASIS: Qualified reservist repayments add Form 8606 nondeductible basis. They are neither deductible contributions nor tax-free rollovers of the original income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RESERVIST_N_N_N_UNREPAID: Original distribution less all entered repayments. A further repayment still needs to meet the two-year deadline; this is not an automatic contribution entitlement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RESIDENTIAL_ENERGY_CARRYFORWARD_: 2026 Form 5695 line 4: unused residential clean energy credit carried to 2027.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RESIDENTIAL_ENERGY_CREDIT: 2026 Form 5695 lines 1–3: the 2025 residential clean energy credit carryforward, limited by tax after preceding credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RETIREMENT_N_LTC_INVESTMENT_REDU: Qualified Form 1099-R code W cash-value charges are excluded under section 72(e)(11); a permitted code 6 exchange is also excluded. Gross stays in this original source and is not reported as pension income or derived as a deductible premium. Box 8a is the actual investment reduction, including zero, not the full charge/exchange value. Another withdrawal or discharge uses its documented already-adjusted investment; the App never subtracts this reduction twice. A post-annuitization exclusion-ratio adjustment needs actual insurer tax results or a separately verified worksheet; this charge alone does not compute it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RETIREMENT_N_QUALIFIED_N_GROSS: Gross distribution assigned to this exception, including recovered basis. Shared limits use gross amounts, not just taxable income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RETIREMENT_N_QUALIFIED_N_TAXABLE: Taxable share qualifying for the early-distribution exception before any special IRA repayment. The separate repayment worksheet may remove ordinary income and the corresponding exception amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RETIREMENT_ROLLOVERS: Eligible amounts actually transferred. Gross distributions and withholding remain on the return; only the taxable amount kept enters income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_ACCOUNT_DEADLINE: The remaining account must be emptied by December 31, {0,number,0}.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_ANNUAL_LIFE_EXPECTANCY: Annual life-expectancy minimum applies; the initial factor is reduced for every elapsed year, including years covered by prior IRS penalty relief.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_EXHAUSTED_LIFE_EXPECTANCY: Life expectancy is exhausted; the full account must be distributed. The shortfall is the current year-end remaining value, including earnings, rather than last year's balance.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_FORM_COMPARISON: Each legally separate plan keeps its own shortfall. Only timely distributions count, capped by that plan or permitted group's minimum. A full correction within the correction window uses 10%; other shortfalls use 25%. Each filer's rates are rounded separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_FORM_WAIVER_REQUEST: This is the shortfall requested to be waived for reasonable error and remedial steps, shown as the RC supporting amount. The estimate subtracts the request before calculating tax; IRS approval is still pending.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_INHERITED_MINIMUM: {0} {1} This minimum does not determine whether a withdrawal is taxable income or satisfy another account group's obligation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_LIFE_EXPECTANCY_CONTINUES: Life-expectancy payments continue under the entered beneficiary status.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_NO_ANNUAL_MINIMUM: No annual beneficiary minimum precedes the final payout deadline because the owner died before the required beginning date.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_N_ACCOUNT_N_MINIMUM: Prior December 31 value plus outstanding incoming rollover, divided by the IRS age-based factor. The joint table applies only to a qualifying sole-beneficiary spouse more than ten years younger. Each account is calculated separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_N_CONDITIONAL_REDUCED_SHORTF: The 10% estimate is conditional on actually submitting the additional-tax return within the correction window. The App has not filed it; recalculate if the planned filing date or IRS notice/assessment changes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_N_DEFERRED_TO_N: First 2026 payment elected for April 1, 2027. Excluded from 2026 excess-accumulation tax; this does not postpone the separate December 31, 2027 requirement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_N_N: Account-group shortfall excludes late corrections and unrelated excess withdrawals. Waiver amounts are requests subject to IRS approval, not granted relief; retain the explanation for Form 5329.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_N_TAX: Separate filer excess-accumulation tax: 10% for fully corrected groups with submitted or explicitly planned filing within the correction window, otherwise 25%; less requested reasonable-cause relief.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_SPOUSE_MINIMUM_NOT_BEGUN: The sole surviving spouse's inherited minimum has not begun: payments may be delayed until the later of the year after death or the year the original owner would reach the applicable RMD age.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_SPOUSE_SINGLE_LIFE: The surviving spouse's Single Life expectancy is recalculated at the current year's age, compared with the deceased owner's remaining expectancy when required.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_RMD_SPOUSE_UNIFORM_LIFETIME: The sole surviving spouse retained inherited status and elected the Uniform Lifetime Table for the current year's age; the deceased owner's remaining expectancy also remains a floor when required.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_CONTRIBUTION_MAGI: Modified AGI used only for regular Roth IRA contribution eligibility; taxable conversion income remains on the return.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_CONVERSION_TAXABLE: Taxable traditional-to-Roth IRA conversions remain in income. Converted amounts are not early withdrawals or regular annual contributions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_FORM_PART_III: This person's Form 8606 Part III uses actual nonqualified distributions and the annual Roth ordering balances. Qualified payments and rollovers are excluded. First-home expenses, qualified disaster amounts and accepted repayments follow their existing calculations; excess repayments remain separately reported basis for next year. Amounts retain cents. Stop lines follow the form's instructions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_N_DESIGNATED: Form 8606 line 25b: line 25a times the qualified disaster distributions over line 21. It is reported on Form 8915-F line 19 and spread over three years, and it is not in Form 8606 line 25c.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_N_N_CONVERSION_RECAPTURE: Previously taxed conversion principal withdrawn inside its own five-tax-year period without an age or disability exception. This is subject to additional tax, not taxed as income again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_N_N_FIRST_HOME: Form 8606 line 20: a qualified first-time homebuyer distribution from a Roth IRA whose first contribution year is 2021 or earlier, up to $10,000 in a lifetime. It is taken out before the contributions and conversions of line 22 and line 24, and Form 5329 shows it on lines 1 and 2 with exception 09.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_N_N_REGULAR_RECOVERED: Regular contribution basis recovered tax-free before conversions and earnings under tax-year aggregation, including eligible current-year contributions and the source contribution portions of qualified 529 rollovers.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROTH_N_N_TAXABLE: Nonqualified Roth earnings remaining after regular contributions and conversion amounts; qualified distributions are excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROYALTY_AMT_DEPLETION: Regular depletion less AMT depletion; oil and gas owners have no basis preference, and the 65% limit is figured separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROYALTY_COLUMN: Schedule E royalty receipts less the expense lines and allowable cost or percentage depletion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROYALTY_N_LINE4_ROYALTIES: Royalties received from this property before its expenses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_ROYALTY_RECORDS: Retain this separately calculated basis or depletion carryover with your next-year royalty records.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SALE_N_MARKET_DISCOUNT: Accrued market discount recognized on the sale of a bond (Form 8949 code D): the smaller of the gain and the accrued discount is interest on Schedule B line 1, not capital gain.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SALT_BEFORE_LIMIT: Income or sales taxes plus real estate and personal property taxes before the applicable limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SALT_DEDUCTION: Allowed state and local taxes, with investment real estate taxes not subject to the personal SALT limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SALT_INCOME_OR_SALES_TAX: The elected income or general sales taxes, including final-year estate and trust shares.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SALT_PERSONAL_PROPERTY_TAX: Annual value-based personal property taxes, including final-year estate and trust shares.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SALT_REAL_ESTATE_TAX: Eligible real estate taxes, after moving an actual-expense home office share to the business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SAVER_AUTOMATIC_WITHDRAWALS_TAXP: Permissible automatic-enrollment withdrawals, including earnings, automatically included once in the Form 8880 distribution lookback. This does not impose early-distribution tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SAVER_CREDIT: Retirement and beneficiary-funded ABLE Saver’s Credit sharing a per-person limit, with foreign-income add-back, 2026 income bands and distribution lookback; limited by tax after preceding credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SAVINGS_BOND_EXCLUSION: Form 8815 line 14 and Schedule B line 3: line 8 less line 13.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SAVINGS_BOND_EXCLUSION_NOT_ALLOW: Form 8815 line 14: no exclusion on a married-filing-separately return, or when the bond owner had not turned 24 before the bonds were issued.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SAVINGS_BOND_EXCLUSION_PHASED_OU: Form 8815 line 14: modified AGI is at or above the top of the 2026 phaseout ($116,800, or $182,650 on a joint return), so none of the interest is excluded.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SAVINGS_WITHDRAWAL_PENALTY: Deductible savings-withdrawal penalty from the payer's statement. Full interest stays on line 2b; the penalty is a separate income adjustment and net-investment-income deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE2_LINE_13A_INVESTMENT_CR: Schedule 2 line 13a: the investment credit recapture of Form 4255 (identified 3468). It is added to the tax after the credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_1: Taxable refunds, credits or offsets of state and local income taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_12: Reservist, performing-artist and fee-basis official business expenses (Form 2106).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_14: Moving expenses for members of the Armed Forces and the intelligence community (Form 3903).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_24B: Expenses of renting personal property for profit, matching the income on line 8l.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_24F: Contributions to a section 501(c)(18)(D) pension plan.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_24K: Excess deductions of section 67(e) expenses from Schedule K-1 (Form 1041).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_2A: Alimony received under a pre-2019 instrument, and alimony recaptured from the payer in the third year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_4: Other gains or losses: the ordinary part of property sales (Form 4797), S corporation loan-basis gains, and stock losses that are ordinary.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_7: Unemployment compensation received, less the same year's repayments.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8A: Net operating loss deduction, shown as a negative amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8D: Foreign earned income exclusion from Form 2555, shown as a negative amount.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8E: Income from Form 8853: Archer and Medicare Advantage MSA distributions and taxable long-term care benefits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8F: Income from Form 8889: health savings account amounts included in income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8K: Stock options: compensation from incentive stock option and employee stock purchase plan sales that no W-2 reports.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8L: Income from renting personal property for profit when the rental is not a business.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8P: Section 461(l) excess business loss added back to income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_1_8Q: Taxable distributions from an ABLE account.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_13B: Recapture of the federal mortgage subsidy (Form 8828).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_13C: Additional tax on health savings account distributions (Form 8889).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_13D: Additional tax when you fail the health savings account testing period (Form 8889).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_13E: Additional tax on Archer MSA distributions (Form 8853).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_13F: Additional tax on Medicare Advantage MSA distributions (Form 8853).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_13K: W-2 box 12 code K tax plus 20% of Form 1099-NEC box 3 excess golden parachute payments. These amounts do not add income or withholding again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_16A: Social security and Medicare tax on tips you did not report to your employer (Form 4137).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_16B: Uncollected social security and Medicare tax on wages (Form 8919).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_17C: Uncollected social security and Medicare or railroad retirement tax on tips or group-term life insurance (W-2 box 12 codes A, B, M and N).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_18: Additional tax on excess contributions and accumulations (Form 5329 Parts III through IX).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_1A: Excess advance payments of the premium tax credit that you repay (Form 8962).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_1B: Repayment of the new clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 Schedule A Part II).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_1C: Repayment of the previously owned clean vehicle credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_2_5: Additional tax on early distributions and other tax-favored account distributions (Form 5329 Parts I and II).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_10: Amount paid with a request for an extension to file.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_11: Excess social security and tier 1 railroad retirement tax withheld.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_12: Credit for federal tax on fuels (Form 4136).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_13B: Credit for repayment of amounts included in income from earlier years.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_13E: Farm income tax deferral installment payment applied (Form 1062 line 14).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_15: Lines 9 through 12 and 14 added: Form 1040 line 31.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_2: Credit for child and dependent care expenses (Form 2441 line 11).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_6B: Credit for prior year minimum tax (Form 8801).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_6D: Credit for the elderly or the disabled (Schedule R).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_6H: District of Columbia first-time homebuyer credit (Form 8859).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_6J: Alternative fuel vehicle refueling property credit (Form 8911).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_6K: Credit to holders of tax credit bonds (Form 8912).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_8: Lines 1 through 4, 5a and 7 added: Form 1040 line 20.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_3_ELECTIVE_PAYMENT: Net elective payment after applying the credit to tax, reported on Schedule 3 line 13c.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_AI_FULL_YEAR_ITEMIZED: Schedule AI line 4 column (d): the itemized deductions on Form 1040 line 12e, or 0 with the standard deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_AI_FULL_YEAR_SELF_EMPLO: Schedule AI Part II column (d): the year's net profit from self-employment, before line 28's 92.35% reduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_AI_FULL_YEAR_SOCIAL_WAG: Schedule AI Part II column (d): the Social Security wages and tips of the person with self-employment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_1: The carryover of this year from line 8 of the prior Schedule B.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_2A: Difference between the estimated and the actual carryback to 2024.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_2B: Change from a foreign tax redetermination reported on Schedule C (Form 1116).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_2C: Domestic audit adjustments and other changes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_3_TOTAL: Total adjusted carryover; it is Form 1116 line 10.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_4: Carryover used against the excess limitation, oldest year first.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_5: The remainder of the oldest year expires.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_6: Foreign taxes above the credit limitation for 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_7: Excess foreign taxes carried back to 2025.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_8: Carryover left in this year's column.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_8_RETURN_YEAR: Excess foreign taxes carried forward from 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_LINE_8_TOTAL: Total carryover from earlier years left for later years.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_ORDINARY_DIVIDENDS: Schedule B line 6: ordinary dividends from every payer, carried to Form 1040 line 3b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_SAVINGS_BOND_EXCLUSIO: Schedule B line 3: excludable interest on series EE and I savings bonds, from Form 8815 line 14.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_SOURCE: {0}: {1}. Exempt interest is excluded. These listings reconcile to the retained source amounts; the return total is rounded to whole dollars.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_TAXABLE_INTEREST: Schedule B line 4: interest from every payer less the savings bond exclusion (line 3), carried to Form 1040 line 2b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_B_TOTAL_INTEREST: Schedule B line 2: total interest from every payer, before the savings bond exclusion.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_D_COMPUTED_TOTAL: Schedule D uses the same admitted capital sources and prior losses as your estimate. K-1 gains, capital gain distributions and carryovers remain separate; the summary keeps short-term and long-term character before the annual loss limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_D_SUMMARY_ANSWER: The summary uses your short-term and long-term results, qualified dividends and the investment-interest form included in this review.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_EIC_CHILD_N_DIED: {0} was born and died in 2026 and had no SSN: enter “Died” on line 2 and attach the birth certificate, death certificate or hospital records showing a live birth.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_EIC_CHILD_N_DISABLED: {0} was permanently and totally disabled during 2026: line 4b is Yes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_EIC_CHILD_N_MONTHS: Months {0} lived with you in the United States during 2026: 7 for more than half the year but under 7 months, 12 for a child born or who died in 2026 whose home was yours.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_EIC_CHILD_N_NAME: Child’s name, from the people page: {0}.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_EIC_CHILD_N_SSN: {0} has a valid Social Security number to enter on line 2.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_EIC_CHILD_N_STUDENT: {0} was under 24 at the end of 2026, a full-time student and younger than you: line 4a is Yes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_E_ESTATE_TOTALS: Schedule E Part III totals use the actual allowed passive and nonpassive income and deduction columns. Line 37 combines line 35 income and line 36 losses; no income or deduction is added again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_E_FARMING_FISHING_GROSS: Schedule E line 42: gross farming and fishing income from Form 4835 line 7 and Schedule K-1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_E_FARM_RENTAL_TOTAL: Schedule E line 40: net farm rental income or deductible loss from Form 4835.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_E_PROFESSIONAL_RENTALS: Income or loss reported from rental real estate activities in which a real estate professional materially participated.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_E_RENTAL_ROYALTY_TOTAL: Total rental real estate and royalty income or loss: each property's income or deductible loss, plus nonbusiness royalties.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_E_TOTALS: Schedule E Part I totals reconcile the property columns and allowed rental losses; royalty losses are included on line 25 separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_N_LINE_13Z_FORM_N: Negative Form 8978 adjustment after Schedule 3 line 6l, limited to verified Chapter 1 early-distribution and section 223 HSA additional taxes on 2026 Schedule 2 Part II. Section 4973 excess-contribution excise is excluded. The 2026 draft places other taxes on line 13z; the published 2025 worksheet calls it line 17z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCHEDULE_N_LINE_6L: 2026 Schedule 3 line 6l: smaller of the negative Form 8978 line 14 magnitude and Form 1040 line 18. Attach Form 8978, its Schedule A, Form 8986, and the prior-tax calculation statement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_ACTIVITY_NET: Ordinary S-corporation result after basis, at-risk and passive limits. Return-level limits and tax classifications remain separate.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_ACTIVITY_PASSIVE_SUSPENDED: Ordinary S-corporation loss remaining after the shared passive limit; distinct from basis and at-risk carries. No rental special allowance applies to this business activity.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_AMT_LOAN_GAIN_ADJUSTMENT: AMT repayment gain minus regular gain from independent adjusted debt bases. Missing AMT records remain unresolved.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_ENTITY_NONDEDUCTIBLE_CARRY: Unused expenses carry only under the established continuing losses-first election.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_N_BACKUP_WITHHOLDING: K-1 box 13 code O backup withholding, included once on Form 1040 line 25c; does not reduce ordinary income or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_N_CASH_CHARITY: K-1 box 12 code A cash contributions (60%), Schedule A line 11 with your own cash gifts or line 12f without itemizing; they reduce stock basis and are not part of Form 8582 or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_N_DISTRIBUTION_N_N: K-1 box 16 code D distributions above stock basis, capital gain on Form 8949 and Schedule D with the holding period of the shares; not corporate operating income or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_N_LOAN_N_N: Written-note repayment gain on Form 8949 and Schedule D, using the source holding period and independent regular/AMT debt basis. Personal-investment gain, not corporate operating income or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_N_SECTION1231: Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) box 9 net section 1231 gain or loss after the basis, at-risk and passive limits: Part I line 2, netted on line 8.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SCORP_ORDINARY_LOAN_GAIN: Ordinary gain on repayment of a personal-investment open-account shareholder loan, including a former open account. Form 4797 and Schedule 1 line 4; not operating income, self-employment earnings or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_BUSINESS_INCOME_LIMIT: Active ordinary business income/losses, your share of materially participated partnership and S-corporation ordinary income after basis and at-risk limits, and employee wages, without section 179 or half-SE deductions, coordinated with the hypothetical home-office deduction before actual limits are applied.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_CARRYFORWARD: Total unused elected cost carried by asset or K-1 to a later year, subject to that year's limits and continued eligibility.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_DEDUCTION: Total current section 179 deduction, included once in the originating businesses and K-1 activities (Schedule E line 28 column (j)). Preserve asset allocations with Form 4562.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_DOLLAR_LIMIT: 2026 maximum $2,560,000, reduced dollar-for-dollar by eligible cost above $4,090,000. For a separate return, this line is your allocated share after combining both spouses' eligible purchases; equal shares apply without matching percentage elections. It is not a per-business limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_ELIGIBLE_COST: All entered eligible 2026 purchases, including zero elections, determine the shared phaseout; Schedule K-1 section 179 shares count toward the elected total, not the phaseout (Regulations section 1.179-2(b)(3)).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_PASSIVE_ALLOWED: Section 179 deduction of this passive activity that the passive-loss limit (Form 8582) allows this year: Schedule E line 28 column (j).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_PASSIVE_UNALLOWED: Section 179 deduction of this passive activity held back by the passive-loss limit (Form 8582), in proportion to the activity's losses. It carries forward as its own section 179 entry of the activity's unallowed losses and is not qualified business income until allowed.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_PRIOR_CARRYOVER_TOTAL: Form 4562 line 10 includes prior disallowed section 179 deductions. The carryover attributable to sold K-1 property is restored to that property's basis and removed from this deduction balance; it does not reduce your outside basis again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_SHARED_DOLLAR_LIMIT: Combined dollar limit after both spouses' eligible purchases when filing separately, before allocating the limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION179_SPOUSE_ELIGIBLE_COST: Spouse's eligible purchases for separate-return phaseout only; not added to this return's income or depreciation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION_1256_NET_LOSS: The most a carryback election can carry back under Form 6781 box D: the lesser of the loss that would carry over to 2027 without a carryback and the Form 6781 line 5 loss plus any 2025 capital loss carryover, less the $3,000 ($1,500 if married filing separately) limit. An upper bound when a 2025 carryover came from section 1256 contracts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION_1256_N_AGGREGATE: Form 1099-B box 11 aggregate profit or (loss) on regulated futures, foreign currency and section 1256 option contracts for this statement; Form 6781 line 1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SECTION_N_ORDINARY_LOSS: Ordinary Form 4797 loss, limited across the return to $50,000 ($100,000 joint). Excess remains capital loss. Gains are never netted against this allowance. The ordinary loss is business loss for the NOL worksheet, not self-employment earnings or QBI.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SELF_EMPLOYMENT_TAX: Per-filer net earnings, Social Security wage-base coordination and Medicare self-employment tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SENIOR_DEDUCTION: Eligible SSN holders age 65 or older: phased deduction per person; unavailable to married separate filers.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SE_COMBINED_WITH_NOTARY: Combined farm and nonfarm profit after exempt notary net profit {0,number,currency} (Exempt—Notary).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SE_EXEMPTION_BOXES: Self-employment tax after exemptions. Taxpayer: Schedule 2 line 4 box {0}, code {1}, Schedule SE line A {2}. Spouse: box {3}, code {4}, line A {5}. Zero means no box or line A. Box 1: Form 4361; box 2: Form 4029; box 3: EN notary or EAS totalization.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SE_NONFARM_WITH_CLERGY: Schedule C and partnership profit plus ministerial earnings {0,number,currency}, before an approved exemption. Schedule SE line A indicator: {1} (1 means an approved Form 4361 exemption).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SOCIAL_LUMP_SUM_TAXABLE_REDUCTIO: Reduction in current taxable benefits from the lump-sum election. Benefits remain in current-year line 6a; earlier returns are not amended. Use the election indicator on the filed return when the reduction is positive.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NET_REPAYMENTS: Excess repayments after combining all box 5 amounts on this return. Net repayments do not create negative current-year benefit income; amounts of $3,000 or less do not qualify for the repealed miscellaneous itemized deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STANDARD_WITH_DISASTER_LOSS: The standard deduction claimed with a qualified net disaster loss; the loss itself is on line 17b.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_ALLOCATED: Prior-year part of one state/local income-tax refund, allocated pro rata by the years in which the tax was paid.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_ALLOCATED_2: 2026 part of the same refund, allocated pro rata. It reduces 2026 Schedule A state-income-tax payments and is not 2026 income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_ALLOCATED_3: 2026 part of the same refund, allocated pro rata. It reduces the retained 2026 state-income-tax payment ledger but has no state-income-tax deduction effect under the selected 2026 route and is not 2026 income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_ALLOCATED_4: One state/local income-tax refund allocated pro rata by the tax paid in this prior federal year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_NET_INCOME_TAX_: Eligible 2026 state-income-tax payments entered in Deductions after the current-year refund share. The existing SALT election and cap use this net amount; the refund is not subtracted a second time.
Net 2026 state-income-tax payment after this refund share, retained as source data only. It is not deducted when the standard deduction or general sales tax is selected.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_TAXABLE: Taxable prior-year recovery after this deduction year's Schedule A tax-benefit worksheet; only prior-year taxable shares reach Schedule 1 line 1.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STATE_REFUND_N_N_TAXABLE_2: Taxable share after this payment and deduction year's own Schedule A tax-benefit worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STOCK_N_CAPITAL_BASIS_LOSS: Capital portion from basis that does not qualify for ordinary loss; any excess over the annual ordinary-loss allowance is added separately.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STOCK_N_ORDINARY_BEFORE_LIMIT: Ordinary-loss portion before the annual allowance, after contributed-property and later-capital-contribution basis rules.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_STRIKE_BENEFITS: Strike or lockout benefits other than true gifts are earned income on Form 1040 line 1h.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_ALIMONY: Qualifying pre-2019 receipts plus payer recapture, after child-support priority and express new-law modifications. Decree-related amounts enter the applicable filer's IRA compensation; neither amount is EIC or SE earnings.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_CASUALTY_LIVING_INSURANC: Insurer-paid temporary main-home living expenses above the temporary increase, when the casualty did not occur in a federally declared disaster area. Schedule 1 line 8z; not wages, self-employment earnings or net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_GRANTS_1099G: Taxable grants (Form 1099-G box 6) on Schedule 1 line 8z; not wages, self-employment earnings, EIC or IRA compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_HEALTH_LOAN_ASSISTANCE: Loan repayment assistance from a health-professional service program (the National Health Service Corps or a state program) that is not confirmed as excluded under section 108(f)(4). Pub. 970 treats it as other income on Schedule 1 line 8z, not canceled debt.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_INCOME: Taxable income is floored at zero.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_LTC_BENEFITS: Taxable qualified periodic LTC and chronic-illness accelerated death benefits after shared per-period exclusions. Schedule 1 income, not wages, self-employment earnings or net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_PRIZES: Personal nonservice cash and noncash prizes on Schedule 1 line 8i, excluding refused and qualifying directly transferred awards. Not EIC, IRA or self-employment earnings; no automatic charitable deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_RELIEF_PAYMENTS: Wildfire or disaster relief payments not confirmed as excluded under section 139M or 139. Schedule 1 line 8z; not wages, self-employment earnings or net investment income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_SCHOLARSHIPS: Non-W-2 scholarships and fellowships on Schedule 1 line 8r. Earned for the dependent standard deduction, not EIC; taxable graduate/postdoctoral non-tuition stipends also supply IRA compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_SOCIAL_SECURITY: Pub. 915 provisional-income calculation before the student-loan deduction.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXABLE_STATE_TAX_REFUND: Schedule 1 line 1 recovery limited to the prior SALT and itemization benefit after allowing the general-sales-tax alternative. Refund interest is separate. This refund is excluded from AMT income and is not earned income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAXES_DEDUCTION: State and local taxes plus other deductible taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAX_CREDIT_BOND_CARRY_N_N: Unused 2026 Form 8912 qualified tax-credit or Build America bond credit attributable to issuer {0} and box 2b identifier {1}. Retain this same-bond balance for 2027 review. It is not a deduction or taxable interest again.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAX_CREDIT_BOND_CREDIT: Form 8912 line 12 and Schedule 3 line 6k: smaller of total same-bond credit and net income tax after the specified preceding credits.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TAX_CREDIT_BOND_USED_N: Form 8912 line 12 credit attributed to issuer {0} and box 2b identifier {1}. When multiple bonds are partly limited, this is the entered share; otherwise its unique amount is automatic. No IRS bond ordering is assumed.
