StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIMBER_AMORTIZATION: Original elected basis times the current allowed months over 84, rounded once and capped at actual remaining elected basis. Ordinary disposition includes its month; the original period never restarts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIMBER_CURRENT_EXPENSE: Actual original section 194(b) expense election, deducted only in its expenditure year. Other-source elections only use the property limit and are not deducted again here.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIMBER_ELECTED_BASIS: Original section 194(a) basis after actually excluded reimbursements and the separate original expense election. Unelected capital costs are retained, not automatically amortized.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIMBER_PERIOD: Section 194(a): 84 months beginning in July of the original expenditure year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIMBER_REMAINING: Qualified capital basis after the original expense election, actual prior amortization and this year's allowance, including unelected capital basis.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_CREDIT_CARRYFORWARD_N: 2026 Form 3800 Part IV line 4f column (i): 2025-origin credit remaining for 2027 within its 20-year carryforward period.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_CURRENT_CREDIT: 2026 Form 8846 line 4 and Form 3800 Part III line 4f column (e): current nonpassive employer-tip FICA credit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_CURRENT_CREDIT_CARRYBAC: Unused 2026 Form 8846 credit applied through a retained 2025 Form 3800 carryback worksheet and Form 1040-X or Form 1045.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_CURRENT_CREDIT_CARRYFOR: 2026-origin Form 8846 credit remaining for 2027 after 2026 tax use and the 2025 carryback.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_CURRENT_CREDIT_USED: 2026 Form 3800 Part III line 4f: current-year credit used after older carryforwards.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_N_CARRYBACK_USED: 2025-origin credit used on the 2024 carryback return before the 2026 carryforward.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_N_CREDIT_ORIGIN: 2025 Form 8846 line 6 and retained 2025 Form 3800 Part III line 4f specified credit; retain for the required carryforward statement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TIP_FICA_N_CREDIT_USED: 2025 Form 3800 applied credit, retained for the 2026 Part IV carryforward statement.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TOTAL_TAX: Income tax after nonrefundable credits plus self-employment and additional taxes.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ABLE_ROLLOVER_N_GROSS: 2026 Form 1099-R code G and Trump-account checkbox: entire account directly transferred to the same beneficiary's ABLE account during the year they turn 17. Box 2a and taxable income are zero; this does not consume the ABLE annual contribution limit.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ACCOUNT_N_N_LINE57_EXCESS: Form 5329 line 57: nonexempt 2026 contributions above $5,000, before completed corrective returns.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ACCOUNT_N_N_LINE59_RETURNE: Form 5329 line 59: excess principal returned by the 2026-return deadline; attributable income is not principal.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ACCOUNT_N_N_LINE60_REMAINI: Form 5329 line 60: excess principal remaining after timely returns.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ACCOUNT_N_N_LINE61_TAX: Form 5329 line 61 and Schedule 2 line 18: 6% tax on remaining 2026 excess contributions.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ACCOUNT_N_N_LINE62_EARNING: Form 5329 line 62: positive income attributable to excess returned during 2026, from Form 1099-R box 7d. Later returns belong to their receipt year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_ACCOUNT_N_N_LINE63_TAX: Form 5329 line 63 and Schedule 2 line 5: 100% additional tax on 2026 returned-excess income; the corrective distribution is not ordinary gross income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_DEATH_N_TAXABLE: Form 1099-R box 2a: death-date account value above trustee-reported basis. Shown provisionally as other income because the account ceases to be an IRA on death; no ordinary IRA contribution deduction or early-distribution tax. This is unearned income and can affect a young recipient's Form 8615.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_DEATH_N_VALUE: Form 1099-R box 1: the qualified Trump account is deemed distributed at its beneficiary's death during the growth period and ceases to be an IRA. Report on the acquirer's return, or the beneficiary's final return if the estate acquired it.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_TRUMP_DEATH_TAXABLE_INCOME: Section 530A(d)(6) income on the qualified beneficiary's death during the growth period: death-date Form 1099-R value less basis, reported once as other income of the acquirer or the deceased beneficiary when the estate acquired the account. The account is no longer an IRA at death; final 2026 Form 1040 line-placement instructions remain pending.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNDISTRIBUTED_GAIN_TAX_CREDIT: Form 2439 box 2 tax paid by the fund or REIT is a Schedule 3 payment credit, not federal withholding and not limited to this return's tax.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_N_N_AGRICULTURE_PAY: Form 1099-G box 7 agricultural program payment, added to this owner's Schedule F fully taxable agricultural-program income (line 4a/4b).
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_N_N_FAMILY_LEAVE: Paid family leave benefits (Form 1099-G box 10) on Schedule 1 line 8z under Rev. Rul. 2025-4, included only when no medical-leave portion is present.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_N_N_GROSS: Gross governmental unemployment benefits before repayments. These benefits are not wages, self-employment earnings or IRA compensation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_N_N_REPAID: 2026 benefits actually repaid in 2026. Show the repayment with Schedule 1 line 7; do not claim a second deduction or reduce recorded withholding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_N_N_TAXABLE: Schedule 1 line 7 taxable benefits after same-year repayments. Earlier-year repayments are not netted against current receipts.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_N_N_TAXABLE_GRANTS: Taxable grants (Form 1099-G box 6) on Schedule 1 line 8z.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNEMPLOYMENT_PRIOR_YEAR_REPAYMEN: Earlier-year benefits repaid in 2026 do not reduce current benefit income. With supported return-wide repayments of $3,000 or less, no deduction or section 1341 credit is allowed in 2026.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNRECAPTURED_SECTION_N_GAIN: Payer-reported section 1250 gain after capital-loss coordination, capped by net capital gain. The regular-tax rate is at most 25%, not a flat 25%.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_UNRECOVERED_ANNUITY_DEDUCTION: Other itemized deduction for contract investment unrecovered at the final annuitant's death, after current-year recovery and other tax-free refunds. Subject to the return's general itemized-deduction limitation.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_VARIABLE_ANNUITY_N_ELECTION: Election statement required under Regulations section 1.72-4(d)(3): annuity starting date {0,date}, age at that date {1}; first day of current payment period {2,date}; original investment shown here; prior tax-free recovery {3,number,currency}. State that the tax-free amount is being refigured. This App displays the calculation and does not file the election.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_VARIABLE_ANNUITY_N_N_ANNUAL_EXCL: Annual tax-free amount from original cost and expected payments, or the retained worksheet plus an elected shortfall adjustment; retain for next year.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_VARIABLE_ANNUITY_N_N_BASIS_RECOV: Annual exclusion prorated for the scheduled installments in a first or final year, limited to total payments received and unrecovered investment.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_VARIABLE_ANNUITY_N_N_EARLIER_REC: Tax-free recovery from the first annuitant's earlier current-year installments, capped by those receipts and common remaining investment. Not survivor income.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_VARIABLE_ANNUITY_N_N_REMAINING_B: Unrecovered cost after earlier first-annuitant and current recipient recovery; retain the common record for the next worksheet.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_VEHICLE_INTEREST_RECOVERY: The taxable recovery is the reduction in the prior Schedule 1-A deduction that reduced tax; current-year interest is unchanged.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_W2_UNCOLLECTED_PAYROLL_TAX: W-2 box 12 codes A/B/M/N enter Schedule 2 as tax due, not additional income or withholding.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_WAGES: Form 8958 community-allocated W-2 box 1 wages, then round the tax line. The worker's personal wages remain separate for payroll, IRA and EIC calculations.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_WAGES_2: Aggregate W-2 box 1 amounts, then round the tax line.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_WILDFIRE_RELIEF_N_EXCLUDED: 2026 section 139M qualified wildfire relief excluded from gross income. The exclusion does not allow a second deduction, credit or property-basis increase for compensated losses.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_WORTHLESS_SECURITY_N_LOSS: Long-term capital loss on a deemed December 31, 2026 sale. Ordinary inherited capital assets are long-term regardless of acquisition date. Netting and annual capital-loss limits apply.
StringResources.EXPLAIN_WORTHLESS_SECURITY_N_LOSS_2: Short-term capital loss on a deemed December 31, 2026 sale, measured from the day after the acquisition trade date. Netting and annual capital-loss limits apply.
StringResources.FARM126_COMPONENTS_ABOVE_COST: The disjoint noneligible, uncertified, rent or service and current-deduction components cannot exceed total cost.
StringResources.FARM126_COST_REQUIRED: Enter actual nonnegative improvement funding and a positive total cost.
StringResources.FARM126_EXCLUDED_FUNDING_ABOVE_SOURCE: Excluded funding applied cannot exceed this improvement's cost or the government payment received.
StringResources.FARM126_FUNDING_WITHOUT_EXCLUSION: Excluded funding applied must be zero when the program is not approved, conservation certification is absent, or you elected not to exclude any payment.
StringResources.FARM126_OWNER_ABOVE_COST: Actual owner and government amounts cannot exceed the total improvement cost.
StringResources.FARM126_PARTIAL_ELECTION_AMOUNT: The partial election amount cannot exceed the supported otherwise excludable portion.
StringResources.FARM126_PRIOR_INCOME_YEARS: Enter gross receipts for the affected acreage in each of the three years before installation began, once each.
StringResources.FARM126_PROPERTY_SOURCE: Select an accepted parcel belonging to this farm and acquired no later than the improvement was received. Save and reopen a new parcel before linking it.
StringResources.FARM126_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Enter the actual improvement, program, installation year, current economic-benefit receipt date and affected property source.
StringResources.FARM126_VALUATION_SOURCE: Use supported nonnegative income-right present values and the actual appraisal assumptions.
StringResources.FARM263A_RECEIPT_YEARS: Supply the actual statutory receipt-test years, months and aggregated gross receipts, including the required predecessor history.
StringResources.FARMER_EVEN_TIMING: Farmers and fishers figure the penalty on Form 2210-F, which has one payment due January 15, 2027: choose evenly for both withholding and income.
StringResources.FARM_AVERAGING_SELECTION_INVALID: Selected capital must not exceed the total election; selected unrecaptured gain must not exceed selected capital. Use distinct valid accepted source identities.
StringResources.FARM_AVERAGING_SOURCES_INVALID: Select each actual accepted farming or fishing source only once.
StringResources.FARM_AVERAGING_TWICE: Enter farm income averaging once for the whole return.
StringResources.FARM_CODE_113000: Forestry and logging (including forest nurseries and timber tracts)
StringResources.FARM_CODE_113210: Forest nurseries and gathering of forest products
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_BEFORE_ACQUIRED: Conservation costs and retained deductions must belong to this parcel's ownership period. Resolve predecessor or inherited history at its actual basis source.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_CARRY_DUPLICATE: Combine each parcel and source year's conservation carry in one record, retaining separate regular-tax and AMT amounts.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_CARRY_YEAR: Enter a prior source year for the unused conservation carry; current costs belong in current records.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_METHOD_CONFLICT: The same taxpayer cannot have both a never-elected section 175 history and a known prior deduction or established deduction method. Check the original returns or actual IRS consent covering a different farm or project.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_METHOD_HISTORY: Carried section 175 deductions and prior district payments cannot predate the claimed original deduction election. Check retained source years and original returns; a later change from capitalization needs its actual IRS consent.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_PAYMENT_DATE: Only a current-year assessment payment can have a current-year date. Keep an earlier payment's actual tax year without inventing a day.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_PLAN_REQUIRED: Identify the actual approved conservation or site-specific recovery plan, or select no approved plan.
StringResources.FARM_CONSERVATION_PROPERTY_SOURCE: Select an accepted parcel of this farm for every conservation cost, assessment and carry. Save new parcel facts first, then reopen this editor to select them.
StringResources.FARM_COST_SHARING_NEEDS_CASH: Enter excluded cost-sharing payments only on a cash-method farm.
StringResources.FARM_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Select an available saved income source for each farm source row.
StringResources.FARM_FERTILIZER_SOURCE: Supply actual capital fertilizer cost, payment/incurrence and application dates and retained original tax treatment. Prior recovered basis cannot exceed cost or precede a current-year cost.
StringResources.FARM_HEADER_CODE_INVALID: Choose the principal agricultural activity code from the current Schedule F list.
StringResources.FARM_HEADER_EIN_INVALID: Enter an actual nine-digit employer identification number, or leave it absent.
StringResources.FARM_HEDGE_SOURCE: Check the hedge identification, entry and settlement dates, ordinary business risk and source amount.
StringResources.FARM_INFORMATION_FILED: Information returns filed or will be filed
StringResources.FARM_INFORMATION_NOT_FILED: Required information returns not all filed
StringResources.FARM_LAND_BASIS_SOURCE: Check the parcel identity, acquisition date, regular/AMT basis and retained conservation/exclusion history.
StringResources.FARM_LAND_DUPLICATE_PARCEL: Enter a whole-parcel disposition once. A partial sale needs its actual allocated parcel and basis records; do not reuse the whole parcel for more than one sale.
StringResources.FARM_LAND_PART_ALLOCATION: The recorded amount must be nonnegative. Amounts allocated to all sold tracts together cannot exceed the selected parcel's corresponding opening amount.
StringResources.FARM_LAND_SOLD_BEFORE_ACQUIRED: The date sold cannot be before the date acquired.
StringResources.FARM_LEASE_ACTUAL_NOT_SUPPORTED: A farm vehicle lease using actual expenses needs the Schedule F rental and vehicle worksheets. Use supported standard mileage for the entire lease or remove this vehicle record.
StringResources.FARM_LIMITATIONS_INVALID: Choose each actual named farm situation once.
StringResources.FARM_LIMITATION_10: Other required income or timing source
StringResources.FARM_LIMITATION_4: Unfinished improvement economic fair market value
StringResources.FARM_LOSS_TWICE: Enter the farm loss carryback choice once for the whole return.
StringResources.FARM_METHOD_ADOPTED_YEAR: Enter the actual year this farm adopted its original accounting method.
StringResources.FARM_METHOD_CHANGE_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: This accounting-method transition needs an accepted, identified Form 3115 source owned by this farm.
StringResources.FARM_METHOD_SOURCE_ID: Select an actual accepted accounting-change source of this same activity and retain its approval/automatic-change evidence. Save new records, then reopen to link their assigned identities.
StringResources.FARM_ONLY_EXPENSE_IN_BUSINESS: Farm-only expense line in a business that is not a farm ({0}). Only a farm reports on Schedule F; enter this expense on its Schedule C line 8-27b, or as a described other expense on line 27b.
StringResources.FARM_OPTIONAL_SE_DIFFERS: The farm optional method applies to all of one person's farms: give each of their farms the same answer.
StringResources.FARM_OTHER_SOURCE: Check the actual ordinary farm other-income source and signed amount.
StringResources.FARM_OTHER_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Describe the actual additional farm source only when Other is selected.
StringResources.FARM_PRODUCTION_ALLOCATION: Production cost allocations must be nonnegative, disjoint, and no greater than their identified paid or incurred cost.
StringResources.FARM_PRODUCTION_DATES: Check the identified production record, actual production/service dates and retained source basis.
StringResources.FARM_PRODUCTION_EXPENSE_OWNER: The de minimis election excludes inventory and section 263A costs. Enter independently eligible purchases in ordinary business expenses; use actual ordinary, meal or nondeductible treatment for production costs.
StringResources.FARM_PRODUCTION_METHOD_SOURCE: Enter the actual original uniform-capitalization election year and supporting statement.
StringResources.FARM_PRODUCTION_RELEASE: Released inventory cost cannot exceed its actual available unrecovered regular or AMT basis.
StringResources.FARM_RENTAL_NO_INVESTMENT_CREDIT: The investment credit for the property of a farm rental is not calculated.
StringResources.FARM_RENTAL_PROPERTY_QUESTIONS_UPDATED: Review the property-use records for the farm rental property you sold, then save again. None of these edits has been saved yet.
StringResources.FARM_SPECIALS_LIST_LIMIT: Use the supported number of distinct farm source records.
StringResources.FARM_SUPPLY_PURCHASE_TERMS: A claimed binding purchase needs its actual quantity, price and delivery terms and a business purpose beyond reducing tax. If terms are unestablished, choose that answer instead of claiming a current unused-supply deduction.
StringResources.FARM_SUPPLY_REFUND_ABOVE_PAYMENT: The refund of this current unused payment cannot exceed its original paid amount. A recovery of a prior deducted payment needs its separate income source.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_ABOVE_PRODUCT_INCOME: Class income must already be included once in the matching raised or purchased product receipts; exclude business-use animal sales.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_COUNTS: Check actual total, normal and weather-forced animal counts and the class income.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_DESIGNATION_DATE: Check the actual federal assistance designation date, or leave the unknown date absent.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_DUPLICATE_CLASS: Combine this farm's source records within each generic livestock class; do not subdivide by age, breed or sex.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_INCOME_SPLIT: The raised-for-sale portion cannot exceed this record's class income.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_SOURCE: Supply the weather relationship and usual-practice evidence from actual records.
StringResources.FARM_WEATHER_YEARS: Use distinct actual years within the preceding three years; a new farm can use regional usual-practice evidence.
StringResources.FARM_WITHHOLDING_ABOVE_RECEIPTS: Federal income tax withheld cannot exceed the farm's income.
StringResources.FBAR_ANSWER_NEEDED: Answer the separate FBAR filing-requirement question for a foreign account; leave it empty when no foreign account is reported.
StringResources.FBAR_COUNTRIES_NEEDED: Select the countries of accounts reportable on your FBAR when filing is required; leave the list empty for No.
StringResources.FBAR_COUNTRY_NOT_LISTED: Select a country from this page's country list.
StringResources.FBAR_COUNTRY_SX: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
StringResources.FBAR_COUNTRY_UK: United Kingdom (England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales)
StringResources.FORECAST_NOT_WITHIN_TEN_PERCENT: The actual and originally forecast income amounts differ by more than10%. Correct the source amounts or retain the required lookback worksheet.
StringResources.FORECAST_SMALL_COST_EXCEPTION: The income-forecast lookback cost exception requires total capitalized cost of no more than $100,000, before depreciation, use allocation or credit reductions.
StringResources.FOREIGN_ACCOUNT_TWICE: Enter your foreign accounts and trusts once for the whole return.
StringResources.FOREIGN_ASSETS_VALUE_NEEDED: Enter the highest total value of your foreign financial assets during 2026.
StringResources.FOREIGN_BUSINESS_INCOME_FROM_SCHEDULE_C: A business run abroad takes its income from its Schedule C entry: enter zero income here.
StringResources.FOREIGN_BUSINESS_OWNER: A business run abroad must belong to the person whose income and tax the row records.
StringResources.FOREIGN_BUSINESS_TWICE: Choose each business run abroad once.
StringResources.FOREIGN_CARRYBACK_ADJUSTMENT_PRIOR_YEAR_: The carryback adjustment belongs only in the 2025 column.
StringResources.FOREIGN_CARRYOVER_BELOW_ZERO: The adjusted carryover of a year cannot be below zero.
StringResources.FOREIGN_CARRYOVER_CATEGORY_TWICE: Enter one Schedule B (Form 1116) for each category.
StringResources.FOREIGN_COUNTRY_CODE: Enter the two-letter IRS country code, or RIC for taxes a mutual fund passed through.
StringResources.FOREIGN_DEDUCTION_OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: Choose a person on this return for the foreign tax on earned income; a spouse's taxes belong here only on a joint return.
StringResources.FOREIGN_GROSS_CORRECTION_UNAVAILABLE: The required Form 1116 gross-income correction for royalties and nonbusiness property cannot be represented in its native amount. No final tax can be reported.
StringResources.FOREIGN_HOUSING_STAY_OUTSIDE_PERIOD: Each housing stay must be inside your qualifying period.
StringResources.FOREIGN_HOUSING_STAY_OUTSIDE_RETURN_YEAR: Each housing stay must start on or before the day it ends, inside 2026.
StringResources.FOREIGN_PASSIVE_GROSS_UNAVAILABLE: The required Form 1116 passive gross income cannot be represented in its native amount. No final tax can be reported.
StringResources.FOREIGN_PRESENCE_PERIOD_OUTSIDE_RETURN_Y: The 12 months must include part of 2026.
StringResources.FOREIGN_PRIOR_ONLY_NEEDS_HISTORY: For prior-service pay only, enter the retained 2025 pay and return records, no 2026 qualifying award months and no current housing claim.
StringResources.FOREIGN_PRIOR_TAX_NEEDS_PAID_BASIS: Tax paid now on earlier years' income counts only when you claim foreign taxes when paid.
StringResources.FOREIGN_QUALIFIED_ABOVE_INCOME: Qualified dividends cannot exceed this source's income.
StringResources.FOREIGN_RESIDENCE_BEGAN_AFTER_RETURN_YEA: A bona fide residence must have begun by the end of 2026.
StringResources.FOREIGN_RESIDENCE_ENDED_BEFORE_RETURN_YE: The residence must end after it began, and no earlier than January 1, 2026.
StringResources.FOREIGN_RESIDENCE_NO_FULL_YEAR: A bona fide residence must include a whole calendar year, January 1 through December 31.
StringResources.FOREIGN_REVOCATION_YEAR_OUTSIDE_PERIOD: Enter a revocation effective for2021 through2025, or choose no revocation in that period.
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_1: Predominantly engaged in a banking, insurance, financing or similar business
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_2: Dividends, interest, rents or royalties from a foreign company you own 10% or more of
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_3: Foreign oil and gas extraction or oil-related income or taxes
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_4: Foreign mineral income with percentage depletion
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_5: Participation in or cooperation with an international boycott
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_6: Foreign taxes suspended under a splitting event, outside a Schedule K-3
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_7: A required Form 5471 or 8865 not filed
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_8: A disposition of property used in a foreign business while an overall foreign loss account is open
StringResources.FOREIGN_SITUATION_9: Interest on debt directly allocated to specific property
StringResources.FORM_1099G_GRANT_NEEDS_A_USE: Say who received the box 6 grant.
StringResources.FORM_1099G_WITHHOLDING_ABOVE_BENEFITS: Box 4 cannot exceed the payments in boxes 1, 5, 6, 7, 9 and 10.
StringResources.FORM_1099_USE_NOT_RECOVERY: A Form 1099 does not report a refund of an earlier year's deduction; enter that as its own Other income item.
StringResources.FORM_2439_PARTS_ABOVE_1A: Form 2439: boxes 1b, 1c and 1d are parts of box 1a and cannot add up to more than it.
StringResources.FORM_2439_SECTION_1202_NEEDS_EXCLUSION: Form 2439: choose the section 1202 exclusion for the box 1c gain.
StringResources.FORM_2439_TAX_ABOVE_1A: Form 2439: the tax paid in box 2 cannot be more than the gain in box 1a.
StringResources.FORM_2555_NOTHING_CLAIMED: Choose the exclusion, a housing claim, or both; otherwise remove this Form 2555.
StringResources.FORM_2555_TWICE: Enter one Form 2555 for each person.
StringResources.FORM_8606_ADJUSTMENT_BELOW_BASIS: The adjustment cannot take the Form 8606 basis below zero: a decrease is limited to line 14 plus any increase.
StringResources.FORM_8606_TWICE: Enter last year's Form 8606 only once for each owner.
StringResources.FORM_8915_CARRIED_BACK_ABOVE_EXCESS: The amount carried back cannot exceed the 2025 form's excess repayment (line 14 over line 13, or line 25 over line 24).
StringResources.FORM_8915_DISASTER_AFTER_FORM: A 2024 Form 8915-F reports only disasters that began in 2024 or earlier (item B).
StringResources.FORM_8915_TWICE: Enter each earlier Form 8915-F once for each filer, tax year and disaster year.
StringResources.FORM_8919_CODE_H_NEEDS_1099: Reason H applies only when the same firm gave you a Form 1099 as well as a W-2; answer Yes to receiving a Form 1099.
StringResources.FUEL_BLOCKED_PUMP_BUYER_RECORD: Enter the buyer's name and address together. Locked-pump sales over five gallons require both.
StringResources.GAMBLING_BUSINESS_WITHHOLDING_ABOVE_WINN: W-2G withholding cannot exceed the gross winnings on line 1.
StringResources.GAMBLING_LOSSES_TWICE: Enter your gambling losses and winnings without a W-2G once for the whole return.
StringResources.GIFT_APPRAISAL_EFFECTIVE_DATE: The effective valuation cannot follow the contribution; a report completed afterward must value the property on the contribution date.
StringResources.GIFT_APPRAISAL_TOO_EARLY: The appraisal report and effective valuation cannot be more than 60 days before the contribution.
StringResources.GIFT_APPRAISAL_UNKNOWN: Choose an appraisal saved on this page.
StringResources.GIFT_BENEFIT_ABOVE_VALUE: The goods or services received must be worth less than the donated property.
StringResources.GIFT_BOUGHT_AFTER_GIVEN: The date you bought it cannot be after the date you gave it.
StringResources.GIFT_ELECTION_NEEDS_CARRY_APPRECIATION: Enter the appreciation included in each prior 30% capital-gain-property balance before making the basis election.
StringResources.GIFT_FACTS_INVALID: Check the contribution dates, descriptions, amounts and carryover records.
StringResources.GIFT_GOODS_SECTION_B: One kind of clothing, household items, books or jewelry totals more than $5,000 for 2026. That needs a qualified appraisal and Form 8283 Section B, which this App does not calculate yet.
StringResources.GIFT_HISTORIC_CREDITS_PURPOSE: Prior rehabilitation credits apply only to an easement on a certified historic structure.
StringResources.GIFT_ITEM_NEEDS_APPRAISAL: Clothing or household items not in good used condition can be claimed only for a single item over $500 with a qualified appraisal.
StringResources.GIFT_PRIOR_HOUSEHOLD_TWICE: Enter one 2025 household item carryover; this App calculates only one.
StringResources.GIFT_PRIOR_STOCK_TWICE: Enter one 2025 stock carryover; this App calculates only one.
StringResources.GIFT_VALUE_ABOVE_COST: A used item's fair market value cannot be more than you paid; property worth more than its cost is under More itemized deductions.
StringResources.HEALTH_CHILD_ABOVE_PREMIUMS: The included child premium increase cannot exceed this month's total paid ordinary premium.
StringResources.HEALTH_CORRECTION_DOCUMENT_DETAILS_REQUI: Complete the contribution correction for each entered HSA returned-excess statement or Archer statement without printed earnings, including its principal, signed attributable income, contribution year and payer.
StringResources.HEALTH_CORRECTION_DOCUMENT_EARNINGS: The linked corrections' positive actual earnings must reconcile to the statement's printed earnings.
StringResources.HEALTH_CORRECTION_DOCUMENT_GROSS: The principal and signed attributable income of the linked correction rows must equal the statement's actual gross cash returned.
StringResources.HEALTH_CORRECTION_DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Select this owner's actual accepted returned-excess statement, or leave the link empty for a manual correction.
StringResources.HEALTH_CORRECTION_DOCUMENT_YEAR: The linked statement is for this tax year; its correction must have been returned during that year.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Enter the matching owner’s current HSA or Archer MSA account facts for a current-year employer contribution.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_SOURCE_CHANGED: Review the W-2 contribution-year allocation before changing its source amount. Clear an accepted split on Health and medical savings accounts before changing the linked W-2.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_SOURCE_NOT_OFFERED: Use every actual entered W-2 medical-account contribution source exactly once.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_SOURCE_REFERENCED: Clear this W-2’s contribution-year allocation on Health and medical savings accounts before removing or changing its owner, source kind or code.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_SOURCE_TWICE: This W-2 medical-account contribution source can be allocated only once.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_SPLIT_ABOVE_REPORTED: The current-year part cannot exceed the actual W-2 code amount; the remainder belongs to the prior year.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_TOTAL_INVALID: Employer contribution amounts must be nonnegative and fit the supported total.
StringResources.HEALTH_EMPLOYER_YEAR_REQUIRED: Choose the actual contribution year for each entered W-2 medical-account employer amount before completing this estimate.
StringResources.HEALTH_FAILED_DEPOSIT_PERSONAL_REQUIRED: A linked failed cash deposit is a personal contribution; choose Personal for its correction.
StringResources.HEALTH_FAILED_DEPOSIT_RETURN_ABOVE_DEPOS: The combined principal returned for this original source, destination, deposit date and year cannot exceed its actual failed cash deposit. Other manual deposits provide separate correction room.
StringResources.HEALTH_FAILED_DEPOSIT_UNAVAILABLE: Choose this owner's actual failed cash deposit with the same destination, contribution date and designated year. Update or remove its correction before changing or deleting that original source.
StringResources.HEALTH_LOAN_INTEREST_ABOVE_ASSISTANCE: The interest paid through the program cannot exceed the assistance.
StringResources.HEALTH_PARTNERSHIP_POLICY_ON_CORPORATION: A partnership-named policy paid by its partner is a partnership source. An S-corporation plan requires the corporation's actual payment or reimbursement and existing W-2 reporting.
StringResources.HEALTH_POLICY_BENCHMARK_REQUIRED: Obtain the actual applicable silver-plan benchmarks for this policy's coverage-family members and its other enrolled family members in Self-employed benefits. They are needed to divide specified and nonspecified premiums without guessing a head-count share.
StringResources.HEALTH_POLICY_CHILD_FUNDING_ABOVE_COST: The child-funded portion cannot exceed the actual included child cost or premium funding. Use the source's actual attribution, independently of the silver-plan allocation.
StringResources.HEALTH_POLICY_EXPENSE_ALLOCATION_REQUIRE: Use the actual premium-funding records to identify how much tax-free payment or reimbursement applies to coverage-family premiums and how much applies to other enrolled people. The self-employed deduction for this policy needs that attribution; the App does not assume a person's reimbursement follows a silver-plan percentage.
StringResources.HEALTH_POLICY_MEDICAL_ALLOCATION_REQUIRE: This Marketplace policy includes someone whose premiums are not independently established as medical expenses for this return. Its medical deduction is omitted pending actual premium-cost and funding attribution. A silver-plan percentage or tax-family membership does not establish that cost; the known premium-credit reconciliation is retained.
StringResources.HEALTH_POLICY_PLAN_MONTH_REQUIRED: Enter the plan's actual establishment and employer-coverage eligibility for each assigned Marketplace month in Self-employed benefits. Enter zero ordinary premiums when the saved Form 1095-A is its only premium source; the policy assignment already supplies that payment.
StringResources.HEALTH_REIMBURSED_CHILD_ABOVE_TOTAL: The reimbursed child premium increase cannot exceed this month's total reimbursed ordinary premium.
StringResources.HEALTH_REIMBURSED_COVERAGE_ABOVE_TOTAL: The reimbursed specified coverage-family premium cannot exceed the total reimbursed premium assigned to this business.
StringResources.HEALTH_REIMBURSEMENT_ABOVE_SOURCE: Actual reimbursement must fit this paid premium and its included child and medical portions. Review the source amounts; reimbursement is not another expense.
StringResources.HEALTH_SOURCE_AMOUNTS_UNAVAILABLE: The combined health premium source amounts exceed the supported arithmetic range.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Enter this statement owner's actual HSA or Archer MSA eligibility and contribution records.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_DEPOSIT_INVALID: Choose each actual same-owner failed-rollover deposit included in this statement once.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_FUNDING_INVALID: Choose each actual qualified IRA-to-HSA transfer included in this statement once, using its original payment and funding date.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_SOURCES_CHANGED: The health-account statements changed. Reopen this page to review the current sources.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_SPLIT_INVALID: Reconcile these contribution classifications with the printed statement amounts.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_SPLIT_REQUIRED: Use custodian and employer records to establish the contribution-year and employer portions of this Form 5498-SA.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_TOTAL_INVALID: The actual health-account source totals cannot be represented. Review the source amounts.
StringResources.HEALTH_STATEMENT_W2_INVALID: Choose the actual same-owner W-2 and only its current-year contribution portion included in this statement.
StringResources.HOH_NEEDS_HOME_COST: Head of household requires paying more than half the cost of keeping up your home.
StringResources.HOME_ACQUIRED_AFTER_SALE: Sale of your main home: the date you got the home must be before the closing date (1099-S box 1).
StringResources.HOME_ACTIVITY_ALLOCATION_INVALID: Enter each activity once, use shares from zero through 10000 and positive allocation parts, and explain any partial income or expense-period share.
StringResources.HOME_ACTIVITY_PERIOD_SHARES_EXCESS: This activity's shares across its homes exceed its annual income or expenses. Allocate the actual annual source only once.
StringResources.HOME_ACTIVITY_REQUIRED: Select at least one saved business or farm for this home-use claim.
StringResources.HOME_ACTIVITY_SOURCE_INVALID: Select a saved business or farm belonging to the owner of this home-use claim.
StringResources.HOME_ACTIVITY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A linked activity is unavailable in this calculation. Resolve its source records before claiming the dependent home-use amounts.
StringResources.HOME_AT_RISK_LOSS_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The home-use deduction creates a business loss whose at-risk source records are unavailable. No completed tax is reported from an assumed risk amount.
StringResources.HOME_BUILDING_SOURCE_INVALID: Correct the building's dates, nonnegative basis and value, land portions, or retained depreciation history. Earlier simplified years must be unique completed years after business use began.
StringResources.HOME_BUSINESS_AREA_ABOVE_HOME: Enter positive qualifying business space whose combined exclusive and shared areas do not exceed the home area.
StringResources.HOME_CARRY_NEGATIVE: Carryovers cannot be negative. Enter the retained operating, depreciation and casualty amounts from their supporting worksheets.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE: The allowed casualty amount or its retained character is unavailable. Resolve the linked casualty worksheet.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_DAMAGE_REQUIRED: A property linked to a business home needs its actual damage status, including an explicit unavailable-records answer when necessary. An unlinked property leaves that answer inactive.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_DAMAGE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The records do not establish whether this business property was damaged, destroyed or stolen. Its business casualty amount remains unavailable.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_GAIN_CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE: This business-property reimbursement produces a gain whose recognition, recapture and replacement-election worksheet is not yet available.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_HOME_BINDING_INVALID: Bind this casualty property to one accepted home and select the same event on that home. Conflicting property bindings cannot establish a deduction.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE: The linked casualty amounts cannot be represented by the native worksheet. Correct the actual source records before calculating.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_PROPERTY_LINK_REQUIRED: Each selected home casualty event must contain exactly one property explicitly bound to that home.
StringResources.HOME_CASUALTY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The linked casualty source is incomplete. Its business-use loss cannot be inferred from the personal amount or from unavailable records.
StringResources.HOME_COMBINED_USE_ABOVE_HOME: The owners' combined allocated business use exceeds the whole property. Allocate their actual space once.
StringResources.HOME_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: This home calculation needs the current return invocation and its observed income and tax limits. A first trial is not a completed return.
StringResources.HOME_COST_OUTSIDE_USE_PERIOD: Use a cost period within each affected owner's qualifying home-use period, and select an owner with a claim on this home.
StringResources.HOME_COST_PERIOD_AMOUNT_INVALID: Enter a nonnegative home cost and valid dates in chronological order.
StringResources.HOME_DAYCARE_TIME_INVALID: Daycare hours cannot exceed the calendar hours available for shared use. Enter zero shared-use hours when no shared area is claimed.
StringResources.HOME_DEATH_AFTER_SALE: Sale of your main home: your spouse's date of death must be on or before the closing date.
StringResources.HOME_DEPRECIATION_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE: This home depreciation schedule needs its retained historical-method, disposition or production-property worksheet. No replacement depreciation amount is assumed.
StringResources.HOME_EARLIER_SALE_AFTER_SALE: Sale of your main home: the earlier home sale must be before this closing date.
StringResources.HOME_EXCHANGE_VALUE_ABOVE_PRICE: Sale of your main home: the like-kind property received cannot be worth more than the selling price.
StringResources.HOME_FARM_PREPAID_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The farm prepaid ceiling depends on an unavailable home-use worksheet. Resolve its actual source records before calculating the coupled deductions.
StringResources.HOME_FIRPTA_WITHOUT_BOX_7: Sale of your main home: enter the tax the buyer withheld only when 1099-S box 7 says you are a foreign person.
StringResources.HOME_GAIN_ATTRIBUTION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The accepted sale records do not identify the capital or business-property gain attributable to this home. The home-use income limit remains unavailable; the sale source is retained.
StringResources.HOME_LAND_ABOVE_BASIS: The land basis cannot exceed the whole-property adjusted basis.
StringResources.HOME_LAND_ABOVE_VALUE: The land value cannot exceed the whole-property conversion value.
StringResources.HOME_LIVED_ABOVE_OWNED: Sale of your main home: the days lived there cannot exceed the days since you got the home, or the 1,826 days of the 5 years before the sale.
StringResources.HOME_MORTGAGE_CREDIT_SOURCE_LINK_UNAVAIL: The mortgage interest credit needs an explicit link between its certificate and this home's canonical loan before the home-use interest can be completed.
StringResources.HOME_MORTGAGE_ROOT_TWICE: Select each original mortgage loan once and bind it to one home. Later lenders follow that same original loan.
StringResources.HOME_MORTGAGE_SOURCE_INVALID: Select a saved original mortgage loan for this home.
StringResources.HOME_NONQUALIFIED_ABOVE_OWNED: Sale of your main home: the days nobody used it as a main home cannot exceed the days you owned it.
StringResources.HOME_OFFICE_AREA_ABOVE_HOME: The office's square feet cannot exceed the whole home's square feet.
StringResources.HOME_OFFICE_LAND_ABOVE_BASIS: The part for the land cannot exceed what the home cost or its value.
StringResources.HOME_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE: These home source amounts cannot be represented by the native worksheet. No deduction or carryover is inferred from an overflow.
StringResources.HOME_OWNER_CLAIM_REQUIRED: Add one claim for each owner using this home, with no more than one claim per owner.
StringResources.HOME_OWNER_CLAIM_TWICE: Combine this owner's activities into one home-use claim for this physical home.
StringResources.HOME_PAYMENT_SHARE_UNAVAILABLE: Enter positive parts for both owners when dividing their paid home costs.
StringResources.HOME_PRIOR_OWNER_AFTER_ACQUIRED: Sale of your main home: the earlier owner's date cannot be after the date you got the home.
StringResources.HOME_PROPERTY_VALUE_WITHOUT_BOX_6: Sale of your main home: enter the value of property or services received only when 1099-S box 6 is checked.
StringResources.HOME_SALE_ANSWERS_NEEDED: Answer what you sold, your main home or other real estate, and its facts, so the sale can be figured.
StringResources.HOME_SALE_NOT_IN_CURRENT_YEAR: Sale of your main home: enter a sale that closed in 2026 (1099-S box 1).
StringResources.HOME_SEPARATE_AREA_ABOVE_WHOLE: Sale of your main home: the separate space must be smaller than the whole property, in the same unit.
StringResources.HOME_SEPARATE_DEPRECIATION_ABOVE_COST: Sale of your main home: the depreciation on the separate space cannot exceed its share of the cost, which is your adjusted basis plus that depreciation, by floor area.
StringResources.HOME_SERVICE_LIVED_ABOVE_OWNED: Sale of your main home: the days lived there in the added period cannot exceed the days you owned the home before the 5 years, up to the days of service elected.
StringResources.HOME_SERVICE_SPOUSE_NEEDED: Sale of your main home: on a joint return, enter the days your spouse lived there in the added period (0 if none).
StringResources.HOME_SERVICE_SPOUSE_NOT_JOINT: Sale of your main home: leave your spouse's days in the added period empty unless you file a joint return.
StringResources.HOME_SERVICE_WITH_SURVIVING: Sale of your main home: the service election is not combined with the surviving-spouse exclusion on this page.
StringResources.HOME_SHARED_AREA_NEEDS_DAYCARE: Shared business area requires an established daycare use. Other home-use qualifications require the qualifying exclusive area.
StringResources.HOME_SIMPLIFIED_AREA_ABOVE_HOME: The monthly exclusive and shared qualifying areas cannot exceed the whole home area.
StringResources.HOME_SIMPLIFIED_DAYS_INVALID: The qualifying-day count cannot exceed the actual calendar days in that month.
StringResources.HOME_SIMPLIFIED_ONE_HOME_PER_OWNER: Each owner can elect the simplified method for at most one physical home during the year. Another home uses its actual-expense worksheet.
StringResources.HOME_SIMPLIFIED_SHARED_NEEDS_DAYCARE: Simplified shared-use area and days require a daycare use.
StringResources.HOME_SIMPLIFIED_TWELVE_MONTHS: Enter each of the twelve months exactly once, using zero qualifying days for a month without qualifying use.

StringResources.HSA_CORRECTED_EMPLOYER_ABOVE_CONTRIBUTED: The employer excess returned for 2026 cannot be more than the employer contributions.
StringResources.HSA_CORRECTED_PERSONAL_ABOVE_CONTRIBUTED: The personal excess returned for 2026 cannot be more than the personal contributions.
StringResources.HSA_CORRECTION_DEADLINE_BEFORE_DEPOSIT: The correction deadline cannot be before the deposit.
StringResources.HSA_CORRECTION_LOSS_ABOVE_PRINCIPAL: A loss cannot be more than the principal returned.
StringResources.HSA_CORRECTION_RETURNED_BEFORE_DEPOSIT: The excess cannot be returned before it was deposited.
StringResources.HSA_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Confirm whether this HSA owner can be claimed as a dependent to calculate contribution income and excess tax. A qualified IRA-to-HSA funding transfer also requires an eligible owner; claimable owners can still receive ordinary HSA distributions.
StringResources.HSA_EXCESS_ACCOUNTING_REQUIRED: Contributions exceed this owner's HSA contribution limit. Review eligibility, the family split and timely returns of excess contributions. If excess remains, open Excess contributions to this HSA and enter the year-end account value and any later deposits so the App can calculate Form 5329's 6% additional tax.
StringResources.HSA_FAMILY_PARTS_ZERO: At least one of you must have a nonzero share of the HSA family contribution limit.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_BEFORE_INHERITED_DEATH: An inherited IRA funding distribution cannot be before the original owner's death. Correct the actual payment date or its inherited source link.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_DISTRIBUTION_AFTER_RECEIPT: The IRA distribution cannot be after the HSA received that transfer. Correct the actual source date or HSA receipt date.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_DISTRIBUTION_YEAR: Enter the actual valid 2026 IRA distribution date. The HSA receipt date and a contribution designation for another year do not change the distribution year.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_HISTORY_SAME_MONTH: Two IRA transfers cannot both be in the same month.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_LIFETIME: Qualified IRA-to-HSA funding is once per lifetime. A second distribution is allowed only in a later month of the same year after self-only coverage changes to family coverage; use the actual IRA distribution dates, not HSA receipt dates.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_LOSS_BEFORE_FUNDING: The first loss of eligibility cannot be before the transfer.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_NEEDS_AN_ACCOUNT: Add the owner's health savings account before the transfers from an IRA to it.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_NEEDS_COVERAGE: A transfer needs eligible coverage when it was made.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_ONGOING_SEP_SIMPLE: An ongoing SEP or SIMPLE IRA cannot fund a qualified HSA transfer. StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_ORDER_CONTRADICTED: The funding-first answer disagrees with an earlier ordinary Roth withdrawal in the same group. Correct the answer in Health accounts or the actual withdrawal date in Retirement.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_OWNER_DIED_BEFORE_RECEIPT: This HSA receipt was after the account owner's death. This transfer needs source treatment the App cannot establish here. Keep its actual IRA distribution date and income source; the receipt does not change that date.
StringResources.HSA_FUNDING_SOURCE_NOT_OFFERED: Choose an existing same-owner IRA Form 1099-R payment. An inherited payment must retain its valid beneficiary/deceased-owner group; the annual group itself is not a payment.
StringResources.HSA_LAST_MONTH_DECEMBER_NEEDED: The last-month rule needs eligible coverage in December 2025.
StringResources.HSA_LATER_EMPLOYER_ABOVE_NET: The employer part of the later deposits cannot be more than the employer contributions left after the excess returned.
StringResources.HSA_LATER_EMPLOYER_DEPOSITS_ABOVE_LATER: The employer part of the later deposits cannot be more than all the later deposits.
StringResources.HSA_LATER_PERSONAL_ABOVE_NET: The personal part of the later deposits cannot be more than the personal contributions left after the excess returned.
StringResources.HSA_LATE_EXCESS_NOT_LATE: The distribution must come after the correction deadline; an earlier one is a timely correction.
StringResources.HSA_LIMIT_METHOD_NEEDS_ACCOUNT: Enter an actual HSA account before choosing the December contribution-limit method.
StringResources.HSA_OTHER_OWNER_CONTEXT_INVALID: Supply other-filer eligibility only for a married return with exactly one listed HSA owner, with all twelve months when eligibility changed. When both owners have entries, use those entries' eligibility instead.
StringResources.HSA_OTHER_OWNER_ELIGIBILITY_REQUIRED: Enter the other filer's actual monthly HSA eligibility, including an ineligible full year. An absent HSA account does not establish whether spouses share the family contribution limit.

StringResources.HSA_ROLLOVER_BEFORE_RECEIPT: The rollover cannot be deposited before the distribution was received.
StringResources.HSA_ROLLOVER_PRECEDING_AFTER_RECEIPT: The preceding rollover must be before this distribution.

StringResources.INTANGIBLE_CLASSIFICATION: This asset or right needs its statutory classification before a section 197 deduction can be determined.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_CREATIVE_SOURCE: Separately acquired film, book and recording rights retain their existing finite-life or income-forecast source, including its original useful-life and election facts. Correct this record through normal editing and enter its cost once in that source.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_DISPOSITION_GROUP: This actual disposition needs the original clock's disposal-month cutoff, actual prior recovery, retained-intangible loss reallocation and grouped recapture before per-asset gain or loss can be recognized.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_EVENTS_UNAVAILABLE: Basis, use and transfer records are unavailable; absence of events cannot be assumed.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_FINITE_SOURCE: This separate government, patent/copyright/know-how, mortgage-servicing or fixed-term right needs the specific statutory exception and useful-life facts. The broad category alone does not resolve section 197. Preserve the existing finite-life non-MACRS alternative when the actual right is excluded, entering its cost once.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_FIXED_RIGHT_SOURCE: This fixed-term right needs the actual underlying property or service right before its section 197 treatment is determined. A whole-business acquisition does not override an excluded right to receive tangible property or services. Preserve its actual finite-life, lease or property source without duplicating cost.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_HISTORIC_SOURCE: Historical or unproved origin needs transition-period holders/users, relationships, transaction-series and applicable seller/depreciability exceptions. A new acquisition or renewal date alone does not resolve anti-churning; a pre-1993 election is not assumed.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_LEASE_SOURCE: The recorded lease needs its actual counterparty and full statutory term, including options, renewals and related arrangements, before any section 197 tax-exempt-use floor is determined. Leased does not mean ineligible.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_LEASE_UNAVAILABLE: The lease records are unavailable; this intangible's section 197 deduction remains undetermined.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_MORTGAGE_SOURCE: Mortgage servicing rights need the actual servicing interest, residential-business-acquisition facts and any stripped-coupon treatment before section 197 is determined. This broad category alone does not establish eligibility or exclusion. Preserve the finite-life property source when its statutory exception applies, entering the cost once.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_NONCOMPETE_TRANSACTION: A covenant not to compete needs its actual connection with a business or business-interest acquisition. The recorded separate-right facts do not establish that connection.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_OTHER_OWNER: Financial interests, land rights and existing tangible-property leases need their actual investment, property or lease source; section 197 does not supply their deduction. Correct this source and enter the cost only once.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_OWNERSHIP_INTEREST: A business ownership interest is not an amortizable acquisition of its underlying intangible assets. Any deemed-asset-purchase treatment needs its actual election and source records.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_PAYMENT_SOURCE: Contingent principal/interest, recurring-use payments and inclusion timing need the actual agreement and accounting sources before this deduction is determined.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_PREDECESSOR_INVALID: Choose an actual earlier intangible in this same activity, or leave the predecessor unlinked. A missing, duplicate, other-source or later record cannot identify the predecessor.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_PRIOR_CORRECTION: Actual earlier regular or AMT deductions differ from the original statutory schedule. Their correction and adjusted-basis treatment need the actual recovery-history source; no catch-up deduction is assumed.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_PRIOR_UNAVAILABLE: Actual pre-return-year regular and AMT deductions are needed from earlier returns and basis records, including all additions.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_RECORDED_EVENTS: The recorded decrease, changed use or transfer needs its dated amount, use and transaction source before recovery is determined. A documented acquisition-date price correction belongs once in original cost; later reductions cannot be treated as that correction.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_SELECTED_ASSETS: The acquired and seller-retained operating assets need the substantial-business-portion analysis; selected assets are not automatically admitted or excluded.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_SELF_CREATED: This separately self-created intangible is outside ordinary section 197 amortization. Use its actual research or finite-life source where applicable, preserving cost once; no useful life or election is assumed.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_SOFTWARE_SOURCE: Classify this software in the existing non-MACRS property source: purchased software, hardware-bundled software, or research/development. Business-acquisition and mass-market software need their actual statutory facts. Move its cost once; do not deduct it in both sources.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_SOURCE_DATES: Acquisition, business commencement and all entered cost-inclusion dates must reach the return year before this year's deduction is determined.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_TRANSFER_SOURCE: This gift, inheritance, entity transaction or exchange needs its actual carryover/stepped-basis and transfer records before section 197 recovery can be determined.
StringResources.INTANGIBLE_USE_UNAVAILABLE: Disposition or continued business-use records are unavailable; continued ownership and use cannot be assumed.

StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_EXEMPT_ABOVE_BOX: The combined nominee and after-death exempt cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_FOREIGN_TAX_ABOVE_BOX: The combined nominee and after-death foreign tax cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_MARKET_DISCOUNT_ABOVE_BOX: The combined nominee and after-death market discount cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_PRIVATE_ACTIVITY_ABOVE_BOX: The combined nominee and after-death private activity cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_TAXABLE_ABOVE_BOX: The combined nominee and after-death taxable cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_TAX_EXEMPT_BOND_PREMIUM_ABOV: The combined nominee and after-death tax exempt bond premium cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_TREASURY_BOND_PREMIUM_ABOVE_: The combined nominee and after-death treasury bond premium cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_OUTSIDE_US_OBLIGATIONS_ABOVE_BOX: The combined nominee and after-death us obligations cannot exceed the statement component.
StringResources.INT_PRIVATE_ACTIVITY_ABOVE_EXEMPT: Box 9 cannot exceed box 8 tax-exempt interest.
StringResources.INT_RETAINED_PRIVATE_ACTIVITY_ABOVE_EXEM: The retained private activity must be included in its exempt component.

StringResources.INVESTMENT_SPLIT_RANGE: Ownership component amounts must be within their permitted ranges.
StringResources.INVESTMENT_ST_ABOVE_CARRY: The investment short-term portion cannot exceed the calculated short-term carryover.
StringResources.INVESTMENT_TAX_ABOVE_PAID: The investment part must be included in the income tax paid; it cannot accompany a sales-tax deduction.

StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_FARMLAND_PERIODS: Schedule AI needs the applicable section 1062 farmland tax liability attributable to each income period; the annual amount cannot establish those period amounts.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_FULL_YEAR_MATCH: Schedule AI column (d) must match your full-year return: line 1 must equal your adjusted gross income and line 13 your taxable income.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_ITEMIZED_ROUTE: Schedule AI line 4 takes itemized deductions only when you itemize on your return; enter 0 in every period.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_OTHER_TAXES: Schedule AI line 16 needs other taxes figured for each period (such as Additional Medicare Tax, net investment income tax, alternative minimum tax or household employment tax), which this App does not do.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_SE_FULL_YEAR_MATCH: Schedule AI Part II column (d) must match your full-year self-employment tax: check the full-year net profit and Social Security wages.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_TAX_WORKSHEET: Schedule AI line 14 is figured here only from the Tax Table or Tax Computation Worksheet; qualified dividends, capital gains, excluded foreign income, Form 8615 or Schedule J need their worksheets refigured for each period, which this App does not do.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_AI_TWO_SE_FILERS: Schedule AI Part II is completed separately for each spouse with self-employment income; this App completes it for one person.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_ESTIMATED_PAYMENT_DATES: Form 2210 line 11 and Form 2210-F line 12 need the date of each estimated payment; enter the payments by date.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_FARMLAND_ELECTION: The selected section 1062 farmland election needs its applicable net tax liability before Form 2210 line 3 or Form 2210-F line 4 can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_FUND_CREDIT_DATE: Form 2439 tax paid by a fund or REIT has no payment date on Form 2210 line 11 or Form 2210-F line 12 in this App.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_JANUARY_PAYMENT_EXCEPTION: Form 2210 line 11 column (d): a balance paid January 16-31, 2027 may be treated as paid on the January 15 due date if you file your return and pay in full by January 31; this App charges interest to the actual payment date instead of applying that rule.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_SCHEDULE_AI_PERIODS: Form 2210 Part II box C: the annualized income installment method needs Schedule AI's income and deductions for each period.
StringResources.ISSUE_2210_WITHHOLDING_PERIODS: Form 2210 Part II box D: withholding on the dates actually withheld needs the four period amounts, adding up to Form 1040 line 25d plus excess Social Security.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_BUSINESS_UNATTRIBUTABLE: Form 8379 line 13b: the App cannot attribute the final business or farm income ({0,number,currency}) between spouses after the return limits. The ordinary federal estimate includes this amount; the Form 8379 refund allocation is unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_CAPITAL_UNATTRIBUTABLE: Form 8379 line 13b: the App cannot attribute the final capital gain or loss ({0,number,currency}) between spouses after the return limits. The ordinary federal estimate includes this amount; the Form 8379 refund allocation is unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_COMMUNITY_FEDERAL_TAX_DEBT: Form 8379 line 5: a federal tax debt in a community property state is offset under that state's law (Rev. Rul. 2004-71 through 2004-74); the App does not apply it.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_COMMUNITY_SEPARATE_PROPERTY: Form 8379 line 5: separate property items under a state's community property law need the state's allocation (Pub. 555); the App does not apply it.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_EIC_UNATTRIBUTABLE: Form 8379: the earned income credit on Form 1040 line 27a cannot be allocated, because neither spouse's separate earned income or loss explains it.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_FARMLAND_INSTALLMENT_OFFSET: Form 8379 line 20: the Form 1062 farmland installment offset on Form 1040 line 31 is not allocated between spouses by the App.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_INJURED_SPOUSE_OWES_DEBT: Form 8379 line 4: an injured spouse who is legally obligated to pay the past-due amount is not an injured spouse. For a federal tax debt you both owe, see innocent spouse relief (Form 8857).
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_JOINT_RETURN_REQUIRED: Form 8379 line 2: an injured spouse allocation needs a joint return; you are not an injured spouse.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_NO_ELIGIBLE_REFUND_SHARE: Form 8379 lines 6-9: the injured spouse made no payments, had no withholding, claims no earned income credit or additional child tax credit and no refundable credit; you are not an injured spouse.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_OTHER_INCOME_UNATTRIBUTABLE: Form 8379 line 13b: the App cannot attribute the final other income ({0,number,currency}) between spouses after the return limits. The ordinary federal estimate includes this amount; the Form 8379 refund allocation is unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_SOCIAL_SECURITY_UNATTRIBUTABL: Form 8379 line 13b: the App cannot attribute the final taxable Social Security benefits ({0,number,currency}) between spouses. The ordinary federal estimate includes this income; the Form 8379 refund allocation is unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_SPOUSE_ONLY_DEBT_REQUIRED: Form 8379 line 3: only a joint refund applied to past-due federal tax, state income tax, state unemployment compensation, child support, spousal support or a federal nontax debt owed by the other spouse alone can be allocated; you are not an injured spouse.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_W2_WAGES_UNATTRIBUTABLE: Form 8379 line 13a: the W-2 wages on Form 1040 line 1a cannot be attributed between you.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_WITHHOLDING_UNATTRIBUTABLE: Form 8379 line 19: the federal income tax withheld cannot be attributed between you.
StringResources.ISSUE_8379_WITHHOLDING_UNTRACED: Form 8379 line 19: federal income tax withheld on Form 1040 line 25d includes withholding the App cannot trace to either spouse's document.
StringResources.ISSUE_8862_HOME_DAYS_CONTRADICTION_SPOUS: Form 8862 line 9b: {0} days contradicts the answer that your spouse's main home was in the United States for more than half of 2026; correct one of them.
StringResources.ISSUE_8862_HOME_DAYS_CONTRADICTION_TAXPA: Form 8862 line 9a: {0} days contradicts the answer that your main home was in the United States for more than half of 2026; correct one of them.
StringResources.ISSUE_8915_MISSING_FEMA_DECLARATION: Form 8915-F item C: only a disaster with a FEMA major disaster declaration (a DR number) can have qualified disaster distributions. Choose No, or enter the DR number.
StringResources.ISSUE_ABANDONED_PROPERTY_THE_LENDER_HAS_: Abandoned property the lender has not taken, a partial transfer or mixed-use property (Pub. 4681 chapters 2 and 3; Form 4797 or Form 8949) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_ABLE_BENEFICIARY_NOT_ON_RETURN: An ABLE beneficiary other than you is on this return only when you file jointly.
StringResources.ISSUE_ABLE_PAYMENT_TO_NON_BENEFICIARY: Form 1099-QA box 6 says this payment went to someone other than the designated beneficiary, so it is not figured as your own withdrawal. Answer Death or Returned excess contribution if either fits; the additional taxes on a payment to another recipient are not estimated.
StringResources.ISSUE_ACCEPTED_DATA_IS_INVALID_NO_CALCUL: Accepted data is invalid; no calculation was performed.
StringResources.ISSUE_ADOPTION_CODE_T_ABOVE_W_2: The adoption benefits entered for this employee are more than the box 12 code T amounts on the W-2s: correct the W-2 or the adoption benefits.
StringResources.ISSUE_AFTER_DEATH_WITHOUT_A_DEATH: {0}: a part paid after a death applies only to a person who died in 2026; clear it, or enter the date of death on their page.
StringResources.ISSUE_ALLOCATE_AT_MOST_300_SQUARE_FEET_P: Allocate at most 300 square feet per month across this owner's simplified-method businesses; do not reuse the same space.
StringResources.ISSUE_ALLOCATING_INTEREST_ENTIRELY_TO_U_: Allocating interest entirely to U.S. income requires combined gross foreign income of at most $5,000, across all sources and categories.
StringResources.ISSUE_ALL_ENTRIES_FOR_ONE_ISSUING_CORPOR: All entries for one issuing corporation must use one reconciled prior eligible-gain amount; the exclusion cap is shared across its current-year lots.
StringResources.ISSUE_ALL_THIS_PERSON_S_FOREIGN_SERVICE_: No owner health or retirement deductions with a business run abroad. Additional related deductions need coordinated worksheets; separately entered U.S. businesses remain outside the exclusion.
StringResources.ISSUE_AMORTIZATION_AMT_SOURCE_NEEDED: This cohort needs its separate AMT recovery and basis before the complete estimate can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_AMORTIZATION_DISPOSITION_SOURCE_NE: Resolve this cost cohort's original election, calendar, credit adjustment and actual prior recovery before the complete estimate can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_ANNUITY_LOSSES_INHERITED_ESTATE_TA: Annuity losses, inherited estate-tax deductions, your own preferential-income election, unresolved investment-interest attribution (including limited mixed expenses) and your own foreign exclusion need additional Form 8615 worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_ANSWER_SPOUSE_ITEMIZES: Answer whether your spouse itemizes on their separate return.
StringResources.ISSUE_ANSWER_WHETHER_COMMUNITY_PROPERTY_: Answer whether community property applies to your separate return: a community-property state divides your income between your separate returns.
StringResources.ISSUE_ANSWER_YOUR_SPOUSE_STANDARD_DEDUCT: Answer your spouse's standard deduction boxes: choose None of these unless your spouse had no gross income, is not filing and cannot be claimed as a dependent.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_ACCRUAL_SECTION_77_ELECTION_NEE: An accrual section 77 election needs coordination between the farm's inventory valuation and the loan's income-inclusion and redemption basis. Aggregate opening/closing inventory alone does not establish that adjustment. Keep the recorded election; do not change an established method to bypass this unfinished worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_ACTUAL_EXPENSE_HOME_OFFICE_FOR_: An actual-expense home office for a farm or a professional gambling business uses the Pub 587 worksheet instead of Form 8829 and is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_AGREEMENT_CHANGED_DURING_RETURN: An agreement changed during 2026 to the post-2018 rules, or replaced during 2026 by a divorce decree signed after 2018, splits this year's payments at the change (Pub. 504): Schedule 1 line 2a or 19a for such a year is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_ALLOCATION_WITH_YOUR_SPOUSE_APP: An allocation with your spouse applies only to separate returns (Form 8962 Part IV allocation situation 2).
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_ASSESSMENT_FIRST_SPREAD_IN_THE_: An assessment first spread in the year of death requires separate final-year treatment; the statutory acceleration covers death during the nine succeeding years.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_EARLY_DISTRIBUTION_MUST_BELONG_: An early distribution must belong to a filer on this original return. The SIMPLE 25% rate applies only to an IRA, not an employer-plan pension.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_ELIGIBLE_2026_ARCHER_HDHP_MUST_: An eligible 2026 Archer HDHP must meet the IRS deductible and out-of-pocket limits; otherwise mark the month ineligible.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_ELIGIBLE_BENEFICIARY_CANNOT_ELE: An eligible beneficiary cannot elect the before-beginning-date fixed payout rule after the owner reached the required beginning date.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_EXISTING_INCOME_ELECTION_CONTIN: An existing income election continues for current loans; changing to loan treatment requires an accounting-change worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_EXPIRED_OR_CURRENT_FINAL_PAYOUT: An expired or current final payout deadline needs administrator review of the remaining balance and prior shortfalls; it cannot be approximated with an annual life-expectancy fraction.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_HSA_ROLLOVER_IRA_TO_HSA_FUNDING: An HSA rollover, IRA-to-HSA funding transfer, returned excess contribution, coverage-loss test from 2025 or prohibited transaction (Form 8889 lines 10, 14b, 18 and 19; Form 5329 Part VII) is not calculated from the HSA page yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_INVESTMENT_ASSET_MUST_MATCH_A_U: An investment asset must match a unique passive foreign-income source; employment income is not portfolio income.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_IRA_TO_EMPLOYER_PLAN_ROLLOVER_C: An IRA-to-employer-plan rollover can contain only pretax funds. The retained IRA balances and amounts not rolled into that plan must cover this owner's available after-tax basis.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_NOL_WITH_EXCESS_PERSONAL_DEDUCT: An NOL with excess personal deductions and itemized state income tax needs business/personal state-tax allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_OWNER_RECEIVING_A_SEP_CONTRIBUT: An owner receiving a SEP contribution is covered by a workplace retirement plan. Update the IRA coverage answer.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_OWNER_WITH_CONTRIBUTIONS_UNDER_: An owner with contributions under the December family method must be eligible on December 1.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_UNRECONCILED_FIXED_STANDARD_DED: An unreconciled fixed standard deduction requires expanded prior-year calculations. Do not freeze an income-sensitive amount from the filed return.
StringResources.ISSUE_AN_UNREVIEWED_CERTIFICATE_NEEDS_IT: An unreviewed certificate needs its original schedule, refinance date, and reissue facts before the Form 8396 credit can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_APPLIED_CREDIT_CAPACITY: The retained planned credit exceeds the current available overpayment, or is negative. Correct it in Payments; it has not been reduced automatically.
StringResources.ISSUE_ARCHER_COMPENSATION_MUST_LINK_THIS: Archer compensation must link this owner's W-2, Form 8919 wages or a Schedule C or Schedule F business maintaining the HDHP.
StringResources.ISSUE_ARCHER_MSA_CONTRIBUTIONS_EXCEED_CO: Archer MSA contributions exceed coverage/allocation or linked compensation limits, or employer deposits bar personal deductions; excess treatment is required.
StringResources.ISSUE_ARCHER_MSA_DISABILITY_BEFORE_BIRTH: The disability onset on a Form 1099-SA cannot precede the account holder's birth.
StringResources.ISSUE_ARCHER_MSA_POST_DEATH_ACTIVITY: A payment after the account holder's death needs the beneficiary's account or inheritance treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_ARCHER_MSA_TREATMENT_UNCONFIRMED: This attempted medical-account rollover is not tax-free. Supply the actual custodian-accepted ordinary cash contribution year and deadline, or actual property character, before calculating its destination contribution and excess treatment. Do not enter the same deposit again in manual contribution totals.
StringResources.ISSUE_ASSET_DISPOSAL_DATE_BEFORE_SERVICE: The date sold or stopped using must be after the date placed in service.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_1099_R_WITH_CODE_T_FOR_AGE_59_IS: A 1099-R with code T for age 59½ is dated before the owner turned 59½: check the distribution date and birth date, or choose disability as the reason.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_2025_HOUSEHOLD_FURNISHING_CARRYO: A 2025 household-furnishing carryover alongside a 2026 regular or AMT operating loss requires coordinated Form 172 and charitable-carryover worksheets, including on the standard route.

A 2025 household-furnishing carryover with a prior cash or other unsupported carryover class or a 2026 hosted-student/whaling 30%-class contribution needs a coordinated worksheet. One documented 2025 public-stock 30%-class carryover may be entered with this balance when the original-year combined worksheet is reconciled.
A 2025 household-furnishing carryover with regular or AMT operating-loss history or a foreign tax credit needs coordinated carryover and allocation worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_2025_PUBLIC_STOCK_CARRYOVER_ALON: A charitable carryover alongside a 2026 regular or AMT operating loss requires coordinated Form 172 and charitable-carryover worksheets, even if this return takes the standard deduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_2026_QUALIFIED_ROTH_TO_HSA_FUNDI: A 2026 qualified Roth-to-HSA funding transfer together with 529-to-Roth transfers needs separate source-date and basis accounting.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_BENEFICIARY_S_CURRENT_REGULAR_OR: A beneficiary's current regular or AMT operating loss needs a combined loss-year and source allocation with the final estate/trust K-1 carryover.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_BINDING_ISSUER_WIDE_SECTION_1202: A binding issuer-wide section 1202 eligible-gain cap with 50%, 75% or 100% acquisition cohorts needs an explicit allocation of that cap across cohorts.
A binding issuer-wide section 1202 limit with both empowerment-zone and ordinary gain needs a verified allocation between 60% and 50% eligible gain.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_CHANGED_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT_BALAN: A changed minimum-tax-credit balance remaining after the restoration year requires post-restoration coordination before finalizing this comparison.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_CHURCH_EMPLOYEE_W_2_MUST_SHOW_ZE: A church employee or ministerial W-2 must show zero Social Security and Medicare wages (boxes 3 and 5); box 1 is reported on Schedule SE line 5a for church employees or line 2 for ministerial services.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_CLAIMED_CASUALTY_LOSS_WITH_FORM_: A claimed casualty loss with Form 1116, a prior AMT operating loss or an inherited estate/trust NOL needs coordinated source and loss-absorption worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_CURRENT_OR_CARRIED_FORM_3800_CRE: A current or carried Form 3800 credit with a negative Form 8978 line 14 needs a combined Form 3800 and Schedule 3 line 6l tax-capacity worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_CURRENT_REGULAR_OR_AMT_OPERATING: A current regular or AMT operating loss with a noncash charitable deduction needs coordinated Form 172 and charitable-carryover worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_DEATH_EXCEPTION_MUST_AGREE_WITH_: A death exception must agree with the account owner's final-return death date.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_DECEASED_SHAREHOLDER_WITH_SUSPEN: A deceased shareholder's K-1 with suspended losses can't also have no other death-related adjustment: say that an adjustment applies on the person's page, and the suspended losses are left out of this final return.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_DEDUCTIBLE_INTEREST_AMOUNT_REQUI: A deductible interest amount requires a positive investment-asset basis for that tax system; zero-basis or substantially distorted holdings require another valuation worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_DIFFERENT_JOINT_FILING_UNIT_BETW: A different joint-filing unit between 2025 and 2026 needs a complete prior-return recapture and ownership review.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_DIRECT_2026_PUBLIC_CHARITY_CASH_: A direct 2026 public-charity cash gift, one ordinary 2026 property or personal road-vehicle claim, and the full reconciled 2025 cash balance are estimated together only when their total fits within 50% of AGI. Above that boundary, amended section 170(b)(1)(G)(i) and retained section 170(b)(1)(G)(iii)(II) impose reciprocal A/G ceilings without settled 2026 allocation guidance; no deduction or carryover is reported as settled.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FARMING_NOL_REQUIRES_AN_EXPLICIT: A farming NOL requires an explicit valid carryback waiver or the separate 2024/2025 carryback computations. Missing, uncertain or ineligible elections never become an automatic waiver.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FARM_LAND_DISPOSITION_WITH_HOME_: A farm-land disposition with home-office use requires gain/loss attribution to the home's business-income limit before coordinating the supply ceiling. Operating receipts alone do not establish that limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FILER_CLAIMED_AS_A_DEPENDENT_DOE: A filer claimed as a dependent does not share Marketplace premiums with the premium tax credit (Pub. 974 specified premiums).
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FILER_WHO_CAN_BE_CLAIMED_AS_A_DE: A filer who can be claimed as a dependent but is not claimed reconciles advance credit under Pub. 974's rules for an individual not included in a tax family (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (f)), which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FOREIGN_ADOPTION_NOT_FINAL_BEFOR: A foreign adoption not final before 2026 cannot have a prior exclusion-limit claim; prior taxable benefits need the foreign-adoption worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FORM_1099_A_FOR_A_CROP_MUST_NAME: A Form 1099-A for a crop forfeited to the Commodity Credit Corporation must name a loan of your farm or farm rental that was forfeited in 2026 and whose principal equals box 2.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FORM_3800_CURRENT_OR_CARRIED_CRE: A Form 3800 current or carried credit with a section 1341 repayment needs a combined tax comparison.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_FORM_8915_F_FROM_2023_OR_EARLIER: A Form 8915-F from 2023 or earlier has no 2026 income; a 2026 repayment of those distributions is carried back to 2023-2025 on amended returns (Form 1040-X, Form 8915-F lines 14 and 25), which this App does not prepare.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_HOME_FIRST_USED_FOR_BUSINESS_BEF: A home first used for business before May 13, 1993 needs the Pub 946 depreciation percentage (Form 8829 line 41) and is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_K_1_BOX_12_CODE_A_ADJUSTMENT_WIT: A K-1 box 12 code A adjustment with a current or prior regular/AMT net operating loss needs its source-character and loss-absorption worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_K_1_BOX_12_CODE_B_QUALIFIED_DIVI: A K-1 box 12 code B qualified-dividend adjustment with a Form 4952 investment-interest election or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT preferential-rate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_K_1_BOX_12_CODE_C_SHORT_TERM_GAI: A K-1 box 12 code C short-term gain adjustment with Form 4952 investment interest or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT rate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_K_1_BOX_12_CODE_D_LONG_TERM_GAIN: A K-1 box 12 code D long-term gain adjustment with Form 4952 investment interest or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT rate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_K_1_BOX_12_CODE_E_SECTION_1250_A: A K-1 box 12 code E section 1250 adjustment with Form 4952 investment interest or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT special-rate worksheets.
