StringResources.ISSUE_A_LONG_TERM_CARE_PREMIUM_NAMES_SOM: A long-term-care premium names someone who is not on this return. Choose the insured person from the people on the return.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_MAIN_HOME_FORECLOSURE_WITH_A_GAI: A main home foreclosure with a gain is entered on the Sale of your main home page, with the amount realized shown here as its price, so the home-sale exclusion applies (section 121; Pub. 4681).
StringResources.ISSUE_A_MIXED_ASSET_S_INCOME_MUST_MATCH_: A mixed asset's income must match a unique passive foreign-income source.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_MIXED_SOURCE_ASSET_NEEDS_A_POSIT: A mixed-source asset needs a positive current-year gross-income yield to characterize its basis; unresolved or zero yield requires a separate worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_MONTH_COMBINING_A_POLICY_WITH_AN: A month combining a policy with an allocated benchmark and another policy needs each coverage family's benchmark (Form 8962 Part IV column (f), lines 12 to 23 column (b)).
StringResources.ISSUE_A_NEGATIVE_FORM_8978_ADJUSTMENT_BE: A negative Form 8978 adjustment beyond Form 1040 line 18 with MSA, ABLE, Trump-account earnings, mortgage-subsidy or education-credit additional tax needs a separate Chapter 1 Schedule 2 Part II classification. Only verified early-distribution and section 223 HSA additional taxes can currently absorb that excess; section 4973 HSA excess-contribution excise cannot.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_NONQUALIFIED_ANNUITY_NEEDS_A_PAY: A nonqualified annuity needs a payer-determined amount or supported annuity calculation, and ordinary, early-without-exception, death, permanent-disability or immediate-annuity treatment. Other basis methods, exchanges outside the direct-exchange calculation, repayments and other section 72(q) exceptions need additional worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PARTIAL_EXCEPTION_NEEDS_A_TRADIT: A partial exception needs a traditional IRA allocation, the qualified pre-annuity withdrawal worksheet, or a complete qualified employer-plan discharge. Other non-IRA basis methods and overlapping public-safety premium exclusions need source-specific allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PASSENGER_AUTOMOBILE_S_SECTION_1: A passenger automobile's section 179 election cannot exceed its first-year depreciation limit on the business-use share, and an income-limited section 179 carryforward on a passenger automobile is not calculated (Form 4562 line 26(i)).
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PERSONALLY_USED_ROAD_VEHICLE_NEE: A personally used road vehicle needs the required timely Form 1098-C or equivalent acknowledgment certifying its charity treatment. An unrelated sale uses the smaller of FMV and proceeds when proceeds exceed $500, or the smaller of FMV and $500 otherwise. Significant use, material improvement or needy-person transfer can use FMV; when similar road-vehicle claims exceed $5,000 together before income limits, each FMV-based exception vehicle needs a qualified appraisal and complete Form 8283 Section B evidence for its donee. Gross-proceeds-limited vehicles stay in Section A. Business use, appreciated basis or duplicated benefits need another worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_POSITIVE_2025_50_CLASS_HOUSEHOLD: A positive 2025 50%-class household-furnishing carry means the original public-charity 50% room was exhausted before any 30%-class stock deduction. The paired single-stock 2025 carry must therefore equal its full original fair market value. Reconcile both amounts against the same filed 2025 class-limit worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_POSITIVE_WITHHOLDING_RATE_REQUIR: A positive withholding rate requires paid eligible tax; review the payment record and credit eligibility.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PRIOR_30_CLASS_PUBLIC_STOCK_CARR: A prior 30%-class public-stock carryover with a prior cash or other unsupported carryover class, current 30%-class student or whaling expense, or a 2026 capital-gain-property basis election needs a separate coordinated worksheet. One documented 2025 household-furnishing 50%-class carryover may be entered with this balance when the original-year combined worksheet is reconciled.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PRIOR_CASH_CARRYOVER_WITH_REGULA: A prior cash carryover with regular or AMT operating losses or Form 1116 needs a coordinated carryover worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PRIOR_PUBLIC_STOCK_CARRYOVER_WIT: A prior public-stock carryover with regular or AMT operating losses or Form 1116 requires a coordinated carryover worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PRIOR_REGULAR_NOL_AND_SECTION_12: A prior regular NOL and section 1202 exclusion need further Form 172 Part II line 6 worksheets when a changed traditional IRA deduction also affects a same-year IRA distribution or QCD, an employer adoption-benefit exclusion changes, or the passive activity result changes under restored gain.

A prior regular NOL and section 1202 exclusion with prior charitable carryovers, noncash, hosted-student or whaling expenses needs further Form 172 Part II modified-income worksheets. Current cash gifts, including percentage-limit excess, are supported.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PRIOR_SUSPENDED_PASSIVE_LOSS_FOR: A prior suspended passive loss for a property now treated as nonpassive under the real-estate-professional election needs its own release calculation before an estimate.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_PRIOR_YEAR_FOREIGN_TAX_DEDUCTION: A 2025 foreign-tax deduction or no-Form-1116 small-credit election cannot generate unused 2025 foreign taxes. Reconcile the origin year and prior election; older surviving balances retain their original years.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_QUALIFIED_REAL_ESTATE_PROFESSION: A qualified real-estate professional needs the confirmed Pub 925 more-than-half and 750-hour tests before rental losses can be nonpassive.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_REGULAR_AMT_NOL_HISTORY_OR_FORM_: A regular/AMT NOL history or Form 1116 claim with noncash gifts needs separate loss-year or foreign-allocation worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_REQUIREMENT_WHOSE_DEADLINE_FOLLO: A requirement whose deadline follows the owner's death needs administrator allocation between the decedent and beneficiaries; do not charge the deceased filer's return for another payee's shortfall.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SALE_AFTER_THIS_FARM_OWNER_S_DEA: A sale after this farm owner's death does not belong to the owner's final individual return. Resolve the estate or beneficiary's ownership and reporting; a surviving spouse's own farm follows that spouse's dates.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SIGNED_FORM_8978_ADJUSTMENT_COMB: A signed Form 8978 adjustment combined with a section 1341 repayment comparison needs a combined tax refigure.
A signed Form 8978 adjustment combined with Form 1062 farmland tax installments needs a combined tax worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SIMPLE_IRA_SOLO_401_K_DEFINED_BE: A SIMPLE IRA, solo 401(k), defined-benefit or other qualified-plan contribution for the owner (Schedule 1 line 16; Form 7206 line 9) is not calculated. Only a traditional owner-only SEP is.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SINGLE_RECONCILED_2025_60_CLASS_: A single reconciled 2025 60%-class cash balance may accompany one documented ordinary 2026 50%-class goods or personal road-vehicle gift, one documented long-term appreciated public-stock gift, or up to one documented 2026 hosted student and one whaling captain claim. A direct 2026 public-charity cash gift may also accompany any one of those supported sources. Ordinary property or a personal road vehicle with the older cash is estimated only when all current cash, the property claim, and the full older cash balance together fit within 50% of AGI; larger A/G mixes need a settled allocation rule. Current direct cash uses its 60% class before the older balance. In the stock pairing, appreciated stock then uses the residual 50% room and separate 30% limit; its excess keeps its 2026 gift year. The combined student and whaling 30% class instead uses its residual 50% limit and statutory 10%-of-AGI cash carve-out. Other prior vintages, multiple claims of either 30% kind, service expenses, QCD cash gifts, multiple property gifts and other imported classes need further coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SOLE_SPOUSE_S_MISSED_INHERITED_I: A sole spouse's missed inherited IRA minimum can trigger deemed ownership. Reconcile the election and complete personal IRA pool with the administrator before calculating a shortfall; do not impose the nonspouse inherited shortfall mechanically.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SPOUSE_S_VEHICLE_BELONGS_ON_A_JO: A spouse's vehicle belongs on a joint return or that spouse's own return.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_STATE_INCOME_SOURCE_LABEL_DOES_N: A state-income source label does not match a unique foreign-income record.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_SUPPORTED_DEFICIENCY_MUST_BE_REQ: A supported deficiency must be required and actually paid for a section 77 income-included loan, and cannot exceed principal. Loan-method deficiencies need a separate worksheet; released or unpaid shortfalls are not deductions.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_USED_VEHICLE_MUST_BE_AT_LEAST_TW: A used vehicle must be at least two model years older than the acquisition year and have a sales price no greater than $25,000.
StringResources.ISSUE_A_WAIVER_REQUEST_NEEDS_A_REASONABL: A waiver request needs a reasonable-error explanation and remedial steps; its amount cannot exceed the actual shortfall. IRS approval remains pending.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_FURNISHED_YEAR: Only a Form 8986 actually furnished during the 2026 reporting year belongs on this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_INTEREST_DOCUMENTATION: Compute and document Form 8978 line 17 interest on the additional 2025 income tax before using this route; that interest is part of the reporting-year net payment, outside Form 1040 tax.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_PRIOR_INCOME_RECONCILIAT: The source wages and original K-1 interest do not reconcile to 2025 taxable income after the basic standard deduction. Other income or deductions require a full Form 8978 refigure.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_PRIOR_TAX_RECONCILIATION: The original 2025 Form 1040 income tax does not match the stated ordinary taxable income and filing status; refigure that return before using Form 8978.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_SCOPE: Confirm one BBA-audit portfolio-interest adjustment, a simple ordinary-tax 2025 return, and no other tax-attribute effects. Other Form 8978 cases need a complete prior-year refigure.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_SOURCE_ID: Identify the single Form 8986 by its tracking number, audit control number, or issuing entity tax ID.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_TAX_TABLE_STATUS: The 2025 filing status cannot be calculated from the published Tax Table.
StringResources.ISSUE_BBA_AUDIT_WHOLE_DOLLAR_VALUES: Use whole-dollar 2025 Form 1040 and partnership-interest amounts. The signed Form 8986 adjustment cannot make the corrected K-1 interest or taxable income negative; both original and corrected income must use the 2025 Tax Table.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOCATION_SUMMARY: Form 8912 line 12 is {0,number,currency} and line 4 is {1,number,currency}. {2}
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_LINE12_OUTSIDE_AVAILABL: Form 8912 line 12 must be between zero and the total available bond credit.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_MISSING_SHARE: A partly limited Form 8912 with multiple bonds needs an allowed whole-dollar share for every bond, including zero.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_SHARES_DO_NOT_SUM: The allowed shares for all bonds must sum exactly to Form 8912 line 12; the IRS does not impose a bond order.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_SHARE_OUTSIDE_AVAILABLE: Each bond's allowed share must be nonnegative and no greater than its current rounded credit plus its own prior carry.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_UNCONFIRMED_SHARE: Confirm each entered bond share against the retained Form 8912 allocation worksheet and its Form 1097-BTC identifier.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_UNIQUE_SHARE_MISMATCH: When Form 8912 has only one possible per-bond allocation, any entered share must equal the automatically determined amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOND_ALLOC_UNUSED_SHARE_FIELDS: Confirm each entered bond share, or leave both the share and its confirmation unused when the App allocates automatically.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOTH_COMPLETE_RESTORATION_YEAR_CAL: Both complete restoration-year calculations must resolve before the repayment credit or future balances can be reported.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOTH_SPOUSES_HISTORICAL_RECORDS_MU: Both spouses' historical records must identify their shared family allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOX_10_BASIS_UNKNOWN: The part of box 10 that was not taxable when rolled in decides the recapture amount for the 10% additional tax; without it that tax is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_BOX_11_CODES_C_D_MUST_RETAIN_THE_S: Box 11 codes C/D must retain the same regular, AMT, investment-property and net-investment-income tax character; differences need separate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CAPITAL_CARRYOVERS_NOT_CONFIRMED_A: Capital carryovers not confirmed as investment losses, nonbusiness loans with unresolved investment purpose need additional Form 4952 worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CARE_DEDUCTION_COORDINATION: The source deductions and Form 2441 earned-income limit did not stabilize; no final tax can be reported.
StringResources.ISSUE_CARRIED_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDITS_WITH_D: Carried minimum-tax credits with differing regular/AMT capital sources require exclusion-only source worksheets before propagation.
StringResources.ISSUE_CASUALTY_MIXED_TERM_EVENT_REDUCTIO: An excess-gain Form 4684 event with short- and long-term property losses needs allocation of its single $100 or $500 event reduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_CASUALTY_MIXED_TERM_ROUNDING: Mixed-term personal casualty gains need a Form 4684 whole-dollar allocation worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CCC_COMMODITY_BASIS_SOURCE: The CCC commodity needs its actual ownership and unrecovered production-cost basis. The zero-basis raised-crop calculation cannot replace those facts or discard known loan income.
StringResources.ISSUE_CCC_ELECTION_TRANSITION_SOURCE: Original section 77 history must agree with the current method and earlier included loans. A documented method change needs its actual transition and commodity-basis owner; changing the method answer alone cannot compute it.
StringResources.ISSUE_CHARITY_NOL_FTC_COORDINATION: Property gifts or charitable carryovers together with a prior net operating loss or foreign tax credit need the coordinated limitation worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CLAIMS_FOR_ONE_PARENT_AND_CHILD_MU: Claims for one parent and child must use the same birth/adoption date and opening prior-distribution total.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINED_CONTRIBUTIONS_EXCEED_THE_: Combined contributions exceed the monthly shared family limit after Archer MSA contributions; excess-contribution treatment is required.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINED_DOMESTIC_MIXED_ASSET_YIEL: Combined domestic mixed-asset yield cannot exceed entered domestic portfolio income.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINED_EARLIER_YEAR_UNEMPLOYMENT: Combined earlier-year unemployment, railroad and net Social Security repayments exceed $3,000. Prior taxable-income records and deduction-versus-credit eligibility must be evaluated; do not subtract them from current unemployment benefits.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINED_MEDICAL_EXPENSE_AND_UNEMP: Combined medical-expense and unemployment-insurance exceptions need allocation of overlapping premiums before calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINED_MIXED_ASSET_GROSS_YIELDS_: Combined mixed-asset gross yields cannot exceed their entered foreign-source income. Reconcile the source records without duplicating income.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINED_STOCK_COMPENSATION_MARKED: Combined stock compensation marked as already reported cannot exceed this filer's entered W-2 box 1 wages. Reconcile employer reporting before calculating.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMBINE_INCOME_TAX_REFUNDS_DEDUCTE: Combine income-tax refunds deducted on the same prior federal return before calculating its tax benefit.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMMUNITY_ANSWER_NEEDED: {0}: say whether this is community or separate income; a community-property separate return divides every item.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMMUNITY_COUNTERPART_PARTNER_SE_U: Your spouse's partnership self-employment loss is held back by activity limits. This App cannot reconcile that partner's Schedule SE or the required Form 8958 allocation; this separate return is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMMUNITY_FILING_SCOPE: A community-property answer applies only to a married-filing-separately return.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMPLETE_ORDINARY_SCHEDULE_F_AVERA: Farm income averaging with mixed QBI with an overall income cap or minimum-deduction allocation, itemized state/local income-tax allocation, prior NOLs, Archer MSA deductions, elected capital gains or young-filer tax needs further allocation worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_COMPLETE_THE_REMAINING_APPLICABLE_: Complete the remaining applicable pages to calculate the federal estimate.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ACTIVE_OPERATION_FULL_AT_R: Confirm active operation, full at-risk exposure and the permitted accounting/inventory method; unlisted business treatments require their own worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ACTUAL_ACCEPTED_REPAYMENTS: Use one repayment record per original Income entry.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ALL_INCLUDED_REGULAR_IRA_D: Confirm all included regular IRA deposits were received by April 15, 2027 and designated for 2026 with their custodians. Their principal must be included once in the retained 2026 traditional or Roth contribution totals.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_AN_ELIGIBLE_ROLLOVER_AND_R: Confirm an eligible rollover and reconcile its source. IRA after-tax basis requires the owner worksheet; employer-plan calculated basis permits after-tax amounts into a traditional IRA by year-end with its basis record, or a confirmed direct employer-plan transfer with separate basis accounting. A payer-reported zero-tax direct rollover must transfer the full distribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_AN_ELIGIBLE_TRADITIONAL_TO: Confirm an eligible traditional-to-Roth IRA conversion completed by year-end. Use the basis worksheet for after-tax contributions; inherited, employer-plan, RMD and other special conversions require another worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_AN_ORDINARY_QUALIFIED_EMPL: Confirm an ordinary qualified employer-plan distribution with correctly allocated nonforfeitable balance and investment. Roth, IRA, unsupported after-tax rollover, repayment, NUA, legacy contribution-first treatment, full-discharge loss and special lump-sum elections need separate calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_AN_OWNED_5_YEAR_VEHICLE_ON: Confirm an owned 5-year vehicle on Schedule C or Schedule F with actual expenses and its actual vehicle design. New vehicles need more than 50% business use for section 179; a heavy passenger SUV without a design exception has a $32,000 election limit. Continuing passenger automobiles need a supported original schedule and annual cap history; unsupported changed-use, carryforward, lease and employer-provided cases need their own rules (Form 4562 Part V).
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_COMMERCIAL_ANNUITY_WITHD: Confirm a commercial annuity withdrawal or newly taxable loan/pledge before annuity payments begin, with ordinary earnings-first treatment and complete pre-withdrawal contract records. Include all required related contracts with reconciled balances before this payment. Full surrender, exchange, legacy investment and unresolved grouping need separate calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_COMPLETE_CASH_DISCHARGE_: Confirm a complete cash discharge of this pension or commercial annuity contract with remaining investment reconciled. Partial payments, IRA/Roth, exchange, NUA, special elections and final-annuitant death deductions use other treatments.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_COMPLETE_TIMELY_ARCHER_M: Confirm a complete timely Archer MSA correction, its contribution year, deadline and known employer wage reporting. Late or incomplete corrections need separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_COMPLETE_TIMELY_HSA_CORR: An HSA excess-contribution return made after its correction deadline needs separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_DIRECT_SECTION_1041_TRAN: Confirm a direct section 1041 transfer to a spouse or former spouse incident to divorce with no recognized gain or loss; other transfers require Form 8828 review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_DIRECT_TRANSFER_FROM_AN_: Confirm a direct transfer from an employer plan to a qualified employee plan or 403(b) with separate taxable and after-tax accounting. IRA sources and indirect transfers cannot use this destination.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_FINAL_2026_FORM_1041_AND: Confirm a final 2026 Form 1041 and that this beneficiary succeeds to the estate's or trust's property before claiming box 11 codes A through F.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_FIRST_REISSUE_THE_ORIGIN: Confirm a first reissue, the original certificate and its 2026 limit interest, and that the reissue went to the same holders for the same home, replaced the original entirely, and retained no old certified debt. A variable-rate original needs a retained scheduled- or hypothetical-interest worksheet with confirmed consistent use of that method; multiple refinancings need separate history.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_FULL_DIRECT_TRANSFER_OF_: Confirm a full direct transfer of this 17-year-old beneficiary's own Trump account to their eligible ABLE account in 2026, and resolve any excess contributions before transfer. Partial, indirect or mismatched transfers require separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_LIVING_ORIGINAL_DESIGNAT: Confirm a living original designated beneficiary and owner death before 2026. Successor/trust rules, other spouse elections and unresolved source allocations need the administrator's minimum.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_PARTICIPATING_QUALIFIED_: Confirm a participating qualified defined-contribution plan and the issuer's certified annual premium statement filed before payment. IRA and ordinary retroactively designated withdrawals do not qualify.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_QUALIFIED_DISTRIBUTION_D: Confirm a qualified distribution during eligible reserve duty, an order for at least 180 days or indefinitely, and actual traditional IRA repayments after release and within two years. All repayments together cannot exceed that original distribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_QUALIFIED_SUBORDINATE_MO: Confirm a qualified subordinate mortgage-loan governmental lender was actually paid at or after the sale, the HomeSale expenses exclude this payment, and the paid share does not exceed the sale gain.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_A_SIMPLIFIED_LIMITATION_EL: Confirm a simplified limitation election made for the first post-1997 AMT foreign-credit claim year and still in force. A later first election or unconfirmed history cannot be assumed.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_BOX_12_CODE_A_EITHER_STAND: Confirm box 12 code A either stands alone or exactly equals the sum of its signed code B qualified-dividend, C short-term and D long-term components. Every nonzero component must have A's sign; confirmed codes E/F are disjoint same-sign portions of D, not additional AMTI. Other box 12 codes, missing or contradictory fiduciary attribution, related AMT items and Form 1116 foreign tax credits need separate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_CLAIM_OF_RIGHT_ELIGIBILITY: The repayment comparison needs more than $3,000 of earlier-year unemployment or railroad repayments. Net Social Security repayments need their own prior-taxability calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_ORDINARY_PORTFOLI: Enter valid portfolio basis records and unique foreign-income labels before allocating investment interest.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_OWN_IRA_BALANCES_: Confirm complete own-IRA balances and source facts; use the inherited branch for supported beneficiary accounts or an administrator's minimum for annuity and unresolved special-relief cases.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_PAYROLL_RECORDS_A: Confirm complete payroll records and one eligible employer record per filer; unresolved payroll exceptions need their own treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_PRIOR_YEAR_CREDIT: Enter each category of the 2025 credit or hypothetical deduction-year worksheets once before allocating excess taxes.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_RETAINED_REGULAR_: Enter each category's retained regular and AMT loss accounts once, with at most one separate limitation loss balance per tax system.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_SECTION_195_START: Confirm complete section 195 start-up costs, the original deduction/capitalization election and an active business begun after October 22, 2004 and continuing through 2026. Disposition, missing prior deductions or other special treatment needs its own calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_COMPLETE_STATE_RECORDS_UNI: Confirm complete state records, unique foreign-source labels and payments matching the itemized income-tax amount exactly.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_DISJOINT_CORRECTED_W_2_COD: Confirm disjoint corrected W-2 code T sources, qualified plans and a joint return for domestic children; benefits for a foreign child paid to both spouses, and foreign benefits taxed before finalization, are not calculated. Deemed line 29 excess reduces joint line 1f, not either employee's earnings.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_EACH_CLAIMANT_IS_ON_THIS_R: Whaling captain expenses can be claimed only by a captain on this return: your spouse's expenses need a joint return. A whaling expense can be claimed only as an itemized contribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_EACH_DISTINCT_IRA_ACCOUNT_: Confirm each distinct IRA account's complete 2026-designated contribution and all attributable net income or loss were corrected by the 2027 filing deadline, with an eligible extension if needed. A late return, another contribution year, or multiple corrections in one account needs separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ELIGIBLE_HOUSING_EXPENSES_: Enter valid housing expenses, allowances, household amounts and 2026 stay dates.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_EVERY_DIRECT_2026_TRUSTEE_: Confirm every direct 2026 trustee transfer for the same beneficiary, each 529 account's 15-year history and administrator-reconciled five-year seasoned source amount after earlier distributions, and $35,000 lifetime room across all 529 accounts.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_FLSA_REQUIRED_OVERTIME_ABO: Confirm FLSA-required overtime above the regular rate, separately reported on a 2026 Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC and included once in this U.S. Schedule C business's ordinary receipts. Other payment and source cases require their own worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ONE_CONSISTENTLY_ADOPTED_E: Confirm one consistently adopted eligible poultry-cost method. An uncertain, income-distorting or changed method needs its own accounting worksheet; neither the supply exception nor this editor elects a new method.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ONE_EMPLOYEE_S_WRITTEN_202: Confirm one employee's written 2025 calendar-year grace balance and current ordinary W-2 box 10 from the same plan, the service and reimbursement dates, and all distinct qualified care. Unmatched W-2, second plans, forfeiture, prior-year taxable wages or separate-return worksheets need review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ORDINARY_AGE_60_OR_LATER_R: Confirm ordinary age-60-or-later RRB pension treatment or documented survivor payments after death. Unresolved repayments, disability-wage routing, unresolved shared employee contributions and other adjustments require additional worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ORDINARY_ORIGINAL_YEAR_RET: An original-year retirement taxable amount cannot exceed its gross distribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ORDINARY_OWN_ACCOUNT_WITHD: Confirm ordinary own-account withdrawals and source dates. Inherited, special repayment, rollover, unentered HSA funding and unlisted exception cases require further support.
Confirm ordinary own-account withdrawals for an owner present on this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ORDINARY_QUALIFYING_ALIMON: Alimony under an instrument executed before 1985 follows special rules that are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ORDINARY_WHOLLY_FOREIGN_SE: Confirm ordinary wholly foreign services subject to U.S. SE tax, without special foreign treatment. Mixed sources, capital-producing activities and foreign property/vehicle/home-office deductions need their additional source and depreciation worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_ORIGINAL_YEAR_ELIGIBILITY_: Medical expenses on the original Form 5329 require a selected medical-exception distribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_PAID_FEDERAL_ESTATE_TAX_TH: Confirm paid federal estate tax, the estate-wide recomputation and gross IRD denominator, and this beneficiary's unused allocation. A shared QCD cap or deductible-contribution adjustment across several sources needs an explicit source allocation before this deduction can be determined.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_POST_JULY_1_1986_ANNUITIZA: Confirm post-July 1, 1986 annuitization, death of the linked final annuitant, ordinary or inherited periodic pension/annuity treatment and complete nonduplicated investment recovery. Payments must cease because of death, not expiration of a fixed period independent of life. Starting date, original net investment and prior recovery must agree with the linked worksheet. A temporary child annuity must end in the death month and agree with the deduction records.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_PRE_AUGUST_14_1982_CONTRAC: Confirm pre-August 14, 1982 contract issuance and the insurer's separate old/new investment and earnings records. Loans, pledges, surrenders, exchanges, losses within a portion and unresolved allocations require further calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_PRIOR_YEAR_ELIGIBILITY_AND: Reconcile the prior return's expense base and excluded/deducted benefits; unresolved history needs review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_PROFESSIONAL_GAMBLING_MIXE: Confirm professional gambling. Mixed casual/professional or multiple wagering activities, inventory, home-office and owner health/retirement coordination need additional worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_QUALIFIED_COVERAGE_ELIGIBL: Confirm qualified coverage, eligible family relationship, medical eligibility and each month's employer long-term-care eligibility.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_QUALIFIED_CUSTOMER_TIPS_SE: Confirm qualified customer tips separately stated on 2026 information returns furnished to this individual, included once in U.S. Schedule C ordinary receipts or Schedule F other farm operating receipts. Partnership and unresolved source cases require their own worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_QUALIFYING_PURCHASED_EQUIP: Confirm qualifying purchased equipment with the entered service date, first-year election or complete continuing history with identical regular/AMT basis or the separately recorded required AMT schedule. A first-use 2026 asset acquired before September 28, 2017 receives no bonus; ordinary 200% GDS for a 3-, 5-, 7-, or 10-year class uses the same basis, recovery period, and convention with 150% for AMT. Continuing earlier purchases require post-1998 service and 150%/straight-line GDS or a supported separate 200%/150% history. Unrecovered basis after the recovery period or an unsupported history needs its separate worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_QUALIFYING_PURCHASED_RENTA: Confirm qualifying purchased rental equipment, 100% income-producing use, no section 179 election or carryforward, and complete depreciation records. Listed property, vehicles, ADS, changed use and other basis treatment need separate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_TEN_YEARS_OF_QUALIFYING_US: Confirm ten years of qualifying use, a qualified individual buyer, an enforceable ten-year covenant and a recognized gain before electing section 1062.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_2025_EMPLOYER_PLAN_S_W: Confirm the 2025 employer plan's written calendar-year grace period, its unused balance, the 2026 service and reimbursement dates, this employee's ownership, and all distinct qualified expenses. Current box 10 benefits, forfeiture, another plan and separate-return spouse worksheets need review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_2026_DEPOSITED_CONTRIB: Confirm the 2026-deposited contribution and direct trustee transfer by the ordinary 2026-return deadline, an actual filing extension, or the timely-filed-return corrective-action route. Confirm Form 1099-R code N for a 2026 transfer; reconcile a 2027 transfer with its information return when available. The final retained IRA total must include the original principal once in the destination account, not the source account.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ALLOCATED_BOX_11_CODE_: Confirm the allocated box 11 code A section 67(e) deduction has no net-investment-income share, or enter that share in the final-year source character.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_BOX_14_CODE_I_STATEMEN: Confirm the box 14 code I statement allocates only qualified section 199A REIT/RIC dividends to this beneficiary. Business, PTP, cooperative or other section 199A items need separate worksheets; an amount marked ineligible needs a corrected fiduciary statement.

Confirm the box 14 code I statement reports one trade or business or aggregation for the entered boxes 6–8 activities, with no publicly traded partnership, cooperative or section 199A(g) items; other statements need their own Form 8995-A worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_CASH_METHOD_ORIGINAL_P: Confirm the cash-method original prior-year Form 4136 return was filed in 2026, or the amended-return credit or fuel-tax refund was received in 2026. For full benefit, the fuel-tax deduction reduced prior income tax in full. The narrow partial 2025 case needs the filed return and retained refigured regular-tax comparison, negative taxable-income exclusion, active deduction, and no AMT, NIIT, credit, carryover or duplicate recovery. Other partial-benefit, passive, NOL and distinct AMT/NIIT histories need separate review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_CASUALTY_DESTROYED_HOM: Confirm the casualty-destroyed home was already replaced on its original site for use as your main home within the ordinary deadline, and any separate casualty gain or loss is accounted for.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_COMPLETED_QUALIFYING_D: Death/disability relief in 2026 requires this filer's employment-authorized SSN issued by the return deadline and included on the return. Missing qualification needs the applicable taxable-debt or other exclusion worksheet; do not assume relief.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_COMPLETE_NONEMPLOYER_S: Distributed property sold for a rollover needs a pension source rolled over by its proceeds. NUA and mixed-property allocations require separate calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_COMPLETE_ORDINARY_CSRS: Confirm the complete ordinary CSRS/FERS death-benefit lump sum to this individual and documented death treatment. Split payments, rollovers, special elections, estate/trust returns and final-annuitant deductions require separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_DISABILITY_RETIREMENT_: Confirm the disability-retirement, age and medical-statement requirements for these Schedule R wages.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_DISTRIBUTION_YEAR_S_MA: Confirm the distribution year's marriage and sole-beneficiary designation, including changes after divorce or death.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ELIGIBLE_ACCOUNT_OR_AN: Confirm the eligible account or annuity, source dates and exception requirements; Roth recapture and unentered repayment adjustments need another worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ELIGIBLE_NUA_DISTRIBUT: Confirm the eligible NUA distribution and lot history. Inherited shares require a reconciled estate valuation at least equal to deferred NUA and no allocable estate or generation-skipping tax; unresolved estate allocations require further calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_EMPLOYEE_PLAN_AND_OWNE: A spouse's employer care benefits belong on this return only when filing jointly; multi-filer or self-employed benefit plans need additional worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ENTIRE_FINAL_YEAR_BOX_: Confirm the entire final-year box 11 code B amount is allocated state/local income or general sales tax without a Form 8960 share, noninvestment real-estate tax or nonbusiness personal-property tax. With a Form 1116 credit, an elected state income tax from the fiduciary needs the income it was paid on, which your state-tax records do not show.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ENTIRE_K_1_BOX_10_ESTA: Confirm the entire K-1 box 10 estate-tax deduction is allocated by the fiduciary to taxable IRD interest included in this K-1's box 1, without a box 14 code H adjustment that may already include it or a Form 1116 foreign-tax-credit claim. Mixed, noninvestment or capital-gain IRD needs a separate allocation and rate worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ENTIRE_K_1_BOX_5_AMOUN: Confirm the entire K-1 box 5 amount is ordinary domestic nonbusiness royalties, with no unentered net-investment-income adjustment. Any limited box 9 code A depreciation, B cost depletion or C amortization below must belong to the same activity; annuities, income in respect of a decedent and other box 5 items need their own calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_FIDUCIARY_S_COMPLETE_B: Confirm the fiduciary's complete box 9 code A allocation is section 167 straight-line depreciation of one master sound recording licensed for box 5 domestic nonbusiness royalties, held by the fiduciary throughout 2026. Retain the per-asset basis, service-date, useful-life and beneficiary-allocation statement. The schedule began before 2026, with no section 181 expense, section 168(k) bonus, section 197 amortization or income-forecast look-back. The deduction must remain fully allowable and nonloss with identical regular, AMT and NIIT treatment, no box 9 B/C, box 12 code G or box 14 code H overlap. Other assets, methods, property succession or separate beneficiary limits need their own worksheets.

Confirm the fiduciary's complete box 9 code B allocation is cost depletion from one domestic nonbusiness mineral royalty property in box 5, held by the fiduciary throughout 2026. Retain its per-property section 611 basis, recoverable/sold-unit calculation and beneficiary allocation statement. Cost must be the allowable depletion method. The amount must remain fully allowable and nonloss for this beneficiary, with identical regular, AMT and NIIT treatment and no box 9 code C, box 12 code H or box 14 code H overlap. Percentage depletion, property succession or a separate beneficiary-level limit needs its own worksheet.

Confirm the fiduciary's complete box 9 code C allocation is section 197 amortization from the same single domestic nonbusiness royalty activity in box 5, on a straight-line schedule begun before 2026. The amount must remain fully allowable and nonloss for this beneficiary, have identical regular, AMT and NIIT treatment, and not appear in box 5 or box 14 code H again. Other box 9 items, box 12 code I or a separate beneficiary limit need their own worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_FIXED_PERIOD_OR_LIFETI: Confirm the fixed-period or lifetime General Rule facts and retained table/method elections. A qualified-plan start on or after November 19, 1996 needs original age at least 75 and at least five years of guaranteed payments. Otherwise use the required Simplified Method or the applicable additional worksheet. Variable payments, refund features other than entered single-life guaranteed installments, exchanges and special ownership cases need additional calculations.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_K_1_BOXES_6_8_ACTIVITI: Confirm the K-1 boxes 6–8 activities before they enter Schedule E line 33: one fiduciary schedule per box with no loss, no passive-activity disposition attachment (Form 8582), no grouping with your own activities, box 9 deductions with identical regular, AMT and net-investment-income treatment (no box 12 code G, H or I), rentals without real-estate-professional treatment, and a box 6 business that does not trade financial instruments or commodities. Other patterns need their own Schedule E, Form 8582 and Form 8960 worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_K_1_BOX_20_CODE_C_FUEL: Confirm the K-1 box 20 code C fuel quantities, use, applicable rate, partner-share cost and no earlier Form 8849/8864/720 claim. Farm-operator fuel lines require an established farm activity; a custom aerial applicator may claim its own farm-use aviation gasoline or kerosene without operating the farm, with an unwaived kerosene claim; public-bus diesel/kerosene and foreign-trade aviation kerosene need unwaived claims; foreign-trade aviation gasoline needs civil-aircraft trade and reciprocity for foreign registry; exports need retained proof, and a blender claim needs the partnership's M registration and certification. Registered-vendor government diesel line 6a and nonaviation-kerosene line 7a require distinct seller UV registration, buyer certificates, sale records, tax relief and no government-issued credit card. Blocked-pump kerosene line 7b requires the partnership seller's UP registration, qualifying fixed and marked pump, nontaxable buyer use, and buyer records for locked-pump sales over five gallons. Registered-vendor bus lines 6b and 7c require the partnership seller's UB registration, current buyer waivers, qualifying public-bus service and distinct sale records. Commercial-aviation kerosene vendor lines 8a and 8b require the partnership seller's UA registration, current signed Model Waiver L, separate original-tax-rate sales, and buyer and cost records. Nonexempt noncommercial aviation line 8c requires its separate UA vendor claim, 24.4-cent original tax, current signed Model Certificate Q, distinct sale and cost records, and no duplicated gallons. Nontaxable noncommercial aviation lines 8d/8e need the original tax rate, eligible use, current Model Waiver L with UA registration or Model Certificate P with UV registration for government sales, and distinct sale and cost records; foreign-trade gallons also generate line 8f LUST credit. A registered card issuer on line 13 needs its own active CC registration, government-issued credit-card purchase, current signed Model Certificate R, buyer tax relief, vendor settlement, actual cost, and no duplicate Form 720/8849 claim; only the partner share from box 20 code C belongs here. Retained buyer tax requires partnership-level income and K-1 accounting and is not supported on this partner path. A prior-year credit producing current Schedule E income belongs in the separate prior-credit field.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_MATCHING_ORDINARY_HOME: Confirm the matching ordinary HomeSale and sale date before calculating Form 8828.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ORDINARY_TRANSFER_QUAL: Confirm the ordinary transfer, qualified MCC or QMB source, issuer notice, owner share and original loan. A gift to a spouse or ex-spouse incident to divorce, casualty replacement and subordinate-loan gain sharing need separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ORIGINAL_FEDERALLY_SUB: Confirm the original federally subsidized loan was provided before 1991 and no later qualifying QMB loan or MCC became subsidized debt on this home.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ORIGINAL_SELLER_S_REDU: Confirm the original seller's reduction of purchase principal, solvency, no bankruptcy or debt transfer, adequate property basis and retained personal ownership or the disclosed ordinary sale. Other cases need their cancellation or disposition worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_ORIGINAL_SUBSIDIZED_LO: Confirm the original subsidized loan's full-payoff or qualifying reissue history for Form 8828 line 20.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_QUALIFIED_PENSION_SIMP: The Simplified Method applies to a qualified pension; IRA, rollover, conversion and special allocation cases require their own worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_QUALIFIED_PLAN_EMPLOYE: Your spouse's employer adoption benefits need a joint return. Multiple employees for one child need additional coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_SAME_OWNER_HSA_DESTINA: Confirm the same-owner HSA destination, complete rollover history, 60-day deposit deadline and one-year limit; ineligible transfers need excess-contribution treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_SECTION_175_METHOD_QUA: Confirm the section 175 method, qualifying plan and complete farming sources. Separate-return owners, nonproduction receipts, subsidies, other farming income, revised assessments and disposal/recapture need their source worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_SINGLE_CHILD_CSRS_FERS: Confirm the single-child CSRS/FERS temporary annuity and death exception. Spouse/lifetime/multiple-child benefits and changed entitlement periods need their own worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_SOLE_FEDERAL_MORTGAGE_: Confirm the sole federal mortgage subsidy was a QMB-funded qualified home improvement loan of no more than $15,000 used for eligible improvements; other subsidized financing needs separate review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_SOURCE_MINIMUM_TIMELY_: Confirm the source minimum, timely payments, legal account group and filer. Unresolved deadlines or source calculations require review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_STATE_PAYROLL_NOTICE_E: Confirm the state payroll notice, employer liability and deposited employee taxes; reconcile withholding with the covered wages and annual limits.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_THIRD_YEAR_PAYMENT_HIS: Third-year recapture for a pre-1987 instrument, or one changed to the post-2018 rules during the recapture period, needs separate review.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_TRUSTEE_S_DEATH_DATE_V: Confirm the trustee's death-date value and basis, the qualified account and complete distributions. The beneficiary's estate acquisition belongs on that beneficiary's final return; another acquirer reports it on their own return. Unentered excess or other distributions need separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_U_S_SCHEDULE_C_OR_FARM: Confirm the U.S. Schedule C or farm activity, tax-paid qualified use, purchase/equipment records, no prior Form 8849/8864/720 claim, and whether the credited tax was deducted or removed from expenses. Farm-operator fuel lines require a farm activity; a Schedule C custom aerial applicator may claim its own farm-use aviation gasoline or kerosene, with an unwaived kerosene claim; public-bus diesel/kerosene and foreign-trade aviation kerosene need unwaived claims; foreign-trade aviation gasoline needs civil-aircraft trade and reciprocity for foreign registry; exports need retained proof, and a blender claim needs M registration and certification. Registered-vendor government diesel line 6a and nonaviation-kerosene line 7a require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UV registration, government-buyer certificate and records, tax-excluded sale, tax repayment or buyer consent, and no government-issued credit card. Blocked-pump kerosene line 7b requires an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UP registration, qualifying fixed and marked pump, nontaxable buyer use, and buyer records for locked-pump sales over five gallons. Registered-vendor bus lines 6b and 7c require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UB registration, current buyer waivers, qualifying public-bus service and distinct sale records. Commercial-aviation kerosene vendor lines 8a and 8b require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UA registration, current signed Model Waiver L, and separate original-tax-rate sale and cost records. Nonexempt noncommercial aviation line 8c requires an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UA registration, 24.4-cent original tax, current signed Model Certificate Q, distinct sale and cost records, and no duplicated gallons. Nontaxable noncommercial aviation lines 8d/8e require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UA registration and current Model Waiver L, or UV registration and Model Certificate P for government sales, eligible use, original tax rate, and distinct sale and cost records; foreign-trade gallons also generate line 8f LUST credit. A registered card issuer on line 13 needs an ordinary Schedule C business, active CC registration, government-issued credit-card purchase, current signed Model Certificate R, buyer tax relief, vendor settlement, actual cost, and no duplicate Form 720/8849 claim. Retained buyer tax additionally requires a direct active issuer, exact line-13 reconciliation, no buyer/vendor profit-and-loss entries, no tax-cost deduction or duplicated credit income, and no separate cash-recovery history. An accrual issuer includes the retained benefit as 2026 Schedule C other income; a cash issuer with no 2026 receipt reviews that separate income in its actual or constructive receipt or credit-application year. Both claim the 2026 Form 4136 refundable payment once. Other fuel uses need their own worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THE_VARIABLE_COMMERCIAL_AN: Confirm the variable commercial annuity payment schedule and history; reduced survivor benefits, split recipients and other special adjustments need further calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONFIRM_THIS_WAS_A_PURE_NONSPOUSE_: Confirm this was a pure nonspouse gift with no consideration, mortgage assumption or other debt relief to the donor; a mixed sale and gift needs coordinated recognized-income treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_CONTRIBUTIONS_EXCEED_THE_7_000_25_: Contributions exceed the $7,000, 25% compensation or 2026 shared $24,500 regular-deferral limit. Excess-contribution and catch-up corrections need resolution before this return can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_COOP_ACTIVITY_NEEDED: The known cooperative income needs its actual same-owner Schedule C, farm or farm-rental recipient; no activity or income is guessed.
StringResources.ISSUE_COOP_CREDIT_INCOME_NEEDED: The actual source does not establish the required credit-related income or its accepted recipient. No required income is guessed.
StringResources.ISSUE_COOP_DISTRIBUTION_CHARACTER_NEEDED: Purchase exclusions require the original patronage-dividend or patronage-notice source. Nonpatronage distributions and per-unit retains are not assumed to be personal-purchase refunds.
StringResources.ISSUE_COOP_NOTICE_HISTORY_NEEDED: Record notice history covering the entire box 5 redeemed amount, including actual ownership, basis and stated value. Above-stated-value proceeds, losses or basis shared with an excluded part need their source allocation; no basis or gain character is guessed.
StringResources.ISSUE_COOP_PROPERTY_HISTORY_NEEDED: The capital-purchase refund needs the canonical property owner's effective-dated regular/AMT basis or disposition result. The refund is not simply taxed as ordinary income.
StringResources.ISSUE_COOP_SOURCE_INVALID: Correct the cooperative source amounts and component records before estimating.
StringResources.ISSUE_CORRECTIVE_PRINCIPAL_CANNOT_EXCEED: Corrective principal cannot exceed this beneficiary's nonexempt 2026 contributions above the $5,000 limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_COVERDELL_CORRECTION_REVIEW: A recorded Coverdell correction no longer agrees with its linked income source. Reconcile the actual principal, earnings and beneficiary before its additional tax is computed.
StringResources.ISSUE_COVERDELL_ELIGIBILITY: A contribution after age 18 without an established special-needs exception needs the actual account consequences under section 530; the App cannot assume a permitted account or a zero added tax.
StringResources.ISSUE_COVERDELL_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE: The actual contributor limit records do not establish the beneficiary’s section 4973(e) tax and next-year excess. No donor or contribution limit is invented.
StringResources.ISSUE_CREATING_A_NEW_HOUSING_CARRYOVER_W: Creating a new housing carryover without current foreign service earnings needs separate eligibility review. A prior carryover can expire when no income capacity remains.
StringResources.ISSUE_CREATIVE_TRANSFER_OWNER_NEEDED: This creative-property transfer requires separate transfer treatment before the complete estimate can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_CREDIT_CARRYBACK_LIMIT: The 2025 carryback of the {0} credit cannot exceed the 2026 credit left after 2026 Form 3800 tax use ({1,number,currency}).
StringResources.ISSUE_CURRENT_LAST_MONTH_TESTING_HISTORY: Current last-month testing history requires December 1 eligibility and a death exception consistent with People.
StringResources.ISSUE_CURRENT_MINIMUM_TAX_SOURCE_HISTORY: Current minimum-tax source history conflicts with the calculated original 2025 worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_BUSINESS_DEBT: Canceled business debt included in income (Schedule C line 6, Schedule E line 3, Schedule F line 8 or Form 4835 line 6) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_BUSINESS_PROPERTY_MISSING: List the business, farm and rental property you hold on January 1, 2027 under Property, with its basis: canceled debt reduces it before personal-use property (Form 982 line 10a).
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_CONTINGENT_INCOME: This contingent-payment instrument needs its comparable-yield and projected-payment adjustments. Its required annual income is unresolved; complete that computation before relying on the estimate.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_DEALER_PROPERTY_ELECTION: The election to treat real property held for sale to customers as depreciable property (Form 982 line 3) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_EXCESS_BUSINESS_LOSS: An excess business loss carryforward (Form 461 line 16) reached by canceled debt (Form 982 line 6) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_FACTS_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm the discharge facts, including a liability or principal snapshot that includes the canceled debt, and the property held on January 1, 2027, after completing the 2026 return.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_FARM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Canceled farm debt above the Form 982 line 1c limit (adjusted tax attributes plus the basis of qualified property, {0,number,currency}) is Schedule F line 8 income, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_FARM_LIMIT_MTC_UNKNOWN: Canceled farm debt above the Form 982 line 1c limit (adjusted tax attributes plus the basis of qualified property, {0}) is Schedule F line 8 income, which is not calculated. The limit also needs the minimum tax credit from 2026 alternative minimum tax (Form 8801 for 2027).
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_FTC_CARRYBACK: A foreign tax credit carried back to 2025 that canceled debt reduces (Form 982 line 13) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_GBC_CARRYBACK: A general business credit carried back to 2025 that canceled debt reduces (Form 982 line 7) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_JOINT_CARRYOVER_SHARE: A joint return needs each spouse's share of the carryover this canceled debt reduces (Treas. Reg. 1.108-7(d), Form 982 line {0,number,integer}); it is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_LIQUIDATION_BANKRUPTCY: Debt discharged in a chapter 7 or chapter 11 case, with its separate bankruptcy estate (Form 982 line 1a), is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDIT_UNKNOWN: The minimum tax credit from 2026 alternative minimum tax (Form 8801 for 2027) that canceled debt reduces (Form 982 line 8) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_MTC_CARRYBACK: A minimum tax credit carried back to 2025 that canceled debt reduces (Form 982 line 8) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_MULTIPLE_DISCHARGES: Several discharges with exclusions for one filer in 2026 need the multiple-discharge basis allocation (Treas. Reg. 1.1017-1(b)(2), Form 982 Part II); it is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_NET_GROSS_INCOME_UNKNOWN: Taxable-premium amortization is not elected, and this net statement does not establish gross taxable income. Enter the actual premium offset already applied to retained income after nominee and after-death allocations, including a documented zero if applicable. Total amortization is not necessarily the applied offset.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_OTHER: This canceled-debt situation (Pub. 4681) is not calculated; the canceled amount is not treated as tax-free.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_PARTIAL_MIXED_CAPITAL: Canceled debt that reduces only part of a mixed short- and long-term capital loss carryover (Form 982 line 9) needs the year-of-origin ledger; it is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_PRINCIPAL_RESIDENCE: Qualified principal residence debt canceled under a written arrangement made before 2026 (Form 982 lines 1e and 10b) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_REAL_PROPERTY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Canceled real property business debt above the Form 982 line 1d limit ({0,number,currency}) is Schedule C line 6, Schedule E line 3 or Schedule F line 8 income, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEBT_REAL_PROPERTY_LIST_MISSING: List the depreciable real property that secured the debt, and your other buildings, under Property with their January 1, 2027 basis (Form 982 line 4).
StringResources.ISSUE_DECEMBER_BASED_ELIGIBILITY_CANNOT_: December-based eligibility cannot begin after the account owner's death.
StringResources.ISSUE_DEFERRAL_REQUIRES_CASH_ACCOUNTING_: Deferral requires cash accounting and proceeds received for 2026 physical crop loss. Price-only or rainfall-index proceeds without physical damage cannot be deferred.
StringResources.ISSUE_DE_MINIMIS_ELECTION_REQUIRES_CONFI: De minimis election requires confirmed eligible book expensing, the annual election for all qualifying purchases, and invoice/item costs at most $2,500 without an applicable financial statement or $5,000 with one. Reclassify ineligible purchases under their ordinary rules; an over-limit item is not a partially deductible safe-harbor purchase.
StringResources.ISSUE_DIFFERENT_REGULAR_AMT_CAPITAL_SOUR: Different regular/AMT capital sources with AMT payable need permanent-exclusion source records. Changed incoming losses need independent exclusion-only netting; do not assume every AMT difference is a deferral.
StringResources.ISSUE_DIFFERING_EXCLUSION_ONLY_LOSSES_EN: Differing exclusion-only losses entering2026 need restoration-year exclusion and future-credit coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_DISABILITY_ONSET_CANNOT_PRECEDE_TH: Disability onset cannot precede the account owner's birth.
StringResources.ISSUE_DISASTER_LIMIT_SPOUSE: Line 1e: your spouse's qualified disaster distributions for disaster DR-{0} cannot exceed $22,000 less earlier years; treat less as qualified.
StringResources.ISSUE_DISASTER_LIMIT_TAXPAYER: Line 1e: your qualified disaster distributions for disaster DR-{0} cannot exceed $22,000 less earlier years; treat less as qualified.
StringResources.ISSUE_DOMESTIC_ABUSE_CLAIMS_FOR_ONE_OWNE: Domestic-abuse claims for one owner must use the same pre-2026 qualified gross total.
StringResources.ISSUE_DOMESTIC_ABUSE_CLAIMS_FROM_ONE_PLA: Domestic-abuse claims from one plan must use the same opening balance and pre-2026 plan usage.
StringResources.ISSUE_DO_NOT_COUNT_ONE_COMPENSATION_SOUR: Do not count one compensation source twice.
StringResources.ISSUE_EACH_MONTH_MARKED_AS_MARKETPLACE_C: Each month marked as Marketplace coverage needs its Form 1095-A month in Marketplace coverage (Pub. 974 Worksheet W line 1).
StringResources.ISSUE_EACH_ORIGINAL_RETURN_MUST_COVER_MA: Each original return must cover matching repayments once or continue an affected loss or minimum-tax-credit history, within the benefits originally included in its income.
StringResources.ISSUE_EACH_STATE_PAYMENT_REQUIRES_A_POSI: Each state payment requires a positive income base; unresolved loss or minimum-tax attribution needs a separate worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_EACH_TRUSTEE_PAYMENT_MUST_BE_MADE_: Each trustee payment must be made on or after the receiving filer's actual age-70½ date, including gifts from inherited IRAs.
StringResources.ISSUE_EARLIER_QUALIFIED_AMOUNTS_ASSIGNED: Earlier qualified amounts assigned to current plans cannot exceed the owner's total earlier qualified amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_EARLIER_TAXABLE_FOREIGN_BENEFITS_B: Earlier taxable foreign benefits belong to a pending foreign adoption or one finalized in 2026; earlier finalizations require the previously filed exclusion history.
StringResources.ISSUE_EARLIER_VARIABLE_PAYMENTS_REQUIRE_: Earlier variable payments require a designated survivor after a 2026 death and the same annual exclusion for both recipients. A new shortfall election during the transition requires separate allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_EXPENSES_ENTERED: This person's college costs are entered on Education credits and again on the 529 and Coverdell expenses record. Enter them once: choose the education credit entry here, or remove the credit entry.
StringResources.ISSUE_EDUCATION_ACCOUNT_STUDENT_HAS_NO_E: A 529 or Coverdell student's college costs come from an education credit entry, but this person has none. Add the entry on Education credits or enter the costs on the 529 and Coverdell expenses record.
StringResources.ISSUE_EDUCATION_RECAPTURE_AMOUNTS: Reconcile the filed 2025 education expenses, credit and later refund or assistance amounts.
StringResources.ISSUE_EDUCATION_RECAPTURE_COMPLEX_PRIOR_: An earlier education credit needs its actual expense year and complete prior-return history established before calculating recapture.
StringResources.ISSUE_EDUCATION_RECAPTURE_PRIOR_CREDIT_M: The filed 2025 Form 8863 credit does not match the ordinary single-credit calculation; reconcile the retained prior return.
StringResources.ISSUE_ELECTED_ADDITIONAL_FOREIGN_LOSS_RE: Elected additional foreign-loss recapture exceeds the remaining account balance or same-category income after statutory recapture.
StringResources.ISSUE_ELECTED_GAINS_AND_DIVIDENDS_CANNOT: Elected gains and dividends cannot exceed the corresponding investment income available for election.
StringResources.ISSUE_ELIGIBILITY_LOSS_CANNOT_FIRST_OCCU: Eligibility loss cannot first occur after the original account owner's death.
StringResources.ISSUE_ELIGIBLE_ARCHER_MSA_MONTHS_CANNOT_: Eligible Archer MSA months cannot follow death or belong to a dependent.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSES_EMPLOYER_MISSING: A W-2 chosen for this Form 2106 is no longer on the return. Choose this job's W-2 again.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_FOREIGN_GOVERNMENT_PAYROL: Foreign government or international organization pay requires its special self-employment and payroll treatment; employee FICA exemption alone does not establish zero tax.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_PAYROLL_COVERAGE_UNAVAILA: Actual payroll coverage is unavailable for this pay; its affected payroll tax cannot be determined. Correct the payroll source on Wages.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_RAILROAD_ORDINARY_TAX: Ordinary RRTA collection and employee representative tax are not calculated. Actual railroad compensation and Additional Medicare Tax remain included.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_RRTA_COMPENSATION_UNAVAIL: Actual RRTA compensation is unavailable; its dependent payroll tax cannot be determined. Correct the railroad source on Wages.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_TIPS_RECORDS: Check the 2026 tip records: enter each month once, with reported tips no more than the tips received.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_VEHICLE_ACTUAL_EXPENSES_S: Form 2106 actual vehicle expenses need an owned 5-year passenger automobile placed in service in 2025 or 2026, or a vehicle outside the passenger-automobile limit, with the IRS table percentages and no section 179 carryforward. Earlier passenger automobiles, a 150% declining-balance history, a lease, an employer-provided vehicle and a personal-use conversion need separate rules (Form 2106 Part II).
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYEE_WAGES_RECORDS: Enter a valid Form 8919 reason and pay amounts; reason H needs the Form 1099 you received.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYER_DEPOSITS_MUST_BE_SUPPORTE: Employer deposits must be supported by compensation from the contributing employer, not by an unrelated self-employed business.
StringResources.ISSUE_EMPLOYER_EXCESS_DEPOSITED_IN_2026_: Employer excess deposited in 2026 for 2025 cannot exceed the retained 2025 Form 5329 total excess.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_A_RETURN_YEAR_DATE_SOLD_OR_S: Enter a 2026 date sold or stopped using, the sale price and selling expenses within the supported limits, and installment amounts no larger than the sale price (Form 6252 lines 5, 6 and 21).
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_A_SALE_DATE_BEFORE_RETURN_YE: Enter a sale date before 2026, a gross profit no larger than the contract price, and payments that do not exceed the contract price (Form 6252 lines 16, 18, 21 and 23).
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_EACH_EARLIER_FORM_8915_F_ONC: Enter each earlier Form 8915-F once, with a disaster year no later than its tax year and a carried-back amount no larger than its line 14 or 25 excess.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_EACH_PERSON_S_ORIGINAL_RETUR: Enter each person's original return only once per year.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_ONE_CONFIRMED_ANNUAL_SECTION: Enter one confirmed annual section 501(c)(18)(D) record per filer; spouse contributions require a joint return.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_ONE_ROTH_IRA_HISTORY_PER_OWN: Enter one Roth IRA history per owner (on the Retirement topic): the first Roth IRA year and the contributions and conversions not yet taken out (Form 8606 lines 22 and 24).
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_PRIOR_YEAR_MODIFIED_AGI_AND_: Enter 2025 modified AGI and filing status to test the prior-year alternative.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_THE_COMPLETE_2026_VARIABLE_A: Enter the complete 2026 variable-annuity schedule through death or contract expiration, including earlier-recipient installments where applicable. Zero installments require zero gross receipts and the owner's final return. Keep beneficiary and estate payments separate.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_THE_RETAINED_FORM_8960_EXCLU: Enter the retained Form 8960 excluded-loss difference, including confirmed zero; Schedule D alone does not establish the investment-tax balance.
StringResources.ISSUE_ENTER_UNEMPLOYMENT_RECORDS_AND_THE: Enter unemployment records and the final 2026 credit-reduction rate for each state covering FUTA wages.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTABLISH_K_1_BOX_14_CODE_A_BEFORE: Establish K-1 box 14 code A before plan compensation.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTABLISH_K_1_BOX_14_CODE_A_FROM_T: Establish K-1 box 14 code A from the reported records. Missing earnings are not zero and cannot be inferred from box 1 or participation.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_AMT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The fiduciary's box 12 adjustment needs its actual regular/AMT source and applicable Form 6251 owner under sections 56 and 57; its added tax cannot be omitted.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_COMMUNITY_NIIT_SOURCE_UNAVA: This fiduciary's net investment income adjustment needs its actual income and property-gain components before community allocation. Establish that source attribution for a complete federal estimate.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_FINAL_INTEREST_LIMITED: Your net investment income doesn't absorb all the final-year box 11 code B investment interest. StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_K1_AMT_ITEMS: A Schedule K-1 (1041) box 12 code G, H or I amount is listed but not entered. Enter its signed amount and treatment in the box 12 reconciliation; this AMT adjustment cannot be left out.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_K1_CREDIT_RECAPTURE: This Schedule K-1 reports credit recapture in box 13 code R. Its additional tax under the applicable credit provision requires the recapture worksheet; it cannot be left out of the estimate.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_K1_OTHER_INFORMATION: Unclassified Schedule K-1 (1041) box 14 information needs the fiduciary's actual income, tax and return treatment before a complete federal estimate. Identified credit, deduction or exclusion benefits have separate categories.
StringResources.ISSUE_ESTATE_OTHER_SOURCE_REQUIRED: This K-1 has unclassified income, foreign-beneficiary or inconsistent-return information. Sections 652 and 662 require its actual income character; known portfolio income is retained but a complete federal estimate needs the owning worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_EVERY_IRA_BASIS_SELECTION_NEEDS_A_: Every IRA-basis selection needs a complete supported owner-level worksheet in Adjustments; it cannot determine pension or annuity taxation.
StringResources.ISSUE_EVERY_REQUIRED_TO_FILE_HOUSEHOLD_I: Every required-to-file household income record must refer to a qualifying dependent on this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_EXCESS_SOCIAL_SECURITY_WITHHOLDING: Excess Social Security withholding by one employer requires employer correction, not the multiple-employer credit.
StringResources.ISSUE_EXCHANGE_DATES_OR_AMOUNTS_INVALID: Enter the exchange dates in order, amounts within the supported limits, and a land part no larger than the value you received for this rental.
StringResources.ISSUE_EXCHANGE_RECEIVED_BEFORE_TRANSFER: Receiving the new property before giving this rental up is a reverse exchange through an accommodation titleholder, which is not calculated (Revenue Procedure 2000-37).
StringResources.ISSUE_EXCHANGE_REPLACEMENT_DISPOSED: You sold or gave away in 2026 the property you received from a related person; that sale and the exchange gain it triggers are not calculated (section 1031(f), Form 8824 line 10).
StringResources.ISSUE_EXCHANGE_REPLACEMENT_IN_BUSINESS: The new property is used in your own business; its depreciation belongs to that business and is not calculated (Form 8824, Form 4562).
StringResources.ISSUE_EXCHANGE_SOMETHING_ELSE: This like-kind exchange is not calculated: other property given up, more than one property, a reverse or build-to-suit exchange, an intermediary's default or a note received need their own statements (Form 8824 lines 12–18, Publication 544).
StringResources.ISSUE_EXTENDED_RULES_COMPLETE_SEPARATE_A: Complete separate AMT partnership activity records; missing data is not a zero adjustment.
StringResources.ISSUE_EXTENDED_RULES_CONFIRM_THE_CASH_ME: A prior-year partner fuel credit recovery requires a continuing nonpassive ordinary U.S. partnership with no retained basis, at-risk or passive losses; other histories need a separate recovery worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_FAMILY_ALLOCATION_REQUIRES_COMPLET: Confirm the contribution-limit method and actual owner eligibility. StringResources.ISSUE_FARM126_ECONOMIC_VALUE_SOURCE: Supply the actual improvement economic fair market value; missing optional exclusion appraisal alone belongs on its improvement record.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM126_INCOME_BASIS_SOURCE: The cost-sharing improvement needs its actual taxable income, exclusion and linked property basis calculation before return totals can be shown.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM126_MIXED_SOURCE_OWNER: Mixed payment character or incomplete improvement funding needs the actual excluded cost-share funding applied to this improvement. Supply that source amount; the income-right present value does not establish the funding allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARMER_GROSS_AMOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: The farmer or fisher gross-income sources exceed the supported monetary calculation capacity.
