Review the source amounts; an independently established qualifying prior-year or next-year answer remains usable for its own payment calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARMER_GROSS_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The current farmer or fisher gross-income test needs complete source-owner gross statements and the actual farming or fishing character of recognized gains before other sources' losses. K-1 net income, Schedule K-3 foreign-tax gross, or an earlier sale's business-property label cannot replace those facts. A qualifying prior-year farmer or fisher answer independently supports the current penalty; a qualifying expected next-year answer independently supports next year's estimate.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_ADDITIONAL_SOURCE: Resolve the described additional farm income, timing or property source; known receipts remain included.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_AMT_PREPAID_SOURCE: Distinct AMT farm expenses or retained supply costs need their final prepaid allowance and any dependent home-office limit. Known receipts remain; an unresolved dependent source does not establish completed tax.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_CURRENT_POULTRY_TIMING_SOURCE: Current production poultry needs its actual cash-payment method, business-use start and lesser-of-12-months/useful-life allocation. Partial-month or earlier starts and depreciation/method changes need their retained source worksheet; no current expense or prepaid percentage is guessed.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_ENTITY_SOURCE: Use the entity/K-1 and required accounting owner for this entity or farming syndicate.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_FERTILIZER_RECOVERY_SOURCE: Fertilizer and lime costs need their actual election or retained capital benefit recovery before the expense and remaining basis can be shown.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_FOREIGN_SOURCE: Foreign farm income needs its actual currency, source and cross-border tax adjustments.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_HEADER_REQUIRED: The Schedule F principal agricultural code and information-return answers are needed.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_HEDGE_ALLOCATION_SOURCE: Resolve the complex hedge's matched income, cost character and timing.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_HEDGE_TIMING_CHARACTER: An unidentified, inventory-matched or multiyear hedge needs its actual income character and timing owner. A realized amount alone does not establish ordinary current income or an investor60/40 result.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_INTEREST_ALLOCATION_SOURCE: Resolve the actual indirect-interest expense, capitalization and property allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_LAND_INSTALLMENT_SHORT_HOLDIN: An installment sale of farm land held one year or less is not calculated (Form 6252 line 26 to Form 4797 line 11).
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_LAND_INSTALLMENT_WITH_DEFERRA: An installment sale of farm land with the Form 1062 tax-payment election is not calculated (Form 6252 and Form 1062 line 15).
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_LAND_LINKED_BASIS_NEEDED: This sale needs its accepted parcel's acquisition, regular/AMT basis and section 126 history. Unknown improvement basis or a payment after disposal cannot be omitted from required gain.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_LAND_PART_ALLOCATION_NEEDED: Enter the sold tract's actual regular and AMT opening basis and prior conservation deductions. Partial sales with parcel-wide cost-sharing, current conservation or cooperative adjustments cannot yet be calculated because those source records do not identify the sold tract. No fraction is assumed.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_LAND_RESOLVE_BUSINESS_PROPERT: Resolve business-property section 1231 character before business QBI.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_LAND_TRANSACTION_OWNER_NEEDED: This sale needs its actual transaction owner for partial, related-party, exchange, special-basis or unresolved transfer facts. Required gain cannot be omitted as an unclaimed benefit.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_METHOD_TRANSITION_SOURCE: Resolve this farm's actual accounting transition, consent and section 481 timing source.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_POSITIVE_METHOD_SOURCE: Resolve the positive section 481 adjustment's AMT and consent/period facts; known receipts remain included, but required tax is unresolved.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_PRODUCTION_BASIS_OWNER: Preproductive costs need the linked inventory or depreciable property's regular and AMT basis, release and recovery facts; a paid cost cannot be both expensed and capitalized.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_PRODUCT_BASIS_AND_INVENTORY_A: Farm product basis and inventory are already accounted for in the farm records; do not also deduct Schedule C inventory costs.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_PROPERTY_DISPOSITION_HISTORY: Resolve the actual disposition's basis and ownership history; required gain is not omitted with an unclaimed deduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_WEATHER_CURRENT_CHARACTER: Current class income from business-use livestock needs its retained Form 4797 character, basis and asset source. It cannot be omitted as an unclaimed postponement or assumed to be ordinary product income.
StringResources.ISSUE_FARM_WEATHER_PRIOR_CHARACTER: Prior postponed income from business-use livestock needs its retained Form 4797 character and asset source. It is not ordinary product income by assumption.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_AMT_SALE_AMOUNTS_MUS: AMT sale amounts must be within the supported nonnegative money range.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_AMT_WASH_SALE_LOSS_M: AMT wash-sale loss must not exceed the AMT investment loss; personal property has no wash-sale adjustment.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_A_DISALLOWED_WASH_SA: A disallowed wash-sale loss cannot exceed this sale's loss.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_BOTH_YOU_AND_THIS_PE: Both you and this person cannot each provide more than half the same total support.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_ENTER_A_VALID_BIRTH_: Enter a valid birth date on or before December 31, 2026.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_QUALIFIED_AND_SECTIO: Qualified and section 199A dividends must be separate parts of ordinary dividends; their sum cannot exceed box 1a.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_RESIDENCE_DAYS_CANNO: Residence days cannot exceed days alive in 2026. Use the qualifying residency exception when the newborn rule applies.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_REVIEW_THE_DOCUMENT_: Review the document amounts; they must be within the supported input range.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_SECTION_1250_AND_COL: Section 1250 and collectible components in boxes 2b and 2d cannot exceed total capital gain distributions in box 2a.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_SPECIFIED_PRIVATE_AC: Specified private-activity bond interest dividends in box 13 cannot exceed exempt-interest dividends in box 12.
StringResources.ISSUE_FEDERAL_RULES_TAXABLE_RETIREMENT_I: Taxable retirement income cannot exceed its gross distribution in this supported path.
StringResources.ISSUE_FIRST_HOME_CLAIMS_FOR_ONE_IRA_OWNE: First-home claims for one IRA owner must use the same pre-2026 lifetime total.
StringResources.ISSUE_FIRST_YEAR_DEFERRAL_IS_AVAILABLE_O: First-year deferral is available only for the year this owner turns 73; later IRA requirements cannot be deferred for continued employment.
StringResources.ISSUE_FOREIGN_AWARDS_ABOVE_PAY: Direct prior-year pay and awards cannot exceed this person’s entered W-2 foreign pay and foreign-employer pay. Correct Work abroad or Wages.
StringResources.ISSUE_FOREIGN_PRESENCE_PERIOD_INVALID: Choose a valid 12-month presence period overlapping 2026.
StringResources.ISSUE_FOREIGN_RESIDENCE_PERIOD_INVALID: Enter valid dates for the bona fide residence, ending after it began.
StringResources.ISSUE_FOREIGN_SOURCE_RECORDS_MUST_RECONC: Foreign source records must reconcile with entered foreign pay and interest or ordinary dividends; enter income once in Income and only its source allocation here.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1040_LINE_26_THE_DATED_ESTIMA: Form 1040 line 26: the dated estimated payments do not add up to the annual estimated payment amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1062_TAX_DEFERRAL_ELECTION_WI: Form 1062 tax-deferral election with a business, mortgage, DC homebuyer, residential energy, clean vehicle, legacy EV or refueling credit, or with prior education-credit recapture, needs a combined tax worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_C_BOX_5_IS_NOT_CHECKED_A: Form 1099-C box 5 is not checked: a nonrecourse debt canceled with its property is part of the amount realized, not canceled-debt income. Enter the property on a Form 1099-A entry with the whole debt as box 2. A nonrecourse debt reduced without a transfer (Pub. 4681) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_DESTINATION_MISSING: Enter the business that recovered this previously deducted expense, then select it in the tax-refund record.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_DESTINATION_NOT_CHOSEN: Select the business that recovered this previously deducted expense in the tax-refund record.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_G_BOX_7_AGRICULTURE_PAYM: Form 1099-G box 7 agriculture payments need an existing farm or farm rental on this return for the same owner before they can reach Schedule F line 4a/4b or Form 4835 line 3.
Form 1099-G box 7 agriculture payments need the farm or farm rental that receives them: choose one of this owner's farms on the form.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_G_BOX_9_MARKET_GAIN_CANN: Form 1099-G box 9 market gain cannot be reconciled to this return's own Commodity Credit Corporation loan calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_MISC_BOX_15_SECTION_409A: Form 1099-MISC box 15 nonqualified deferred compensation that fails section 409A carries a 20% additional tax and premium interest (Schedule 2 line 13h) that are not calculated; the deferral history they need is not kept.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_PATR_BOX_6_SECTION_199A_: Form 1099-PATR box 6 section 199A(g) deduction passed through from a specified cooperative (Form 8995-A Part IV line 38) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_PATR_BOX_7_QUALIFIED_PAY: Form 1099-PATR box 7 qualified payments with W-2 wages on the farm need the Form 8995-A Schedule D patron reduction (the lesser of 9% of the QBI allocable to the qualified payments or 50% of the allocable W-2 wages); that allocation is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_PATR_BOX_9_SECTION_199A_: Form 1099-PATR box 9 section 199A(a) specified service trade or business items (Form 8995-A) are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_1099_PATR_DISTRIBUTIONS_NEED_: Form 1099-PATR distributions need an existing farm or farm rental on this return for the same owner before they can reach Schedule F line 3a/3b or Form 4835 line 2a/2b.
Form 1099-PATR distributions need the farm or farm rental that receives them: choose one of this owner's farms on the form.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_2555_COMMUNITY_SPLIT: A separate return that splits community wages cannot also claim the foreign earned income exclusion: Form 2555 figures the exclusion as if the income were not community income.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_2555_LINE_44_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSE: Form 2555 line 44: job expenses on Form 2106 are allocable to excluded foreign earned income in part. Not calculated; remove the Form 2106 or the Form 2555.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_3468_NEEDS_AN_ACTIVE_U_S_SCHE: Form 3468 for business property needs an active U.S. business or farm in which you materially participate.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_5884_LINES_1A_1C_NEED_AN_ACTI: Form 5884 lines 1a–1c need an active U.S. Schedule C employer whose certified employees each match one of its W-2s, with the 2026 credit wages within that W-2's Medicare wages and included in full on Schedule C line 26, a start date after January 1, 2025 for first-year wages (after January 1, 2024 for second-year wages) and before 2026, and 2025 wages within each targeted group's limit. Successor employers, controlled groups, summer youth employees, designated community residents, passive activities and unconfirmed certifications are not calculated. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), its Form 5884 amount on line 4b.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8582_CR_NEEDS_THE_FORM_8615_O: Passive credit limits use the return’s Form 8615 or Schedule J tax method, including the reduced-income comparison.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8615_LINES_6_TO_8_ENTER_YOUR_: Form 8615 lines 6 to 8: enter your parent's return, and any brother's or sister's Form 8615 that uses it, on your parent's return page.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8615_LINES_9_AND_15_WITH_SCHE: Form 8615 lines 9 and 15 with Schedule J on your parent's or a brother's or sister's return (on your parent's return page) are not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8615_LINES_A_C_6_AND_7_WHICH_: Form 8615 lines A–C, 6 and 7: which parent's return to use, or a brother's or sister's Form 8615, is not settled on your parent's return page; the tax at your parent's rate waits for it.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8881_PART_I_SECTION_1_AND_PAR: Form 8881 Part I Section 1 and Part II need an active U.S. Schedule C employer with employee W-2s, an eligible small employer (no more than 100 employees paid $5,000 in the prior year, no plan for substantially the same employees in the prior three years, no controlled or affiliated service group), and start-up costs included in Business expenses. The employer contributions credit (Form 8881 lines 6a–6g, which needs Schedule C line 19) and the military spouse participation credit (Part III lines 12–13) are not calculated for a business's own plan. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), Form 8881 lines 1j,1dd and1ee.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8912_REQUIRES_A_PRE_2018_QUAL: Form 8912 requires a pre-2018 qualified tax-credit or holder-credit Build America bond owned directly by a filer throughout 2026 and separately reported on its own Form 1097-BTC. Original CREBs, older QZABs, pass-throughs, nominees, combined reports, partial-year holdings and direct-pay issuer bonds need a separate review.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8915_F_LINES_11_AND_22_ONE_EL: Form 8915-F lines 11 and 22: one election applies to every qualified disaster distribution of the same disaster year on this filer's form. Choose the same timing on each.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8915_F_LINE_1B_ENTER_THE_SAME: Form 8915-F line 1b: enter the same earlier qualified disaster distributions on every 1099-R for this disaster.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8941_NEEDS_AN_ACTIVE_U_S_SCHE: Form 8941 needs an active U.S. Schedule C employer whose listed employees each match one of its W-2s, with the premiums you paid included in its employee benefit programs expense, and one Form 8941 per owner. Other businesses, household or leased employees, controlled groups and several rating areas are not calculated. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), its Form 8941 amount on line 4h.
StringResources.ISSUE_FORM_8994_NEEDS_AN_ACTIVE_U_S_SCHE: Form 8994 needs an active U.S. Schedule C employer whose listed employees each match one of its W-2s, with each employee's leave wages (and any work opportunity credit wages) within that W-2's Medicare wages, the leave wages included in its wages expense and the insurance premiums in its employee benefit programs expense, and one Form 8994 per owner. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), its Form 8994 amount on line 4j.
StringResources.ISSUE_FTC_NO_SOURCE: Form 1116 Part II: enter at least one foreign income source, a carryover history or a foreign loss account.
StringResources.ISSUE_FTC_SOURCE_RECORD_MISSING: A foreign source row names a business run abroad or an investment sale that is no longer on this return; choose it again or remove the row.
StringResources.ISSUE_FUNDING_EXCEEDS_THE_ANNUAL_AMOUNT_: Funding exceeds the annual amount for the coverage at transfer and the owner's age-55 catch-up; both permitted transfers share the family maximum.
StringResources.ISSUE_GUARANTEED_PAYMENTS_SCHEDULE_K_1_1: Guaranteed payments (Schedule K-1 (1065) boxes 4a and 4b) where the Form 4562 line 11 business income limit binds need an established treatment as active-business compensation, which this App does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_HEALTH_MARKETPLACE_SOURCE_OVERALLO: The selected health deduction and retained premium subsidy exceed a linked plan's available source expenses, or its subsidy allocation exceeds the actual enrollment source. No complete estimate can be reported from an overallocated source.
StringResources.ISSUE_HEALTH_PTC_INITIAL_PASSIVE_ALLOCAT: The initial health-insurance and premium-credit calculation must omit rental real estate losses before completing Form 8582. The source-supported interim treatment is not verified for competing non-rental passive losses, concurrent nonpassive rental losses, or disposed/former-passive loss releases. No complete estimate can be reported from a guessed allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_HEALTH_SERVICE_PROGRAM_PAID_INTERE: Health-service program-paid interest and interest your employer paid under an educational assistance program together cannot exceed the student loan interest entered. Reconcile the entries so no payment is subtracted twice.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_OFFICE_ESTATE_TAXES: An estate's or trust's final-year state and local taxes with an actual-expense home office are not calculated (Form 8829 Line 11 Worksheet lines 1-4).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_OFFICE_MORTGAGE_CREDIT: A mortgage interest credit with an actual-expense home office is not calculated (Form 8396 and Form 8829 line 10).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_OFFICE_MORTGAGE_INSURANCE_LIM: Mortgage insurance premiums reduced by the adjusted gross income limit with an actual-expense home office need the Mortgage Insurance Premiums Deduction Worksheet for Form 8829 and are not calculated (Form 8829 lines 10 and 16).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_OFFICE_MORTGAGE_LIMIT: Home mortgage interest above the Pub 936 limit with an actual-expense home office is not calculated (Form 8829 lines 10 and 16).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_OFFICE_MORTGAGE_RECORD_MATCH: When you itemize, enter the Form 1098 for the home with the office under Home mortgage interest as well; its interest or mortgage insurance premiums are less than the office's (Form 8829 line 10, Schedule A lines 8a and 8d).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_OFFICE_PROPERTY_TAX_MATCH: When you itemize, include the real estate taxes of the home with the office under Taxes you paid as well; they are less than the office's real estate taxes (Form 8829 Line 11 Worksheet, Schedule A line 5b).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_EXCHANGE_COMBINED: An exchange of a home is calculated for a whole property held more than a year and paid in full; a separate business or rental space, an installment note or a short holding period is not calculated with it (Form 8824).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_FIRPTA_WITHHOLDING_UNKNO: The tax the buyer withheld from a foreign seller (Form 8288-A) is not known, so the credit on Form 1040 line 25c cannot be figured.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_INSTALLMENT_CONTRACT_PRI: An installment sale needs a contract price above zero: the loans the buyer took over must be less than the sale price (Form 6252 line 18).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_INSTALLMENT_SEPARATE: An installment sale that also sells a separate business or rental space is not calculated (a separate Form 6252 for each part).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_PRIOR_EXCHANGE_UNKNOWN: Whether the earlier owner got this home in a like-kind exchange within 5 years of the sale is not known, so the exclusion cannot be told (section 121(d)(10), Pub. 523).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_PROPERTY_VALUE_UNKNOWN: The value of the property or services received as part of the price (1099-S box 6) is not known, so the amount realized cannot be figured (Pub. 523).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_PROVIDE_BOTH_SPOUSES__HO: Provide both spouses' home histories for a joint return and only the taxpayer's otherwise.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_PROVIDE_SEPARATE_REDUCED: Provide separate reduced-exclusion periods for each joint filer, and no spouse periods on other returns.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_RESOLVE_HOME_SALE_BASIS_: Depreciation on a home held one year or less is not calculated (Form 4797).
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_RESOLVE_THE_SURVIVING_SP: The surviving-spouse exclusion needs your own two-year ownership and residence, no excluded sale in the two years before and a sale held more than a year; otherwise evaluate a reduced exclusion.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_SEPARATE_DEPRECIATION_UN: The depreciation on the separate business or rental space is not known, so its gain and the share of the price left for your home cannot be figured (Form 4797; Pub. 523). Your Schedule C, Schedule E and Form 4562 records show it.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_SEPARATE_PASSIVE_LOSS: Passive rental losses carried over from earlier years are released by the sale of the rental space (Form 8582, section 469(g)), which is not calculated here.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_SEPARATE_SHORT_TERM: A separate business or rental space sold within a year of acquisition is ordinary income on Form 4797 Part II, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_SPECIAL_2: Sale of your main home: the tax on a person who gave up citizenship or long-term residence (Form 8854, section 877A) is a return-wide tax on a dual-status return, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_THE_FULL_OWNERSHIP_RESID: The full ownership/residence exclusion is not established; evaluate reduced or special exclusions before completing this sale.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOME_SALE_THE_SELECTED_EVENT_DOES_: The selected event does not establish a reduced home-sale exclusion; review other facts and circumstances.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOUSING_REQUIRES_A_VALID_QUALIFYIN: Housing requires a valid qualifying period overlapping 2026.
StringResources.ISSUE_HOUSING_STAYS_MUST_HAVE_NONOVERLAP: Housing stays must have nonoverlapping inclusive dates within the 2026 qualifying period.
StringResources.ISSUE_INCOME_LIMITED_SECTION_179_WITH_AD: Income-limited section 179 with adoption or care benefits needs the coordinated employee-compensation worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_INCOME_TAX_EXPENSE_ATTRIBUTION_COU: Income-tax expense attribution could change the Form 4952 deduction or carryforward and needs additional coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_INHERITED_DISASTER_OVERLAP: The group's qualified disaster distributions cannot include amounts already excluded for a qualified charitable distribution or qualified HSA funding. Reconcile the actual linked payments.
StringResources.ISSUE_INHERITED_GIFTS_MUST_FOLLOW_THE_OR: Inherited gifts must follow the original owner's death and be included in the linked group's gross beneficiary distributions.
StringResources.ISSUE_INHERITED_IRA_KIND_MISMATCH: This payment names an Inherited IRA of the other kind: a Roth IRA payment needs the Roth record and a traditional IRA payment the traditional one.
StringResources.ISSUE_INHERITED_IRA_OTHER_OWNER: This payment names an Inherited IRA that belongs to the other filer. Choose one of this filer's own.
StringResources.ISSUE_INHERITED_MEDICAL_BENEFICIARY_PRED: An individual medical account beneficiary must survive the original holder; use estate treatment when the estate is the beneficiary.
StringResources.ISSUE_INHERITED_MEDICAL_ESTATE_DATE_MISM: An estate-beneficiary account belongs on the original holder's final return; its death date must match People.
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_DEALER_SALE: Dealer sales of property held for customers cannot use this capital installment-sale worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_GAIN_FROM_AN_EARLIER_S: Installment gain from an earlier sale of rental or passive-activity property is passive income that allows part of this return's unallowed passive losses (Form 8582 lines 1 through 4), which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_NOTES_FROM_RETURN_YEAR: Installment notes from 2026 sales above $150,000 total more than $5,000,000 at the end of 2026, so interest is owed on the deferred tax (section 453A, Form 6252 and Publication 537), which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_NO_MAXIMUM_PRICE: A contingent installment price without a stated maximum requires a separate basis recovery schedule; this sale is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_PAYMENTS_EXCEED_PRICE: Installment sale: the loans the buyer took over and the principal received in 2026 cannot exceed the sale price (Form 6252 lines 5, 6 and 21).
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_QSBS: Installment sales of qualified small business stock require the exclusion history; this sale is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_SPECIAL_TRANSACTION: An installment sale to a related party, by a dealer, with a price that depends on later events, or with a note pledged as security or disposed of in 2026 is not calculated (Form 6252 lines 3 and 4 and Part III; sections 453(e), 453(g), 453A(d) and 453B).
StringResources.ISSUE_INSTALLMENT_UNSTATED_INTEREST: An installment note charging less than the applicable federal rate has unstated interest: part of the sale price is interest income (Form 6252 line 5; sections 483 and 1274, Publication 537), which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_INTERVIEW_A_RECORD_IDENTITY_IS_REP: A record identity is repeated in this section.
StringResources.ISSUE_INTERVIEW_A_RECORD_NO_LONGER_BELON: A record no longer belongs to this section. Reopen the section.
StringResources.ISSUE_INTERVIEW_REVIEW_THE_ACCEPTED_PAGE: Review the accepted page values before saving.
StringResources.ISSUE_INTERVIEW_THE_RECORD_IDENTITY_LIMI: The record identity limit has been reached.
StringResources.ISSUE_INTERVIEW_THIS_RETURN_HAS_REACHED_: This return has reached the supported revision limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_INVESTMENT_CREDIT_RECAPTURE_NEEDS_: Investment credit property sold or taken out of use within five years needs a confirmed credit history; recapture from increased nonrecourse financing or a later prevailing-wage failure (Form 4255 Parts II Section C and IV) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_NEXT_YEAR_DEPOSITS: Confirm every actual 2027 IRA deposit was made by April 15 and designated for 2026 with its custodian. Its traditional and Roth amounts must be included once in the matching retained 2026 contribution totals.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_NONDEDUCTIBLE_ELECTION: The voluntary nondeductible amount must be between zero and this filer's regular traditional contributions.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_QTP_ROLLOVERS: Confirm each 2026 direct 529-to-Roth transfer, its distinct source-account history and five-year seasoned amount after earlier transfers, its source contribution/earnings split, and the $35,000 beneficiary lifetime room across all accounts.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_ROTH_EXCESS_NEEDS_YEAR_END_VAL: Form 5329 Part IV line 23: 2026 Roth IRA contributions exceed this filer's income-based, age-based or compensation limit. Enter the December 31, 2026 IRA values under More about these contributions on the IRA contributions page so the 6% tax is calculated, or correct or recharacterize the excess.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_SPOUSE_COVERAGE: Complete both IRA coverage records for a joint return; remove spouse IRA facts for any other filing status.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_SPOUSE_SITUATION: Choose the IRA spouse situation matching filing status and whether you lived together during the year.
StringResources.ISSUE_IRA_TRADITIONAL_EXCESS_NEEDS_YEAR_: Form 5329 Part III line 15: 2026 traditional IRA contributions exceed this filer's age-based or compensation limit. Enter the December 31, 2026 IRA values under More about these contributions on the IRA contributions page so the 6% tax is calculated, or correct the excess.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_ACTIVITY_OWNER_OUTPUT_UNAVAILAB: This estimate does not yet calculate the combined basis, at-risk and passive limits for these activity records.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_AMT_LIMIT_DIFFERS: Your AMT basis allows a different section 179 deduction, contribution, other-income loss or other deduction than your regular basis, and this App does not calculate those differing allowances.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_AMT_LINE_CLASSIFICATION_UNAVAIL: The K-1's supporting statement is needed to identify the AMT activity adjustment's form line.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_COOPERATIVE_QBI: A section 199A statement with items from a specified agricultural or horticultural cooperative (Form 8995-A Schedule D patron reduction and the section 199A(g) deduction) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_CREDIT_RECAPTURE: Carbon oxide sequestration credit recapture (K-1 code AX, Form 8933 Part III) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_DISPOSITION_OTHER: A part sale, gift, transfer at death, sale to a related person, installment sale, liquidation with property, redemption, carried interest (section 1061) or interest held partly one year or less is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_GAIN_NIIT_ADJUSTMENT: A gain on a partnership interest or S corporation shares — a distribution above your basis or a sale — from a business you materially participate in, with modified AGI above the net investment income tax threshold, needs the Form 8960 line 5c adjustment for the entity's business property (proposed Regulations section 1.1411-7), which this App does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_INVESTMENT_INTEREST_AT_RISK: {0}: investment interest (box 13 code H or box 12 code H) with a loss the at-risk limit holds back needs Form 4952 and Form 6198 together, which this App does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_PTP_PROPERTY: Business-property gains, losses and their carryovers in a publicly traded partnership need its separate property and passive-loss worksheets; they are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PROFESSIONAL_STATUS: A Schedule K-1 box 2 rental real estate activity in which a real estate professional materially participated needs that owner's Real estate professional answer on About you or About your spouse.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PROPERTY_LIMITED: A rental activity's section 1231 loss held back by basis or at-risk limits needs an activity-specific property carryover that this K-1 record does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PTP_DISPOSITION: A disposition involving rental activities of a publicly traded partnership needs its separate entire-interest and suspended-loss worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PTP_PARTICIPATION: A real estate professional rental of a publicly traded partnership needs its separate former-passive and participation worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PTP_PROPERTY: Rental property gains, losses and property passive-loss carryovers of a publicly traded partnership need its separate property-character worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PTP_QBI: A rental section 199A statement of a publicly traded partnership needs its actual qualified-source and specified-service classification before the qualified PTP deduction can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_RENTAL_PTP_SOURCE: The rental activities of this publicly traded partnership need the same selected regular or AMT passive-loss source, including its checked section 179 allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_SALE_AMT_UNAVAILABLE: AMT amounts for a section 179 sale are unavailable. Enter the property's AMT statement before its AMT sale worksheet can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_SALE_CARRYOVER_SPLIT: More than one section 179 property was sold and a carryover belongs to sold property. Each property's carryover must be allocated separately; this K-1 does not calculate that allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_SALE_PASSIVE_ALLOCATION: Review this K-1's sale losses and owner loss worksheets; the allowed amounts do not reconcile.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_SALE_RECORDS: Enter valid section 179 sale statements and nonnegative carryover amounts within the supported limits.
StringResources.ISSUE_K1_SECTION1231_QBI_SPLIT: The section 199A statement and loss records do not determine the qualified share of the section 1231 lookback recapture. Provide a business-level qualified allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_K_1_BOX_13_CODE_R_FOR_A_SIMPLE_IRA: K-1 box 13 code R for an IRA payment or a SEP with other facts (Schedule 1 line 16 or 20; Form 7206 line 9) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_LIFE_EXPECTANCY_IS_EXHAUSTED_SUPPL: Life expectancy is exhausted: supply the actual December 31, 2026 remaining account value, including earnings. Last year's balance is not the full-distribution shortfall.
StringResources.ISSUE_LINK_A_SAME_OWNER_2026_TRADITIONAL: Link a same-owner 2026 traditional IRA birth/adoption, emergency, domestic-abuse or terminal-illness distribution. Repay after distribution and within three years, no more than its qualified gross amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_LINK_A_SAME_OWNER_IRA_DISTRIBUTION: Link a same-owner IRA distribution and matching traditional or Roth basis method. Roth source distributions cannot follow HSA receipt and need complete opening history. Basis funding needs dated aggregate balances. Earlier own nonqualified Roth withdrawals require confirmed opening history and distinct actual payment dates. Current regular contributions are supported only when each recorded Roth value covers its transfer plus all opening basis and retained annual regular contributions; other incoming basis or earlier activity needs further support. Inherited sources need the linked beneficiary/deceased-owner history and must follow the original owner's death. Nonqualified inherited Roth funding also supports dated ordinary withdrawals in that group; its opening regular and conversion basis remains separate from personal accounts and other deceased owners. A funding-first answer cannot override an entered earlier ordinary withdrawal date in that same Roth group.
StringResources.ISSUE_LINK_EACH_INHERITED_GIFT_TO_AN_EXI: Link each inherited gift to an existing inherited traditional IRA income entry belonging to this filer.
StringResources.ISSUE_LINK_EACH_PREMIUM_TO_THE_OFFICER_S: Link each premium to the officer's governmental pension or disability-pension Income entry with a supported taxable-amount calculation. An IRA, commercial annuity or railroad pension does not qualify.
StringResources.ISSUE_LINK_THE_EMPLOYER_OR_BUSINESS_MAIN: Link the employer or business maintaining the HDHP to calculate the compensation limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_LOSSES_EXCEEDING_THE_ORDINARY_ALLO: Losses exceeding the ordinary allowance with both short- and long-term lots need a verified allocation of the annual allowance.
StringResources.ISSUE_LOSS_ORIGIN_WORKSHEET_BALANCES_MUS: Loss-origin worksheet balances must reconcile separately to the calculated short- and long-term carryovers after 2025 use. Supply all surviving years or leave the optional history empty when unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_LTC_LIFE_CHARACTER_UNRESOLVED: The actual life-policy or viatical facts do not establish section 101(g) treatment. Its required income needs the existing life or annuity source calculation; the receipt cannot be treated as zero income.
StringResources.ISSUE_LTC_NONQUALIFIED_CHARACTER_UNRESOL: This nonqualified long-term-care receipt needs its actual accident/health, life or annuity tax treatment. Its mandatory taxable income is not established by Form 1099-LTC alone.
StringResources.ISSUE_LTC_PERIODS_OTHER_OWNER: This 1099-LTC names a Long-term care periods record that belongs to the other filer. Choose one of this filer's own.
StringResources.ISSUE_LTC_PERIOD_PAYMENTS_DIFFER: The payments of the periods do not total the per diem payments on the 1099-LTCs that name this record. Make each period's payments add up to them.
StringResources.ISSUE_LTC_SOURCE_CHARACTER_UNRESOLVED: Establish the actual source of the LTC insurance receipt before estimating its required taxable income.
StringResources.ISSUE_LUMP_SUM_SHARED_AND_COMBINED: A lump sum shared with other recipients (box 9a) or with an annuity share (box 8b) is figured from its own statement. It cannot be combined with another 1099-R of the same participant's lump sum.
StringResources.ISSUE_LUMP_SUM_TREATED_DIFFERENTLY: All of a participant's lump-sum distributions in one year must be taxed the same way. Choose the same Form 4972 method for each 1099-R of this participant, or tax none of them separately.
StringResources.ISSUE_MARKETPLACE_COVERAGE_ESTABLISHED_U: Marketplace coverage established under more than one business needs the credit allocated among them (Pub. 974 Step 3, More than one trade or business).
StringResources.ISSUE_MARKETPLACE_MARRIAGE_YEAR: The alternative calculation for the year of marriage (Form 8962 Part V, lines 35 and 36, Pub. 974 Worksheets I and V) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MARKETPLACE_NOT_LAWFULLY_PRESENT: Coverage of a person not lawfully present in the United States (Form 8962 lines 1 to 5 and column (f), Pub. 974 Worksheets A and B) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MARKETPLACE_QSEHRA: A QSEHRA permitted benefit (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (e), Pub. 974 Worksheets N and Q) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MARKETPLACE_THREE_TAX_FAMILIES: A policy shared among three or more tax families (Form 8962 Part IV lines 30 to 33, Pub. 974 Allocation of Policy Amounts Among Three or More Taxpayers) is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MARKETPLACE_UNPAID_PREMIUMS: Enrollment premiums not paid by April 15, 2027 are left out of Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (a) and change the months that can take the credit; this is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MARRIED_SEPARATE_SECTION_179_NEEDS: A Schedule K-1 section 179 amount on a married-separate return needs the spouse's eligible purchases and agreed dollar-limit allocation; without them the amount is lost while still reducing basis, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MATCH_EACH_ORIGINAL_FILING_UNIT_TO: Match each original filing unit to these filers. A prior joint return with a different or absent spouse requires ownership allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_MATCH_REPAYMENTS_TO_THE_ORIGINAL_R: Match repayments to the original recipient and benefit component. Contributory repayments with tax-free basis recovery require a separate allocation; unrelated pension or unemployment income cannot supply the repaid amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_MEDICARE_MSA_PRIOR_DIFFERS: Two Medicare Advantage MSA forms for the same person show different December 31, 2025 balances. Use the same account value on each.
StringResources.ISSUE_MEDICARE_WITHHOLDING_BELOW_ORDINAR: Medicare withholding below ordinary payroll tax requires special payroll review.
StringResources.ISSUE_MIXED_QUALIFIED_NONQUALIFIED_LOSSE: Mixed qualified/nonqualified losses combined with profitable activities, or special entity/property character, need further suspended-loss allocation. Loss-only ordinary sources preserve their qualified proportions.
StringResources.ISSUE_MODIFIED_ADJUSTED_GROSS_INCOME_ABO: Modified adjusted gross income above $505,000 ($252,500 if married filing separately) with an actual-expense home office needs the Line 11 Worksheet iteration (Form 8829 line 11) and is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_MULTIPLE_BUSINESS_EXCESS_LOSS_ALLO: Excess-loss allocation across multiple businesses remains incomplete.
StringResources.ISSUE_MULTIPLE_EXCLUDED_HOME_SALES_IN_ON: Multiple excluded home sales in one year require coordinated spouse and prior-sale allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_MULTIPLE_SELF_EMPLOYED_PLANS_NEED_: Multiple self-employed plans need combined plan-limit and related-employer worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_NIIT_NONRESIDENT_SPOUSE_DOCUMENTS_: The nonresident spouse has income documents other than wages, interest and dividends. Without the joint election for the net investment income tax, the U.S. spouse's separate figures cannot be separated from them here; choose the joint election or review Form 8960.
StringResources.ISSUE_NONDEDUCTIBLE_CONTRIBUTIONS_AND_IR: Nondeductible contributions and IRA distributions for the same owner require a complete basis worksheet in Adjustments.
StringResources.ISSUE_NOTARY_GROSS_ABOVE_INCOME: Notary gross income cannot exceed this business’s gross income after cost of goods.
StringResources.ISSUE_NOTARY_PROFIT_ABOVE_NET: Notary profit cannot exceed this business's net profit.
StringResources.ISSUE_OBTAIN_THE_APPLICABLE_SECOND_LOWES: Obtain the applicable second-lowest-cost silver plan premium from the Marketplace or HealthCare.gov's tax tool before claiming credit for a paid coverage month (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (b)).
StringResources.ISSUE_ONLY_ONE_ANNUAL_EMERGENCY_DISTRIBU: Only one annual emergency distribution per person is permitted; enter traditional IRA repayments in the owner's basis record.
StringResources.ISSUE_ONLY_ONE_HOME_OFFICE_FIGURED_WITH_: Only one home office figured with actual expenses is calculated on a return, and not with a simplified-method office of the same owner (a second Form 8829 or the line 36 allocation between businesses).
StringResources.ISSUE_ONLY_ONE_PREVIOUSLY_OWNED_VEHICLE_: Only one previously owned vehicle credit per buyer may be selected within this three-year window.
StringResources.ISSUE_ORDINARY_ROTH_WITHDRAWALS_BEFORE_T: Ordinary Roth withdrawals before the last qualified funding transfer require supported own-account nonqualified, dated ordering. Current regular contributions need enough recorded earnings to cover every funding transfer without using basis; other earlier activity needs further support. Funding-only earlier entries are permitted.
StringResources.ISSUE_ORIGINAL_EXCLUSION_ONLY_INCOMING_L: Original exclusion-only incoming losses must reconcile with the preceding worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_ORIGINAL_RAILROAD_INCOME_MUST_BELO: Original railroad income must belong to a filer on this historical return.
StringResources.ISSUE_ORIGINAL_SOCIAL_SECURITY_SOURCE_RE: Original Social Security source records do not reproduce Form 1040 line 6b. Reconcile benefits, exempt interest, filing status and original-year adjustments.
StringResources.ISSUE_ORIGINAL_YEAR_EARNED_INCOME_CREDIT: Original-year earned-income-credit facts and published table do not reproduce filed Form 1040 line 27. Reconcile the source return and any IRS changes.
StringResources.ISSUE_ORIGINAL_YEAR_FILING_TABLES_ARE_NO: Original-year filing tables are not implemented for this year.
StringResources.ISSUE_OTHER_TAXES_CANNOT_EXCEED_THE_RETA: Other taxes cannot exceed the retained Form 1040 line 16 amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_PAPER_NOTHING_ENTERED: Nothing is entered from this paper: enter it from the printed form, or delete it.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_A_NEW_ACTIVITY_CANNOT_: A new activity cannot contain prior investment or loss history.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_A_PARTNERSHIP_SELF_EMP: A partnership self-employment source was supplied more than once.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_COMPLETE_THE_ORDINARY_: Complete the ordinary partner-basis source records and identify additional adjustments.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_EARNINGS_AND_INCOME_DE: Partnership earnings and income-dependent deductions did not stabilize to one consistent calculation. No final tax can be reported from these intermediate amounts.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_ESTABLISH_THE_PARTNERS: Establish the partnership business classification and material participation before applying passive limits.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_PARTNER_AT_RISK_RECAPT: Partner at-risk recapture requires separate return and character coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_A_PUBLICLY_TRADED_: The App calculates ordinary PTP qualified losses from reconciled basis, at-risk and same-PTP passive records. Combinations with partner deductions or other carried characters, EBL combinations with positive business adjustments, and retained-loss combinations with property or full-interest sales still need a separate qualified-source worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_COMPLETE_AND_RECON: Complete and reconcile the partnership's ordinary section 199A statement and partner adjustments.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_COMPLETE_HISTORICA: Complete historical partnership QBI loss records for each nonzero suspended balance.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_ESTABLISH_POSITIVE: Establish positive gross-income allocation weights for the owner's half-SE deduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_FOREIGN_PROFIT_OFF: Foreign profit offsets with mixed qualified/nonqualified losses require further allocation; uniformly qualified or nonqualified loss sources retain their character.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_MIXED_PARTNERSHIP_: Mixed partnership/Schedule C excess losses require ordinary loss-only sources with resolved domestic QBI or wholly foreign nonqualified character, without separate foreign exclusions, housing, health or retirement deductions.
Mixed partnership/S-corporation property character needs separate allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_PARTNERSHIP_EXCESS: Partnership excess-loss allocation mixed with other business sources remains unresolved.
Partnership excess-loss allocation with profits, guaranteed payments or special business character remains unresolved.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_PROFIT_OFFSET_PART: Profit-offset partnership excess losses require current ordinary nonpassive sources with a single loss source or the same qualified fraction, no historical losses, partner deductions, guaranteed payments or other businesses.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_PROVIDE_PARTNERSHI: Provide partnership gross income for partner-deduction QBI attribution.
Provide partnership gross SE income for the owner-level QBI deduction allocation; net earnings cannot substitute for gross income.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_QUALIFIED_PARTNERS: Qualified partnership gross SE income must fit total gross SE income.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_RECONCILE_HISTORIC: Reconcile historical partnership qualified-loss records with each separate suspended balance, including rounded totals.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_RECONCILE_PARTNERS: Reconcile partnership QBI with the resolved passive limit and partner deductions.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_RECONCILE_QUALIFIE: Reconcile qualified and total gross income for partner deductions.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_RECONCILE_THE_ROUN: Reconcile the rounded partnership QBI loss-year amounts and their qualified portions.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_RESOLVE_ACTUAL_MAT: Resolve actual material participation for the minimum QBI deduction; nonpassive trading classification alone is insufficient.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_RESOLVE_ALL_PARTNE: Resolve all partnership loss-only sources before excess-loss allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_QBI_ROUNDED_PARTNERSHI: Rounded partnership at-risk vintages do not reconcile to the at-risk worksheet.
Rounded partnership basis-loss vintages do not reconcile to the basis worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_RECONCILE_BOX_14_LESS_: Reconcile box 14 code A after guaranteed payments: a limited partner includes only service payments, trading earnings need separate treatment, and an ordinary loss held back by basis, at-risk or passive limits needs a compatible self-employment share.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_RECONCILE_PARTNER_FINA: Reconcile partner financing and additional at-risk adjustments before applying loss limits.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_RESOLVE_EVERY_PARTNERS: Resolve every partnership's regular self-employment source before combining this owner's earnings.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_REVIEW_THE_RETAINED_OR: Review the retained ordinary passive-loss balance.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_SELF_EMPLOYMENT_LOSS_P: Self-employment loss portions cannot exceed their separate retained total balances.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_THE_PARTNER_BASIS_SOUR: The partner-basis source amounts cannot be reconciled.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_THE_PARTNER_S_AT_RISK_: The partner's at-risk loss allocation is inconsistent.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_THE_PARTNER_S_RECAPTUR: The partner's recapture history is inconsistent.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_THE_REGULAR_TAX_PASSIV: The regular-tax passive allocation does not reconcile with this partnership activity.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_THE_RETAINED_AT_RISK_H: The retained at-risk history is inconsistent.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNERSHIP_THE_SECTION_179_DEDUCT: The section 179 deduction allowed for this partnership does not reconcile with its K-1 box 12 amount.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_AT_RISK_HISTORY_NEEDED: Reconstruct opening at-risk history; outside basis cannot substitute for it. Your 2025 Form 6198 figures are needed when this K-1 has a loss, a loss carried because of the at-risk limits, a section 179 deduction or earlier losses to recapture.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_DISTRIBUTION_HEALTH_PREMIU: Distribution-paid health premiums must fit the coverage total after taxable premiums and be included once in both regular and AMT cash-distribution records.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_EXCESS_LOSS_QBI_AND_PROPER: Resolve partnership QBI and property character before excess-loss allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_AMT_ITEMS: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 17 alternative minimum tax items beyond the separate AMT activity records (Form 6251) are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_INTERNATIONAL: Schedule K-3 (Form 1065) Parts VI and VII (sections 951(a)(1) and 951A inclusions, passive foreign investment companies) and the Part I box 6 section 267A disallowed deduction are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_MULTIPLE_ACTIVITIES: For Schedule K-1 (1065) box 22 or box 23 checked, or a statement with multiple activities, use the Partnership K-1 with a distinct-activity statement document. Enter the actual activity statement and retained loss records there; unsupported activity types still receive their own review notice.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_OTHER_DEDUCTIONS: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 13 code O dependent care benefits (Form 2441 Part III) and a code V section 743(b) adjustment to another item are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_OTHER_INCOME: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 6c dividend equivalents, box 11 codes B, D, I, L, M, N, O, P and ZZ, a code A portfolio loss or REMIC residual interest, a code C straddle, a code F section 743(b) adjustment to another item and gambling of a gambling business are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_OTHER_INFORMATION: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 20 investment income or expense totals requiring separate Form 4952 reconciliation (codes A and B), recapture, look-back interest, section 179 dispositions other than fully taxable sales, installment and section 1260 interest, precontribution gain, section 1061, inversion gain and section 48A–48D items (codes F through M, O through S, W, AL for a U.S. transferor, AM, AP, AS through AU, and ZZ with an amount) are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_PROPERTY_DISTRIBUTION: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 19 codes B and C property distributions (sections 732 and 737) are not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_K1_RENTAL_DISPOSITION: A partnership rental activity's installment sale, like-kind exchange, casualty or theft, or disposition to a related buyer needs separate property and passive-loss worksheets that this App does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_LONG_TERM_PARTS_LIMITED: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 9b collectibles or box 9c amounts with a box 9a long-term loss that your basis or amount at risk limits, or with a long-term loss carried from 2025, need the parts of the allowed loss, which the partner basis worksheet does not give.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_SEPARATE_ITEMS_RECONCILIAT: Review the separately stated Schedule K-1 (1065) amounts: box 6b cannot exceed box 6a.
StringResources.ISSUE_PARTNER_TAXABLE_HEALTH_PREMIUMS: Taxable partnership-paid health premiums must be included in both the entered premium records and guaranteed service payments, without adding either amount twice.
StringResources.ISSUE_PENSION_IRA_PHASEOUT_COORDINATION: Section 501(c)(18)(D) contributions combined with a partially phased-out traditional IRA deduction need verified limit-ordering coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_PENSION_IRA_SPOUSE_COVERAGE: Complete both IRA coverage records for a joint return.
StringResources.ISSUE_PENSION_ROTH_COORDINATION: Section 501(c)(18)(D) contributions with this employee's Roth IRA contributions or 529-to-Roth rollover require further verified contribution-limit coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_PENSION_TRADITIONAL_IRA_LIMIT: Traditional IRA contributions exceed the remaining annual or compensation limit after section 501(c)(18)(D) contributions; resolve the excess before calculating this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_PERSONAL_USE_REFUELING_PROPERTY_MU: Personal-use refueling property must be placed in service during 2026 and no later than June 30.
StringResources.ISSUE_POST_DEATH_CORRECTIVE_DISTRIBUTION: Post-death corrective distributions require the beneficiary's account or inheritance treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_POST_DEATH_DEEMED_DISTRIBUTIONS_BE: Post-death deemed distributions belong to the beneficiary's account treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_POST_DEATH_EMPLOYER_DEPOSITS_NEED_: Post-death employer deposits need beneficiary or estate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_POST_DEATH_HSA_CORRECTIONS_REQUIRE: Post-death HSA corrections require beneficiary or estate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_POST_DEATH_HSA_ROLLOVER_ACTIVITY_R: Post-death HSA rollover activity requires beneficiary treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_POST_DEATH_HSA_WITHDRAWALS_REQUIRE: Post-death HSA withdrawals require beneficiary account treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_PREMIUMS_ALLOCATED_TO_ONE_PENSION_: Premiums allocated to one pension cannot exceed its available distribution after rollovers.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRE_2018_FARM_EQUIPMENT_REQUIRES_I: Pre-2018 farm equipment requires its applicable 150% or straight-line depreciation method, not ordinary 200% declining balance.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_AMT_CAPITAL_LOSSES_NEED_THEI: Prior AMT capital losses need their business/nonbusiness source allocation when property gains enter an ATNOL; the regular Form 8960 difference is not that source.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_ATNOL_WITH_FORM_1116_ALLOCAT: Prior ATNOL with Form 1116 allocation requires the foreign loss-allocation worksheet. The eligible payee-statement election uses the existing shared regular/AMT credit.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_CAPITAL_LOSSES_NOT_ESTABLISH: Prior capital losses not established as investment losses need business/nonbusiness source allocation when current property gains enter an NOL. A Form 8960 difference alone does not establish that allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_CASH_METHOD_CROP_DEFERRALS_O: Prior cash-method crop deferrals on an accrual-method return require an accounting-change worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_CONTRIBUTIONS_MUST_FIT_THE_2: Prior contributions must fit the 2025 limit including the last-month rule; remaining prior excess needs separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_LAST_MONTH_RULE_ELIGIBILITY_: Prior last-month-rule eligibility loss and any death exception must agree with the account owner's final-return date.
StringResources.ISSUE_PRIOR_REGULAR_NOL_WITH_YOUNG_FILER: Prior regular NOL with a young filer or Form 1116 requires further coordinated NOL and carryforward worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROFESSIONAL_ELECTION_ALL_RENTALS: With the election to treat your rentals as one activity, choose Professional for every rental real estate activity or for none.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROGRAM_PAID_INTEREST_OVERLAP_CANN: Program-paid interest overlap cannot exceed the total interest entered in Adjustments. Reconcile the servicer and program entries without double subtraction.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROPERTY_DISTRIBUTIONS_REQUIRE_THE: Property distributions require the taxable liquidation path; ordinary noncash corporate distributions need separate treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_ALL_TWELVE_MONTHS_FOR_EACH: Provide all twelve months for each filer with a student or self-care exception.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_A_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_RETURN: Provide a complete original-return record for every repayment year and owner; missing years cannot contribute a zero credit.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_FORM_532: Provide complete original Form 5329 Part I and medical-expense records for the entered early distributions, even when the original tax was zero.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_COMPLETE_PRECEDING_YEAR_EX: Provide complete preceding-year exclusion and rate records for this original filing unit. Missing facts and changed credit ownership need their own calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_EVERY_AFFECTED_HISTORICAL_: Provide every affected historical return through 2025 before the restoration-year comparison; a missing intervening year is not zero income.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_SPOUSE_FACTS_FOR_A_JOINT_R: Provide spouse facts for a joint return only.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_THIS_RECIPIENT_S_IRA_BASIS: Provide this recipient's IRA basis record after an employer-plan rollover of after-tax contributions. The App adds the incoming basis automatically; do not include it in prior basis.
StringResources.ISSUE_PROVIDE_UNIQUE_YEAR_CATEGORY_BALAN: Provide unique year/category balances from the regular and AMT records through 2025.
StringResources.ISSUE_Q1099_STUDENT_IS_THE_RECIPIENT: This Form 1099-Q is addressed to the same person you chose as its student. Choose that the form is addressed to the student (box 6 not checked), or choose the other person.
StringResources.ISSUE_QBI_PTP_COMPONENT_CLASSIFICATION: Separately reported PTP items need their actual business and specified-service source classification before the income limit can be applied.
StringResources.ISSUE_QBI_SERVICE_BUSINESS_AGGREGATION: A specified service trade or business cannot join an aggregation group (Form 8995-A Schedule B); remove its group above the income threshold.
StringResources.ISSUE_QOF_DEFERRAL_ABOVE_GAINS: {0}: the gain deferred is more than your 2026 {1} capital gains on this page.
StringResources.ISSUE_QUALIFIED_FUNDING_CANNOT_EXCEED_TH: Qualified funding cannot exceed the linked source IRA distribution. QCDs use only the remaining source dollars.
StringResources.ISSUE_QUALIFIED_FUNDING_IS_ONCE_PER_LIFE: Qualified funding is once per lifetime, with only a second transfer in a later month of the same year after self-only changes to family coverage.

StringResources.ISSUE_RARE_LOOK_BACK8697: Long-term-contract look-back interest: the App does not calculate the required source history (Section 460; Form 8697; Schedule 2 line 13n). This additional tax must be resolved before a federal estimate can be completed.

StringResources.ISSUE_RECONCILE_THE_BASE_YEAR_CAPITAL_LO: Reconcile the base-year capital-loss deduction and carryover; the unused deduction must be between zero and the deduction claimed.

StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_RESOLVE_AND_RECONCILE_: Resolve and reconcile the property activity pool before investment-tax classification.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_RESOLVE_DIRECT_FARM_LA: Resolve direct farm-land basis, holding period and transaction eligibility before section 1231 netting.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_RESOLVE_FARM_LAND_SALE: Resolve farm-land sale eligibility before rental MAGI.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_RESOLVE_PARTICIPATION_: Resolve participation before calculating nonpassive property income for rental MAGI.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_RESOLVE_SOURCE_RECAPTU: Resolve source recapture before investment-tax classification.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_RESOLVE_THE_PROPERTY_A: Resolve the property activity pool before the investment-interest worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_SECTION_1231_LOOKBACK_: Section 1231 lookback recapture needs business-level gain allocation before source character can be determined.
