StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_THE_PROPERTY_QBI_RESUL: The property QBI result has no matching business source.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION1231_THE_SECTION_1231_HISTO: The section 1231 history or activity amounts cannot be reconciled.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_DIRECT_AT_RISK: This direct business loss needs its at-risk admission stage coordinated with the selected section 179 allocation. Retain the original source and at-risk records.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_DIRECT_CURRENT_WORK: This business or farm needs established current management or operating work for the section 179 income limit. Historical or deemed material participation alone does not establish that work; combined spousal work on a separate return does not establish your individual work.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_DIRECT_PAL_INCOME: Current work is established, but this business or farm needs its native passive classification and allowed-loss source certified before its taxable income can enter the section 179 income limit. Operating profit alone does not establish that amount; any passive section 179 deduction needs its separate passive-loss treatment.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_OWNER_DEDUCTIONS: {0} section 179 or an income-limited section 179 combined with partner health-insurance or retirement deductions still needs verified income-limit coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_PERCENTAGE_DEPLETION: Percentage depletion with section 179 allocation is not supported yet. Retain the original depletion and section 179 source records.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_PTP_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: This publicly traded partnership's selected section 179 allocation and passive-loss source records do not establish an available result. Retain its separate source worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_PUBLICLY_TRADED: {0} section 179 of a publicly traded partnership follows the PTP rules for Form 4562 line 12, which this App does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_RISK_CARRYFORWARD: {0} section 179 above the activity's remaining amount at risk (Form 6198 line 21) depends on the Form 4562 business income limit, which itself depends on the at-risk limit; this App does not calculate that case.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_RISK_HISTORY: {0} section 179 is tested against your remaining amount at risk (Form 6198), which needs your 2025 Form 6198 figures (Your at-risk history on the K-1).
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_SELECTED_SOURCE_UNAVAIL: Section 179 requires complete, consistent regular and AMT income, asset, carryover and before-deduction at-risk records; the selected source amount is unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_SEPARATE_OWN_WORK: Section 179 on a separate return needs your own work in this business; not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_WAGERING_CURRENT_WORK: Professional wagering income needs established current management or operating work for the section 179 income limit. Historical or deemed material participation alone does not establish that work; combined spousal work on a separate return does not establish your individual work.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_WAGERING_OWN_DEDUCTION: Professional wagering income with its own section 179 election or carryforward, or a home-office deduction, needs coordinated wagering-expense treatment, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION179_WAGERING_PROPERTY: Professional wagering income with a business sale, asset disposition, partial disposition or a fall in business use needs the checked wagering-property source, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION_1256_CARRYBACK_ABOVE_NET_L: The section 1256 loss carryback of {0,number,currency} is more than {1,number,currency}, the most your net section 1256 contracts loss allows. Reduce it.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION_1256_CARRYBACK_WITHOUT_LOS: A section 1256 loss carryback needs a net loss on Form 6781 line 5; your 1099-B contracts show a net gain. Remove the carryback or enter the contracts that produced the loss.
StringResources.ISSUE_SECTION_179_COMBINED_WITH_OWNER_HE: Section 179 combined with owner health-insurance or retirement deductions still needs verified income-limit coordination.
StringResources.ISSUE_SELECT_THE_RETIREMENT_INCOME_ENTRY: Select the retirement income entry for the ended contract.
StringResources.ISSUE_SELLING_YOUR_HOME_IN_CURRENT_YEAR_: Selling your home in 2026 with an actual-expense home office needs the depreciation up to the sale (Form 8829 line 41, Pub 946) and the business-use part of the sale (Pub 523), and is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_SEPARATE_NEW_OR_RETAINED_AMT_LOSS_: Separate new or retained AMT loss accounts with the simplified election require coordinated account worksheets. Regular loss adjustments flow through the elected regular Form 1116 line 17 numerator.
StringResources.ISSUE_SEPARATE_RETURN_FAMILY_CONTRIBUTIO: Separate-return family contributions require the other spouse's shared-limit allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_SEPARATE_SPOUSE_BOXES_WITH_SPOUSE_: Spouse standard deduction boxes require a spouse who is not filing; they cannot be combined with a spouse who itemizes.
StringResources.ISSUE_SEPP_RECAPTURE: A change in a series of substantially equal periodic payments before the later of five years after the first payment and age 59½ adds the earlier years' 10% additional tax with interest, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_SHORT_TERM_RENTAL_IS_A_BUSINESS: Substantial services for guests belong on Schedule C. Enter this property in Self-employment as a business, and remove it from Rentals.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_ALTERNATIVE_MINIMUM_TAX: Alternative minimum tax adjustments and preferences (Form 6251) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_ASSET_DISPOSED: Sales of purchased goodwill or another section 197 intangible, and of section 1254 or 1255 property (Form 4797) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_BUSINESS_CREDITS: Enter a completed source-form credit under More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), choosing the line the source form names. The App does not compute every source form from its underlying facts.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_CASUALTY: Casualty and theft losses of business, rental or income-producing property and Ponzi-type or other investment theft losses (Form 4684 Sections B, C and D, Schedule A line 17d) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_CHAPTER_11_DEBTOR: Chapter 11 debtor with self-employment income is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_COMMUNITY_PROPERTY: Community property shared with a registered domestic partner (Form 8958) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_DUAL_STATUS: Part-year residency, dual-status and U.S. territory returns (Form 1040 line 12c, Form 1040-NR, Forms 4563 and 8689) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_ELECTIVE_PAYMENT: Eligible elective payment is entered with its source-form credit under More credits → General business credits (Form 3800); the net payment reaches Schedule 3 line 13c.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_FOREIGN_CORPORATION: Schedule 1 lines 8n and 8o (Forms 5471 and 8992), Form 8960 line 6 (controlled foreign corporation and PFIC adjustments) and line 10 (additional modifications) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_HOUSING_CREDIT_RECAPTURE: Schedule 2 line 9 (Form 8611 recapture) and line 13n (Forms 8697/8866 look-back interest) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_LIKE_KIND_EXCHANGE: Like-kind exchanges of business, farm or investment real property that is not a rental, and conflict-of-interest sales (Form 8824) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_NONCASH_GIFTS: Gifts of property needing a qualified appraisal (Form 8283 Section B), art, real estate, partial interests and conservation easements, inventory or business property, inherited, gifted, restricted or closely held property, the capital gain property basis election, and gifts with goods or services received in return (Form 8283, Form 1098-C, Schedule A lines 11 and 12) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_OTHER_ADDITIONAL_TAXES: Schedule 2 lines 1d–1f and 1y, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13a, 13g–13m and 19a–19c is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_OTHER_ADJUSTMENTS: Other adjustments to income, including section 501(c)(18)(D) pension contributions (Schedule 1 lines 24a–24z) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_OTHER_CREDIT: Other credits (Schedule 3 line 6z), including a fuel cell vehicle bought before 2022 and first placed in service in 2026 is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_RAILROAD_REPRESENTATIVE: Railroad employee representative compensation and taxes (Form CT-2; Form 8959 line 8; Schedule 8812 lines 12–15) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_REMIC_RESIDUAL: REMIC residual interest (Schedule Q; Schedule E lines 38 and 39) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_SECTION965: Schedule 3 line 13d (deferred section 965 tax liability) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_SPECIAL_DEPRECIATION: Form 4562 lines 14b, 14c, 14d, 19g, 19h and 19k (specified plants, reuse and recycling, qualified production, water utility and railroad property) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_STRADDLES: Straddles and offsetting positions (Form 6781 Part II, boxes A–C, Schedule D lines 4 and 11) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SITUATION_TAX_TREATY: Tax treaty positions (Form 8833) is not calculated yet.
StringResources.ISSUE_SPLIT_MIXED_QUALIFYING_AND_NONQUAL: Split mixed qualifying and nonqualifying Schedule R disability payments before allocating the insurance exclusion.
StringResources.ISSUE_SPOUSE_EDUCATOR_EXPENSES_REQUIRE_A: Spouse educator expenses require a joint return.
StringResources.ISSUE_SPOUSE_MOVE_REQUIRES_A_JOINT_RETUR: A spouse's moving expenses require a joint return.
StringResources.ISSUE_SPOUSE_OWNED_INCOME_NEEDS_A_JOINT_: Spouse-owned income requires a joint return or a community-property separate return.
StringResources.ISSUE_SPOUSE_PAID_ALIMONY_REQUIRES_A_JOI: Spouse-paid alimony requires a joint return.
StringResources.ISSUE_STATE_DEPOSITED_EMPLOYEE_PAYROLL_T: State-deposited employee payroll tax cannot exceed combined Schedule H payroll tax; reconcile the notice before completing this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_STATUTORY_BUSINESS_HAS_OTHER_INCOM: Select this statutory job's Schedule C with expenses only, no other income or owner health and retirement deductions.
StringResources.ISSUE_STATUTORY_BUSINESS_OTHER_OWNER: The statutory employee W-2 and its Schedule C must belong to the same person.
StringResources.ISSUE_STATUTORY_FOREIGN_HOUSING: Foreign housing with statutory employee pay needs the employee funding worksheet; the self-employed housing worksheet does not apply to that pay.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_A_POSITIVE_ELECTION_AND_ALL: Supply a positive election and all three valid base-year records.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_BOTH_SPOUSES_COVERAGE_RECOR: Supply both spouses' coverage records, including a zero-contribution row, to determine the family limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_EACH_INTERVENING_RETURN_FOR: Supply each intervening return for the same filing unit; changed credit ownership needs allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_EVERY_AFFECTED_MINIMUM_TAX_: Supply every affected minimum-tax-credit continuation return through 2025; a missing year is not zero credit use.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_EVERY_INTERVENING_ORIGINAL_: Supply every intervening original return and reconcile its actual regular and AMT incoming capital losses. Changed filing-unit ownership needs allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_NEGATIVE_INCOME_RECORDS_EXA: Supply negative-income records exactly when the base year's AGI minus deductions is negative.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_THE_EXCLUSION_ONLY_WORKSHEE: Supply the exclusion-only worksheet for every affected continuation year.
StringResources.ISSUE_SUPPLY_THE_SOURCE_INCOME_UNDERLYIN: Supply the source income underlying itemized state/local income-tax payments before allocating their foreign deduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_TAXABLE_ABLE_EARNINGS_COULD_CHANGE: Taxable ABLE, 529 or Coverdell earnings could change the Form 4952 deduction or carryforward; verify whether they count as investment income before completing this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_TAXABLE_ADOPTION_BENEFITS_OR_NEGAT: Taxable adoption benefits or negative wage adjustments for a filer using monthly deemed earnings need monthly allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_TAXABLE_DISABILITY_RETIREMENT_INCO: Taxable disability retirement income requires consistent permanent-and-total-disability facts in People.
StringResources.ISSUE_TAX_CREDIT_BOND_INCOME_UNKNOWN: The direct bond's required income source or tax character is unresolved; credit omission alone does not establish ordinary federal tax.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_ASSET_ELECTIONS_AND_SCHEDULE_K: The asset elections and Schedule K-1 section 179 amounts exceed the 2026 shared dollar limit after the eligible-purchase phaseout (Form 4562 line 5). Reduce your own elected costs; the excess cannot become an income-limit carryforward, and a K-1 share above the limit is lost while still reducing basis (Regulations sections 1.179-2(b)(3) and 1.179-3(a)), which this App does not calculate.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_BINDING_CONTRACT_AND_PAYMENT_M: The binding contract and payment must precede October 1, 2025, and possession must occur in 2026.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_BOX_12_CODE_E_PATH_REQUIRES_NO: The box 12 code E path requires nonnegative AMT unrecaptured section 1250 gain after adjustment, with both adjusted special-rate pools within adjusted code D long-term gain.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_BOX_12_CODE_F_PATH_REQUIRES_NO: The box 12 code F path requires nonnegative AMT 28%-rate gain after adjustment, with both adjusted special-rate pools within adjusted code D long-term gain. Unrecaptured section 1250 gain also needs confirmed code E.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_COMBINED_QUALIFIED_AMOUNT_FROM: The combined qualified amount from different plans exceeds $2,600. Cross-plan treatment above that amount requires review before the early-distribution tax can be determined.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_COMPLETE_RETURN_MUST_PROVIDE_B: The complete return must provide both regular and AMT future capital-loss balances.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_COMPLETE_RETURN_MUST_PROVIDE_I: The complete return must provide its Chapter1 tax comparison.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_CURRENT_RETURN_MUST_PRESERVE_C: The current return must preserve credit ownership; changed filing units require allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_CURRENT_RETURN_S_RETAINED_PRIO: The current return's retained 2025 capital worksheet must reproduce the actual regular and AMT balances of the repayment history, for the same filing unit.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_ELECTED_AMOUNT_MUST_BE_POSITIV: The elected amount must be positive and cannot exceed eligible farm income after attributable deductions or current taxable income.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_ELECTED_CAPITAL_GAIN_EXCEEDS_T: The elected capital gain or dividends exceeds its available AMT pool; review the actual election and AMT records.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_EXCEPTION_S_DATE_ACCOUNT_TYPE_: The exception's date, account type, employment eligibility or separation age/service does not qualify for this distribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_EXCLUDED_LOSS_DIFFERENCE_MUST_: The Form 8960 excluded-loss difference must fit the regular capital carryover; it is independent of Form 4952 investment-property attribution.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_EXCLUSION_AND_INCOME_DEPENDENT: The exclusion and income-dependent deductions need further coordinated worksheets; the provisional exclusion does not agree with the final income calculation.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_FINAL_2026_FEDERAL_FUTA_CREDIT: The final 2026 federal FUTA credit-reduction rate is required; do not substitute a potential or prior-year rate.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_FIRST_ROTH_IRA_YEAR_IN_THE_ROT: The first Roth IRA year in the Roth IRA history cannot be before the owner's birth year.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_FORM_8828_SALE_MUST_IDENTIFY_O: The Form 8828 sale must identify one matching HomeSale income entry.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_HISTORICAL_INCOME_DEDUCTIONS_A: The historical income, deductions and credits do not reproduce original line 22 tax. Reconcile missing income, deductions, credits and tax methods.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_HOUSEHOLD_FACTS_DO_NOT_ESTABLI: The household facts do not establish eligibility for the selected filing status; special dependency exceptions are not yet supported.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_IRA_DEDUCTION_AND_QCD_EXCLUSIO: The IRA deduction and QCD exclusion require further coordination; the verified worksheet candidate does not agree with the recalculated deduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_MATCHING_HOME_SALE_TAXABLE_GAI: The matching home-sale taxable gain must be calculated before Form 8828 modified income.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_NAMED_BUYER_IS_NOT_ON_THIS_RET: The named buyer is not on this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_NARROW_BOX_12_CODE_C_PATH_REQU: The narrow box 12 code C path requires a nonnegative beneficiary AMT short-term gain after applying the signed adjustment to box 3. A fiduciary AMT short-term loss needs its own allocation and carryover statement.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_NARROW_BOX_12_CODE_D_PATH_REQU: The narrow box 12 code D path requires a nonnegative beneficiary AMT long-term gain after applying the signed adjustment to box 4a. A 28%-rate gain needs matching code F; section 1250 gain needs matching code E. Other capital-character allocations need separate worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_ORIGINAL_RETIREMENT_SOURCES_AN: The original retirement sources and exceptions do not reproduce the filed early-distribution tax. Reconcile each original Form 5329 before calculating the repayment credit.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_ORIGINAL_YEAR_SSN_SELECTION_MU: The original-year SSN selection must identify only people included on that original return.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PART_OF_A_BUSINESS_FARM_OR_REN: The part of a business, farm or rental debt above your insolvency is Schedule C line 6, Schedule E line 3, Schedule F line 8 or Form 4835 line 6 income, which is not calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PAYEE_STATEMENT_ELECTION_REQUI: The payee-statement election requires only statement-reported passive foreign income and taxes at or below $300 ($600 jointly); other claims require Form 1116.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PERSON_WHO_RECEIVED_QUALIFIED_: The person who received qualified overtime needs a Social Security number valid for employment.
The person who received qualified tips needs a Social Security number valid for employment.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRECEDING_AFFECTED_LOSS_HISTOR: The preceding affected loss history needs its exclusion-only worksheet before continuation.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PREPAID_CEILING_STILL_NEEDS_CO: The prepaid ceiling needs its dependent expense worksheet when separate-return owners or accounting methods differ, section 179 or separate AMT depreciation applies, or source records are incomplete.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRIOR_AMT_SCHEDULE_D_NET_GAINS: The prior AMT Schedule D net gains/losses and line 21 deduction must reconcile independently from regular tax.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRIOR_ELIGIBILITY_HISTORIES_MU: The prior last-month-rule history and each prior funding transfer must agree on the first loss of eligibility across overlapping testing periods.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRIOR_ENHANCED_SENIOR_DEDUCTIO: The prior enhanced senior deduction must be included in total deductions and respect that return's filing-status limit. Do not enter the additional standard deduction here.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRIOR_FUNDING_TRANSFER_CANNOT_: The prior funding transfer cannot precede the account owner's birth.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRIOR_RETURN_MINIMUM_TAX_CREDI: The prior-return minimum-tax credit needs complete exclusion and rate records and unchanged credit ownership. Missing preferential worksheets, foreign treatment, loss histories and other special adjustments need additional work.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PRIOR_SCHEDULE_D_NET_AMOUNTS_A: The prior Schedule D net amounts and line 21 loss must reconcile.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PROPAGATED_SOURCE_WORKSHEET_MU: The propagated source worksheet must resolve its exclusion tax and ownership before calculating credit use.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_PUBLISHED_FORM_8834_LINE_3B_AN: The published Form 8834 line-3b and Form 8936 predecessor lists do not resolve their combined ordering. Review a return claiming both credits before using either tax limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_RECORDED_CURRENT_CAPITAL_HISTO: The recorded current capital history conflicts with the actual 2025 repayment worksheet's regular or AMT loss balance.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_RETAINED_FORM_4952_DIVIDEND_EL: The retained Form 4952 dividend election exceeds the base-year qualified dividends; reconcile lines 4g and 4e, including any dotted-line allocation.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_RETAINED_NEGATIVE_INCOME_ADJUS: The retained negative-income adjustments exceed the base-year deficit; reconcile the NOL and capital-loss worksheets.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SAME_FIDUCIARY_S_FINAL_YEAR_EX: The same fiduciary's final-year excess deduction cannot contain both state/local income tax and the elected general sales tax. Obtain a corrected source classification.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SECTION_1256_PART_OF_THE_PRIOR: The part of the 2025 carryover from section 1256 contracts cannot be more than the short- and long-term carryovers calculated from that return.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SELECTED_STUDENT_MUST_BE_A_FIL: The selected student must be a filer or an eligible dependent on this return.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SEPARATELY_ENTERED_PRECEDING_Y: The separately entered preceding-year minimum-tax history conflicts with the calculated original worksheet. Omit a duplicate worksheet or reconcile its source facts.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SEP_CONTRIBUTION_EXCEEDS_THE_2: The SEP contribution exceeds the 2026 income-based, plan-rate compensation or $72,000 annual limit; excess correction or carryover needs a separate worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SUPPORTED_FORM_5329_PATH_REQUI: The supported Form 5329 path requires a current personal/employer excess or retained 2025 line 48 with positive line 49, reconciled W-2 wages for employer excess, and the statutory equal division or an actual agreement for shared eligible family months. Monthly limits are divided by 12 and rounded to cents before qualified IRA funding is subtracted.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SUPPORTED_INHERITED_ACCOUNT_UN: The supported inherited-account Uniform Lifetime election requires a sole surviving spouse age 73 or older in 2026 and an original owner who died in 2023 or later, on or after the required beginning date. Reconcile other election histories with the administrator.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_SUPPORTED_OWNER_SPECIFIC_FORM_: The owner-specific Form 5329 Part VI path requires current uncorrected excess or retained positive-tax 2025 excess, reconciled W-2 wages and complete year-end account value.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_TAX_ON_EARLIER_PASSIVE_INCOME_: The tax on earlier passive income has zero current income and belongs to the no-withholding/net-basis-tax group. Current income in that same group needs separate source-year coordination; current passive income in the other withholding groups is calculated independently.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_TOTAL_EXERCISE_SPREAD_EXCEEDS_: The total exercise spread exceeds this prototype's supported amount range.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_TRANSFERRED_AMOUNT_MUST_EQUAL_: The transferred amount must equal the vehicle credit on the accepted seller report; reconcile the dealer report.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_TWO_HISTORICAL_FAMILY_ALLOCATI: The two historical family allocations must use matching spouse coverage, Archer deposits and reciprocal agreed shares.
StringResources.ISSUE_THE_TWO_SOURCE_RECORDS_MUST_IDENTI: The two source records must identify the same 2025 filing status.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_EARLIER_YEAR_INSTALLMENT_SALE: This earlier-year installment sale is not calculated: a related-party sale, a dealer sale, a contingent price, a pledged or disposed note, remaining recapture, collectibles, small business stock, unstated interest, a different AMT gain or suspended passive losses need their own worksheets (Form 6252 lines 3, 4, 25 and Part III; Publication 537).
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_ELECTION_STILL_NEEDS_COORDINA: This election still needs coordination with parent-rate tax or a final return. No installment totals are shown until the applicable worksheet is supported.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_MONTHLY_WORKSHEET_REQUIRES_A_: This monthly worksheet requires a joint return; separate-return exceptions need their additional worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_NARROW_CURRENT_YEAR_PAYMENT_R: This narrow current-year payment route supports one reconciled refund only; combine or separately review other 2026 state-tax refunds before calculating the deduction.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_NARROW_FORM_8978_ROUTE_NEEDS_: This narrow Form 8978 route needs a separate worksheet when the negative adjustment competes with child, other nonrefundable, or AMT foreign-tax credits.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_ORDINARY_PERSONAL_PROPERTY_PA: This ordinary personal-property path requires eligible public charities, good used condition for clothing and household items, reliable valuation and complete substantiation. If clothing, household goods, books or jewelry exceed $5,000 per similar-property group across all recipients before AGI limits, every affected gift needs a qualified appraisal covering it and complete Form 8283 Section B evidence for its donee. Other gifts use Section A when required. An inherited, appreciated, business, pass-through or special property gift needs another worksheet.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_PREPAID_SUPPLY_WORKSHEET_USES: This prepaid-supply worksheet uses cash-method timing. Accrual supply expenses follow their separate recognition records.
StringResources.ISSUE_THIS_SEP_WORKSHEET_REQUIRES_ONE_SE: The owner plan worksheet requires one self-employment business and one self-employed plan for this owner.
StringResources.ISSUE_TIMBER_DISPOSITION_NEEDED: This timber disposition needs its gain, loss and section 1245 expense/amortization recapture calculation. The complete return estimate is unavailable.
StringResources.ISSUE_TIMBER_ORIGINAL_HISTORY_NEEDED: Confirm qualified U.S. commercial timber and complete original elections, unchanged basis/use and actual prior recovery before this cohort can be calculated.
StringResources.ISSUE_TIMELY_RETURNED_PERSONAL_AND_EMPLO: Timely returned personal and employer principal cannot exceed their respective original excess above the Form 8853 deduction or employer limit.
StringResources.ISSUE_TRANSFERRED_PROPERTY_SALE_PRICE: Form 4797: enter this business, farm or rental property's 2026 sale on its own page with {0,number,currency} (the amount realized) as the sale price.
StringResources.ISSUE_TWO_FARMING_SPOUSES_WITH_SEPARATE_: Two farming spouses with separate base-year returns require separate histories and an election allocation. A sole farmer may use differing actual filing statuses.
StringResources.ISSUE_UNCORRECTED_2025_DESIGNATED_EMPLOY: Uncorrected 2025-designated employer excess deposited in 2026 cannot exceed retained 2025 Form 5329 line 40 excess.
StringResources.ISSUE_UNRECOVERED_ANNUITY_COST_MUST_LINK: Unrecovered annuity cost must link to retirement income.
StringResources.ISSUE_UNUSED_BALANCES_ENTERING_RETURN_YE: Unused balances entering 2026 conflict with available 2025 capacity in the same category and tax system. Reconcile older usage before allocating new taxes.
StringResources.ISSUE_USE_CONSISTENT_APPLICABLE_FINANCIA: Use consistent applicable-financial-statement facts for this activity's de minimis purchases.
StringResources.ISSUE_USE_CONSISTENT_BONUS_AND_GDS_METHO: Use consistent bonus and GDS method elections for each recovery class across businesses and nonbusiness rentals.
StringResources.ISSUE_USE_CONSISTENT_FIRST_LOSS_FACTS_FO: Use consistent first-loss facts for overlapping current funding, prior last-month and current last-month testing periods.
StringResources.ISSUE_USE_EITHER_COMPLETE_EXCLUSION_ONLY: Use either complete exclusion-only capital sources or fixed capital adjustments, never both.
StringResources.ISSUE_USE_ONE_ACTIVE_U_S_FOOD_BEVERAGE_O: Use one active U.S. food/beverage or qualifying beauty-service Schedule C employer with complete monthly employee records and matching W-2 box 5 payroll. Beauty service must identify barbering/hair care, nail care, esthetics, or body/spa treatment; other tipped services are unsupported. Confirm customary customer tipping, employer FICA payment, all employee wage-base limits, and the separate 2025 carryback. StringResources.LTC1099_CONTRACT_CHECK_CONFLICT: The retained contract answer conflicts with the printed box 4 check. Correct the actual contract answer.
StringResources.LTC1099_DATE_CERTIFIED_INVALID: Enter the actual calendar date printed in box 5, or select that the date is not reported or unavailable.
StringResources.LTC1099_EXCLUDED_PORTIONS_ABOVE_EMPLOYER: Medical reimbursement and permanent-injury portions cannot exceed the benefit attributable to tax-free employer payments.
StringResources.LTC1099_ILLNESS_UNANSWERED: The accelerated death benefits need the insured person's printed illness status before a complete estimate is available.
StringResources.LTC1099_NO_AMOUNT: Enter the benefits (box 1) or the accelerated death benefits (box 2).
StringResources.LTC1099_ORIGIN_STREAM: Use LTC insurance for box 1 and the actual life-policy advance or viatical settlement for box 2.
StringResources.LTC1099_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The linked annuity or prior-year recovery must be an actual same-owner source covering this receipt. Remove or change its LTC link before deleting or reassigning that source.
StringResources.LTC_FUNDING_HISTORY_INVALID: Use all of the latest available group-policy years, up to three unique years, or the first-year method when none is known; do not use both.
StringResources.LTC_FUNDING_ZERO: The actual employee and employer net premiums must add up to more than zero.
StringResources.LTC_PERIOD_ENDS_BEFORE_START: The last day of care cannot be before the first day.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_BORN_AFTER_DEATH: The participant's date of birth must be before the date of death.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_CAPITAL_GAIN_WITHOUT_BOX_3: The 20% capital gain rate needs a box 3 capital gain above zero. Choose the 10-year tax option alone, or enter box 3.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_DEATH_BENEFIT_AFTER_1996: The death benefit exclusion is only for a participant who died before August 21, 1996. Leave your share at 0.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_ELECTION_TWICE: Enter the Social Security paid for earlier years once for the whole return.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_FIRST_PAYMENT_NOT_IN_2026: The first payment of the lump sum must fall in 2026.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_NUA_WITHOUT_BOX_6: Including the net unrealized appreciation needs a box 6 amount above zero.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_OTHER_TREATMENTS: A lump sum taxed on Form 4972 cannot also use the Simplified Method, box 10, a disability pension, a qualified disaster distribution or public safety officer premiums.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_PRIOR_PAYMENT_NOT_EARLIER: The latest earlier payment must be before 2026. Payments in 2026 belong to this lump sum.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_REFIGURED_ABOVE_BENEFITS: The refigured taxable benefits cannot exceed that year's benefits and earlier lump sums.
StringResources.LUMP_SUM_TAXABLE_ABOVE_BENEFITS: The taxable benefits on the earlier return cannot exceed that year's benefits.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_ADVANCE_ABOVE_PREMIUM: Column C cannot exceed column A for the same month.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_ADVANCE_ON_UNSUBSIDIZED_SHAR: A policy shared without advance credit cannot report an advance credit.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_CALCULATION_INCOME_UNAVAILAB: The required income for the Marketplace and self-employed health insurance calculation cannot be represented in its native amount. No final tax can be reported.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_FAMILY_BENCHMARK_NEEDED: Two of your forms show different column B amounts for the same month. Enter your family's benchmark for that month.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_FAMILY_BENCHMARK_NOT_NEEDED: Enter a family benchmark only for a month in which two forms show different column B amounts.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_GAP_MONTH_NOT_COVERED: A month someone could not take the credit must be a month a Form 1095-A covers.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_ISSUER_TWICE: Enter each Form 1095-A once; add the line 2 policy number to tell two policies from the same issuer apart.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_SHARE_MONTHS_REVERSED: The first month shared cannot be after the last month shared.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_SHARE_OUTSIDE_POLICY: The months shared must be months this Form 1095-A covers.
StringResources.MARKETPLACE_TAXABLE_SOCIAL_ABOVE_GROSS: The taxable part of Social Security benefits (line 6b) cannot exceed the benefits (line 6a).
StringResources.MEDICAL_ADOPTED_CHILD_RELATIONSHIP: The adopted-child medical exception applies to your own adopted child or a child lawfully placed with you for adoption. Review this person's relationship.
StringResources.MEDICAL_DEPOSIT_AFTER_DEADLINE: The actual deposit must be no later than its applicable ordinary contribution deadline.
StringResources.MEDICAL_DEPOSIT_YEAR_INVALID: Use the actual ordinary contribution year accepted by the custodian for this deposit date.
StringResources.MEDICAL_EXPLANATION_UNAVAILABLE: A medical-account worksheet explanation exceeds the display amount range. The known income and tax remain included; retain the original account records.
StringResources.MEDICAL_FAILED_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Add this same owner and destination account type on Health accounts with actual eligibility, compensation and excess facts. The linked failed cash deposit is counted once as an ordinary contribution; keep it out of manual totals.
StringResources.MEDICAL_FAILED_PRIOR_YEAR_DEPOSIT_UNRESO: This failed deposit was designated for a prior year. Reconcile its actual prior-year deduction and any excess carried into2026; the App does not apply2026 contribution limits to that prior year.
StringResources.MEDICAL_FAILED_PROPERTY_DEPOSIT_UNRESOLV: A failed property rollover is not an ordinary cash contribution. Its destination account-qualification treatment is unresolved; the affected complete estimate is unavailable.
StringResources.MEDICAL_PARENT_SUPPORT_FACTS_CONFLICT: The separated-parent medical facts require your child, over-half combined parental support, and no multiple support agreement. Review the relationship and support answers.
StringResources.MEDICAL_REQUIRED_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE: A required medical-account amount exceeds the report's supported amount range. The federal estimate is unavailable; retain the original account and source records.
StringResources.MEDICAL_ROLLOVER_HISTORY_CONFLICT: Use the same actual prior-year successful rollover receipt for this owner and source account type on every statement. Current-year successful history is derived from actual source entries.
StringResources.MEDICAL_ROLLOVER_SAME_DAY_PRIORITY_UNRES: Competing potentially tax-free rollover receipts on the same day need a verified source priority rule. The App does not choose one by statement identity or editor order; the affected complete estimate is unavailable.

StringResources.QA1099_TREATMENT_NEEDED: Answer what this ABLE payment was.
StringResources.QBI_AGGREGATION_ACCEPT_SOURCE_FIRST: Save this new income source with no aggregation group, then reopen it before selecting a group.
StringResources.QBI_AGGREGATION_FACTS: Review this selected QBI aggregation’s eligibility, election history and complete annual business disclosures. The current facts do not establish a supported aggregation, so its estimate cannot be completed.
StringResources.QBI_AGGREGATION_HISTORY: Review the retained QBI election history for these actual businesses. Keep or explicitly correct their history in the aggregation facts; clearing or changing a group name does not end a continuing election or erase unavailable or known IRS history.
StringResources.QBI_AGGREGATION_PARENT_NOT_BUSINESS: Choose only an actual eligible business for this aggregation. Publicly traded partnership items stay separate.
StringResources.QBI_AGGREGATION_SOURCES: Review the aggregation sources and annual disclosures. Choose each actual saved business once and keep the current members and source information.
StringResources.QBI_LOSS_CARRYFORWARD_TWICE: Enter last year's QBI loss carryforward once for the whole return.
StringResources.QBI_WAGE_PART_SOURCE: Check the employee statement labels and amounts. Documented qualified wages cannot exceed either total box 1 wages or total box 5 Medicare wages.
StringResources.QCD_SPLIT_INTEREST_ABOVE_LIMIT: The one-time gifts to a split-interest entity cannot add up to more than $55,000 for one person.
StringResources.QOF_COLLECTIBLES_LONG_TERM: A collectibles gain (special gain code D) is long-term; leave the short-term gain empty.
StringResources.QOF_DEFERRAL_NO_GAIN: Enter the short-term or long-term gain you deferred.
StringResources.QOF_EVENT_NEEDED: Tell us what happened to this opportunity fund investment during the return year.
StringResources.QOF_NO_DEFERRED_GAIN: Enter the short-term or long-term gain still deferred.
StringResources.QOF_SECTION_1231_LONG_TERM: A section 1231 gain (special gain code B) is long-term; leave the short-term gain empty.
StringResources.QOF_SOLD_BEFORE_INVESTED: The date sold must be after the date you invested.
StringResources.QPP_CONTRACT_AFTER_ACQUISITION: The binding purchase contract cannot follow the acquisition date.
StringResources.QPP_DESIGNATION_ABOVE_ELIGIBLE: The designated production-property basis cannot exceed the eligible allocable basis.
StringResources.QPP_ELECTION_NO_DESIGNATION: Enter the positive basis designated by the production-property election.
StringResources.QPP_ELECTION_PRODUCTION_FACTS: A production-property election requires a qualifying production operation, product and substantial transformation.
StringResources.QPP_ELECTION_PROPERTY_FACTS: A production-property election requires domestic nonresidential section 1250 property used directly in the qualifying operation.
StringResources.QPP_ORIGINAL_OR_ACQUISITION_FACTS: Supply the original-use construction facts or the qualifying used-acquisition facts for this production-property election.
StringResources.QPP_RECORD_INVALID: Check this production property's original text, dates, basis and changed-portion records.
StringResources.QSBS_ANSWER_NEEDED: Answer the question about this stock sale to finish its section 1202 treatment.
StringResources.QSBS_LOT_OUTSIDE_SECTION_1202_DATES: Qualified small business stock: each sale needs stock issued from August 11, 1993 through July 4, 2025, sold in 2026 more than five years after it was issued. Stock issued later cannot meet its minimum holding period in 2026.
StringResources.QSBS_LOT_PROCEEDS_NOT_ABOVE_BASIS: Qualified small business stock: the proceeds must be more than the basis. A sale at a loss or break-even is an ordinary Form 1099-B sale on Investment sales, not a section 1202 gain.
StringResources.QSBS_LOT_ZONE_GAIN_OUTSIDE_THE_LOT_GAIN: Qualified small business stock: the gain through 2018 for the empowerment-zone exclusion cannot be negative or more than this lot's gain (proceeds less basis).
StringResources.QSBS_LOT_ZONE_GAIN_OUTSIDE_ZONE_DATES: Qualified small business stock: the empowerment-zone gain applies only to shares acquired December 22, 2000 through February 17, 2009.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_ACTIVE: Did at least 80% of asset value serve a qualified active business throughout substantially all of each holding period? Check issuer records, including subsidiaries, working capital and exceptions. Professional services, finance, investment, farming, mining and hospitality businesses do not qualify. No taxes the whole gain without a section 1202 exclusion.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_HISTORY: Have you confirmed this issuer's complete prior section 1202 history and all current-year sold lots? Include the taxpayer's and both spouses' separate and joint prior returns and every current-year disposition once. No taxes the whole gain without a section 1202 exclusion and adds a notice.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_ISSUER: Was the issuer a qualified domestic C corporation at every issue date, with aggregate assets of the issuer, its predecessors and controlled group no more than $50 million immediately before and after issuance? Check issuer records and statutory contribution valuations. No taxes the whole gain without a section 1202 exclusion.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_PRIOR_GAIN: How much eligible gain was already taken into account under section 1202 for this issuer before 2026? Reconcile prior returns, allocating earlier joint-return eligible gain equally to its spouses. Enter zero only after checking the complete history; do not enter prior proceeds or taxable gain.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_REDEMPTIONS: Have you confirmed there was no disqualifying issuer redemption or other section 1202 exception? Check shareholder and significant-redemption windows around every issuance and any rule or election changing qualification, recognition or character. No taxes the whole gain without a section 1202 exclusion.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_SPECIAL: Did you acquire these shares other than for cash at original issue, or does a gift, inheritance, exchange, pass-through ownership, installment sale, rollover or another special treatment apply? Yes leaves this sale out of the estimate with a notice.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_ZONE: Is the additional 60% empowerment-zone exclusion established for these eligible lots? Check the issuer's retained zone certification and historical valuation. Without those records the increase remains unclaimed with a notice; an explicit No confirms the issuer did not qualify.
StringResources.QSBS_QUESTION_ZONE_GAIN: Enter the gain attributable to time through December 31, 2018 for this sold lot, using its historical valuation or an earlier cessation date and limiting it to this lot's realized gain. Enter gain, rather than proceeds or a second basis. No established valuation leaves the increase unclaimed with a notice.
StringResources.QSS_NEEDS_HOME_COST: Qualifying surviving spouse requires paying more than half the cost of keeping up your home.
StringResources.RECOVERY_DEDUCTED_ABOVE_ITEMIZED: What you deducted for these items cannot be more than that year's total itemized deductions.
StringResources.REFUND_DEDUCTION_NEEDED: Choose how the refunded tax was deducted.
StringResources.REFUND_INCOME_TAX_ABOVE_SALT: Line 5a state income tax cannot exceed line 5d taxes paid.
StringResources.REFUND_PROPERTY_ABOVE_OTHER_TAXES: Real estate and personal property taxes refunded cannot exceed the taxes other than income tax that you deducted that year.
StringResources.REFUND_SALT_DEDUCTED_ABOVE_PAID: Line 5e allowed taxes cannot exceed line 5d taxes paid.
StringResources.REFUND_WITHHOLDING_ABOVE_REFUND: Box 4 cannot exceed box 2 refund, credit or offset.
StringResources.REHABILITATION_NEEDS_AN_IMPROVEMENT_ROW: The rehabilitation credit applies only to an improvement placed in service in 2018 or later.
StringResources.REHABILITATION_NEEDS_A_BUILDING_ROW: The rehabilitation credit belongs on a 39-year building row placed in service in 2018 or later that holds only the qualified rehabilitation expenditures.
StringResources.REHABILITATION_NOT_SUBSTANTIAL: Rehabilitation credit: the qualified rehabilitation expenditures during the measuring period must exceed both $5,000 and the building's adjusted basis at its start; otherwise there is no credit.
StringResources.REHABILITATION_PERIOD_AFTER_PLACED: Rehabilitation credit: the measuring period must begin before the date the building was placed in service.
StringResources.REHABILITATION_PERIOD_NOT_IN_SERVICE_YEA: Rehabilitation credit: the measuring period must end in the year the building was placed in service.
StringResources.RELATED_EXCHANGE_DISPOSED_BEFORE_TRANSFE: The property was disposed of before the exchange ended; check both dates.
StringResources.RENEWABLE_FACILITY_MIXED_CARRYBACK_ATTRI: The post-2022 facility's unused-credit attribution is not established for this mixed-vintage statement. A carryback to 2023 or 2024 needs that source-specific attribution; the recorded facility facts are retained.
StringResources.RENEWABLE_FACILITY_SOURCE_STATEMENT_INVA: Enter each actual renewable-electricity facility identity, its original date when known, and its positive source credit. The component amounts must exactly equal the gross credit, with no duplicate facility reference.
StringResources.RENTAL_1993_RECOVERY_SOURCE_REQUIRED: For commercial property first available from May 13 through December 31, 1993, answer the actual historical contract or construction source. Do not assume a recovery period.
StringResources.RENTAL_1993_TRANSITION_NOT_APPLICABLE: The 1993 transition source applies only to nonresidential property first available from May 13 through December 31, 1993. Clear it for this property type or service date.
StringResources.RENTAL_1993_TRANSITION_SOURCE_DATE: Enter the actual binding-contract or construction-commencement date before May 13, 1993.
StringResources.RENTAL_1993_TRANSITION_SOURCE_REFERENCE: Enter a reference identifying the actual contract, construction or qualifying transfer record.
StringResources.RENTAL_ASSET_NO_SECTION_179: A rental asset cannot claim a section 179 deduction in this estimate.
StringResources.RENTAL_BUILDING_SALE_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE: The sold rental's mixed-use building needs its actual business basis and regular/AMT business depreciation through the sale date.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_AMOUNT: Casualty property values, basis, depreciation, reimbursements and replacement costs cannot be negative.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_BASIS_HISTORY_UNAVAILABL: This rental casualty needs actual event-date basis and depreciation history. Current personal-use days and sale-date records cannot establish that history.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_CONTINUATION_UNAVAILABLE: This surviving rental property needs its dated adjusted-basis depreciation schedule after the casualty. Its original cost and credit records cannot substitute for that schedule.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_CREDIT_UNAVAILABLE: This property's tax credit needs its coordinated casualty, credit, recapture and basis worksheets before the complete result is available.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_DATE: Enter a valid date. The casualty or theft-discovery date cannot be later than the year after this return.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_DECLARATION: Use the actual declaration reference; choose the major-disaster option only for a presidential DR- declaration.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_DEDUCTION_CONTEXT_UNAVAI: This home casualty needs the return's actual deduction choice before its allowed loss can be calculated.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_DEPRECIATION_RECORDS: Prior-year depreciation cannot exceed depreciation through the event. The event-date adjusted basis plus that depreciation cannot exceed the original depreciable basis.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_DISPOSITION_UNAVAILABLE: This property has both a casualty and another disposition. Reconcile their actual dates, remaining basis and depreciation before estimating.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_ELECTION_DECLARATION: A next-year disaster elected onto this return requires a federal disaster declaration.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_EVENT_REQUIRED: Name the casualty or theft event.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_EVENT_WITHOUT_CASUALTY: Enter this property's casualty or theft records, or clear its saved event.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_EVENT_YEAR_UNAVAILABLE: This earlier insurance-resolution event or next-year disaster election needs its actual event-year basis and election worksheet. Those results remain unavailable.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_GAIN_UNAVAILABLE: This rental casualty gain needs the return's Section B gain netting, depreciation recapture and final tax-character worksheets.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_HOLDING_PERIOD_UNAVAILAB: This casualty needs the actual acquisition holding-period records for the converted or gifted property.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_HOME_ALLOWANCE_UNAVAILAB: This home casualty needs its shared personal-casualty allowance worksheet, including the actual deduction choice, qualified-disaster increase and any personal casualty gains. Its source loss and basis records remain available.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_NONRECURRING_UNAVAILABLE: This exceptional casualty loss needs its separate passive-activity exclusion and coordinated at-risk worksheet. It cannot be treated as a recurring rental loss.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE: The casualty records do not establish a representable property loss, gain or remaining basis.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_PERSONAL_ALLOWANCE_UNAVA: The personal casualty records need their shared allowance worksheet before this rental's casualty loss is available. Resolve any personal casualty gains, qualified-disaster loss or property allocation on Other itemized deductions.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_PROPERTY_BINDING_UNAVAIL: On Rentals, link each damaged building or improvement to its saved whole-dwelling casualty property. The linked costs must represent distinct parts of that dwelling, with consistent use and actual basis, value and reimbursement records. A property cannot be assigned to competing dwellings or business-home uses.
StringResources.RENTAL_CASUALTY_SALVAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This destroyed property source does not establish its actual remaining salvage value. Its casualty loss remains unavailable.
StringResources.RENTAL_CREDIT_REDUCTION_ABOVE_BASIS: The credit basis reduction cannot exceed the building or improvement cost less land.
StringResources.RENTAL_DAYS_ABOVE_365: Fair rental days plus personal-use days cannot exceed 365.
StringResources.RENTAL_ENERGY_BUILDING_ASSOCIATION: The energy claim needs its actual saved physical building and cost-row identities. Correct the source selection in Rentals.
StringResources.RENTAL_ENERGY_BUILDING_RECORDS: Review the physical building designation, positive conditioned area and documented ownership fraction.
StringResources.RENTAL_ENERGY_CERTIFICATION_RECORDS: Review the actual certification, license, reference standard, savings and increased-amount records.
StringResources.RENTAL_ENERGY_CLAIM_RECORDS: Select this rental's actual physical building and reconcile the unique project cost, construction and installation dates with its cost row.
StringResources.RENTAL_ENERGY_HISTORY_RECORDS: Enter each documentary year once, identifying all relevant claimants and its actual nonnegative deduction or absence.
StringResources.RENTAL_EXCHANGED_BEFORE_IN_SERVICE: The date you gave up the rental must be after the date it was first available to rent.
StringResources.RENTAL_EXPENSE_AMOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: A required rental or royalty expense output cannot be represented in its native amount. No final tax can be reported.
StringResources.RENTAL_FOREIGN_ASSET_ADS_UNAVAILABLE: The foreign rental's incidental assets need their actual ADS class lives and original no-bonus recovery records.
StringResources.RENTAL_FOREIGN_COUNTRY_INVALID: Use the actual IRS two-letter foreign country code for this property's location.
StringResources.RENTAL_FOREIGN_POSSESSION_UNAVAILABLE: This rental needs its actual U.S.-possession income and recovery records before its territorial tax treatment is available.
StringResources.RENTAL_FOREIGN_RECOVERY_HISTORY_UNAVAILA: This foreign rental needs its actual original ADS election, change-of-use or disposition history before its depreciation can be calculated.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_AGI_UNRESOLVED: The home-use worksheet and final AGI did not stabilize. No final tax can be reported.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_CARRIES_NEEDED: Enter the carries from last year's home-use worksheet for this rental.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_PRIOR_CARRY_RECORDS: The casualty carry must be nonnegative and cannot exceed its corresponding combined carry.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_PRIOR_CASUALTY_ACTIVITY_UNAV: This former home needs its original casualty activity character before the prior casualty carry can be deducted.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_PRIOR_CASUALTY_QBI_UNAVAILAB: The prior casualty carry needs its original qualified-business-income history before its QBI treatment is available.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_PRIOR_CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE: Supply the casualty character of the prior home-use carry before separated deductions are available.
StringResources.RENTAL_HOME_PRIOR_TOTAL_UNAVAILABLE: Supply the independently tracked prior home-use worksheet carry for this tax system.
StringResources.RENTAL_INTEREST_ELECTION_ADS_HISTORY_UNA: This elected rental building needs its actual ADS recovery and conversion history before its depreciation, basis or sale can be computed.
StringResources.RENTAL_LAND_ABOVE_COST: The land part cannot exceed the cost.
StringResources.RENTAL_LAND_PRICE_ABOVE_PRICE: The part of the sale price for the land cannot exceed the sale price.
StringResources.RENTAL_MIXED_COMPONENT_HISTORY_UNAVAILAB: A separately disposed component of a mixed-use rental needs its own business basis, regular/AMT depreciation and personal-sale allocation. Whole-building sale records do not establish these component amounts.
StringResources.RENTAL_MORTGAGE_ROOT_TWICE: A saved mortgage loan can belong to only one whole-property rental. Split-property loan allocations are not supported; correct the loan selections in Rentals.
StringResources.RENTAL_MORTGAGE_SINGLE_SOURCE: For personal-use property, save the whole-property ownership share on Mortgage and select its original loans in Rentals. Leave Rental mortgage interest zero; do not enter those points or mortgage insurance again. Links require personal-use days.
StringResources.RENTAL_OVERLAP_DAYS_ABOVE_RENTAL_DAYS: Rented days that were also personal-use days cannot exceed the days rented at a fair price.
StringResources.RENTAL_PROFESSIONAL_NEEDS_STATUS: Record your real estate professional status on About you (your spouse's on About your spouse) before choosing it for a rental.
StringResources.RENTAL_PROPERTY_CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE: Resolve the sold rental's section 1231 character before completing its qualified business income.
StringResources.RENTAL_PROPERTY_QBI_ACTIVITY_UNAVAILABLE: Resolve the sold rental's single qualified activity before adding its ordinary property income.
StringResources.RENTAL_SALE_PERSONAL_SHARE_NEEDED: Enter the personal-use share of a property you also used.
StringResources.RENTAL_SECTION179_BUSINESS_NEEDED: Answer whether you actively conduct this rental as a trade or business.
StringResources.RENTAL_SOLD_BEFORE_IN_SERVICE: The date sold must be after the date the building and each improvement were first available to rent.
StringResources.RENTAL_STATEMENT_DATE_DIFFERS: The Form 1099-S box 1 date of closing must equal the date sold or the date you gave up this rental.
StringResources.RENTAL_STATEMENT_PROCEEDS_DIFFER: The Form 1099-S box 2a total gross proceeds must equal the sale price.
StringResources.RESEARCH_PROPERTY_SOURCE_INVALID: Select an actual saved property of this business. Keep its disposition on that property once, and update or remove this link before deleting or moving the property.
StringResources.RESERVIST_DISTRIBUTION_OUTSIDE_DUTY: The distribution date must fall from the day you were ordered to active duty through the last day of the active-duty period.
StringResources.RESERVIST_DISTRIBUTION_TWICE: Enter each original reservist distribution once, with all its 2026 repayments.
StringResources.RESERVIST_REPAYMENT_ABOVE_GROSS: Repayments of a reservist distribution cannot add to more than the distribution.
StringResources.RESERVIST_REPAYMENT_LATE: A reservist repayment must follow the end of the active-duty period and fall within two years after it.
StringResources.RESERVIST_VEHICLE_STANDARD_MILEAGE: A reservist's vehicle is deducted at the standard mileage rate; choose Standard mileage rate.
StringResources.RESIDENCE_ANSWER_NOT_ALLOWED: On the final return of a person who died, a person's time in your home is counted in days through the date of death; on any other return it is counted in months.
StringResources.RESIDENCE_DAYS_ABOVE_DAYS_ALIVE: A person can't have lived in your home for more days than you were alive in 2026.
StringResources.RETAINED_CHARITY_ENTITY_RECORDS: Enter the other entity's actual name and employer identification number from the retained gift records.
StringResources.RETAINED_CHARITY_SOURCE_APPRECIATION_ABO: Activity appreciation must be nonnegative and cannot exceed the retained gift's total original appreciation.
StringResources.RETAINED_CHARITY_SOURCE_APPRECIATION_NEE: Enter each activity's actual original appreciation, including zero, for this basis election.
StringResources.RETAINED_RESEARCH_PARTS_ABOVE_BALANCE: The identified business portions must be positive and cannot exceed this retained balance.
StringResources.RETAINED_RESEARCH_SOURCE_TWICE: Enter each originating business only once for this retained balance.
StringResources.RETAINED_RESEARCH_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Select an actual eligible business on this return for each retained source portion.

StringResources.RETURN_1040_1I: 1040 1i — Nontaxable combat pay elected for the earned income credit
StringResources.RETURN_1040_24A: 1040 24a — Total tax before the first farmland installment
StringResources.RETURN_1040_32C: 1040 32c — Payments and refundable credits after Schedule 3-A
StringResources.RETURN_1040_35A: 1040 35a — Refund after the estimated tax penalty
StringResources.RETURN_1040_37_2: 1040 37 — Amount you owe including the estimated tax penalty

StringResources.REVIEW_CARE_COSTS: Care costs for {0,plural,one {# person} other {# people}}
StringResources.REVIEW_CONTINUE_FROM: Continue the interview on {0} to calculate the federal estimate.
StringResources.REVIEW_HSA_ACCOUNT_NEEDED: Employer HSA contributions or a linked failed cash deposit need this owner’s matching health-account facts
StringResources.REVIEW_MOVING_EXPENSES_NEEDED: A W-2 shows government moving reimbursements (box 12 code P); enter that move on More adjustments so the reimbursement is compared with your moving expenses.
StringResources.REVIEW_PAYER_NAMES_NEEDED: Payer names are needed on Schedule B above $1,500
StringResources.RISK_METHOD_INVALID: Complete valid regular and AMT risk-method facts for this activity.
StringResources.RISK_RECAPTURE_DETAILED_REQUIRED: Supply the detailed at-risk balance before calculating recapture from a negative simplified worksheet.
StringResources.RISK_RECAPTURE_HISTORY_REQUIRED: Supply the prior deducted losses and recapture history needed for this negative closing at-risk balance.
StringResources.ROTH_CONVERSION_BEFORE_FIRST_YEAR: A conversion year cannot be before your first Roth IRA year.
StringResources.ROTH_CONVERSION_YEAR_TWICE: Enter each conversion year once; add together what you converted that year.
StringResources.ROTH_DISABLED_AFTER_DISTRIBUTION: The date you became disabled cannot be after the distribution.
StringResources.ROTH_HISTORY_TWICE: Enter the Roth IRA history only once for each owner.
StringResources.ROTH_ROLLOVER_ONCE_A_YEAR: Only one rollover from an IRA to an IRA is tax-free in any 12 months across all of a person's IRAs, Roth IRAs included. Move the other by a direct transfer between trustees, or keep it.
StringResources.ROW_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_EIC_OFFSET: {0} {1} — Earned income credit and excess Social Security tax
StringResources.ROW_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_OTHER_PAYROL: {0} {1} — Other payroll taxes and the half self-employment deduction
StringResources.ROW_ADDITIONAL_CHILD_CREDIT_WITHHELD_TAX: {0} {1} — Social Security and Medicare tax withheld
StringResources.ROW_CARE_EARNED_SPOUSE: {0} {1} — Spouse’s earned income, or yours again
StringResources.ROW_CARE_EXPENSES_ALLOWED: {0} {1} — Qualified expenses, up to the limit
StringResources.ROW_CHILD_CREDIT_CHILDREN: {0} {1} — Qualifying children under 17 with the required SSN
StringResources.ROW_CHILD_CREDIT_CHILDREN_AMOUNT: {0} {1} — Child tax credit before the phase-out
StringResources.ROW_CHILD_CREDIT_OTHER_DEPENDENTS_AMOUNT: {0} {1} — Credit for other dependents before the phase-out
StringResources.ROYALTY_ADVANCE_WITHIN_RECEIPTS: Lease bonuses and advance royalties cannot exceed the total royalties, including linked Forms 1099-MISC.
StringResources.ROYALTY_INTANGIBLE_NO_DEPLETION: A copyright, patent or other intangible royalty does not take depletion.
StringResources.ROYALTY_UNITS_SOLD_WITHIN_RECOVERABLE: Units sold cannot exceed the recoverable units at the start of the year.
StringResources.RRB_ANNUITANT_BIRTH_NEEDED: Your age at the annuity starting date comes from your date of birth, which is missing or later than that date. Correct it on the About you page, or choose the entered age.
StringResources.RRB_BOX7_NOT_SUM: Box 7 should equal boxes 4, 5 and 6 added together. Check the form.
StringResources.RRB_BOX_8_NOT_SPLIT: Enter box 8 by the year the benefits were paid.
StringResources.RRB_EARLIER_YEARS_DIFFER: The attached earlier-year amounts must total RRB-1099 box 9.
StringResources.RRB_EARLIER_YEAR_ALLOCATION_NEEDED: RRB-1099 box 9 combines earlier years without a year-by-year breakdown. The estimate uses the regular method until actual year details are available; no earlier year is inferred.
StringResources.RRB_EARLIER_YEAR_NEEDED: The attached box 9 breakdown must name a year before the years in boxes 7 and 8.
StringResources.RRB_RECIPIENT_NEEDED: Choose whose railroad annuity this is.
StringResources.RRB_RECOVERY_COST_NEEDED: Box 3 is blank on this statement, or the annuity started before 2026. Enter the employee-contribution cost for this recovery worksheet, or answer No to recovering the box 3 contributions.
StringResources.RRB_REPAYMENTS_NOT_BOX_8: The repayments by year should add up to box 8.
StringResources.RRB_REPAYMENTS_WITHOUT_BOX_8: Leave the repayments empty when box 8 is zero.
StringResources.RRB_SOURCE_NONNEGATIVE: Enter a nonnegative amount for this railroad statement box.
StringResources.RRB_STATEMENT_YEAR: Enter the RRB-1099 for this return’s tax year.
StringResources.R_ANNUITANT_BIRTH_NEEDED: Your age at the annuity starting date comes from your date of birth, which is missing or later than that date. Correct it on the About you page, or choose the entered age.
StringResources.R_BOX10_ABOVE_GROSS: Box 10 cannot exceed box 1 gross distribution.
StringResources.R_BOX10_BASIS_ABOVE_BOX10: The part of box 10 not taxable when rolled in cannot exceed box 10.
StringResources.R_BOX10_BASIS_WITHOUT_BOX10: The part of box 10 not taxable when rolled in belongs only to a code B distribution with a box 10 amount.
StringResources.R_BOX10_WITHOUT_B: Box 10 is for a designated Roth account distribution (code B). Leave it empty with other codes.
StringResources.R_BOX2B_METHOD: Choose a method that fits the box 7a codes and box 7b; box 2a as printed always fits.
StringResources.R_BOX3_ABOVE_TAXABLE: Box 3 capital gain cannot exceed box 2a taxable amount.
StringResources.R_BOX7B_NEEDED: Codes K, S and Y are for a traditional or SIMPLE IRA, so box 7b IRA/SEP/SIMPLE is checked with them. Check the form.
StringResources.R_BOX7B_NOT_IRA: Box 7b IRA/SEP/SIMPLE is never checked with code 6, 9, B, C, D, F, H, L, M, N, R, U or W: an IRA has no such contract, loan, designated Roth account or recharacterization code. Check the form.
StringResources.R_BOX7_CODES_NOT_COMBINED: These box 7a codes are never printed together on one 1099-R, and code Y is always printed with 4, 7 or K. Check the codes printed on the form.
StringResources.R_BOX7_EXCHANGE_TAXABLE: A section 1035 exchange (code 6), long-term care charges (W), a recharacterization (N) or an earlier year's amount (P, R) show nothing taxable in box 2a. A taxable part comes on its own Form 1099-R with another code.
StringResources.R_BOX7_H_TAXABLE: A direct rollover of a designated Roth account to a Roth IRA (code H) shows nothing taxable in box 2a. Check the form, or use code G.
StringResources.R_BOX7_H_TO_ROTH: Code H is a direct rollover to a Roth IRA or designated Roth account. Choose that destination.
StringResources.R_BOX7_NO_CODE: Enter the code printed in box 7a.
StringResources.R_BOX7_TOO_MANY_CODES: Box 7a shows at most two codes; enter only the codes printed there.
StringResources.R_BOX7_TREATMENT: Choose what the box 7a codes mean: 7 normal, 1 or 2 early, 3 disability, 4 death (box 7b unchecked), 4 with box 7b an inherited IRA, 4 or G with box 7c a Trump account, G or H direct rollover, S SIMPLE IRA, Q, J or T Roth IRA, 6 or W exchange or long-term care charges, 8 corrective distribution, N, P or R not 2026 income, 9, E, F or U taxable as printed, 5 prohibited transaction (box 7b checked), A the 10-year tax option; B, D, K, L, M and Y follow the code printed with them, and D alone is a nonqualified annuity. For any other code, Another code.
StringResources.R_BOX8B_WITHOUT_BOX8A: Box 8b needs the box 8a annuity contract value.
StringResources.R_CARE_CHARGE_SOURCE_INVALID: For a qualified long-term-care cash-value charge use the actual code W (alone or with 6), box 2a zero, no IRA/Trump checkbox or other taxable treatment, and the reported box 8a investment reduction no greater than gross. Keep other retirement boxes and premium deductions separate.
StringResources.R_CONVERSION_ABOVE_GROSS: The amount converted cannot be more than box 1.

StringResources.TAX_NAVIGATION_PROMPT: Income without a form, undocumented income, income with no tax form, cash income, side jobs, gig or app work, tips not reported to an employer, jury duty pay, a prize or hobby income belong to Income without a form when the person wants to add income no form shows. Existing business receipts and expenses stay on Self-employment; actual employer, monthly and payroll facts for unreported tips stay on Wages. Software depreciation, units of production, ACRS, pre-MACRS property and income forecast belong to the actual asset record under Self-employment, Farming, Rental property or Employee expenses. Form 4562 follows that activity. Find the offered tax page matching the person's request across all available sections, even when another section is currently open. Match the selected destination's documented scope, form numbers, Internal Revenue Code references and common names. Prefer the page where the person can enter or correct the requested facts over a generic overview, checklist, review or merely related page. A word mentioned to distinguish another destination does not make this page a match. For every offered page, recognize both prefixed and bare identifiers case-insensitively: Form 1098 or 1098, Form 1099-R or 1099-r, and Section 199A or 199a. Rank an exact documented identifier match ahead of broad topic matches; distinguish form suffixes such as 1098-T, 1098-E, 1098-C, 1098-VLI and 1099-QA rather than treating them as the base form. For an ambiguous subject return suitable alternatives; return no match if no offered destination fits. For Section 199A, 199a, Form 8995, 8995, Form 8995-A, 8995-A, qualified business income, QBI and QBI deduction, rank the offered Self-employment page first, unless the query names rental property, Schedule E, a partnership, S corporation or K-1: then rank that page first. A plain vehicle, car or auto query ranks Deductions first (personal car loan interest); a specific vehicle intent takes priority. An electric car's clean vehicle credit belongs to More credits, a car used for work to Self-employment, Farming or Rental property, donated clothes, goods or a car to Gifts of property and carryovers, car purchase sales tax and vehicle registration tax to Taxes you paid. Selling your house belongs to Investment sales, but a business asset, vehicle or rental sold, scrapped or condemned belongs to its own record under Self-employment, Rental property or Employee expenses. Digital assets received as pay belong to Other income, their sale to Investment sales. Incentive stock options belong to Investment sales, other alternative minimum tax items (Form 6251) to Other taxes. Form 8824 or a 1031 exchange without another qualifier belongs to Rental property. Rental income on a Schedule K-1, K-1 royalties and selling a partnership interest or S corporation shares belong to Partnerships, S corporations, estates and trusts; royalties you receive directly, to Rental property. Forms 1099-NEC and 1099-K belong to Self-employment unless you were the payer's employee (Wages, Form 8919). The S corporation that paid a W-2 is selected on Wages. Leased vehicles and Schedule C returns belong to Self-employment; solo 401(k), profit-sharing and defined-benefit plans to Self-employed health insurance and retirement plan. Investment credit (Form 3468), Form 4255 and recapture follow the property's page; solar panels, batteries or heat pumps at your home are a Form 5695 carryover on More credits. A K-1 credit statement belongs to Partnerships, S corporations, estates and trusts, K-1 and Schedule K-3 foreign taxes likewise; credits on their own source form, Form 1097-BTC and your own foreign tax credit to More credits. Form 3115 follows the activity: Self-employment first, Farming for farm or Schedule F, Rental property for rental or Schedule E; crop-share rent is Farming, not Rental property. TIPS interest, nominee components, savings-bond interest already reported, seller-financed mortgage interest and FBAR countries belong to Interest and dividends; a TIPS loss, bond-premium deductions and GST tax to Investment interest and other deductions. A child's income on the parent's return (Form 8814) belongs to Interest and dividends, Form 8615 to Your parent's return. Tuition and Form 1098-T belong to Education credits, 529 and Coverdell withdrawals (Form 1099-Q) to Prizes, scholarships, relief payments, account payouts and other income. A Roth conversion belongs to Retirement and Social Security for the Form 1099-R and to IRA contributions for the nondeductible part (Form 8606). A nanny, babysitter or daycare belongs to Child and dependent care for the care credit and to Other taxes for the household employer's Schedule H. A death in 2026 belongs to About you or About your spouse, a child who died to Children and people you support. Community property and spouses living apart belong to Your 2026 return; a registered domestic partner and a dual-status or part-year return to About you; innocent spouse relief, injured spouse allocation and the choice to treat a nonresident spouse as a resident to About your spouse.

List.Name: tax_interview
List.Description: Prepares a 2026 U.S. federal income tax return estimate. Import your tax documents with AI, answer only the questions your documents and situation raise, and see your estimated tax, payments and balance due or refund. One saved return per user; resume where you left off. Alpha version.

Claim sources: https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i4136 (line 13), https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f4136--dft.pdf (2026 rates), and https://www.irs.gov/irb/2005-46_IRB#NOT-2005-80 (buyer/vendor consent and Model Certificate R). Retained-tax income is an inference from the reconciled economics, not the IRS tax-benefit recovery rule: section 61 includes business gains (https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/26/61), and Schedule C line 6 includes federal fuel credits and retained buyer-collected tax (https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i1040sc). An accrual issuer's fixed 2026 right follows the all-events rule, while a cash issuer recognizes the separate benefit when actually or constructively received or applied as a credit (https://www.irs.gov/publications/p334). Publication 510's filing-year rule expressly covers deducted-tax recoveries; it does not independently establish timing for this no-deduction route (https://www.irs.gov/publications/p510). A Secretary-catastrophe basis needs an actual Treasury or IRS determination. A common-carrier payment must come from the named transportation carrier because the disaster caused death or personal physical injury; an accident involving that carrier can itself be the qualifying disaster. A nonfederal government-assistance basis requires an applicable authority's determination and a government welfare payment; it cannot support a private expense reimbursement. The payment is not wage or business-income replacement or compensation for services. A government-welfare payment came from a federal, state or local government or its agency and served individual or family needs. Do not enter this amount elsewhere as taxable income or claim a deduction or credit for a compensated expense; account for any property-loss reimbursement separately. Types.Description: Publication 525, Nonitemized Deduction Recoveries, excludes a prior deduction without an income-tax benefit. Treasury regulation 26 CFR 1.111-1(b)(2) measures that benefit by comparing taxable income with and without the recovered item; the retained refigure includes related half-SE and QBI changes. Original 2025 Form 1040 line 15 was zero, so the refigured positive taxable income is the tax-benefiting portion of this single item. List.Name: Cost recovered tax-free before 2026

List.Name: Fixed-payment General Rule pension or annuity with complete, unchanged records
List.Description: A qualified-plan pension must either have started before November 19, 1996 using the General Rule, or meet the age-75 and five-year guarantee rules using the entered original age and guaranteed installments. Prior payments must consistently use the General Rule, without an irrevocable Simplified Method election. Not variable, foreign, charitable or exchanged; inherited contracts are excluded except the designated survivor of the entered joint-life contract. For lifetime or temporary-life contracts, Tables V through VIII apply to the entire cost: contributions after June 30, 1986, or a documented election to use these tables. No allocation to older sex-specific tables. No refund feature except the entered single-life guaranteed installments, payment changes other than the entered cost-of-living increases, changed basis, surrender, loan, simultaneous shared-recipient allocation or unentered adjustment. All this contract's 2026 payments are entered once; prior recovery used the General Rule. Starting dates before July 2, 1986 still need separate treatment. For July–December 1986 starts, prior tax-free recovery can exceed original cost; the periodic exclusion continues without a lifetime cost cap. No recovers no cost: the whole payment is taxed, with a notice.

Types.Name: HsaCoverage
Types.DisplayName: HSA contribution eligibility on the first day of the month
Types.Description: You must have qualifying coverage, no disqualifying other coverage and no Medicare enrollment, including retroactive enrollment. People separately establishes whether someone can claim you as a dependent. Qualifying coverage includes ordinary HDHPs and eligible individual-market bronze or catastrophic plans: an Exchange plan, the same plan sold off-Exchange (including an otherwise identical plan without cost-sharing loading), or the Notice 2026-5 off-Exchange safe harbor when you have no reason to believe it is unavailable on an Exchange. SHOP bronze coverage must satisfy the ordinary HDHP rules. The recent-IHS-service restriction does not apply to the qualifying American Indian/Alaska Native bronze variant described in Notice 2026-5. An HRA that pays only premiums does not by itself disqualify you; other reimbursements can. Telehealth before the deductible does not by itself disqualify an otherwise eligible HDHP; connected in-person services, equipment and drugs do not automatically receive that exception. A qualifying direct-primary-care arrangement also does not disqualify you when all its fixed periodic fees, annualized by month, total at most $150 for one person or $300 for an arrangement covering more than one person. It must provide solely qualifying primary care by a family/internal/geriatric/pediatric physician, nurse practitioner, clinical nurse specialist or physician assistant, with no separate charge for care within the arrangement. General anesthesia, non-vaccine prescription drugs and laboratory services outside an ordinary ambulatory primary-care setting disqualify that arrangement; merely declining those services does not cure its terms. Separate services available to members and nonmembers outside the arrangement are permitted.

Enum.Description: You or your spouse made management decisions in a significant and bona fide sense, such as approving tenants, setting rents or approving repairs, and together owned at least 10% of the activity all year.
